He was not just anyone. He was the one of the noble relation there. अरे, he who had become the true Ka'bah, he was that one. The Prophet was giving it to him. For this very reason, the Prophet, with great honor and respect, mentioned Amir al-Mominin. And one time, in excitement, he started to say, "Ali, in your praise I would say all things, but what can I do? The world... concerning 'Uzayr and 'Isa, they declared them sons of God. Concerning you too, what they will think, I don't know." But "For me too, there are not those things, Ali, that are for you." Now the people were perplexed, "O Messenger of Allah, what do you wish to say?" You were silent. For five minutes you were silent. Now the people were astonished, "What does he want to say? Ali has that which I do not have." Now the people were astonished, "What is this mystery that the Prophet wants to convey?" And the Prophet, *'alayhi al-salatu wa'l-salam*, was silent. He was silent for a while, he tested them with his silence, and after taking the test, he said... *kallimu al-nasa 'ala qadri 'uqulihim* ("Speak to people according to their level of intellect"). "You have to speak to people according to their intellect." Now he saw that the audience is what it is. They always demand miracles. "Sometimes bring down angels, sometimes split the moon, sometimes make the wind blow, sometimes reverse the sun." Now these people, these ignorant Arabs, these Bedouin Arabs, they don't believe without miracles. So now what should I do with them? So in this way, the Prophet, *'alayhi al-salatu wa'l-salam*, what did he do? He... finished the matter by explaining it away. So, in any case, what I was saying was that the Prophet, *'alayhi al-salatu wa'l-salam*, concerning Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib, you said three such things after that. And you said that "Ali... I did not get such a father-in-law as Ali got. I did not get such a bride, such a wife, as Ali got. And children like Hasan and Husayn, Ali got, I did not get." So, the Prophet said this thing, but that thing which the Prophet had finished, that was something else. This thing, you said it to make the people understand. And that thing was also correct in its own place. This thing is also correct in its own place. But the Prophet wanted to explain something else. And he wanted to show something else. But surely the Prophet, my Prophet, *'alayhi al-salatu wa'l-salam*, surely would have told. Those who sat on the mat, who bowed their heads before you, he must have told them. But he doesn't tell every single person. So, in any case, this state continued. And you saw that when all the Imams, the pure Imams, all of those Imams... Now you will say, you will have questions arising in your mind, "Fatimah al-Zahra came here in the form of a woman, in what form was she there?" For now, these forms, these things, the coming, the going, all these things, do not reflect on them for now. Because when I talk about the physical world, I will form this world, and after that, those things will be discussed. For now, what you have to reflect on is that all the noble Imams were there, and their center was who? Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib. For this very reason, he became *Abul-A'imma* (Father of the Imams). From here, the chain began, and *Imamat* remained in your progeny. But you were not an Imam yourself. আরে brother, a person who has done his M.A., to call him a matriculate or a B.A. is an insult to him. You should give him the station he has, the degree he has brought, the capabilities he has created, remember him by that, that is much better. So you, Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib... the Prophet is saying, "*al-Hasan wa'l-Husayn, qama aw qa'ada, wa abuhuma khayrun minhuma*" ("Hasan and Husayn, whether they rise or sit, and their father is better than them"). "Hasan and Husayn are both true Imams, whether they rise for their right or they relinquish their right. But their father is better than them." So the Prophet, *'alayhi al-salatu wa'l-salam*, is saying such a thing. If he only had to state the *Imamat* of Hazrat Ali, he would have said, "Ali, Hasan, Husayn, all three are true Imams." The matter would have ended. To say just this much, would the Prophet speak like this, "Hasan and Husayn are both true Imams, whether they rise or don't rise, and their father is better than them"? Saying "their father is better than them" was indicating this, that he is not an Imam, but he is greater than an Imam, he is *Abul-A'imma*. This is what he was showing, that that goodness, that خیر-pan (quality of being the best), that is what the Prophet was showing, that Ali was greater than them.

So, you are at the rank of *Wasayat*. And *Wasayat*, this is not an ordinary *Wasayat*. Apparently, just as Adam's *Wasi* was Seth, Nuh's *Wasi* was Sam, Ibrahim's *Wasi* was Isma'il, and Musa's *Wasi* was Harun, 'Isa's was Sham'un. So... Janab Yusha. So Janab... all these, as many of the *Nutuqa* as had *Awsiya*, আরে not only this, as many *Anbiya* as there were, all appointed their *Wasi*. No prophet passed without appointing his *Wasi*. So if there was a master (*sardar*) of all the *Awsiya*, who was it? *Abul-A'imma*. That was Amir al-Mominin, Hazrat Ali. Now, the one whom you are calling *Abul-A'imma*, Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib, he is *Sayyid al-Wasiyyin* (Master of the Vicegerents). আরে, the matter of *Abul-A'imma* is greater than *Sayyid al-Wasiyyin*. So will you call him *Sayyid al-Wasiyyin*? So, to understand this, as far as explaining is concerned, there you can call him *Sayyid al-Wasiyyin*. আরে, where is *Sayyid al-Wasiyyin*? He has become *Abul-A'imma*. আরে, I don't even feel like saying *Abul-A'imma*. I feel like... the ranks that I counted out for you, I should establish him on those lofty ranks and show you what *Ahadiyyat* and *Samadiyyat* are like.

So, in any case, these were the states of Ali, because of which he is *Badr al-'aja'ib wa'l-ghara'ib*. Look through all of history, you will see that no one in history has been called *Mazhar al-'aja'ib wa'l-ghara'ib* (the Manifestor of Wonders and Marvels), that is, the one who manifests strange things. That has been said for Mawla-e-Ka'inat, Amir al-Mominin. That you... when you used to walk, what used to happen? The trees would also prostrate, the stones would also prostrate, and when animals came, they would speak, they would greet. This state was also there for Janab Amir al-Mominin. All these things were there. And all these things, the whole world was watching. Now you will say, "The historians there, the residents of Quraysh, they were seeing all these things. Then why did they deny? Why did they insult the Mawla so much? For the sake of the caliphate, why did they divide it like that? They should not have done it." What is happening today? Today, have you accepted the noble *Da'wat*? What are you doing? Have you accepted the noble *Da'wat* with your heart and soul? "Yes, brother, we have absolutely accepted it." No. Accepting and accepting are very different things. Accepting is what is called... when the obedience is also of the same kind. Believing also will be in such a way that there is obedience. For this very reason, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq was asked, "*Hal al-din?*" "O Imam, what is religion?" He said, "*Illa al-ta'ah*" (except obedience). "Religion is nothing but obedience." So it became known that the more obedience increases, the more the religion will increase. Whatever our religion is, that will be our faith. Because of faith, our ranks will be high, and we will be successful in the hereafter.

Although we too had an opportunity, but we also made a mistake there. We also made a mistake there, and we were not ready to accept. Had we accepted, we would have been counted among the *taaboot-e taabooti*. Had we accepted, we would have been counted among the *labb-u nida*. If we had accepted, we would have entered into the *kal-lamam*. So now we were not counted among any of them. And where did we remain? We remained included in that same disobedient group. For now, we are included. Now, since the command had come to him, the divine command, which was coming from God, the Lord of the Worlds (*Rabb-ul-‘aalameen*). And who is the Lord of the Worlds? The First Intellect (*aql-e awwal*). The command was coming from the First Intellect that now, *inṭaliqū ilá ẓillin dhī thalāthi shu`ab* (Go forth to a shadow with three branches), that you should go towards a shadow with three prongs. Now cast them down, remove them from here; they are not worthy of living in the sacred realm (*‘aalam-e quds*). This is a pure realm (*paak ‘aalam*), this is a sacred realm (*qudsaani ‘aalam*), a spiritual realm (*ruhaani ‘aalam*). This physical realm (*jismaani ‘aalam*) and the realm of similitudes (*mushabbihaat ka ‘aalam*), or a realm that embraces darkness (*zulmat lene waale ‘aalam*), has no business with this. It is necessary for them to leave this place. Anyway. Now, what happened was that just as every being above looks upon the one below with an eye of mercy (*rahm*) and acts with an eye of grace (*karam*), in exactly the same way, here too, all of them started to work, and here the call (*da‘wat*) ceased to be individual (*infradi*) and became collective (*ijtimaa‘i*). Where was the individual call? It was with the First Intellect, with the Second Intellect (*aql-e saani*), with the Tenth (*‘aashir*), or with the circles (*dawaa’ir*) whose leaders (*sardaar*) were intellects, it was with them, or it was with the Tenth, or it was with the last individual of the *taaboot-e taabooti*, or it was with the last individual of the *labb-u nida*. These were all individual calls. But the call that is happening now is of a completely different kind. And how is this call happening? It is happening in a collective manner; that is, it is a collective call. Everyone is calling, and everyone feels the urgency. They all understand that we are bound by this, and indeed, the last individual of *labb-u nida* had bound them, that you must be reformed by them, and you must reform them. So now, all of them began to make the call collectively; teamwork began. Teamwork began, and everyone started to call them. But as I said to you, I will move forward while reiterating a little. There were two affinities (*nisbatein*) there that the First Intellect had left behind. They proceeded on these two affinities; they began to walk on these same narrow paths. And what were those affinities? The nobler affinity (*nisbat-e ashraf*) and the lower affinity (*nisbat-e adna*). The *nisbat-e ashraf* was related to its existential essence (*ma huwa wujudi*), and the *nisbat-e adna* was related to its own self (*ila-zaati*). That is, the affinity of the First Intellect towards its own self (*zaat*) was weaker, and its affinity towards God Almighty (*Allah Ta‘ala*), towards the Unseen of the Unseen (*Ghaib-ul-Ghuyoob*), towards the Exalted Originator (*Mubdi‘-e Ta‘ala*), that was the higher affinity. On these two affinities that it had left, some people began to run. What does "began to run" mean? Not the people, but their minds (*azhaan*) began to run; their intellects began to work. And their intellects worked in such a way that some people accepted the higher affinity, and some people accepted the lower affinity. These were *‘alafi* (of the highest rank), *‘uqool* (intellects); they were splendid, luminous, souls (*nufus*), sacred (*qudsaani*), spiritual (*ruhaani*). They are all spiritual entities (*ruhaani zawaat*). All are spiritual entities. So, compared to these spiritual entities, those entities—the entity of the First Intellect, or the entity of the Second Intellect, or the entity of the Holy Presence (*Hazrat-ul-Quds*), or the entities of all the intellects of the circles—are immeasurably superior. They have no standing. Are you understanding? And here, what has the world of Islam understood? *ba‘d az Khuda buzurg tu’i qissa mukhtasar* (After God, you [the Prophet] are the greatest; the story is brief). After sending blessings and peace upon the noble Prophet, what do they say? That after God Almighty, if any descend, it is from monotheism (*tawhid*) that they descended, and they came and ended at the Prophetic mission (*risaalat*). So this is the state of the world of Islam. This is the courage of the people of faith (*ahl-e imaan*) and their reward, that the Lord of the Worlds made us aware of such secrets (*asraar*). So that we could know, that look, how many more heavens have been created and how many spiritual things have come into being, and there are countless beings whose names cannot even be mentioned, and whose roles we cannot describe, as to what kind of end they are bringing about. Anyway, they are all high beings. Those who came into the active field, who said "yes" after saying "no," and who affirmed after denying, were countless entities; some took the higher affinity, and some the lower. Some went towards the *nisbat-e ashraf*, some towards the *nisbat-e adna*. Those who went towards the *nisbat-e ashraf* were the noble Imams (*aimma-e kiraam*). And those who went towards the *nisbat-e adna*, who were they? They were their servants, their slaves, their subordinates, their followers, those who obeyed them, who walked on their paths (*shari‘at*), who carried out their commands; they were under their construction, under their command. And who were they? They were the Prophets (*anbiya*), the pure ones (*asfiya*), the friends of God (*auliya*), the proofs (*hujjatein*), the summoners (*du‘at*), the messengers (*rasool-ein*). All of these, as many as there are, the *du‘at*, *anbiya* and all of them, are on a lower level. You could say that if the former are at the level of planning (*tadaabir*), then the latter are at the level of detail (*bataa’ib*). If the former are inside the spiritual Ka‘ba, in the middle, then the latter are in the vicinity of the Ka‘ba. There was a world of difference between them in knowledge. When the affinities changed, then obviously, although in this very world there is night and there is day, the matter of the day is different and the matter of the night is different. So in the same way, what happened here? That despite that, such an affinity was established, and such a great and clear (*bayyin*) difference emerged before you. And I had told you that now when the call began, to understand that call, I had left a point here, and for that reason I will tell you this: that the call that was happening, although it was not individual but collective, along with being collective, that call had another quality. What was that? Meaning, from the First Intellect to the last individual of *labb-u nida*, all the calls that had happened are called affirmative (*musbit*) calls; they were positive calls. They were positive calls, where only one command was coming: "Do." "Practice monotheism (*tawhid*)." No prohibition was coming, no restriction saying "Don't do this." Now what happened? The call that is coming now, what is it? Now it is not an affirmative but a negative (*manfi*) call. That now, along with "do," the command to "stop" is also coming. Commands (*awaamir*) are coming, and prohibitions (*nawaahi*) are coming. Do this, don't do that. This is lawful (*halaal*), this is forbidden (*haraam*). This food is okay, that food is not okay. This clothing is okay, that clothing is not okay. This work is okay, that work is not okay. Now in everything, you will see that religion (*din*) has remained even in clothing, religion has remained even in eating and drinking, religion has remained even in our conversations. So there is religion in everything. So this matter of commands and prohibitions that has arisen, why did it come? It came for this reason, that now it is a negative call. This is why God Almighty said: *ma ataakum al-rasulu fa-khudhuhu wa ma nahakum ‘anhu fa-ntahu* (Whatever the Messenger gives you, take it; and whatever he forbids you, abstain from it). That whatever the Prophet gives you, take it, and what he stops you from, stop. Beware, do not take a step forward. *fa-ntahu*, stop. So when the Quran says this, it becomes known that what the Messenger is telling... and the noble Imams were very much inclined towards this, and they explained it clearly. God willing, when that topic comes, I will tell you. But anyway, the person of the noble Prophet is the most clear person, a special person. In that regard, you can see that God Almighty commanded His Prophet: O Prophet, convey it to the community. Whatever you command, they should take, and whatever they are stopped from, they should stop from. So it becomes known that this is the trend of the negative call, and the negative call began. Where? In this teamwork. Along with the collective call. Now, along with the negative call, what happened? Those of the higher affinity were in God's mercy and fragrance (*rauh-o-raihaan*). So were those of the lower affinity not? They too were in God's mercy and fragrance. But the station (*maqaam*) of both is different. The affinities are different. If you take gold and throw it in mud, or take a diamond and throw it in mud, it will still shine. It will keep shining and will glitter. So on it, that dirtiness or muddiness will not come. That diamond will definitely show its luster. No matter what kind of place it gets. So here, they got a good place with God Almighty. And even if they were ahead or behind, whatever station they got, they would have remained in their place, having taken that station. They had taken the higher affinity. Those who took the higher affinity, took it, and those who took the lower affinity, remained below; they became the lower ones. Whether they sat above or below. Anyway, for our understanding, for our minds, I was saying that they are in one line, understand, and these are in another line. Those are above, these are below, so that your minds can properly set it and understand. And I was saying that among all those Imams and entities, among those who took the *nisbat-e ashraf*, whose was the highest self? The Master of the Age (*saahib-e asr*). This one who is the *Qaa’im-ul-Qiyamah ‘ala jaddihis-salaam* (the one who establishes the Resurrection, peace be upon his ancestor), who is the establisher of the resurrection, who is to come, that self was the greatest of all. No self was greater than his self. And if after him... now you will say, "Were numbers assigned there? What?" Nothing. In whatever way the wealth was, in whatever way they achieved perfection, they did it. *man jadda wajada* (He who strives, finds). Whoever tried, found. There, as the call was, so he found. He who expanded his vision, who gave importance to his vision, and who showed his speed, he moved forward. So there, in that race, in that running, we will have to see how much he achieves. So this was the race, that there, inside that contest, whoever came, came. So at that time, the one whose point was established, whose point was it? It was of Maulana *Qaa’im-ul-Qiyamah ‘ala jaddihis-salaam*. And after him, if anyone's point was established, who was it? Hazrat 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, upon him be prayers and peace. And after that, the points of four Imams were established in succession. There is no need to list them all: Fatimah al-Zahra was there, Hasan al-Mujtaba was there, Husain, the Martyr of Karbala was there, Imam Zayn al-'Abidin was there, Maulana Muhammad al-Baqir was there, Ja'far al-Sadiq was there, Ismail was there. They all continued in sequence. But now you will say, Fatimah al-Zahra was also there as a woman... Oh, there is no distinction between man and woman there. Rather, she has the status of a man there, understand. But the distinction between man and woman does not even exist there. It is a spiritual realm. These are all characteristics of the physical realm. When I get to that, I will go into great detail. Right now, I haven't even touched upon the physical realm. Right now it is the spiritual realm. So at that time, when the call to God (*da‘wat il-Allah*) was going on, within that call to God, I had told you that everyone's gaze, while making the call, saw the best call. Whose? That of the Commander of the Faithful, Hazrat 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, upon him be prayers and peace. That there is no one who can make the call better than you. If there is a call, it should be like this; if there is ingenuity, it should be like this; if there is vision, it should be like this; if there is intelligence, it should be like this; if there is a decision, it should be like this; if there are virtues, they should be like this. All those gazes, the gaze of all the Imams... it wasn't necessary there. It wasn't necessary at all. It was possible that Janaab-e Muhammad would move ahead, possible that Hasan would move ahead, anyone could have. But what to do, the way it happened, fact is fact. What happened has to be narrated. What happened became history. Whatever happens becomes history. The history that was made was that the manifestation (*mazhar*) for all, the center (*markaz*) for all, and the candle of guidance (*sham‘-e hidayat*) for all, who was he? Hazrat 'Ali ibn Abi Talib. Hazrat 'Ali ibn Abi Talib... everyone's gazes were falling upon him, and they were learning from your call, understanding that whatever call there is, it is the call of 'Ali, and it was 'Ali and only 'Ali. "Wherever I look, there is only You." It was 'Ali and only 'Ali, on all four sides. 'Ali's name was supreme, 'Ali's drum was beating. But what happened? The Master of the Universe (*Maula-e Kaainaat*) looked where? Towards Janaab-e Qaa’im. As soon as he looked towards Janaab-e Qaa’im... and what does it mean to look? It means to learn, to take from him, to benefit (*istifaada*) from him, to acquire from him, whatever to take from him. So as soon as he tried to benefit and as he took from Janaab-e Qaa’im, what happened immediately? All the gazes, for which 'Ali had been the center, now who became the center? Janaab-e Qaa’im became the center. This was the first state (*kaifiyat*) that was established there. Now, all the spirits (*arwaah*) are in this situation, in this state. All those who are *kal-lamam*, all those who are Prophets and Messengers and Imams, all of them are watching, and such a state is going on there that suddenly, in the lower part... below, the entities that were there, the Prophets who were there, Janaab-e Sham‘un (Samuel) is there, Dhul-Kifl is there, Sulayman (Solomon) is there, Dawud (David) is there, Yusuf (Joseph) is there, Yunus (Jonah) is there, Ya‘qub (Jacob) is there. All these prophets, the chain of 124,000, and many more. All those prophets are in their places, and among them is the Leader of the Universe, the Pride of Creation, the most sacred person of Hazrat Muhammad al-Mustafa, peace and blessings of God be upon him. Now, when everyone's center had become who, here? Now, was it necessary there that a center be made? It was not necessary. This was the first blueprint being made; it wasn't necessary. Whoever wanted to could make the call in their own place. There was no need to accept anyone as a teacher. But what can be done, he was accepted. At the time he was accepted, he was accepted. We are narrating that. Otherwise, there was no need for anyone to be appointed as a teacher. So there, everyone was looking at the most sacred person of the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him, that if there is a call, it should be a call like yours. For this reason, he became the Master of the Prophets (*Sayyid-ul-Anbiya*). He became the leader of all the prophets. The Master of the Messengers and the Master of the Prophets (*Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen o Sayyid-ul-Anbiya*). Whose person became this? The Prophet's, peace and prayers be upon him. As the Master of the Prophets, Master of the Two Worlds (*Sayyid-ul-Kaunain*), Master of the Messengers (*Sayyid-ul-Rusul*), you are the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him, that this state is going on, above and below. This affair is happening that Hazrat 'Ali... that Hazrat 'Ali, leaving everything, started to look down, that there is a need to learn from the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him. If a call is to be made, this is the call, and this is the style of making a call. Now look, as it is said among us, that if one has to learn, what difference does it make if it's from a junior? If the junior has knowledge, then take knowledge from the junior, learn it. So it is the same matter. Although the Prophet was lower (*dani*), inferior (*adna*), junior, but what did Janaab-e 'Ali do? He turned towards him and started learning from him. And as soon as he turned towards him, what happened? All the noble Imams turned. Those who were looking at 'Ali now started looking at the Prophet. All the prophets were already looking at the Prophet. Now, the center of the entire spiritual realm, of the Ark (*taabuut*), who became it? The most sacred person of the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him. This is the Ascension of the Prophet (*mi‘raaj-e nabi*), peace and prayers be upon him. That such was the sharpness of his vision, and such was your grandeur, and your specialty of Prophethood was so tremendous, that what happened now? That you... God Almighty said that your throne (*‘arsh*) should be raised. Accordingly, your throne was raised, and you were lifted from the lower affinity and placed in the higher affinity. As soon as you were taken from the lower affinity and placed in the higher affinity, *dana fa-tadalla, fa-kana qaba qawsayni aw adna* (He drew near and descended, and was at a distance of two bow-lengths or nearer). He reached that station; the *mi‘raaj* of the Prophet was achieved. Now it is another matter, that distance of two bow-lengths or nearer, to understand this, these are secrets; God willing, when you read it in the tradition (*taqleed*), you will understand. But for now, understand that station, *fa-awha ila ‘abdihi ma awha* (And He revealed to His servant what He revealed). God Almighty revealed to His Prophet what He had to reveal. So all these things that are happening, for whom are they happening? For the person of the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him. The *mi‘raaj* is being bestowed upon you. And the Prophet's *mi‘raaj* happened, and you were established in the Praised Station (*Maqaam-e Mahmood*). The crown of excellence was placed upon you, and you, for this entire universe, for that entire spiritual universe, what did you become? You became the crown. And you began to shine as the candle of guidance. The candle of the arena, *siraajan munira* (a shining lamp). *Ya ayyuha al-rasulu inna arsalnaka shahidan wa mubashshiran wa nadhiran wa da‘iyan ila Allahi bi-idhnihi wa sirajan munira* (O Messenger, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner, and as one who invites to God, by His permission, and as a shining lamp). God Almighty made you a shining lamp (*siraaj-e munir*). Now he is shining as a shining lamp, shining... Prophet. Now, this state is that of the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him, but this was the matter, this was the point, that when the chain of guidance was formed in this world—now how they came and in what way they came, I will tell you all that later. For now, just understand this, that since the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him, came into this world, 'Ali also came, Hasan also came, Husain also came, Fatimah also came, marriage happened, and all the prophets also came into the world and guided in their own times and to their own people and community. So when you see, the history of the Prophet is also before you, *Sirat-e Nabawi* (The Prophet's Biography), and Sulaiman Nadvi and Shibli Nu'mani have written it in eight volumes. But this biography that is written, whose is it written of? Of an ignorant prophet (*jaahil nabi*). An ignorant prophet. Our Prophet was not a knowledgeable prophet (*‘aalim nabi*). All the scholars of Islam agree on what? On an ignorant prophet. God forbid, God forbid. There can be no worse thing than this. And what do they say? This is the very specialty of the Prophet. Hey, what is this, what specialty? Oh, he is knowledgeable despite being ignorant. What is this, knowledgeable despite being ignorant? What does that even mean? He was not ignorant. I will tell you where he received his learning, when he acquired it, in which school he studied, when he studied, what he studied, it will all come, God willing, when the prophets are discussed. But for now, this has to be told, that the Prophet... we... the Muslims consider him ignorant, God forbid. The person of the Prophet cannot be seen as a student. Now, when the most sacred person of the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him, had become so blessed, so lofty, and a knight like 'Ali, that Father of the Imams (*Abu-l-Aimma*), before whom all the Imams, all those of the *nisbat-e ashraf*, bowed their heads, became followers, all of them performed the prostration of respect, bowed in 'Ali's court. That 'Ali, where was he bowed? Towards the Prophet. That is why when he came into this world, 'Ali had to recite the *kalima*, the creed, that *la ilaha ill-Allah, ashhadu anna Muhammadan rasulullah* (There is no god but God, I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of God). You gave witness that indeed the Prophet is the Messenger of God. So this testimony, 'Ali could never have given, but because he had already done it there. He had done it there, that's why he gave it. Otherwise 'Ali would never have done it. 'Ali had no need; he was of the higher affinity. But 'Ali had to bow. He bowed for this reason. And the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him, understood 'Ali's status. He understood 'Ali's status and knew who this 'Ali was, one of the higher affinity. And let me tell you another specialty of the higher affinity. When those of the higher affinity come into this world, they come *waladan ‘an walid* (son from father). The father's son will have the manifestation. This is a condition. The Imamate is from father to son. After Hasan, Husain came; that was an exception the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him, made for them, saying that Hasan and Husain are the two Imams of the youth of Paradise. Otherwise, if you leave this exception, you will always see the Imamate in the son after the father. Janaab-e 'Ali, whose son was he? Hazrat Maulana Abu Talib. His lineage runs from 'Abd Manaf... you can trace the lineage, it is father to son: Murrah is there, Kilab is there, Qusayy is there, Hashim is there, then after him is Janaab 'Abd al-Muttalib, after 'Abd al-Muttalib is Janaab Abu Talib, and Abu Talib's son is 'Ali. But nature wanted to join the chain of Prophethood here too. For that, being a son from a father is not a condition, but how was the condition joined? And how did that chain continue? Janaab 'Abd al-Muttalib had two sons, Janaab 'Abdullah and Janaab Abu Talib. And 'Abdullah's son is who? Janaab Prophet, the Leader of the Universe. Now this became the chain of Prophethood. But when I begin the chain of Prophethood from Adam, I will tell you what prophethood came to the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him, and how it came, and what the chain was and what it wasn't, with all its subtleties. It is a very deep and very subtle subject. It would be better if you understand it at the right time. For now, what I have to say is that Janaab-e 'Ali's reciting the *kalima*, the creed, shows that there was submission, there was obedience (*ta‘at*) to the Messenger. And because he had already obeyed there, he had bowed his head there, he also recited the *kalima* here. He said that the Messenger is the Messenger of God, and he is the Prophet of God. He gave testimony for the Prophet, peace and prayers be upon him. So when all these things are there, now all these things have happened, and everyone has established their position in their place, so at that time, you have to consider that all these individuals, whether they are the entities of the Imams or the entities of the Prophets, of all these entities there is a record. There is a record at what angle, at what degree, with what vision, on what path, from what perspective they inclined their minds and accepted the call. The call to God, that is, the call of the last individual of *labb-u nida*, how they accepted it. So whatever path they had—meaning, to say *nisbat-e a‘ala* and *nisbat-e adna* is one thing, but within the *nisbat-e a‘ala* there were a thousand. Now, won't you subdivide those thousand? So each one has a path. Just as here, each of our faces is different, each person's soul is different, each person's thought is different, all these things are different. So in the same way, there too everyone's was different. And everyone's different minds, their conception, that conception God Almighty preserved there. That place of preservation is called the Pillar of Light (*‘umood-e noor*). They call it the Pillar of Light, where the forms of all were preserved. You can understand it in your own words as a "record room." It is a record room where they were preserved. Now, when you have understood how the call of our Friends of God (*auliya-Allah*) happened, and the call that was happening, to whom were they making the call? They were making the call to us. We who were disobedient, we who were opposing, we who were the last ones in the group of *‘aashir*, and who were not ready to accept, the call was being made to us. And when the call was happening, what state began to emerge? Some were making fun, some were joking, some were laughing, some were talking. Some were saying, "The lesson was good today." "Yesterday's lesson was good... I think yesterday's was good." "No, no, yesterday's was good, but today it was a bit like this." As many minds, so many opinions. So just as everyone's thinking is different here, in the same way, what happened is that when the call began to that group, and especially to the disobedient group—because you people are the people of Solomon's religion—so to the disobedient group, now you see, voices of running away, voices of shouting, and strange states began to be created in them. What? Some people started saying, "Brother, it is necessary to accept." They are feeling the need now, but not accepting. "It is necessary to accept." Some started saying, "No, brother, this satanic call that is there, they are doing very, very well. We need to think about this matter, and it is better that we become firm in our place, become unrighteous." [unclear]. Yes, there were such people. And there were people who followed them too. As I have said, despite knowing, and having been told, that an Imam is being made, but they are drinking alcohol, playing cards, doing all sorts of worldly things, which an ordinary believer avoids, he is not involved in such things, and he is indulging in them, and despite that, he is the Imam. And when he is asked how he accepts such an Imam, he says, "What is there in that? In India, when monkeys and cows can be worshipped, and their idols are worshipped, then he can be worshipped." Yes. Okay. Anyway, the point was that when they don't want to accept there, then... the excuse to trip a camel, there are a hundred excuses. Okay. And they started to refuse, saying "No, no, we will never accept." But there were some people who were stuck in the middle. Sometimes they go this way, sometimes they go that way. Meaning, they are in a state of hesitation. Sometimes there, sometimes here. Sometimes towards good, sometimes towards evil. They remained in such a state. Now, these states of theirs were going on when *‘aashir* executed the command. Which *‘aashir*? The last individual of *labb-u nida*. He executed it: *inṭaliqū ilá ẓillin dhī thalāthi shu`ab* (Go forth to a shadow with three branches). Now it is necessary for you to go towards the three-pronged shadow. Now go. Now as soon as his command was issued and the command was implemented here, what happened along with the implementation of the command? That all of these people, their... their luminous state, the luminous entities they had become, the sacred entities they had become—look, who were they? You might think they are the people of the *taabuut*. No, not the *kal-lamam*. It is about those who are left, the disobedient group. They are spiritual, aren't they? They are spiritual, sacred, in an *‘alafi* state, a *qaa’imi* state, people who live in the spiritual realm there. All of them, their light began to diminish. I have said that you might think that the diminishing of light is because there is a light, and it is being reduced, some device for reduction has been installed and it is being reduced. No. In the same way that here your... your face itself changes. When you have to refuse, your state is different, your color is different. Upon affirmation, your color is different. Exactly that same state was there. Because we are conceptualizing it in the physical realm, it is a bit difficult to conceptualize, but still, I am giving you the concept through physicality, that their light began to diminish. The light began to be snatched away, understand, darkness began to come, and the luminosity in them began to decrease. That luminosity began to decrease in them, and now hardness came upon them, and a rigidity came into their nature. Why? Because punishment was now coming to them. Due to the punishment, this state was created in them. Now when this thing was created, what happened? That as their entities became dark (*muzlim*), as they became dark, these people started to feel great darkness. For example, if the light is turned off here, what will happen now? Darkness will suddenly spread here, and I will say that I am ending the lesson today, so you may go from here now. So look, what will you do to go? You will need to take support from each other. You will start to feel your way around. Why, brother? Why are you feeling your way? Why are you feeling your way? So you will say, because there is darkness, it is dark. In the dark, one has to feel one's way. One has to see a little where the door is, where the light is, where we are, where the people are, all this has to be seen, one has to go very carefully. So just as this state is here, exactly that state began to happen there, that in that spiritual realm, in that abode of darkness, those who are trapped there, and that disobedient group, who have not accepted yet despite the call of the *kal-lamam*, and they were calling but they have not yet accepted them. They have not accepted, and the punishment has also been implemented. And due to the punishment, they began to become dark. When the darkness began to come, what did they do? They consulted amongst themselves that this darkness is a very bad thing, this is a strange situation that has been created, and it is better that we collectively give such a jolt that we cross over from this side to that side and get out of this darkness. Just as when you feel lazy, you stretch, or you crack your knuckles, or when you feel stiff, so in exactly the same way, or you move in some way, in exactly the same way, they thought of a collective movement. Now, the reality is that *‘aashir* also wanted this, and they themselves also wanted this. So what nature wanted, and they... they also wanted the same, so it was a state of *raaziyatan marziyyah* (well-pleased and pleasing [to God]), that God also wanted this, and they also wanted this. So to get out of this darkness, the light of knowledge, power, and life in their entities began to diminish, and their entities began to become dark, and darkness began to come, so what did they do? To get out of this, they made a collective movement. So all of them together, just as if, understand, there is a large beam, how workers move it with one motion, with one voice, so that the strength of all of them is applied at once. So in exactly the same way, these people, they also here, all of them in a dark state, made one movement. And as soon as they moved, and that movement which was the intention, it was also the intention of that Exalted Planner (*mudabbir-e Ta‘ala*) that they should move. And as soon as they moved, a handcuff was put on. Fetters were put on. And they came and got trapped. What was that first thing... what did they get trapped in? They got trapped in length (*tool*); length was created. Length, meaning mental lengthiness (*toolaniyat*) came. Because it is upon the minds. Meaning, physicality has not yet fully taken over. It is a mental concept. You have to... if you have to say something or do something, a blueprint first comes to your mind. You have to... you have to build a house, so you first bring a blueprint to your mind. For anything, you first form a concept. So in exactly the same way, a state of lengthiness was created in them, length was created. And along with length, from heat and cold, moisture and dryness, two... two movements were created. One fast movement, one weak movement. Heat and cold were created with that movement, along with length. Now you might say, where is the heat there? Look... where is the dryness? Where is it coming from? Tell me. No, no, there, its principles (*usool*) are being established. It has not come yet. Are you understanding? It is about to come. But it is an imaginary lengthiness, a mental conception. And material length has not come upon them. So when length came, a handcuff was put on them, and of the three dimensions, one dimension was applied to them. As soon as it was applied, they said, "No, no, what is this trouble? By making one movement, we have fallen into more trouble. No, no, we should make another movement." They all together made a second movement. They said, "Now let's make a stronger movement than this, so that we get out of this too, we cross this too." So as soon as they moved, width (*‘arz*) came upon them, breadth came. And along with that, cold remained, and with it, moisture was also created. These characteristics were created, its effects were created. Meaning, in a limped manner, like a scheme comes to you. I am saying it like that. So first, lengthiness came, length came, then breadth came. When they got stuck in breadth also, they said, "We have fallen into even more trouble. It is better that we make one more movement and get out of this movement." So they made a strong third movement. And with the third movement, depth (*‘umq*) also came. Length, breadth and depth. All three things came. Now the qualities of matter were all manifest in them. They were created. They were trapped in three dimensions. Now, but what is it now? It is the state of primordial matter (*hayula-e ula*). This is called *hayula-e ula*. This is an imaginary state, a state of thought, a mental state. The embodiment has not yet been properly found, but the outline has been drawn. The outline came. When they were trapped in this, after this they did not make a fourth movement. Look, these were the three movements because of which we got addition, subtraction, multiplication. And the work we generally do, what is it? We make things in threes, we do things in threes... that "three-ness" that has come, the characteristics that have come in us, have come from there. It is the state from there, because of which we started to do it here as well. Are you people understanding? You are understanding, right? So when this length, breadth, and depth came into it, and heat and cold, moisture and dryness, that is, dryness, coolness, and all these... moisture and dryness, all these things were created, these qualities were created, their limbs came, so what happened after that? That they came into the state of *hayula-e ula* and got trapped. Now when you... having come, when they got trapped in this way, now nature wanted to put handcuffs on them properly and then treat them. As you know, if a wild animal needs to be operated on, or if it is a predator, a lion, and needs to be given an injection, how is it given? It is trapped. They trap it with sliding doors. First, they confine it in a vice, then they inject it or do whatever. So in exactly the same way, nature also wanted that first... whatever it wants to make of you, it makes, but before making, it puts handcuffs on you. Just as here, a criminal, before being taken away, is handcuffed, put in chains and fetters. In the same way, nature put you in the fetters of length, width, and depth. When nature did this, then from nature... the destiny (*taqdeer*) that was, that is, that last individual of *labb-u nida*, he is the planner of the universe, and who is above the *kal-lamam* and is watching the states of all the *kal-lamam*. What is the state of the *kal-lamam*? They are continuing the call to God. Until when? Until length, width, and depth came upon them, until then their call was continuing. Whose? The *kal-lamam's*. That is, those of the higher affinity, those of the lower affinity, all the Imams, all the Prophets, were all making the call. Now, when they were making the call, then at that time, within the act of calling, the state of some people was such that they had become ready to feel remorse (*nadaamat*). As I said, the leaven was being prepared; they were getting ready to feel remorse, that yes, brother, it is necessary to repent. What, until when will we keep refusing? There is no benefit in refusing, no gain. Look, we have left that station of grandeur, that abode of mercy has been abandoned by us, that nest of ours has been scattered from us. And it is better that we attain it. We become worthy of going to that sacred realm, that would be better. So these people who were feeling remorse, how did they feel remorse? By accepting the call. Because if they had to accept, they would have accepted right there, in the middle stage, they would have accepted in the stage of *taabuut-e taabuuti*, they would have accepted in the stage of *labb-u nida*. But they had not accepted. Since they had not accepted, they had to be made to accept. And to make them accept, which entities came? The entities of the Prophets, and the entities of the *auliya*, the entities of the Imams came. And when they made the call, then after hearing something, understanding something, "Yes, brother, this is what he is saying, it has entered our minds, and we should accept." Those who understood by saying this, and those who conceived of it this way, they were called the remorseful (*naadimeen*). Those who feel remorse. One group was formed, one section, one branch was formed there. What is the name of that branch? The remorseful. Alright. Now who were the others? Those who considered the satanic voice to be their everything, who had made its call, the satanic and Shaybanic call, their all-in-all, and their whole basis was on insistence and arrogance, and they were not ready to accept. So what were they like? Insistent and arrogant; they were the insistent and the arrogant (*musirr o mutakabbir*). Absolutely firm. We will stand firm, we will not accept. We will not accept anyone. So these non-acceptors became a second group. Now those who remained in the middle, besides these, those who remained, they were divided into an intermediate state, some remained in a state of hesitation: to accept or not to accept, to accept or not to accept. So this state of theirs, this very state, was the state that remained at the very time that length, width, and depth were coming. It's a delicate matter. At the time length, width, and depth were coming... for example, the first matter, let's go to remorse. The remorseful, at the time that... these handcuffs were being put on them, or the court's judgment was being passed, at that time, in whatever state they were, all of it was written down as a statement. Meaning, just as a criminal's statement is taken down, and his signature is taken on it, in exactly the same way was the state of the remorseful; their signature was taken, understand, or their exam papers were taken from their hands, or something happened, the final bell rang and their matter was finished. So that state they were in at the last moment was one of remorse. And their end (*khatma*) came upon remorse. Their end came. Now the others, what was their matter? That while the call to God was happening, these Imams and these Prophets were all calling and summoning, they remained insistent at the last moment, and arrogant. "Go, we don't accept." The label of "insistent and arrogant" was put on them. And those people who were in doubt and amazement, the matter of those in doubt and amazement was very flexible. It was possible that... they could have jumped and joined the group of the remorseful, or jumped and joined the insistent and arrogant; this was possible. But what happened? They remained in this state of hesitation until when? Until the water congealed (*injimaad-e maa’i*), until the water froze, until the water became ice, until the intention was fixed and their thoughts were noted down. At that time, what did they say? "We are in doubt." So all these groups that are there, these groups were: the remorseful (*naadim*), the insistent and arrogant (*musirr o mutakabbir*), and the doubting and bewildered (*shaak o mutahayyir*). [unclear]. One is the remorseful, the remorseful and pious. Second is the doubting and bewildered, and third is the insistent and arrogant. The whole world is divided into these three groups, understand. That whole world, that group of the disobedient that was with *‘aashir*, and besides this, there is nothing. Erase the concept of this world; it does not exist at all. Do not keep the concept of this world. Keep your conception completely separate from this world. Keep your conception exactly there. And imagine that whoever was there, all of them were divided into these three parts. Now when they were divided into three parts, then upon these three parts, on which length, width, and depth are coming, and on which all these severities are coming, of cold, moisture, heat, and dryness, upon them God Almighty issued and implemented the command, *inṭaliqū*. And with *inṭaliqū*, this command came, and you saw that towards the three-pronged, that is, the three shadows, they got trapped in three dimensions. Now a new command came out, *ihbiṭū*. Fall. Now what I have to tell you is that *‘aashir* has three intentions (*qasd*). What are intentions? Intentions (*iraade*). There are three intentions of *‘aashir*, that is, the last individual of *labb-u nida* has three intentions. What are the three intentions? His first intention was that the command he has implemented, in accordance with that command, they should be made to fall. "*Ihbiṭū*" should be said. Which is a Quranic word. As it has come in the Quran, "*ihbiṭū*," that "fall." This should be said to them. One. Second, along with it, this: *thumma nunajjī alladhīna ittaqaw, wa nadharu al-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyyā* (Then We will save those who feared God, and We will leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees). Yes, O people, you will have to be trapped in this world, but what is it? That We, from here, those who practice piety (*taqwa*), meaning those who bring faith, We will surely pull them out from here. We will take them towards that spiritual realm. *wa nadharu al-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyyā* (and We will leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees). And We will keep the wrongdoers in this very world. Who are the wrongdoers (*zaalim*)? Meaning, those who kill each other? No. By wrongdoer it is meant that *waz‘ al-shay’i fi ghayri mahallihi* (placing a thing in other than its proper place). Because they had to feel remorse, and they did not, that is why they became wrongdoers. And the wrongdoer will be kept here in this universe. So the meaning is that I am also telling from the Quran that the first intention of *‘aashir* was of "*ihbiṭū*," that "fall." This is the first intention. The second intention of *‘aashir* was that he, of these... now this universe which he is making, will make later, he will form it from these very ones. And I will tell you how he will form it. I will tell you in great detail. So this universe... this physical universe which is our universe, when God Almighty formed it, the canopy that is spread above it all is called the encompassing sphere (*falak-e muheet*). Encompassing... *muheet* means that which surrounds. It is the sphere that surrounds, which is not visible to the eyes. For us, it is only for understanding; it is not seen and is not understandable by the eyes. That *falak-e muheet*, it is also called the sphere of spheres (*falak-e atlas*), it is also called the gate of the sacred realm (*baab-e ‘aalam-e quds*). To rotate that *falak-e muheet*, that I will do all these things by rotating it. This was the second intention. The third intention that came to his mind was that I, where these wrongdoers are, these evil... these evil souls (*shreer nufus*), I will collectively put them into the molds of animals, of lions, of leopards, of calves, in such molds, in birds I will put them. These three intentions were coming to his mind, to *‘aashir's*. Are you understanding? There are three intentions of *‘aashir*. These were the intentions: first, to say *ihbiṭū*, second, to rotate the *falak-e muheet*, and third, to confine the evil ones in animal forms (*asba'*). But these were his intentions. What was the thought (*fikr*)? Thought is a different thing, intention is a different thing. The thought was the thought of creating man. He thought, *‘aashir* did, that I will create this whole universe, and within the whole universe, how to make air, how to make water, how to make earth, how to make this, how to make that, everything... the way he did the making, that will all come, God willing. It will all come. No thing will be left out. But for now, you should keep in mind that along with making all this... this also started to come into his thought, that after making everything, I... in that world, this one... an *‘alafi* state in which each and every human has been made, whom the Lord of Might (*Rabb-ul-‘Izzat*), the Exalted Originator, had made, had created. Those who were in the *‘alafi* state, in the spiritual state, who were given knowledge, power, and life, were entities, were universal intellects, rare, who were sensitive in their entities, active. These entities who possessed this state, how do I create these entities here? This was his thought. But what happened? That when God Almighty... now what happens? The difficult task, you think about it first, but you do it last of all. In this world, the difficult task, you think about it first, but you do it last. So the Lord (*Parwardigaar*), because God Almighty also did it in the same way, that the Lord of the Worlds, the thought of creating man came first of all, that man... that is, those intellects of the world of intellect, I should confine them in a cage, confine them in a form (*qaamat*), confine them in a human form. If today you were to... all these humans were to be removed and the surface of the earth were to be wiped clean, and it were to be put in your hands, just look and see what kind of blueprints would emerge. Oh, you get muddled over making one house. So this was the creation of the universe, and leave aside creating the universe, just take the concept of creating man. You would either make a demon, as has come in stories, or Aladdin's genie would be made. Or what would you have made? But this is the planning of the Lord of the Worlds, that how He... for all these humans... chose this form, chose this style, chose these habits, chose these limbs, chose this state, chose this flexible human. He chose this human, rich with all these jewels, and made him by casting him in this mold. And when He had made him, He began to say, *fa-tabarak Allahu ahsan al-khaliqin* (So blessed is God, the best of creators). Blessed is that God who is the best of creators. Oh, there were entities there who were creators. Look, today the entire Islamic world says, He was the creator (*khilqat karne wala*), God created us. What? He is saying *khaliqin* (creators), it is plural. Just... think a little, here it is the plural form, He is not saying *khaliq* (creator), He has said *khaliqin*. Of the creators. It became known that others also had the capability. Oh, they were higher than him; above *labb-u nida* were the *taabuut-e taabuuti*, above the *taabuut-e taabuuti* were the seven circles, above the seven circles was *Hazrat-ul-Quds*, there was the Second Intellect, and above the Second Intellect was the First Intellect. All of them had the capability. And if those people had not applied their intellect and their minds, could this have been achieved? So He made, and after making, divinity (*khudaai*) itself began to sway. Divinity itself began to sway when it had made man, then *fa-tabarak Allahu ahsan al-khaliqin*. Blessed is that God who is the best of creators. So now, when I... when this world comes, then at that time I will repeat this verse before you again, at that time the enjoyment will be even more. Because at that time I will tell you who the speaker is. Right now I am not telling you. *fa-tabarak Allahu ahsan al-khaliqin*, I am only giving its meaning, that blessed is that God who is the best of creators. So it became known that the first thought in his mind was man, to create man. That is, those intellects that are there, those souls that are there, those who exist as intellects in the world of shadows (*‘aalam-e azilla*), in what cage to bind them here, and how to bring them into confinement, into captivity. So to bring them into captivity... all this flesh, skin, bone, limbs, and senses, and this conscience and feeling, to bring them into the grip of all these things was not an ordinary matter, it is not an easy matter. You should see for yourselves that in the field of medicine, there are thousands of books. Just analyze the veins and sinews, or just do an analysis of the blood. If you go into one thing, it is like an ocean, and a world is populated. So it became known that the Lord of the Worlds was doing it. So this was the first thing that came to his mind. And the last of deeds (*wa aakhir-ul-‘amal*). We pray that "the first of thoughts and the last of deeds (*awwal-ul-fikrati wa aakhir-ul-‘amal*)." Man was the first thought, and in terms of action, he was created last of all. Man was made last of all in this universe. And how he was made, that will come, great detail will come. Anyway...

Listen, if you go into the *ma'rifat* of Ali, by God's oath, even a year is not enough. Such is the depth of knowledge.

So, it is a sermon from our Mawla, and it is Mawla's statement, so if you act upon it, there will be no shortcoming in it. But however much I am explaining to you now, if you understand that much, it will be a very great thing. But you should understand that if there is a *jan-e haqa'iq* (soul of realities), if there is a *jan* (soul) of the *sabab* (cause), then it is the *ma'rifat* (gnosis) of Amir al-Mu'minin Ali. Understand this.

So this, the *kalmah* of Amir al-Mu'minin, was read, it was the reading of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, but all these, whether in the *nisbat-e 'adna* (lower realm) or in the *nisbat-e a'la* (higher realm), their *nadamah* (remorse) was complete and perfect. They performed a complete *nadamah*. Now, when you have seen that their *nadamah* has taken place and they have started to guide everyone, and what was our condition? That we were in denial upon denial. We were committing denial, we were in denial; such was our condition. And as I told you, that they, like a mother, are anxious for a mischievous child and happy for a good child. So that was the state of a mother they were in, and we, like their children, were writhing, some were crying, some were... our condition was strange.

In that state, the last individual of *lubb-o-nida'* (the essence and the call), who is the *'ashir-e mudabbir* (the tenth manager), he gave us the command to fall, because from the side of *'Aql-e Awwal* (the First Intellect), these orders had already been issued. What? "*Inṭaliqū ilā ẓillin dhī thalāthi shuʿab*" (Proceed to a shadow with three branches). "Go towards the three-branched shadow." And you had to go there. I explained this to you in detail, that there was the first movement, the second movement, the third movement. In the first movement came length, in the second came width, in the third came depth, and they came into a state of captivity. Now, when they came into captivity, at that time, what happened? That those who, in reality, had agreed to perform *nadamah*, those few people started shouting and saying, "Hey, we perform *nadamah*! We perform *nadamah*!"

So now... what was the state of that mother? That from whose hand, as I had said, that woman is standing on the balcony, and from her hand, the child has fallen, and her jewelry has fallen, and her... that... valuable relic has also fallen. But she will pick up the child first. In the same way, they also looked with a compassionate gaze. At whom? In what? Those *A'immah*, those of the *kalmah*. At whom? They looked at us. Those who were performing *nadamah*. They looked upon the repentant ones with mercy, that this is a strange state, that these merciful ones, where have they gotten stuck?

Just as when the people of faith, in this *dawlab* (water-wheel of life), come and get stuck, their elders feel great pain at what kind of struggles they have to endure. "Oh, where do they have to go, they have to leave their homeland, they have come and are living in a foreign land, so-and-so..." All these things are there. So in the same way, they too were looking with a compassionate gaze, "Oh, what have we gotten ourselves into? We have fallen in with the *musir wa mustakbir* (insistent and arrogant). We have ended up with the *shakk wa mutaraddid* (doubtful and hesitant)." You understand my point? So they were divided into three groups. All the people, meaning the entire *ummah*, was divided into three factions. They were the *shakk wa mutaraddid*, the *musir wa mustakbir*, and the... *nadim-e mustaqirr* (the steadfastly repentant). One group repented, one was in doubt, and one insisted [on sin].

There are several types of those who insist, and there are several types of those who perform *nadamah*, and there are several types of the *musir wa mustakbir*. The *musir wa mustakbir* have 35 types. The *shakk wa mutaraddid* have 20 types. And the *nadimeen* (repentant ones) have 15 types. How many does that make? 70.

That is why the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, what did he say? Now look, where is the Prophet speaking from? That... "*sataftariqu ummatī fī thalāthatin wa sabʿīna firqatan wāḥidatun nājiyah*" (My *ummah* will split into seventy-three sects, one of which will be saved). My *ummah* will split into 73 sects, and from them, one will be the saved one. Today, all the researchers, what are they doing? They are writing, "Murji'ah, so-and-so, so-and-so..." This is all false research, what research is this? This is research. This research is going on. The situation is that there, in Hyderabad, the researchers... they had included me too. I also went to do research there. So there I saw that... I did the very first research, that I asked them, "Brother, how many sects have been gathered so far?" So they said, "Brother, so far, some 92 have been gathered." I said, "Brother, 92 have been gathered, remove them. Bring the 73." "No, they have increased, the number of sects is very large." So this is the research I did. You understand? 92 have been gathered. Now our Prophet is saying 72, 73, and you are saying 92. So what does this mean? Was the Prophet talking about these sects? That after me, there will be such division? That the caliphates will become like this? Or the Shias will become like this, the Sunnis will become like this? Was the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, talking about these sects? No, God forbid. Look, this *ummah* of the Prophet was the *ummah* that was about to fall from there. And he is speaking to those who are falling: "*sataftariqu ummatī fī thalāthatin wa sabʿīna firqatan wāḥidatun nājiyah*" (My *ummah* will split into seventy-three sects, one of which will be saved). Seventy-three. Now you will say, "Brother, you counted 70."

Alright. The thing is, the fact is that there are 35 sects of the *musir wa mustakbir*. And our *du'at* (missionaries) have defined every single sect. Please, just think about it. It is not a small matter. Your senses will leave you. If you listen to the 35 sects, your senses will leave you. He defined 35 sects. And he defined 20 sects. And he defined our 15 sects.

Now, if you add them all up, how many are there? 70. The fact of the matter was that among the *musir wa mustakbir*, their 35th sect will be the most insistent and arrogant. Will it be or not? And the first one will be less so. Of the 35th. The first of the *musir wa mustakbir* will be less so. And just like the *shakk wa mutaraddid*, the first one will be less, the last one will be the most. Similarly, with *nadamah* (remorse), the first one will be the most remorseful, and the last one will be the least remorseful. The opposite.

Does that make sense to you? The fact was that the head of the last person of remorse was his feet, and the head of the *shakk wa mutaraddid* was upright. That is why we have the method of *pa-bosi* (kissing the feet) and *musafahah* (shaking hands). And the *musir*... the *shakk wa mutaraddid* that was there, his head was attached to the feet of whom? The *shakk wa mutaraddid*... the *musir wa mustakbir*'s head was attached to the feet of the *shakk wa mutaraddid*. They were joined in this way. And these 73 sects. Now listen carefully. I said there were 35 sects of the *musir wa mustakbir*. Their "cream" also has to be prepared. From among them, whoever was capable of pulling himself out of that *dawlab* (water-wheel) and, leaving the 35, tries to join the *shakk wa mutaraddid*...

Progress is happening, evolution is occurring. Progress doesn't stop. No thing is static. So, the one who leaves the 35 and becomes the 36th, or, let's say, is becoming their cream, the Prophet is counting that cream. Similarly, the cream that is forming from the *shakk wa mutaraddid*, he is counting that. Similarly, what is happening with the remorse, he is counting that. So now how many are there? 73. And he said that from among them, one is the saved one. So what does that mean? That one saved one, who is it? The Sulaimani. The sect of remorse that is advancing on its path and reaches the Imam of the time, that one will be saved.

And what will happen? Everyone has to go to paradise one day. This is our belief. And everyone has to come into this terminology. But *yawman ma* (one day). The last of the *musir wa mustakbir*, when will he go? You can keep thinking. But when he feels it in his heart, because everyone has freedom. So, anyway, this matter is... the corporeal world, which I am starting today, but for now, I cannot show you the whole thing. But what I have to tell you is that these sects were formed in this way. And the last sect of remorse was us.

Now what happened? When we started to fall from there, at the time of falling, because our remorse was the highest, they... they began to look at us with a compassionate gaze. "Oh, they are also being thrown down. Oh..." "Okay, if you fall, you fall, no harm, but we are the ones who will take care of you. We will send our *du'at* to you first. We will be the first to explain the Quran to you. We will be the ones to give you guidance. Yes, yes, we will hold your hand."

So the *A'immah* held our hand. But whose hand did they hold? The one who had repented. Not one person can be added there, not one person can be subtracted. This was the very point, that the Prophet was making efforts to elevate these repentant ones. And... "*mā anzalnā ʿalayka l-qurʾāna li-tashqā*" (We have not sent down the Quran to you to cause you distress). The Quran says, "O Prophet, we did not reveal the Quran upon you for you to undergo hardship." He was undergoing hardship upon hardship. And he is in the effort of elevating them, so that the line of remorse may increase. So many efforts the Prophet was making. But because the Lord of the worlds knows that whatever the intention was there, the action will be here. So the one who has become a *musir wa mustakbir*, no matter how much he bangs his head, even if you bring the whole world's wealth and place it before him, he is not going to become a *shakk wa mutaraddid*.

He will become one *yawman ma* (one day), after being beaten and beaten and beaten in the *dawlab* for lakhs of years, he will become one. Similarly, it will take an age for a *shakk wa mutaraddid* to become a believer. Whatever has happened there, its reflection will appear here. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, had this in view, and despite that, he was trying. Because your mercy was so vast. Your rank was so high. You had been given authority over everyone. That is why the Mercy to the Worlds wanted to reform everyone and make them enter Islam.

When this started happening, Allah Ta'ala saw that the Prophet was undergoing a lot of difficulty. So, "*lā tahdī man aḥbabta wa-lākinna llāha yahdī man yashāʾ*" (You do not guide whom you love, but Allah guides whom He wills). This verse was revealed, that, "O Prophet, you cannot guide whom you wish." Why? Look, the Prophet is a guide, the Mercy to the Worlds, the greatest scholar, the City of Knowledge, he is everything... the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him... why didn't... why did Allah Ta'ala say to the Prophet that you cannot give guidance? Because whatever has happened there, its reflection will appear here. Why are you trying, O Prophet? Those who have become believers will be believers. Those who have become disbelievers will remain disbelievers. Even if you bang your head, or show miracles, or bring the sky down to earth, he will never believe. Just as today you... it is known that prayer has so many benefits. Can you make someone steadfast in the five daily prayers?

You know that fasting has so many benefits. They will accept it. Yes, the benefits are... "I accept it with my heart." But when it comes to doing it... "It should be accepted with the heart." Does accepting it with the heart bring the benefit?

Does writing "gold" give you gold? It doesn't happen like that. So, just by knowing a thing, you do not attain that thing. That thing is not attained. To attain it, one has to attain it. So, in the same way, the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, did a lot. But it is that this... verse came down and the revelation was revealed that "*lā tahdī man aḥbabta*" ("You do not guide whom you love"). "O Prophet, the one you wish to guide, that cannot happen." "*wa-lākinna llāha yahdī man yashāʾ*" (but Allah guides whom He wills). Allah guides whom He wills. Whom does Allah will? Allah wills as you will. When you will, Allah... That is why it has come in the noble Quran that we have not... "We have not changed the condition of any people until they themselves have had the thought to change." It is in the Quran.

So this means that for the community, it has been told, for the group, it has been told, and for the individual, it has been told. That they can never change. Whatever has happened, has happened in the *'alam-e zarr* (world of particles). Now, I am starting the corporeal world. Before that, two things as a preface need to be stated. Because they are very necessary in terms of the corporeal world. One thing is that, what is our *jan* (life/soul)?

The spirit that we keep shouting about, the soul that we call it, so... that thing. What is the *jan*? The truth is, we are unaware of this *jan*. Understand? Now, for this, what will I say? I will only say, "Die and know." That you die and then you will know. So, what should we achieve? What should we do? This *jan*, this... you can go to any corner of the world, ask anyone, ask a common person, ask an educated person, he will say that so-and-so's *intiqal* (passing away) happened. Or in other words, he will say that his *jan* (soul) left. This is what is said, "*jan nikal gayi*" (the soul left). Does the soul leave? The soul leaves. Yes, brother, thousands die, the soul certainly leaves. But what is the reality? The soul can only leave if the soul is inside. But what is the reality? The true, true fact is that first, let's understand how many *jans* there are. We think there is one *jan*, but there isn't even one *jan*. There are three *jans*. And second is that regarding the *jan*, we understand that our *jan*, our soul, is inside us. It's wrong. It is wrong. It is a big lie. It is completely wrong that our *jan* is inside us. It's wrong. The *jan* is what? It is outside of us. The *jan* is outside of us. Our *jan* is not inside us. Now you will say, "Brother, the proof for this?" I will give it. The proof is that any power in the world, it will always work on the surface, not inside. For example, take electricity, take steam, take any power, it will always work on the surface. There is an electric wire, so the wire... I will tell you that the switch is here and the light came on there. So you will say, "Yes, I flipped the switch and the light came on." So if I ask you, "How did the light get there?" You will say, "Through the wire." If you say "through the wire," but if I ask you, "Did it go *through* the wire?" you will have to think. Your answer "through the wire" will be a common answer. It will not be an intelligent answer. It doesn't go through the wire. Electricity always travels on the surface. You know this simple fact. It travels on the surface. It does not go through the core of the thing. So, in the same way, this *ruh* (spirit) that we have, it is on our surface. That's why what happens? If you cut off a foot, you remain alive. If you cut off a hand, you remain alive. And if the head is slightly cut off? You are finished. This is because the surface has been contacted. You will say, "I should not have kept my hand there." The contact would have been broken. The contact that Allah has, it is not going to be broken by your hand being cut. But the point is that the contact, whatever it is, is from the head. From the head. Now, regarding understanding the *ruh*. As I told you, you understood that the *ruh* is not inside us, but outside. Inside are all the things, for example, machinery. The machinery moves because of what? It moves... on the surface, that wheel that turns, because of which the entire factory starts to run. But it acts on the surface. And it runs everything. Nothing comes inside. So, in the same way, inside us are our limbs and organs. And what is the thing that runs these limbs and organs? It is our *jan*. It is the *nafs*. The moment that *nafs* comes into contact with us, this entire inner world becomes populated. The eyes start to see, the nose to smell, the ears to hear, the tongue to taste. All the limbs. Though they are the same limbs and organs, but just let the soul depart. Now you... now speak, taste, taste a little bit. You can neither taste, nor see, nor do anything. Nothing. So it is known that the world has become dark. So that contact broke. If you broke the contact, it is suicide. And if nature did it, then it is your natural death. And if you have done it, then that is an offense. Nature had given you a blessing, and you did that. Now this is a separate branch of discussion. Now I don't want to bring that into the discussion for now. So you should understand that is what suicide is. Anyway, this contact is there. So which *ruh* of ours has the contact? How many types of *ruh* are there? This is what Mawla al-Kainaat Amir al-Mu'minin said, that the *ruh* is of three types. Which are they? One is *Namiyah* (vegetative), one is *Hissiyah* (sensory), and one is *Natiqah* (rational). The *Namiyah ruh* is the one that is changing inanimate objects (*jamadat*) into plants (*nabatat*). That *ruh* which brings inanimate objects into the realm of plants, the quality of sprouting, the quality of growing, this quality that it creates from inanimate objects into plants, this quality's name is what? *Namiyah*. And taking the *ruh* from plants and bringing it into animals, so that sensation (*hiss*) is also created in them, not just the power of growth, but sensation also comes, that is called *Hissiyah*. And taking it from animals and bringing it to the level fit for humanity, that power, its name is *Natiqah*. Meaning, the power of speech also comes. Understand it again. The thing that comes from inanimate to plant is *Namiyah*. From plant to animal is *Hissiyah*. From animal to the human body is *Natiqah*. *Namiyah* is given only to what? To plants. It knows how to grow. It doesn't know how to walk. Trees don't walk. What do animals have? Only sensation (*hiss*). And they can feel. They can't speak. They will feel heat and cold. And the third thing is what? *Natiqah* was given to man, speaking. Now, what is speaking? That this speaking, which is done with the tongue, the scholars understand this to be *Natiqah*. They have defined the powers, but they have not explained that the *nafs* has three types in this way. So *Natiqah*, *Hissiyah*, and *Namiyah*, these three things exist. But the reality is that *Namiyah* and *Hissiyah*... the three children of the heavens and the earth are plants, animals, and minerals. From these three children, these three things have come. What thing has come? *Namiyah*, *Hissiyah*, *Natiqah*. They are from sensation and *Natiqah*. So taking these three things, they say that all these things are working in the universe, and these things are coming like this. But what happens is that in reality, two *nafs* are formed from this. The first is *Namiyah*, which is from *numuww* (growth). This is the first *nafs*. That man, when... from the earth, "*sulālatin min ṭīn*" (an extract of clay), the Quran says that you were drawn like a fragrance from the earth. "*wa jaʿalnāhu fi qarārin makīn*" (And We placed him in a firm lodging). "*wa jaʿalnāhu nutfatan fi qarārin makīn*" (And We made him a drop in a firm lodging). And we placed the drop in a firm lodging. So this placing that happened. Now this is the second stage. Then "*khalaqnā al-nuṭfata ʿalaqatan fa-khalaqnā al-ʿalaqata muḍghatan fa-khalaqnā al-muḍghata ʿiẓāman fa-kasawnā al-ʿiẓāma laḥman*" (We made the drop into a clot, then We made the clot into a lump, then We made the lump into bones, and We clothed the bones with flesh). All these stages of the fetus, Allah Ta'ala has enumerated. But the point is, the fragrance that was drawn and brought into this mold, that which was drawn, as soon as it came and found stability, with that stability, a *nafs* is created, which is called *Namiyah*. If this *Namiyah nafs* were not there, then that child in the mother's womb would not grow. It would not grow at all. So it is known that it is the miracle of the *Nafs-e Namiyah* that it spreads and grows in the mother's womb. The limbs and organs are all created. This is all the work of *Namiyah*. And as soon as it came out of the mother's womb, it receives a thing because of which it starts to breathe. And with breathing, what does it get? It gets *Hissiyah*. So these are the only two *nafs* that the entire universe has. Meaning, the entire universe... what does that mean? All the people of the world have. But we Sulaimanis have three *nafs*. We have three *nafs*. There is a third *nafs* as well. And that third *nafs* that we get is *Natiqah*. And that *Natiqah* is what thing? It is not this *nutq* (speech). This is metaphorical speech.
