So the `ruhani `alam`... from it, the `jismani `alam` is below, and `kasafat` comes below, and this came below. But how far below did it come? What did it come to? If you sit there and measure it, there is no measure, there is no `kasafat`. That is a `latif` world. What can you say about that `latif` world? It was removed from there, and after being removed, this `hayula` that was there, `hayula` and `surah`, this entire block that was... which consists of the `shak wa mutar` and `nadim mustagfir` and `musirr wa mustakbir`, this whole thing came downwards. And after coming, `Qudrat` willed for a time that it should go down, and after going down, it stopped it. Now, `Qudrat` stopped it. You might say, "Well, it was Allah's `Qudrat` (power) that wanted it, and as it wants, `Qudrat` does as it wants." But now what is it? In the `jismani `alam`, `Qudrat` will never act directly. Remember this. Without means (`asbab`), `Qudrat` will never act. Meaning, this is the `dar-i asbab` (abode of means). Here, a cause (`sabab`) will be formed. So much so that the belief of common Muslims that a miracle (`mo'jizah`) is a miracle, not a single such miracle has happened. Not a single miracle, in the sense that Muslims understand it, has happened. It was only a feat (`karamat`) of sight. It was appearing to our eyes. Neither the sun turned back, nor the moon split, nor did anything happen. In the world, not a single miracle... indeed, the thousands of miracles that the prophets showed, they all happened, but how did they happen? As things visible to the eyes. But in reality, had they changed their form (`qalib`)? Or had the sun changed? Or had such and such happened? Nothing. It is for this very reason that this thing does not happen, but is visible to the eyes. What will `Qudrat` do here? It is the `dar-i asbab`. Here, if our cause (`sabab`) is hot, there will be heat; if it is cold, there will be cold. It is the `dar-i asbab`, and in the `dar-i asbab`, all these things will happen. The prayer we make to Allah Ta'ala is only this: that our means (`asbab`) be changed, our means be altered. So, in the `dar-i asbab`, everything will happen by a cause. Without a cause (`cause`), without a `sabab`, nothing is going to happen here, in this world. So now, when this `hayula` fell, `Qudrat` stopped it, and it stopped it through them. Now, what is it? For example, understand that if in the community here, I see that we are having a confrontation with someone, God forbid there is a fight, then we will take such young men who are well-built, who are like good wrestlers, we will call them and say, "Please come and help, such and such a thing is happening." Why, sir? Today you are not looking for highly educated people, but such people? So if such a matter arises, then it will be like that. If it is an intellectual matter, we will choose scholars from among them. If some other matter arises, we will choose some other people. So for every aspect, a selection is made. For every aspect, a selection is made. For whichever aspect it is created, for that aspect it is chosen. So now what happened here? `Qudrat`, on that falling group, that entire block that was falling, in it, `Qudrat`'s sight was on a few people, and through them, `Qudrat` saw that they are such, whether they are `musirr wa mustakbir`, or `shak wa mutar`, or `nadim mustagfir`. They can be in any of them. Do you understand? It is a technical (`fanni`) matter. So, from a technical perspective, there were some powers, there were some among those falling, whom `Qudrat` entrusted with this task, that you should stand firm in your place and stop. So they became firm in exactly the same way as pegs (`mekhein`) are. To pitch a tent, there is a peg, and the tent is pitched with the help of the peg. In exactly the same way, like a peg, they stopped that `hayula`, and there were four pegs. It was through these four pegs that this entire `hayula` was stopped. Their names are Ghalib, 'Ashir, Rabi', and Talib. Talib, 'Ashir, Rabi', Ghalib. These are four powers (`quwwatein`), and these are the names of the four powers. And these are four powers that, like nails, like pegs, they caught hold of it and controlled it, and this `hayula`, this `hayula` and `surah`, stopped at one place. When it stopped, `Qudrat` began to give it shape. That to it... in it, whatever had fallen, this falling group, in this group, `Qudrat` had already made an arrangement from the beginning, that he who is high is high. Meaning, the one who repents, the one who repents, the one who repents the most, is always like cream on top. No matter how much you churn, the froth comes on top. So that cream was on top. And it was on top. Through that cream, what did `Qudrat` do? It gave it rotation (`gardish`). This `hayula`, `hayula` and `surah`, it gave it rotation through that cream, which is the leaven of `nadamah` (regret). From the leaven of `nadamah`, it gave this rotation, and that entire `hayula` and `surah` went into rotation and began to spin. And its spinning was just like if we take an onion and pierce it with a skewer and spin it very fast. In exactly the same way, this entire `hayula` and `surah` were spinning. And they were spinning on whose weight? From the top surface. The top surface, which was `awwal al-nawadim` (the first of the repentant), it was the leaven of the most `nadamah`. And through it, `Qudrat` made everything spin. As soon as they spun, what happened? `Qudrat`, since it now wanted a workshop (`karkhanah`) to be made, a prison (`qayd-khanah`) to be made, and in it there should be some prisoners, and some wardens for the prison. So all these things, the prison, the requisites of the prison, and the wardens of the prison, and whatever else there is, who will all these be? They will be from among them. `khud kuzah gar o khud gil-i kuzah` (He is the potter and the clay of the pot Himself). Meaning, everything will be from among them. The prisoner is the same, the prison is the same, living is the same, eating is the same, and their comforts are the same, and the punishment is also the same. All things, all provisions, are also the same. So there is no difference in anything, it is all the same thing. The wall and this and that, the house and the mountain and the tree, all these things, what are they? They are all one. They are spirits (`ashbah`) that have taken on different forms. So this entire `hayula`, when it fell from there, now this upper part, when it started spinning... this leaven of `nadamah` that was there, when it started spinning, it made the lower parts spin too. And when it started spinning, this uppermost part, it is obviously a sphere. So the entire upper part, this which is, it is called `falak-i muhit` (the encompassing sphere). It is called `falak-i muhit`, it is called `atlas`, it is called `bab `alam al-quds` (the gate of the world of holiness). Do you understand? `Atlas` is the name of a cloth which has no embroidery (`bel buta`). You know `atlas`, you must have seen it, that it has no embroidery. That's why it's named `atlas`. And it is also called `basit`. It is also called `muhit`, and also `basit`, and also `atlas`. It is called `muhit` because it encompasses everything. It is called `basit` because it is completely transparent, there is no obstructing thing in it. And it is called `atlas` because it has no embroidery-like pattern. So it was given various names in various ways. And it is called `bab `alam al-quds` because if you enter from there, where will you go? You will go towards `kal-lumum`. If you take a step towards the `alam-i ruhani`. So it means that this is the most `basit` (vast/simple) part, and this `muhit` spun the lower part. Now `Qudrat` wanted... `Qudrat` wanted, the way it wanted, it is making it. Just like a potter takes clay and gives it the shape he wants. Now, in the same way, why? Because you... just as to give an animal an injection or to operate on it, you first restrain it with a sliding door. First you tie it down. After tying it down, you can give it an injection or whatever. Otherwise, if you go to give an injection to a lion, it's not a small matter. So in the same way, first we were tied down. And after being tied down, all this was done in this manner. When it was tied down, now `Qudrat` is giving it shapes. So as soon as they spun, the upper part, along with its spinning, the lower part also started to spin. And the lower part that spun, and the part below it also spun. But what happened was that if the upper part was spinning in this way, then the part below it was spinning in this way. And the part below that was spinning in this way, in the opposite... in the opposite direction it spun. In the opposite direction it began to spin. So when the upper part spun, the part below it that spun, the part below the `falak-i muhit` that spun, that was called `falak-i buruj` (the sphere of constellations). And the part below the `falak-i buruj` that spun, that was called `zuhal` (Saturn). `Falak-i zuhal` (the sphere of Saturn). The part below the `falak-i zuhal` that spun in this way, that was called `falak-i mushtari` (the sphere of Jupiter). And the part below it that spun, that was called `falak-i mirrikh` (the sphere of Mars). The part below it that spun, that was called `falak-i shams` (the sphere of the Sun). Below that, `zuhrah` (Venus), `utarid` (Mercury), and `qamar` (Moon). In the way it spun, it was called `falak-i mushtari`. And the part below it that spun, it was called `falak-i mirrikh`. The part below it that spun, it was called `falak-i shams`. Below that, `zuhrah`, `utarid`, and `qamar`. It means that these are the seven `kaukab` (planets), the seven planets have seven `falak` (spheres), and these are its suspended spheres, and all these planets are revolving in their own spheres. Now, `Qudrat` wanted it to be this way, so the upper part, as soon as it spun, its... just as the layers of an onion are separate, in the same way, these were breaking off, they were becoming separate. So the first part that happened, I told you, was the `falak-i muhit`, which encompasses everything. And inside it, the first part that separated, it is called `falak-i buruj` (the sphere of constellations). Now why `falak-i buruj`? I will tell you, insha'Allah. And the part below the `falak-i buruj` was `falak-i zuhal` (the sphere of Saturn). In this, there is only one `kaukab` (planet), and that planet is revolving, and the name of that planet is `zuhal` (Saturn). Below Saturn was Jupiter, below Jupiter was Mars, below Mars was the Sun, below the Sun were Venus, Mercury, and the Moon. These seven stars, seven spheres, are revolving, and on the seven spheres, the `falak-i buruj` is the eighth sphere, and above the eighth, the highest sphere is which one? `Falak-i muhit`. `Falak-i muhit`, I said, is `falak-i basit` (the vast/simple sphere), and it is `atlas`, and there is no star or anything there. It is a completely ethereal quality. And it is completely a `basit` quality. Now below it is the `falak-i buruj`. What is `falak-i buruj`? It is such a sphere in which all the stars we see are in it. All these stars are in it. It is obvious, after that the planets began. Among the planets, the first was Saturn (`zuhal`). After Saturn came Jupiter (`mushtari`), after Jupiter came Mars (`mirrikh`), after Mars came the Sun (`shams`), after the Sun came Venus (`zuhrah`), Mercury (`utarid`), and the Moon (`qamar`). These seven `sayyare` (planets) came, and `sayyare` are those which move. And `sitare` (stars) are those which are fixed in their place, they do not move, from their place... that's why they are called `sawabit` (the fixed ones). These are `sawabit`, and these are `sayyare`. There is a big difference between the two. Now, this which was `falak-i buruj` became the second sphere. The third sphere is Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon. Why did Allah Ta'ala establish this order? I will explain that a little. The matter is actually this, that... if you see, the seven... first the spheres were formed. On the seven spheres, the eighth sphere was `falak-i buruj`. And on `falak-i buruj` was `falak-i muhit`. This is the matter of nine, which is why a child's birth takes nine months. Otherwise, the completion (`takmil`) of the child happens in seven months. In seven months, the child is alive and is completed. And these seven planets are responsible for the seven months. But this eighth and ninth, these two months that are extra, they allude to these two spheres. Okay. And the second thing is that if you... this whole arrangement... if you want to see it within this cosmos, it's possible from an intellectual perspective that you may or may not understand it, but just as Allah Ta'ala says that "We... what are you... from an extract of clay" —*salatun min tin*— "We drew you like an extract from clay." *fa-ja`alnahu fi qararin makin* (then We placed him in a firm lodging)... *fa-ja`alnahu nutfatan fi qararin makin* (then We made him a sperm-drop in a firm lodging). And We made you a `nutfah` (sperm-drop) and placed you in a secure place. *fa-ja`alnahu nutfatan `alaqatan fa-khalaqna 'l-`alaqata muzghatan fa-khalaqna 'l-muzghata `izaman fa-kasawna 'l-`izama lahman summa ansha'nahu khalqan akhar* (Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump of flesh, and We made the lump of flesh into bones, and We clothed the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation). This is a verse of the Quran Majeed. The Lord of the worlds explains seven stages of the birth of an embryo. Now tell me, look, first of all, `sulalah`. `Sulalah` means to draw out. That which is the water in the father's backbone, that is called `sulalah`. That `sulalah` is the `muhit`. And `falak-i buruj` is the `nutfah`. And the `nutfah`... the seven `aflak` (spheres), these seven spheres are `muzghah` (a lump of flesh). And `alaqah` (a clinging clot), `izam` (bones), and `lahm` (flesh) are `madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` (mineral, plant, and animal). And `insan` (human) is the `khalq-i akhar` (other creation). It is in this way. Okay. From another perspective, if you see, I will show you a map from another perspective. That `Qudrat` made this arrangement, that if you want to take a print (`naqsh`) of something, you first have to make a reverse print on the ring. You will make a reverse print, then you will get a correct print. If you don't take a reverse print, you will not get a correct print. So `Qudrat`, since the birth of man had to happen, for the birth of man, `Qudrat` made a reverse map. How did it make the reverse map? That first the feet come. And after that, the heart's part comes, and after that, the brain comes. The brain comes last. So this is the reverse map. So Saturn and Mars are the feet. Saturn and Mars, which are above, they are in the place of the feet. And the heart is the sun. And the moon is the brain. And the brain is the `wazir` (minister). The moon is the `wazir` of the sun. The sun is the king of the spheres. So this entire map, you see, is of a reverse man, because of which a correct man was established here. Anyway, this was a philosophical matter, but I was saying that `falak-i muhit`, `falak-i buruj`, and the spheres below it, what are they made of? `Qudrat` selected them... just as a potter has clay in his hand, and he takes the clay as he wishes and does with it, in the same way, we were caught in the hands of `Qudrat`. We were stuck. Now we are in the hands of `Qudrat`. How did `Qudrat` select? It selected in such a way that all the `nadim` (repentant ones)... listen carefully. The repentant ones, all the repentant ones... from the repentant ones, this shining world was made. The ones who fell with repentance, from those repentant ones, this `jirmani `alam` (corporeal world), this shining, glittering world was made. From `falak-i muhit` down to `falak-i shams`. All the `nadimin` (repentant ones) were spent, were used up. In what? In the making of... from `falak-i muhit` down to `falak-i qamar`. They were all finished in the making of it. This... in other words, what will we say? This is the storage of the `nadimin`. The `nadimin`... The world below the spheres is called `ummhat` (mothers). These are all called fathers, and these are called mothers. The world below is called mothers, and this is called fathers. The result of the union and marriage of this mother and father, what is it? The children are `madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` (mineral, plant, and animal). And a type of animal is man. Now, you have seen from top to bottom that the entire `jirmani `alam`, the shining, glittering world, all of it, is made from the `nadimin`. So the `ummhat` below, what are they made of? From the `shak wa mutar`. And who are they? `Ab wa atish, bad wa khak` (water and fire, wind and earth). Meaning, these are the four elements. First, the sphere of fire was made, after that, the sphere of air was made, then the sphere of water was made, and then the sphere of earth was made. Now, how they were made, I will tell you. But you are being told that these spheres are the `ummhat`. Now, who was spent in the `ummhat`? The `shak wa mutar`. The `shak wa mutar` were entirely spent within this. Now you see, the power and quality of `ab wa atish, bad wa khak` (water and fire, wind and earth)... what is its nature? That if a sphere of fire is made, then fire is that thing which, as you observe day and night, has flames (`shole`), `lab`, `ilhab`, `iltihab`. That is, that flaring up and that which happens... so you see the flames, there is no rest (`chain`). Just as the `shak wa mutar` has no rest, a person in doubt has no rest, so is the nature of fire. And then, what is the state of the air? It is being buffeted. And what is the quality of water? It is a flowing wave. Wavy water, and what is the quality of earth? Dust rises from it. So it means that these four things, this turbulence (`tamawwuj`) that is in them, this restlessness (`be-qarar pan`), why did it come? It came from the `shak wa mutar`. That's why Iqbal said, "Stability is only for change in time." Meaning, if anything has stability in this time, then what does it have? Change. To change, to keep changing, only this one thing has stability. So change is inherent in this world. So it means that these `ummhat` that were made, they were made from the `shak wa mutar`. Now, you see, who has been spent? The `nadimin`... from them, the entire `jirmani `alam` was made. And the `ummhat` were made from whom? From the `shak wa mutar`. Now who is left? The `musirr wa mustakbir`. `Musirr wa mustakbir`, of which there are 35 `firqas` (sects). These, which are the most numerous in number, and the most severe in their power and their denial. These `musirr wa mustakbir`, what did `Qudrat` do with them? Just as here in the dungeon, the biggest prisoner is put, and they are tied up with plenty of fetters, and are put in a dark place, in exactly the same way, `Qudrat` also decided that these who were `musirr wa mustakbir`, they were put under the feet. They were put under the feet. This earth that we see, this is the upper part of the earth. This solid (`saladi`) part of the earth, the hard part, this part and the part inside the earth, this entire part was made from whom? From the `musirr wa mustakbir`. And from the `musirr wa mustakbir`, this part was made. And now `Qudrat`'s artistry is evident, that `Qudrat` wanted this prison... this itself is a prison. This whole world, this world of water and clay (`ab-o gil`), is a prison. Although you... in this prison too... it is obvious that you may be disheartened with your life, but what happens? Man adjusts himself. In exactly the same way, we... what are we doing? Despite knowing that temperaments are very strange and so on, but we don't bring complaints to our lips. We say, "We'll take some medicine, we'll do something, but we'll adjust." So we keep adjusting ourselves. So in exactly the same way, our condition is here. And `Qudrat`... these `musirr wa mustakbir` were put under our feet. And `Qudrat` made this arrangement, that this prison is for everyone to live in, but within this prison, another prison needs to be made. Within this prison, another prison needs to be made. Just as every country has a prison, a `prison`, in the same way, this whole world should have a prison, which `Qudrat` named what in the words of the Quran? Jahannam. Jahannam. Now, ask all Muslims, "Where is Jahannam?" Amir al-Mu'minin... people came and asked during the time of the caliphs, they asked, "Maulana, tell us, where is Jahannam?" The breadth of the heavens and the earth (*Arz wa samawat wa al-arz*) is so vast, so where will this Jahannam be? He said, "Tell me this, when it is day, where is the night? And when it is night, where is the day?" Strange, strange questions the questioner asked. Anyway. So the point was that for them, there is no fixed location for Jahannam, nor any fixed location for Jannah. No fixed location at all. If you ask about Jannah, they will show it on their palm. They will tell you Jannah... this is the date palm tree, and these are fruit-laden branches, and these are `hur` and `ghilman` roaming around, and four rivers are flowing. This is the map of Jannah. This is the Jannah of the Muslims. And indeed, if the Quran has called this Jannah, then that metaphorical Jannah (`majazi jannah`), I will tell you about that too. How that will be. But that... when its time comes, it will come. For now, you must believe that the most important thing is that Jannah for us is to reach the `ruhani `alam`. This is Jannah. And to remain in the lowest part of `jismaniyyat`, to remain in this prison, what is this? This is Duzakh (Hell). And it was made a Duzakh in the true sense. Now, the state of Duzakh... it is such that this whole... I want to start explaining the state of Duzakh from this because things start from the feet, so it is better if the explanation starts with Duzakh to reach Jannah. The matter of Duzakh is this, that `Qudrat` did this, that this earth, this solid (`saladi`) earth that we have, in the inner part of this earth, Jahannam was made. But since the center (`markaz`) is the `Ka`batullah`, it... Jahannam does not come exactly perpendicular to it, but the... some part of Jannah... it is not opposite to it, but is made slightly shifted. And how big was it made? Those going to Jahannam are also many, after all. For this reason, a very big Jannah... uh, Jahannam was made. Duzakh is quite large. And it is so large that its... no calculation can be made of it, but those who can calculate have its complete dimensions. How long it is, how wide it is, what its quality is, what its temperature is, how many parts it has, how many zones (`mintaqe`) it has, how many valleys (`wadiyan`) it has, and what the names of those valleys are. By God, all this exists. But for your information, what I am telling you is this, that in it there are 70 valleys. 70 valleys. There are mountain ranges inside too. And how deep is it? This is the central core. What science calls the central core, that is in reality Jahannam. For example, this is the sphere of the world, and it is spinning. So its inside (`jauf`), its belly, and the central core, which is called the central core, in the words of science, that central core is in reality Jahannam. And science, till today, has not been able to find out about it. Till today, it has not been able to research it. It only says that it is in liquid form or in gas form. It is possible that it is gas, possible that it is liquid form. It is only this much that science has said and left it. But what is the reality? It is neither in liquid form entirely, nor... nor is it in gas form, but you will have to understand. Anyway, it has 70 valleys and it is quite vast. And the mention of this very thing, the Quran Majeed, in one surah, in one `ruku'`, Allah Ta'ala has described Jahannam completely. That *taghliyul hamim* (boiling of heated water)... the words that have come in this way, and the whole of Jahannam has been described in it. Now what is there in Jahannam? There... it is not... as we think, that if there is a spark here, then there... the real fire is there. This is actually just for explaining, for making one understand. That there... the atmosphere (`fiza`) there is a fiery atmosphere. An inciting (`bhadka denewali`) atmosphere. So inciting that there is no limit to it. No limit. Imagine that this sun, which is so hot, what do we estimate about the sun? Its heat... science has measured how much heat there is. And today, what they are saying is that its heat is decreasing. We have been saying for 1400 years that its heat will decrease. And its heat is decreasing. The sun is losing its heat. And this sun, the flames that are in it, the biggest flame that emerges from it is 200 miles long. A 200-mile-long flame is what science has seen emerging from the sun's... from the sun. And imagine, this sun, which is giving you life, which is providing heat, and is providing heat to the whole world, this sun, despite this, it is so hot and has so much of everything, but this is not Jahannam. Jahannam is much worse than this. And it is much greater than this. Its heat and its... you can't even ask. `na'uzubillah`, `na'uzubillah`, it is much more. Now, Jahannam is... how deep is it? Science has... what it has measured of this earth, has drilled it, has dug it, that is 80,000 feet. So far, science has gone 80,000 feet deep. It has not gone further than that. And this is just like pricking an orange peel with a pin. As he has written about an orange, that it is like pricking an orange peel with a pin. It has only gone that deep so far. It has not gone deeper than that. So now you tell me, how deep must it be? It has only gone 80,000 feet, and this is the central core. It is very deep. And its... there are valleys, there are different divisions, there are different qualities, and... anyway, when the detailed discussion of Jahannam comes, I will explain it then. For now, I was telling you this, that Jahannam was made from the `musirr wa mustakbir`, and they were placed in Jahannam. So anyway, the divisions that `Qudrat` made, from the `nadim wa mustagfir`, the shining, glittering world was made. The `alam-i ummhat` (world of mothers) was made from `shak wa mutar`. From `musirr wa mustakbir`, Jahannam was made. Now, these are all finished. And this surface of the earth, it was made just like a stage. A stage is that where the actors who come from the green room, they play their parts. Those who come out from behind this curtain, whether they are those who come from the heavens, or those who come from the `shak wa mutar`, or those who come from the `musirr wa mustakbir` from this Jahannam, everyone comes and plays their part. The `shaqi al-qalb` (hard-hearted ones), they only know how to wield swords and shoot guns. They only know how to fight and kill. And those who are in doubt, you can explain to them a million times, do whatever you want, but they will not leave their doubt. The state of the `nadim wa mustagfir` is that if you say a little, they will bow their head. So these who are playing their parts, all three types of people are coming, where? To this `masrah-i shuhud` (stage of witnessing), on this earth. These three are all coming. So `Qudrat` made this arrangement, that the `jirmani `alam` was made entirely from `nadamah`. The parts below it, the `ummhat`, how were they made? From `shak wa mutar`. How were the `shak wa mutar` made? I will explain that a little. The way `shak wa mutar` were made was that `Qudrat`... when all these heavens were spinning, the spheres were spinning, for example, `falak-i muhit` spun, `falak-i buruj` also started to spin. `Falak-i buruj` spun, Saturn spun, Saturn spun, Jupiter spun, Jupiter spun, Mars spun, below Mars, the Sun spun, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, all these spun. Now, the very last sphere was that of the Moon. When the Moon's sphere spun, it is obvious that the atmosphere below it became hot. As soon as the Moon's sphere spun, the atmosphere below it became hot. And as soon as the atmosphere became hot, heat has two properties. What are they? `yubusat` (dryness) and `hararat` (heat). Meaning, heat and dryness. These two things were created in it. Now see, the blend of male and female is here too. `hararat` and `yubusat` are male qualities, and `rutubat` (moisture) and `burudat` (coldness) are the qualities of the female. Anyway, this was a side point. But now, this `hararat` and `yubusat` started to move. For example, this is a rod. If you apply fire to it at the bottom, then what will happen here? This will become hot. So the heat, while spreading, will reach here. But the hot part that is here, that part will not be here. This is a common matter. So the hot part, as much as it is here, will not be here. In the same way, from the friction of the Moon, the part above was hotter than the part below. So as far as the heat reached, that was called the sphere of ether (`kurrah-i asir`), the sphere of fire. And where it started to lose heat, a time will come when there is no heat in that rod. So in the same way, where the heat ended, what came there? Coldness (`burudat`) came. And `burudat` and `yubusat` are the properties of air. So the sphere of air started to form from there. `Burudat` and `yubusat`, these two qualities... these qualities, `burudat` and `yubusat`, these two... cold and these two things... the sphere of air started to form and it... while going, these two qualities, cold and dryness, they both started going, and a layer was formed. And the layer ended where the heat ended. `yubusat` ended. When dryness ended, it was necessary for its place to be filled, and moisture (`moisture`) came. `Rutubat` (moisture) and `burudat` (coldness) are the properties of water. The sphere of water began to form. And the sphere of water, while forming, came down. And this is `burudat` and `rutubat`. Now coldness ended, but moisture remained. With moisture, heat came again. And `hararat` (heat) and `rutubat` (moisture) are the properties of earth. The sphere of earth began to form. So in this way, these spheres were formed. The upper sphere is the sphere of ether (`kurrah-i asir`), which is called the sphere of fire. And below it is the sphere of air. Below that is the sphere of water, which is also called `zamharir`. `kurrah-i zamharir`. And below `zamharir`, the sphere that was formed, what is it called? Sphere of earth (`kurrah-i khak`). So these four spheres were formed in this way, and below these four spheres, as I was telling you, Jahannam was formed. And Jahannam was made from whom? From the `musirr wa mustakbir`. From the `musirr wa mustakbir`, Jahannam was made. And Jahannam has various names: `saqim`, `duzakh`... but they are not different things, but the entire... the entire Jahannam is referred to by various names. But how people go into Jahannam, what the atmosphere is like there, where they are kept, how their... how they are moved from one zone to another, insha'Allah, the details will come. There are many details. But for now, the way I have to explain, since I have to explain the formation of the world, for this reason, I am explaining this much and leaving it, that you... your thirst should not remain, that you should understand how the spheres were formed. The sphere... there... first, how were the spheres formed? Below the spheres, how were the elements (`kurre`) formed? And below the elements, this Jahannam, how was it formed? This entire physical world, from what was it made? From the `musirr wa mustakbir`, `shak wa mutar`, and `nadim wa mustagfir`. When this entire world was formed, the Lord of the worlds, what did it do? It is surrounding this very world with this very world. It is controlling this world with this world itself. It is creating the cause and effect (`dar-i asbab`) from among its own people. Those who govern are also here, those whose... who feel are also here. Meaning, those who perceive and those who make others perceive are also here. They are all from among them. So the instruments that are effective, who are those instruments? The spheres (`aflak`). From `falak-i muhit` down to `falak-i buruj`, down to Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, all these are the effective planets. And what do they affect? They affect the `ummhat`, and they affect the `mawlid-i salasah` here on the surface of this earth. `Madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` (mineral, plant, and animal). `Madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` are not some separate thing. `Madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` are the three children of whom? Of the heavens and the earth. `Madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` are called `mawlid-i salasah`. These three are the children of the mother and father. The fathers are these spheres, the mothers are these `ummhat`. From the union of these `ummhat` and fathers, who were born? These `mawlid-i salasah`: `madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan`. In `madhan`, `nabat`, and `haywan` too, if you take `madhan`, in it there will be `shak wa mutar`, there will be `musirr wa mustakbir`, and in it there will also be `nadim wa mustagfir`. ...this entire formation, you did it, or... `Qudrat` did it, or you... gave support (`ta'id`)? It was supported. But the self did it. Support was indeed there. It was supported by all the `quwa-i dawwarah` from `aql-i awwal`. That support is there because the formation of the world is happening. So support was indeed there. But the most important work it did with its support was the creation of man. And which... I will tell you in detail. For now, you just see how the world is being formed. See the place (`makan`), the dweller (`makin`) will come later. Now the `makan` is coming. And the `makan` is not yet fully decorated. Now I am telling you in its raw state, how the order was created and how it was established. But keep this in mind, in what way this has happened. And in what way these `alat-i majburah` (constrained instruments), in what way they... on the `ummhat`, in what way they affect these `mawlid-i salasah`. Meaning, these planets all affect us. Why do they? Because they were made to have an effect. And who are all these? They are the `nadimin`. They were made from the `nadimin`. `Qudrat`, from whomever it wants to take work, it is taking work from them. It is taking its own work from the `ummhat`. But this entire world is made from whom? From the falling group. On whom the punishment came. On all of them. As the Quran has said, you have to enter this world. So who had to enter? The one who did `takhaluf` (opposition), who disobeyed there. All the disobedient ones have to come. Now, one thing to understand... let me explain a little point to you. That we are being commanded, "Look, you have disobeyed, you will have to enter this world." Now you... in this world, you see that the Lord of the Two Worlds also came, the Seal of the Messengers, and with Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa, may peace and blessings be upon him, Amir al-Mu'minin also came, and all the Ahl al-Bayt came, the Imams came, the prophets, 124,000 came. So you will say, "In this prison?" So `Qudrat` does not want that. `Qudrat` does not want that those who are pure and holy servants, who have repented, how can it send them to this world? How can it send them to this world, to this prison? And it is obvious that if you think, "We are stuck here, so they should be stuck too," this cannot happen. This also cannot happen. So now, if all these prophets and all these Imams came here, this is a very big point to understand. So you... these all... all the prophets and messengers, whom the entire Islamic world, `na'uzubillah`, `na'uzubillah`, says are `bashar` (humans), are our Rasul, are `insan` (men), are at the pinnacle of humanity. With such words, the blood boils. Hey, when the Quran is saying, *innama ana basharun mithlukum* (I am only a man like you), is there any rhetoric greater than the Quran? So `Qudrat` says, "Say, O Prophet, 'I am a man like you.'" I am a man. What was the need to say "like you"? So it means there is a point. The point is that they came here, you are seeing them. They came because they had to guide you. But the one who comes to guide is not called a prisoner. If a jailer is in a prison, he is not called a prisoner. A jailer, if he comes into your dungeon, or sits with the prisoner, or eats, even then he is not called a prisoner. And what happened here? The entire Islamic world is calling the Prophet an `insan`, is considering him a prisoner. `na'uzubillah`, `na'uzubillah`, they consider him a prisoner. And we do not consider him a prisoner. Do you understand our difference? A jailer, if he goes to a prison, he is a jailer. Wherever he is, he will remain a jailer. He does not become a prisoner. Just as in a hunting ground, a `shikar-gah`, when a hunter goes, then first the hunter has to wear a khaki dress. There are also some requisites for hunting. He knows how to shoot a gun, but along with that, the hunt... first he wears a khaki dress. Why, sir, did he wear a khaki dress? Because the atmosphere there, the grass there, he adopts its color. So that the animals become familiar with him, familiar with that atmosphere. And he can hunt with ease, the hunter. So first he will wear such a dress that he will make the prey familiar and then kill it. So in the same way, they, to hunt our fallen souls (`nufus-i habita`), these prophets came. So if they are coming wearing this dress, adopting the form of a man, then by God, do not call them human. They are coming, we are seeing them as human, but in reality, we are not seeing them. That's why Allah Ta'ala said, *wa tarahum yanzuruna ilayka wa hum la yubsirun* (And you see them looking at you, but they do not see). O Prophet... look at the rhetoric of the Quran! *wa tarahum yanzuruna ilayka wa hum la yubsirun*. *wa tarahum*, you see them that they are looking at you, but they do not see... `yubsirun` also means to see. *wa lakin la yubsirun*, and they do not see you, O Prophet, with the eye of the heart. *wa tarahum yanzuruna ilayka wa hum la yubsirun*. Hey, this is seeing with this fatty eye. This is only seeing with the external eye. If they saw with the eye of the heart, they would see you, O Prophet, as something else. So what did they do? Who was the Prophet? A great... at the pinnacle of humanity. They saw the Prophet as a human, and they attributed all the qualities of a human to the Prophet. It's not like that. He is... how can he be human at the pinnacle of humanity? When is he human at all? He is not a human like us. He became `bashar` so that we could be familiar. So how did he adopt that form, and how did he come? It is a detailed story, and when that time comes, you will hear it, how the prophets come, how the `awliya'` come, how their successions are established, how the `da'wah` is spread. All these details will come. For now, what I am telling you is that you must believe that there is a difference between the prisoner and the jailer. There is a great difference between us and them. And this difference... if you do not consider this `farq-i maratib` (difference of ranks), it is `zindiqi` (heresy). So it is necessary to understand this difference of ranks. These are the `awliya'-Allah` (friends of God), and there is a great difference between them and us. A difference like that of the earth and the sky. That's why what did Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, may peace and blessings be upon him, do? Once, it is a well-known incident, a famous incident, a very grand incident. That he was sitting, the court was assembled, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, may peace and blessings be upon him's. You... there, a man came and sat down. And upon sitting, he began to say to the Imam... he had come for the first time, he had heard a lot about the Imam, and after hearing from his friends, he came and sat in your court. And after sitting, he said, "I am seeing, there are two eyes, the nose is the same, the mouth is the same. He is a human just like us. What's the difference? He is a human just like me. And they say there is such a great difference between the Imam and us, I don't understand it. He looks like a human just like us." Now, he was thinking this, and everything was being revealed to the Imam. He was understanding everything, he was reading his... his mind. Now, when `thought-reading` is happening, that a person can generate such powers, and he was the Imam. He is the master of the universe. He was sitting. He read his thoughts. After reading, he said, "This person, come here for a moment." He came immediately. He thought, "I have been called in the court, I cannot refuse." He came. Near the Imam. The Imam said, "Sir, my back is itching, please scratch it for me." You said, "I am itching, scratch it." And you were wearing a silk (`reshmi`) shawl. He removed the shawl a little and you said, "My... I am itching, please... scratch my back." Since our hand doesn't reach there, it's a known fact. And he came, and after removing your shawl, he raised his hand to scratch, and he saw that the entire back was covered with boils and sores. And pus and matter were oozing from it. Now he was very scared. He said that "what I was thinking, this is even worse than that. I was considering him a human, but this... the state is that he is called an Imam, and look at the Imam's condition, that this is the state of his back." Now, when this was the state, he... he couldn't do anything in front of all the people. He went and sat down. After scratching, he went and sat down. He said, "What a mess I've gotten into." Anyway, he sat quietly. After that, after a little while, the Imam saw him and said, "My back is itching again, please scratch it." Now he came, and what does he see? The back is completely clear. Completely clear. He was surprised. "Just now I saw that there were all boils and sores, and now it is completely clear here. What's the matter?" And he went and sat down. A little while passed, and the Imam said, "Scratch it again." A third time, you got him up. Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, may peace and blessings be upon him. He came. As soon as he raised his hand to scratch, he couldn't find the back. Now the back is not there. And his hand is going through the shawl. *`ala an kama kan* (back to as it was). *kulla yawmin huwa fi sha'n* (every day He is in [a new] matter). "In whose hand is the divine, that servant am I." So what will you understand of the Imam's powers and the Imam's matters? Insha'Allah, the details will come aplenty, insha'Allah. We will understand the `imamat`, we will understand the Imam too. For now, what I was saying was that `lillah-fillah` (for the sake of Allah), we will have to differentiate between the jailer and the prisoner. And if you keep this difference in mind, insha'Allah, you will be able to understand the upcoming topic easily. For now, I have told you this, that the physical world, how was it made? How was the `jirmani `alam` (corporeal world) formed, and after that, how were the `ummhat` formed, and from the `shak wa... `musirr wa mustakbir`, how was the formation of Jahannam done? Some details of Jahannam are many, and they will come later, insha'Allah.

Yesterday, I explained to you everything regarding the celestial spheres, how our celestial spheres were prepared, and how the *hayula-i thaniyah*, which is called *hayula* (matter) and *surat* (form), was created by the *'Aql-i Mudabbir* (Governing Intellect).

The fact of the matter is that our knowledge, and we, are so entangled and engrossed in our knowledge and worldly affairs that we never turn towards this religious inclination and never even tried to go towards this philosophy, and never even pondered upon it. And although astrology, astronomy, and all these things are in their own place, but *din* (religion), and the philosophy of the *Shari'ah*, are in their own respective positions. It has a great magnificence, and we must recognize this magnificence.

I am reminded of something, and I have said it in some gatherings and have narrated it, that one of our elders has written a strange incident: that a very great—many different scholars gathered. There was an astrologer, an astronomer, some physician, and some doctor, and of various such fields of knowledge—there was a philosopher, there was a logician. All of them gathered and began to say, "It's true that we are experts in our fields of knowledge, and let's form a good society. And let's have a guild. How nice it will be, and we will live together, and with our cooperation, we will continue to share our thoughts with one another, so it will be very good."

So it was approved, and they said it's a very good thing, but it is so that the beginning of everything happens with some happiness and from this, from festivity. It is better that we begin our gathering, the one we start, with a trip on the river.

So they decided to take a trip on the river, and they took a boat and boarded the boat, and they began to say to the boatman, "Take us for a trip." And the boatman started to take them for the trip.

When they sat down, what happens is that everything—*al-ina'u yatrashshahu bima fihi* (the vessel spills what is in it)—whatever is in the cup, spills over. Now, these were scholars, and they wanted to—they were also proud of their knowledge, and they began to display their knowledge. And when they tried to assert their dominance, on whom did they do it? On the poor boatman. They started saying to the boatman, "Look, do you know a bit of chemistry?" They said such things, that this is organic, this is inorganic, and this and that happens. The astrologer began his own discourse on the celestial spheres. They talked about astronomy, so every person began to ask him according to their own fields of knowledge. So the one who was without knowledge, or if there was anyone ignorant there, who was it? It was that poor boatman. That boatman was giving an answer to everyone, and he was saying this: "Brother, I don't know this. I don't know this." That poor fellow [thought], "You are a humble person, I row the oars. Brother, they ask all these questions, and I cannot answer them." And it happened like this, and afterwards, he sat down completely silent and began to say, "I will not give any answer, and I absolutely will not..." He thought, "They are talking nonsense, saying such things; I don't know these things."

The situation arose that after just a short while, winds began to blow. Now, when the winds began to blow, it was a precursor to a storm. A storm began to arrive. When the storm started to arrive, then...

A boat was going, and it had many learned people. Even the boatman did not understand what they were saying. But now a storm is approaching, and they are getting an idea of the storm. And, and there is this apprehension that it might overturn. Someone asked, "What will happen?" He said, "Everyone stand up." Everyone stood up and said in a panic, "What will happen?" "What will happen?" "The boat will overturn." "We will all be in the river." So, they were asked, "Do you all know how to swim?" "Do you know how to swim?" "We don't know." He said, "Then what's the use? If you don't even know how to swim, then of what use is this knowledge (*'ilm*) of yours? What is this philosophy (*falsafah*) of use? What is this astrology, this astronomy of use? If you cannot even save your own life, then of what use are these arts and sciences (*'ulum*)?" It is the same way, that the sciences that are useful in our life, which are undoubtedly beneficial, they are certainly beneficial and are sciences that give us a lot of benefit. So, these sciences that give benefit, their benefit is only up to our life. They are not the sciences that will be of benefit in the valley of death and after death. So, that knowledge (*'ilm*) is far better which will be useful to us. So, this... the sun and the moon and going to the moon, and science making this much progress, this is all in its own place. No doubt, science has made great progress, but one claim of science is wrong. One claim is very wrong. Everything else about science is correct, and science itself is a great knowledge (*'ilm*) that we have. But one of its claims is very wrong. And what is that wrong claim? That we have harnessed nature. We have pierced the chest of nature (*fitrat*). We have captured nature (*fitrat*). This claim that it makes is wrong. This is its grand claim, and it is extremely wrong, and it can never be true. Because you are subservient to nature (*fitrat*). Hey, just deal with sleep first. Treat sleep. Stop old age from coming. Can you do it? Hey, you cannot turn white hair, the white hair that there is, you cannot make it black. You can dye it, but you cannot make it black, you cannot change it. So today, whatever is in its place, you are in that very place. You are not anything more than that. This much has certainly happened, that you have greatly benefited yourselves. For your own sake, you have created many beneficial things. You have become very fast. You have traveled with great speed. You made a computer, you made mathematical sciences, you have made countless things in the world. No doubt, you did all this for your own benefit. But what? As scholars say, "He who arrested the rays of the sun... He who arrested the rays of the sun... He who arrested the rays of the sun... in his own... in his own world of... his own life's... dark night, he could not bring about dawn." "He who arrested the rays of the sun, could not turn the dark night of life into dawn." The one who sought the pathways of the stars, the one who sought the pathways of the stars, could not travel in the world of his own thoughts.

The revolving star had to travel through the pathways of the stars, had to travel in the world of its own thoughts. So it became evident that all this exists, but the *falsafah* (philosophy) which is the philosophy of the Prophet, which is the philosophy of the *Ahl al-Bayt*, which is the scheme of *‘aql* and *tadbir* (intellect and planning), and which is the power that is working behind all these things, and how this work is to be done—to know this is *‘ilm ladunni*. This is the knowledge of *ma kana lahu ‘ilmun* (of which he had no knowledge) which the Quran speaks of. This is the essence of Islam. Islam was not for the purpose of just telling you about acts of worship and then urging you to be bound by them. This was not it. Or to have you read the Quran with *tafsil* (detail). Reading the Quran with *tafsil* is certainly necessary, but the purpose of reading it in such a manner was not just a superficial reading. You were commanded to dive deep into it, you were to see its effects. You had all these commands. So it became clear that these are just external, outward matters. No one went into the inner dimension, into its depth. And it is evident that those who did go into the *batin*, and whom Allah Ta'ala, through His grace, has connected to these things, then we should acquire more and more information, be more and more involved, create more and more *taqwa* (piety), our worship should be greater, our *i'tiqad* (conviction) should become stronger and stronger. This is what should happen. Because, after knowing these sciences, if you do not implement their effect, then you have done nothing. Its effect must also manifest. Knowing the sciences does not mean that you become negligent in your acts of worship, as is commonplace. What is it among the general Muslims? That if you have acquired a lot of information, then you are called *Ahl-e-Falsafah* (people of philosophy), and you are expected to abandon all *namaz*, fasting, and so on, and just sit comfortably. Sit in a corner like a sufi. The problem with sufism is that it often involves the abandonment of worship. They frequently abandon worship and become lost in their own thoughts. That is not the case for us. We are meant to do even more. In any case, what I meant to say was that you should listen to these things not just for pleasure, but listen to them and, according to their importance, give them due respect. And their respect is this: that after acquiring it, you also act upon it. Your conviction should be firm, you should move forward in your worship, your morals should be rectified, your dealings should be corrected. This should be your objective. In any case, yesterday I stated before you that the *hayula* (prime matter) which was before that *'arif* (gnostic), that flame which was composed of the *muta‘ayyin* (determinate), *musallam* (sound), *mustaqirr* (stable), *nadir* (rare/base), and *musaffaq* (refined), and from which a *musaffaq* was made—which is called *hayula* and *surat* (form). And I told you its technical meaning, that it refers to the *namiyah* (vegetative) and *hissiyah* (sentient) faculties. So that *hayula* and *surat* which was before him, which is a collection in its entirety, he sorted it and gave to each what was worthy of it. Now, how did Allah Ta'ala sort it? It is evident that those who were base, who were regretful, who were *nadir*, He gave them the highest place. Those who were *saqit* (fallen) and *mutahayyir* (bewildered), He placed them in the middle. Doubt is in the middle. And those who were *musallam* and *mustaqirr*, He cast them underfoot. He made them their footstool. Now, I had started the explanation of these three levels before you, but then I stopped.

I want to explain that first of all, Allah Ta'ala, the All-Wise Dispenser of affairs (*Hakim*), gave motion (*gardish*) to the *Falak-e-Muheet* (the Encompassing Sphere). This... and I had previously told you while explaining this motion (*gardish*) that Nature (*Qudrat*) had stopped this *Hayula* (Prima Materia), this *Hayula-e-Thaniyah* (Secondary Prima Materia), which is called *Hayula-e-Surat* (Prima Materia of Form) - it had stopped and supported this *Hayula* with four powers (*quwwat*). Which powers are they? *Taleh* (Ascendant), *Gharib* (Descendant), *Ashir* (Tenth House), and *Rabih* (Fourth House). There are four powers: *Taleh*, *Gharib*, *Ashir*, and *Rabih*. These are the four powers. What are *Taleh* and *Gharib*? *Taleh* is the place of rising (*tulu'*), meaning the highest point. And *Gharib* is the place of setting (*ghuroob*). So... the *Mashriq* (East) and the *Maghrib* (West), there, at that location, the inclinations came. Now, from what will the direction be determined? From the *Khana-e-Ka'bah*. The *Khana-e-Ka'bah Muqaddas* is that point, the center point (*nuqta-e-markaz*). The entire circle (*daira*) will be drawn from there. Now, this... what is the significance of the *Khana-e-Ka'bah Muqaddas*? What is it? All of that will come, *insha'Allah*, at its proper time. For now, you have to understand that *Mashriq* (East) and *Maghrib* (West), these two locations, at these two states, the powers were working. I told you that Nature (*Qudrat*) took some people who were about to fall and held them there. Whether they are in companionship, or whether they are... engaged... or whether they are helping assistants. It could be anyone. It can be anyone, but those powers were working under them. And where? At *Taleh* and *Gharib*. When they were at *Taleh* and *Gharib*... that is, in the *Mashriq* (East) and *Maghrib* (West), then where were *Ashir* and *Rabih* working? In the middle of the sky. In the middle of the sky, in the center of the heavens, these were at the *Ashir*. And *Center of the Earth*, in the very middle and center of the earth, the power that was working, its name is *Rabih*. With these four powers, Allah Ta'ala had stopped this entire *Hayula*. And after stopping it, He gave it motion (*gardish*). And the motion (*gardish*) was such that, just as when you give motion to an onion, its layers are separate, in the same way, they started to separate here. So, Nature (*Qudrat*) had already... those who were at the level of regret, their station was already high. The name always comes at the top. The form always comes at the top. So it is obvious that for them, who had come to the top, from them, He made nine *aflak* (celestial spheres). How many *aflak*? Nine *aflak*. The very first *falak* (sphere) that was made, which is in the most *basit* (simple/uncompounded) realm, meaning it is completely smooth and polished, there is no *naqsh* (design/imprint) in it, no patterns, no stars in it, it is completely *basit*. It is transparent. So this *basit* *falak* that was made, which I call *Muheet* (Encompassing), which we call *Falak-e-Atlas* (The Primum Mobile). The *Falak-e-Atlas* or the *Muheet*, their meaning is one and the same. And that *falak* was encompassing the entire realm. This upper part, which we call a *falak*, and that *falak* was encompassing everything, and there was nothing in it. After that, it was rotating in an eastern (*sharqi*) manner. The second one was rotating in its opposite direction. The lower part that was rotating in the opposite direction, that is called the *Falak-e-Burooj* (Sphere of the Zodiacal Signs). What is the *Falak-e-Burooj*? The *Burooj* are the twelve zodiacal signs (*burj*), and the twelve *burj* are inside it. Now, did Allah Miyan create these *burj* beforehand and tell man that these are the *burj*? No, it's not like that. Rather, man, in this world, here from this place...

All these heavens, because they are transparent, we can see the stars, we can see Zuhal (Saturn), we can see Marikh (Mars), we can see Zuhra (Venus). Although Marikh is on its sixth heaven, Shams (the Sun) is on the fourth heaven, Zuhra is on its third heaven, Zuhal is on the seventh heaven. But we can see all of them. These are all planets, *sayyaray* (wanderers), that are seen to be revolving. But the stars that we see, which are fixed, which are called *Sawaabita* (the fixed stars), all of them are on the eighth *falak* (celestial sphere). They are on the eighth *falak*. The other *falak* that... from the upper glass and the lower glass appears to the eyes... which we call *Falak al-Buruj* (the Sphere of the Constellations). These stars that were there, who observed them? This... the one who was an expert in the science of astronomy (*'Ilm al-Falakiyat*) and the one who derived it, was our Prophet whose name was Idris. And his name is also Yunan. His name is... uh... uh... [unclear]... Iglag is also his name, Yunan is also his name, and Idris is also his name. He was our Prophet, and he was the first to derive this knowledge, and he observed. From here, of that heaven. And he spent 30 years of his precious life in mastering this astronomy. And what was the result of that? He saw that at one time, six constellations (*buruj*) are visible in the sky, and at the other time, meaning after six months, the other six constellations are visible. So apparently, there are then twelve constellations (*buruj*) in our sky. How did these constellations emerge? And what character did they adopt? In reality, all these stars that were there were forming different shapes. He designated these shapes, that these are the specific shapes. Just like our children also make things out of clouds and see them, that, 'Oh, this has formed a lion,' 'that has formed.' This is a changing cloud, it is not going to remain. But these fixed stars (*sawaabit*), these stars that were there, they were fixed in their place. The shape that they had formed, was formed; it was formed for eternity. So what shape was formed? A shape of a lion was formed, a shape of a bull (*Saur*) was formed, a shape of a fish was formed, and Sunbulah (Virgo), a Hubb-e-bil shape was formed. Mizan (Libra), the shape of a scale was formed. Like this, twelve shapes were formed, and today the entire world agrees on this, that the sky is divided into these twelve sections. There are twelve sections, and it is according to those very sections that all our... whatever is derived here, the horoscope (*za'icha*) that is looked at, things of the world that happen, the predictions (*peshingoiyan*) that are made, they are all according to those very sections. Anyway. Now there was another matter. The point to be told was, how did the twelve constellations (*buruj*) come to be? These twelve *buruj* came from the fixed stars. And where are all those stars? They are on the eighth *falak*. The *falak* below the eighth *falak*... the next one, what was that *falak* called? Zuhal (Saturn). It was the *falak* of Zuhal. In it, there is only one *sayyara* (planet), and it is revolving in its place. There is only one *sayyara* in that *falak*, and its name is Zuhal. Below Zuhal came Mushtari (Jupiter). After Mushtari came Marikh (Mars). Below Marikh came Shams (the Sun). Below Shams came Zuhra (Venus), 'Utarid (Mercury), and Qamar (the Moon). These were the complete seven stars. Zuhal, Mushtari, Marikh, Shams, Zuhra, 'Utarid, Qamar. These seven *sayyaray* are revolving. These seven became the *aflak* (celestial spheres). These seven *aflak*, and above them, which one? Is the eighth *falak*, *Falak al-Buruj*. And above *Falak al-Buruj* is *Falak al-Muhit* (the All-Encompassing Sphere).

...these nine `falak` (spheres) are there, and in the same regard, the... also that Allah Ta'ala has kept for humans, here the matter of birth has also been set for nine months, which is somewhat similar to this. And the matter of the seventh month is in this regard, that its life will continue. If it is the eighth month for the human fetus, then its death occurs. So what is the reason for this death occurring? That same discussion... your... your topic will remain the same, and from that, I am... beginning. What I wanted to say was that the Lord of the worlds, all these `sayyare` (planets) that He created, and all the `thawabit` (fixed stars) that He created, or the `buruj` (constellations) He created, all of these are influential upon this world. Not just on humans, but on `nabatat` (plants), on `haywanat` (animals), on the earth, on all of its workings that exist from Allah Ta'ala in this universe, these are things that have an influence on everything. These `sayyare` (planets), they... do have an influence. Iqbal says: "These stars are something, they appear as something else. These stars are something, they appear as something else. These tricksters openly deceive." "These tricksters openly deceive." So one should not go by their external glitter and shine. They undoubtedly have an influence on us, and how they have an influence, and in what way Allah has... what things... there are matters [to discuss]. What I wanted to say was that Allah Ta'ala placed Saturn (`Zuhal`), Jupiter (`Mushtari`), Mars (`Mirrikh`), the Sun (`Shams`), Venus (`Zuhra`), Mercury (`'Atarad`), and the Moon (`Qamar`)—all of them—He... seated each one in its own `falak` (sphere). They are revolving in their own respective `falak`. And the eighth `falak` became the `falak-e-buruj` (the sphere of the constellations). And after that is the `falak-e-muhit` (the encompassing sphere). This, which Allah Ta'ala had created, the stars, He had created them for this reason: so that there may be change (`tabdili`) in the universe, so that there may be creation (`takhliq`) in the universe, so that the universe may proceed on its... appointed term (`mi'ad`), and so that from here... the paths that lead from materiality (`maddiyat`) to spirituality (`ruhaniyat`) may be paved. This is why Allah Ta'ala appointed the planets. First of all, the `mudabbir-e-hakim` (the wise governor/arranger), the `'arsh` (throne) of the `mudabbir-e-hakim`, entrusted the `tadbir` (arrangement/governance) to `Zuhal` (Saturn). Look, the `sayyare` (planets) are in their places. As soon as those planets began to revolve, with the revolution of the `falak-e-muhit` (the encompassing sphere), `zamana` (time) was created. The clocks started ticking, `zamana` (time) was created. And the creation of time, for you, for us, is a very good thing, that we... live in time, and it is obvious that we should know the time, whether it is day or night, what time it is now, and so on. But what is this in reality? It is a punishment (`saza`). It is the greatest punishment. Being in `zamana` (time) and `makan` (space)... this is the greatest punishment. `Makan` (space) is what? That from which one takes support is called `makan`. And the `waqt` (time) that passes over us is called `zamana`. So you live in the prison of `zaman-o-makan` (time and space). And as you keep exiting the prison of `zaman-o-makan`, `waqt` (time)... will keep diminishing. And Einstein has also proven it... the theory of relativity has come to you. And you know that when a person travels at the speed of light, the sensation of time ends there. And it stops. So if we, while living here in the world, can feel this, then how can we not believe in `ilahiyat` (the divine sciences), that over there, it does not exist at all. There is no trace of time. In that `'alam-e-ruhani` (spiritual realm), there is no time, no language, no space, nothing, nor what. The One who is timeless (`be-zaman`) and spaceless (`be-makan`), He who created it innumerably, that Being is `al-aan kama kaan` (He is now as He was). He has the status of `kulla yawmin huwa fi sha'n` (Every day He is in a [new] state of glory). And He is...

Here, our dwelling place is also there, in its fields, it is well established. So anyway, the Lord of the worlds, that is, the *Aashir-e-Mudabbir-e-Aa'zam* [The Tenth, The Great Governor], first of all, thought of a plan for Zuhal [Saturn]. On top of its head is the very first star, it is a planet, for that planet, he devised a plan that you should become the ruler and act upon this world. He gave this plan to Zuhal. And to what extent did he give the plan? I told you that ever since the seven *mutalaqeen* [associates] have come into the world, that plan has entered their homes. I had told you, how were the seven *mutalaqeen* created? They were *aab-o-aatish-o-baad-o-khaak* [water, fire, wind, and earth]. And when were the *musir-o-mustakbir* [the rebellious and the arrogant] created? They were placed under the feet, that place which we call Jinn, which we call Saqrah, which is called Jahannum [hell], which is called Saqar, which is called Aqim. All these are names related to Jahannum. This *dozakh* [hell], the real *dozakh* is not somewhere here or there. It is present beneath our feet. And what is its dimension? How much heat is there? How many people live there? What is the capacity? How many valleys are there? How many gorges are there? How many mountains have come? And for how long will one have to stay there? What is the duration? And how many *mala'ikah* [angels] are appointed there? How are they punished there? This is all known. It is all a known matter. Nothing is hidden. Allah Ta'ala says: *'alayha tis'ata 'ashar* (Over it are nineteen). On this, on this *dozakh*, We have appointed nineteen. There are nineteen *mala'ikah* who are appointed over this *dozakh*. Now, look, *nauzubillah, nauzubillah* [we seek refuge in God], *dozakh* is a bad thing, so the *mala'ikah* must also be bad. The *mala'ikah* are just as good. Do not think that the *mala'ikah* have also become bad. This is a task; whoever is entrusted with a task will be the one to carry it out. So, this Jahannum that was created, all of them were spent, were used up. Who? The *musir-o-mustakbir*. All the *musir-o-mustakbir* that existed, Allah Ta'ala put them all underfoot, and this Jahannum that was formed is entirely in their possession. And I had told you that from the seven *mutalaqeen*, the *ummahat* [mothers, i.e., the elements] were created, which are called *aab-o-aatish-o-baad-o-khaak*. First of all, let me tell you, and then repeat it, that when the *falak-e-qamar* [sphere of the moon] rotated—look, the *falak-e-zamin* [sphere of the earth] rotated, below it the *falak-e-buruj* [sphere of the constellations] rotated. The *falak-e-buruj* rotated, and below it Zuhal, Mushtari, Mirrikh, Shams, Zohra, Utaarid, Qamar [Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon] rotated. And when the *falak* of Qamar [the moon] began to rotate, this *falak*, the path on which the moon is moving, when it began to rotate, the atmosphere beneath it began to get hot. It is obvious that friction creates heat, *haraarat* [heat] is produced. So this *haraarat* that was there, along with the *haraarat*, another quality was created. What is that thing? *Yubusat* [dryness]. *Haraarat* and *yubusat*, these two qualities. Whose qualities are they? This is the quality of fire. So that sphere of fire, a layer of fire was created. Now you will see flames there, you will see embers, but there are no flames or embers. Just as you describe the quality of something, that it is hot but it appears cool to the eye, but what is its quality? It is hot. So in exactly the same way, the state of this entire atmosphere was that of the *kurrah-e-asir* [sphere of ether], of the sphere of fire. *Asir*, it was called *asir*, and it became the sphere of fire. Now, this sphere of fire, up to where was it formed? How far did this layer extend? As far as the *haraarat* and *yubusat* continued. Where the *haraarat* came and ended... I heated this, this corner will not get that hot. A time will come when it will be completely cool. That part which was completely cool, from there the sphere was seen to begin.

...began to be created. And that *ḥarārat* (heat) was eliminated. The *yubūsat* (dryness) remained. With *yubūsat*, for a void (*khalā*) to always exist is impossible (*maḥāl*). Something or other has to come. So, for the necessary replacement, what is needed? With *ruṭūbat* (moisture)... what thing came? *Ruṭūbat* came. So, *ruṭūbat* and *burūdat* (coldness)... these both... with *yubūsat*... with *yubūsat*, *burūdat* came. And these two qualities are of what? Of air (*hawā*). A sphere of air began to be created. So, the sphere of air continued to descend. And it... where did it reach? It reached as far as the *dukhān* (smoke). And there, what happened? The *yubūsat* was eliminated. When *yubūsat* is eliminated, what will take its place? *Ruṭūbat* came. *Ruṭūbat* and *burūdat* are the qualities of what? Of water (*pānī*). A sphere of water began to be created. Now, if you look, there isn't a single drop of water there. It’s a vast body of water. Not even a drop of water, but its qualities (*ṣifāt*) are of water. A sphere of water was created from that. Now that sphere, descending, where did it come to? To the point where... that *ruṭūbat* was eliminated. And *yubūsat* was eliminated, and *ruṭūbat* remained. With that *ruṭūbat*, *ḥarārat* combined, and that became a sphere of fire (*āg*). A sphere of fire was formed. So, in this way, spheres were formed. And after the spheres were formed, how many were left? Seven.

The one at the end... where *yubūsat* was eliminated, and it was said to have combined with *ḥarārat*. *ḥarārat* was not there. You said that a sequence started: *ḥarārat*, then *yubūsat*... *yubūsat* with *ruṭūbat*, yes... *ruṭūbat* was eliminated... yes. So where did this *ḥarārat* come from again?

It was there from the start. From the beginning, there were two... what were they? Over there... like *burūdat*... with *burūdat*, *yubūsat* remained. Yes. After that, it came further down, and *yubūsat* was eliminated. *Burūdat*... then... further on... *ḥarārat* and *ruṭūbat*...

No, *ḥarārat* and *yubūsat*. Two qualities must remain. Two qualities must always be present. These four elements (*ʻanāṣir*) are everlasting. And this... where did this come from, you are asking? The simple answer to that is this: that they had created *ṭūl* (length), *ʻarḍ* (breadth), and *ʻumq* (depth). And I had told you that with *ṭūl* came *ḥarārat* and *yubūsat*, with *ʻarḍ* came *burūdat* and *ruṭūbat*, and with *ʻumq* two other qualities were created. So the fundamental things that were created there cannot be separated. They were born there; they are inherent. Now, what happened here? Their manifestation began. For us to say that the spheres were rubbing and being created... The reality is that these things were already created; they are enduring and not things that perish. So this was the situation, and then *Saqar* remained. And how was *Saqar* made? It was made from those who showed *istigbār* (arrogance) and *takabbur* (pride). So Allah Ta'ala made them with *Saqar*, which is a house that is a tremendous manifestation of divine power, where there is the most severe arrangement and a powerful system of torment. That *Dozat* (Hell)... that *Dozat*... it has gates, for coming and going, it has stations, it has names, it has a place, it has a location, it has everything. For now, I will... because when its mention comes up, I will explain it in detail.

The one which is called *Jahannam*. The way it is... is that its lower part is its throne, and its canopy (*chhat*) is its upper part. The roof is the upper part. The way we cook milk, when we boil it, it boils over, so we add some water or something so that it settles down. But how has *Qudrat* (Divine Power) cooked it? Its method is also... It is below, the banner is above it. This kind of net has been made. The banner is above, and the milk is below, and from below there are paths for coming. Paths for going and coming. And those... are very painful paths. And this is mentioned in the Qur'an. And it is spread out in such a way... if we were to describe its state, you would find it to be a very terrifying thing. This kind of *jahannam* has been made. And the *jahannam* that is made, it is apparent that it is for those who are spiritually filthy. As are the spirits, so are the angels. So it is apparent, as are the inhabitants, so is their home. Their home is also made like that. And all these things, the parts that are made of fire, Allah Ta'ala has... arranged for *jahannam*. For what is it made? It is apparent that it is made of metal, brass, lead, and frankincense. All these kinds of things, those that fan the flames and those that cause burning. All these things, from these... and the way they are made, whether... when the exegesis comes, then it will be known that *jahannam* is made of all these things. And the inhabitants of *jahannam* are also of this same type, and their home is also of this same type. Understood? So, the human is such that he cannot get out of his shell, because he is a prisoner of his own thoughts and his own environment. That as are his thoughts, his environment has also been made by Allah Ta'ala in such a way that you will stay in the environment you deserve. So, I was explaining that *falak-e-qamar* (the sphere of the moon)... above the *falak-e-qamar* are the seven planets and then *Zuhal* (Saturn). *Zuhal* was the first to be given the *tadbir* (governance)... that you, first of all, establish your rule over this realm and so that the *takhliq* (creation) is completed here. *Ma'dan* (minerals), *nabat* (plants), and *haywan* (animals) come into existence in their places, and this realm, in terms of all these things... becomes complete. So for completing it, first of all, Allah Ta'ala chose *Zuhal*. Above it are the planets. And *Zuhal* was given the *tadbir* for how many years? For one thousand years. For one thousand years, *Zuhal* will perform the *tadbir*. Now, please pay a little attention to this matter of *tadbir*. That Allah Ta'ala, the *tadbir* He has assigned to these planets is such that first of all, He gave the *tadbir* to *Zuhal*, that for one thousand years, you... perform its *tadbir*, you be its king, of this realm. Of this entire realm. Meaning, whether it is the *'alam-e-ajram* (realm of celestial bodies) or the *'alam-e-mahw* (realm of erasure) or *sughra* (the lesser). He was given the order and the responsibility to rule over all of them. To whom? To *Zuhal*. For one thousand years. When the second thousand years began, then in the second thousand years, what will happen? The kingship will be of *Zuhal*, but *Zuhal* will not do it alone, it will not perform the *tadbir* of the realm alone, but its companionship will be there, it will provide assistance. Who? *Mushtari* (Jupiter). And after that *Zuhra* (Venus), *'Atarid* (Mercury), *Shams* (Sun), and similarly the *katib* and *na-katib* will come. And for one thousand years each, they will perform its vizierate, they will work under it. In this way, it has been said that 7000 years will pass in this manner. So when 7000 years are completed, then we will say that the *dawr* (cycle) of *Zuhal* has ended. Now, you understand this point, right? And in the same way, when these 7000 years are completed, then whose kingship will it be?

that is, it will establish Sri, and that daur, in the first thousand years, will become Sri. In the second thousand years, it will become. In the second thousand years, it will be a very difficult daur, it will go into the daur of the Prophet. In the third thousand years, that very one who is the wali will [unclear], and after the wali, the Sant will come. After the Sant, the now eighth seven-thousand-year daur will be completed. Whose daur will be completed? The Hukm. After the Hukm, the wali's daur will also be seven thousand years. After the Hukm, the Sant's daur will be seven thousand years. After the Sant, there will be a daur, there will be daras, there will be sabak. These seven times seven thousand years, how much is that? Seven sevens are forty-nine. A forty-nine-thousand-year period exists. And the reality is that it is a section of one thousand years or two thousand years. They calculate it in money. And just as within our day we have to do it again, we try, that is, one has to do eighty-four [unclear]. In the same way, there are matters here as well. And these forty-nine thousand years, in becoming so, became fifty-one thousand years. So a fifty-one-thousand-year period is called a major period. And the name of that entire period is what? It is called the name of Zohar. Whose beginning he had initiated. Although in the factory of Zohar and in the government of Zohar, and in the government of Zohar, the Zohri land, the Zohri thing, that used to run. When the Zohri, Zohri government used to run, but from the other side, the second government, when it is counted, it will be counted a lot. Zohar's government will be counted for fifty-one thousand years. You think, for fifty-one thousand years. And when fifty-one thousand years are complete, then Mushtari's government will start somewhere or the other. And periods of this kind are in the crores, innumerable, which we cannot even calculate. It's impossible. We cannot even calculate how many have passed already. Whose calculation is impossible. That has passed upon the world. And now, which sayyara is ruling at this time, that is a known matter. That is a known matter. Anyway, before telling that, I will tell you a matter concerning Imam al-Baqir, alayhi as-salatu was-salam. Someone came to Imam al-Baqir, alayhi as-salatu was-salam, and said, "O Maula, I had a request to make. I wanted to ask you one thing, you give the answer." He said, "You can ask everything." He said, and that person said, "O Maula, I want to know this thing: what is the age of the world? What is the age of the world, I want to know." The Imam said, because the Imam was asked, the Imam said, "Look, what the age of the world will be, it is not possible to say this. It is possible to say what the age of the world has been so far. How long man will remain, I am not going to tell you that, but how long he has been, I can tell you that. What has happened to the world until now, I can tell you that.
