In the same way, to test the general Muslims, just see if their history (*tārīkh*) is correct or not. One whose history is not correct, which of his pillars will be straight? Which pillar of that camel will be straight when its history itself is not correct? One scholar gives one fatwa, another gives another. Has Allah kept his religion as such a plaything? That whoever wishes can set the date as they please? When Eid is occurring, there are two or three Eids. There you have it. They are celebrating Eid. I mean, in one city there are two or three Eids. Is this a way? So the world of Islam, the Messenger of Allah did not leave it in such a neglected state. He codified every single law with strictness. It wasn't like that. It is the leavers who, when they want to leave, leave everything. When they left, everything was left behind. So see, even the history became wrong. So today, neither is the history of the Shias correct, nor that of the *Ahl as-Sunnah wa-l-Jamā'ah*. So when the history itself is not correct, then tell me, which of their things... neither is their *Laylat al-Qadr* Laylat al-Qadr, nor is their Day of 'Arafah the Day of 'Arafah, nor is their Day of Ghadir the Day of Ghadir. So no day is the day it should be, and no night is the night it should be. So what will be correct for them? What deed of theirs will be their deed? Neither is Eid, Eid, nor is *Shab-i-Barāt*, *Barāt*. So it is known that the whole affair, from here to there, is ruined. The whole matter is wrong. So, I was saying that still, the mercy of Allah takes them. Who are they? They are the *'affīf* and the *ṣulaḥā*. The reality is that among these Muslims, there are some religious people for whom, to explain, there is a completely different school of thought, and it becomes a matter of digressing from one's place. That is why I want to leave that topic for a bit because it is a very delicate matter. And the *ṣulaḥā* and the *'affīf*, as they are called. Those who possess chastity and adopt purity, and perform ablutions, and believe in Ali, and love the followers of Ali. Such are those pious believers. They are the closest to the believers. And these *ṣulaḥā* and *'affīf* are those whose salvation also happens slowly. But how does it happen? At a rank lower than that of a believer. At a rank somewhat lower than a believer, their salvation also happens, but it does happen. Now, for those other than them, salvation is very difficult. And it is just like this, as you imagine, that I set a destination at the very top, my goal, that this is the truth. The thing at the very top is the truth. And from here down, I draw a ladder. And by drawing the ladder, I am saying that those climbing this ladder are Budh-mazhab (Buddhists), Hindu-mazhab (Hindus), Yahudis (Jews), Muslims, Shias, Bohras. All these communities are climbing, following their respective religions. So it is clear, we who are sitting at the peak, we are the people of truth (*Ahl al-Haqq*). We are the people of truth. The one who falls from the top will be hurt more. It is clear that these Bohras who have fallen after reaching very close to us, they will be hurt more. They will have more torment, they will get more punishment. And after that, if anyone will get it, it will be the Shias. And after that, the Ahl as-Sunnah. And after that, all of them... now there are levels to it, we don't need to get into the details, but... torment is to be faced, it is to be faced. Punishment is to be received, it is to be received. And they will have to receive continuous punishments. Now, the matter of punishment that begins, it begins with the torment of the grave (*'adhāb al-qabr*). And the stage before the torment of the grave, which stage is it? It is the valley of death. The valley of death. A person who, let's say... leave aside Muslims for now... let's say a *kāfir* (infidel). If a *kāfir* is passing away, dying, what happens at the time of death? This is what I am explaining. At the time of death, he has only two souls: one is the vegetative soul (*nafs-i-nāmiyah*) and the other is what? The sensory soul (*nafs-i-ḥissīyah*). Only these two souls are with him. And as soon as he died... the rule of death I have explained to you before. The principle I explained was what? That the *nafs al-hawā'īyah* (aerial soul), which was among the counted souls, that soul ended, and he collapsed. He finished here. The tongue was sealed, on the mouth. And the doctors saw, the breath stopped, the heart stopped, he is dead. They issued the death certificate. As soon as the death certificate was received, death occurred, now they take him. Now what is the condition of this poor soul? The condition of this poor soul is this... that the *nafs-i-nāmiyah* is within him, and the *nafs-i-ḥissīyah* is also within him. Meaning, what happens is, as I told you that the souls are outside, but their repositories are inside, right? The organs that are working are inside him. So that *nafs-i-ḥissīyah* and *nafs-i-nāmiyah*, which were acting upon it, will join with it and what will happen? The *nafs-i-ḥissīyah*... there is no pilot to pull it. There is no rational soul (*nāṭiqah*), no noble covenant (*'ahd-i-sharīf*), to pull it away. So when there is nothing to pull it, it just lies there. Now that there is nothing to pull it, what will happen? The *nafs-i-nāmiyah* and *ḥissīyah* are inside it. The matter of *nāmiyah* is far off. The trouble is of the *ḥissīyah*. The *ḥissīyah*, which has been sensing throughout its life, that *ḥissīyah* is within its body. This *ḥissīyah* will remain within its body and will spread. It will spread just like, if a thermometer breaks, how the mercury spreads. In the same way, this thing will become diffused in the body. The Du'at say it becomes diffused (*shā'i'*). It becomes diffused, it spreads. And after spreading, what are you doing? You are thinking he has met death. You are wailing, and he is listening. You are giving him warm water [for the final bath], and he is feeling it. You are taking him to the grave, and he is feeling it all. And what is the thing that will separate? Only one thing will separate. I told you that the *nafs al-hawā'īyah* departs, that's one thing. The second thing that will depart is its concept. Its imagination, its concept, that concept... now you will ask, where did its concept come from? Although its concept is not in the Realm of Light (*Wujūd-i-Nūr*). But it does have a concept. Even if it is bad, even badness has a concept. Let it be a concept of badness. Whatever his beliefs are, whatever creed he follows, whatever actions he did, whatever deeds he did, whatever knowledge he acquired, from all that, a hideous picture of his is formed. A hideous picture of his is formed. And that picture, that satanic picture, and that hideous picture, that is the *sūrat al-khabīthah* (the vile form), the frightening form, that form separates from him. When it separates from him and he begins to see it, he is astonished, thinking, "Were these the deeds I did? Was this the picture? If only there were a great distance between me and it!" The Quran states this: "*būnan ba'īdan*" (a great distance). "If only there was a great distance between me and it, O Allah, so that I would not have to see this picture of mine." "Was I living to see this picture? Today I have met death, so this valley of death should have been peaceful. The trouble is that now I am seeing the picture I was creating my whole life. It has turned out to be so dark and ugly." Seeing that ugly form, he will become terrified. This is the very first valley of death. This is the first torment that he will receive from Allah. As soon as he sees his form, he will start trembling, thinking how ugly a form he has received. This is the first punishment. The second punishment is that *Mawlā-i-kā'ināt* will appear to him. As I told you, there is no person leaving this world, no living being, who does not see Ali. It cannot be. Why? Because you are the master of the age (*ṣāḥib al-dawr*). You are the master of the time (*mālik-i-waqt*), and in the *nisbat al-'ālā*, you hold the highest station. And in that respect, in the state of possibility, you are the God of the time (*khudā-i-waqt*). So your appearance is absolutely necessary. That is why the Prophet said, "Ali, *qasīm an-nāri wa-l-jannah*" (the distributor of Hellfire and Paradise). "*'Alīyyun ḥubbuhu junnah, qasīm an-nāri wa-l-jannah*" (Ali, love for him is a shield, the distributor of Hellfire and Paradise). That is, love for Ali is what gives salvation from the fire of hell. And Ali is what? He is the distributor of hell and paradise. So you saw that when he appeared to the believer, it was with good tidings, saying, "Come towards paradise. You have endured hardship your whole life, now paradise is prepared for you." And to a *kāfir*, what are you giving? It is *nazārat* (a warning). Now you are threatening him: "Why did you...?" Now you will say, a *kāfir* was born in a *kāfir*'s house. He received no lesson, nothing. Neither did he have any Muslim company, nor did he receive the call of a missionary. He doesn't know the Imam. Nor does he know anything. The reality is that our intellects are very limited. We do not see all these things. If Providence (*qudrat*) does not provide all these things and then punishes, then it would be a reflection on Providence itself. Providence provides this to everyone. It is the right of Providence to provide the right path to everyone. At some point, it shows them the right path. But when one does not understand the right path, then they are left alone, saying, "It is your choice. If We had to compel you, We would have compelled you right there." Why did Providence not compel us? In that pre-eternal realm, that spiritual realm, when the Tenth Intellect presumed equality, to make him understand, the First Intellect and the Second Intellect would have explained together, "Brother, you have been given intellect, knowledge, power, life. You are in this spiritual realm, near the supreme throne of Allah. So believe, understand." They would have made him understand. Why? Because with Allah, there is no compulsion. He has everything, but not compulsion. When there is no compulsion, then it is a realm of free will. If there is free will, then it is upon our understanding. Because it was a realm of free will, at that time we chose what we thought was appropriate for ourselves. We chose, so we came to remorse. We chose, so we became *kallam*. We chose, so we became the Tenth Intellect. We chose, so we became pure among all creatures. If we chose, we did. If we did not choose, we became *shāk-i-muṭahhir* or *nasl-i-mustakbir*. So it was a realm of free will. Not of compulsion. Now this that is happening here... now they are coming into a state of compulsion, now they are getting trapped. And now their form is becoming vile, it is becoming bad. Because the Messenger of Allah had given them guidance. The one who was to make them understand had made them understand. You will ask when he made them understand, what he made them understand? I don't know anything, there is no letter, no... no voice from the radio, nothing. Leave all that. But this is... That is why the Prophet said, "*wa mā 'alaynā illā-l-balāgh al-mubīn*" (And our duty is only to convey the clear message). We have no other duty but to convey. If the Prophet had not said this, this is proof that it is the duty of every messenger to convey. It is the duty of every conveyor to convey. The work of conveying happens, and it is conveyed. If the message does not reach you, then let it not reach. You want to remain in evil, then remain. How is God? As you are, so is He. You might think that we will become this or that. It cannot happen. That is why it is said in the noble Quran that God has not changed the condition of a people until they have a desire in themselves to change. This has been turned into a couplet, but it is a verse of the noble Quran. It is a verse of the Holy Quran that Allah Ta'ala does not change the condition of a people until they themselves change their condition. So it means that one has to change oneself. Since they did not change, God also did not change. As they desired, God also said so. So now this vile form starts appearing before them, and they start trembling because of it. And *Mawlā-i-kā'ināt* appears to them at that time, and he will give them a warning: "Now go towards hell. You did not do the work you were supposed to do. Now you have to face punishment. You have to face punishment." Where for the believer there is good tidings, here for him there is a warning. Now this form will be separated from him. This form, which is his ugly form, his evil form, which holds his evil beliefs, and all his evil thoughts, evil characters, evil deeds, evil words... Now you will say, how many Muslims will be good, how many infidels will be good? Leave aside the good and bad. Take the fundamental thing. Those good and bad, I have also explained that God sees every good person and every bad person. I will tell you, in the course of the lesson, how their goodness is rewarded, and how their evil is rewarded. How the results of their night vigils are obtained, and how the result of their good character, their good deeds, is obtained. But they must receive punishment, and that fundamental thing is their heedlessness, their turning away from the truth of the religion. As they have turned away from the religion, their first punishment is that their form appears before them, and they start trembling, thinking, "If only there were a great distance between me and this." Now this state of the form occurred. Now with the form, what happened? You gave him the ritual bath (*ghusl*), shrouded him, and after shrouding him, you went and buried him. When you are burying him, this vile form is walking along with him. This vile form that has come out of him is walking along with its body. Just as the owner does not leave his house, a horse always looks at its stable and turns, in the same way, this house in which it has lived for many, 60-70 years, it does not leave that house. That vile form keeps wandering along with it. And when you take it and bury the corpse, as soon as you bury it, what happens? That you have buried it. Now what has happened? That the body, whose humors, the six humors are his too, as they were ours, along with the six humors, what else is there? Plus *nāmiyah*, plus *ḥissīyah*. Do you understand? Plus *ḥissīyah*, plus *nāmiyah*, he was buried with that. He is buried with the *nāmiyah*, he is buried with the *ḥissīyah*. This is the doomsday, that he is buried with the *ḥissīyah*. Just think about it. The one whom we consider dead, he has not been able to die. What will happen? Sensation (*ḥiss*) is present, but only one difference occurs with death, and what is that? In the active state, our sensation is like this, and after death, the state that occurs is a passive state. The state of active and passive, the state of potential and actual, that state remains. Now, in this state of potentiality, they are put in, and that body is buried. After it is buried, that vile form stands there and watches the scene, and it wails greatly in its place, and it is in a state of great anguish. Our pens cannot describe that state of anguish. They cannot describe that state of anguish, that the form is watching its own body, with which it was attached for a long time, whose essence it itself is, whose output it itself is, it starts watching that body. And with great regret, it watches the body. But the body gets buried. It tries to somehow attach itself to the body. So many attempts are made by that form... Our eyes cannot see them, and we cannot know what is happening and what is not happening, but that vile form is clashing with the body. And it hits it countless times, to become attached to the body, but it cannot become attached. It cannot become attached, and finally, the body is buried. After being buried, this vile form that is there, it starts circling around it. It starts circling around the grave, and its circling is in such a way that, just as we circle the Kaaba, or we circle around some good thing, in the same way, it starts wandering around its grave. It keeps wandering, and this wandering of its continues for how long? For 40 days. It continues for 40 days. That is why the forty-day mourning period (*chehlum*) came into being. Did you see? The *chilla*, *chilla* that came about, it came from this. You understand? *Chehlum* is this. Why? Because those who came and taught us, did the Prophet not tell us? Did Ali not tell us? Did the prophets not tell us? This *chilla* was told by whom? By this very form, it said, "Look, it's a matter of 40 days." For 40 days it stays near its grave and wails. It cannot leave. And it is sitting there, doing this. What happens is that finally, when the final period starts to end, after 40 days, at that time, it goes out of its mind. It goes out of its mind, and because there is corporeality in it, a little corporeality is in it, so because of that corporeality, it takes on a form and starts to cry a little. And those sounds of crying are heard. That is why in old graveyards, the sounds of crying are heard. Our Du'at call it *anīn*. Its name is *anīn*. Those sounds of crying are called *anīn*. These sounds of crying keep happening, and after being there for 40 days, after 40 days of confinement, their release is completed, and this form is removed, "Now go. Get out of here. Now you are not fit to be here." "You are not fit to be near this grave, which is your grave." So now that form leaves from there. After leaving, its condition becomes even worse. The condition of that form, which is called the *sūrat al-khabīthah*, becomes even worse. Its condition becomes even more wretched. And what is that condition? Either what does it do? As they say, "a rat in a trap fights with its teeth." The same is the case, that now it is ready for battle. "Do whatever you want, however you want." Such becomes its state. And after leaving from there, it comes straight... six or seven places have been mentioned. Those are its dens. These are its dens, its lairs, its homes, its abodes, where it stays. The first thing it likes very much is the latrine (*bayt al-khala*). It likes the latrine. That is why our elders, the venerable Du'at, the 12 etiquette they first wrote in the treatise were for what? For the latrine. You would say, brother, what is this? They should have written for the mosque. They should have written for the throne, or for something else. What is this, etiquette for the latrine? It is for this reason that it starts from here. First, say *a'ūdhu*, then say *bismillāh*. So this... this latrine, this is its abode. This is their abode. This is the latrine. And what are you commanded? "Go with your head covered." And you are going with your head uncovered. And why is there a command not to go with the head uncovered? It is because these forms are present there. Because these are their abodes. If there are two, or four, they are there. At least one is there. Because these are their abodes. So these... if sometimes it happens that they are countless. And your eyes cannot see them. Because they have left the body, you are in a state of the body, so you cannot see them. They hang from there. And what do they do first? They affect the head. They affect the head. That is why we are commanded to go with our head covered. He had said that the reason for covering the head is that there is filth there, and if a fly sits there and then sits on our head, how bad is that? Brother, your outward eyes see this. I was just reading a pamphlet, I wanted to read it to you too. Regarding ablution, they have written a page and a half, some Maulvi sahib, and the absurdities he has uttered in it are worth seeing. That from wiping the feet this happens, from wiping the hands a person starts getting fat, from wiping the face it gets irrigated, becomes fresh and verdant, and this and that happens. These are fantastical things regarding ablution. And the things I said, you can compare them. Inshallah, if you give me some time, I will give you a pamphlet. You read the pamphlet. It is about ablution. Anyway, that was a digression. I was saying that now this vile form, its first abode is the latrine. In the latrine, it... because it is vile, it likes a vile place. And now, if it leaves this vile place and goes somewhere else... it happens that a person gets tired of staying in one place, so we also have picnics, we go on excursions, we celebrate holidays, we celebrate Juma, other people celebrate Sunday. They do celebrate. So anyway, what is their way of celebrating? They also need recreation. How do they recreate? I will tell you. They leave from here, and if they get bored of staying in one place, the other place they look for, which place is it, do you know? It is where there is a garbage dump. Where all the garbage comes and falls, or where garbage is lying, which we call a garbage pile in our language, or a place where there is a lot of garbage, they are buzzing there like countless flies. These are the vile forms. Did you understand? And its third place is where dead bodies are kept. The mortuary, where the bodies of dead people are kept. They also go and rest there a little. These are their abodes. Those are also their recreation spots. They stay there. And if they leave from there, then a barren field is also very pleasing to them. And thorny trees, very dense thickets, that is also very pleasing to them. Thorny trees are very pleasing to them, they hang there. They go to that place. And after that, the thing that is dear to them, sometimes for their recreation, what is that place of recreation? It is a crossing. The crossing of roads, on that crossing they are always present. They are always there. That is why accidents happen. You think that this is his fault, that is his fault, he didn't see the light, he did that. You can say all you want. The speakers can say all they want. But we will say that this is it. The real reason is that they are present at the crossing. And when you come under their influence, if you have not recited *a'ūdhu billāh*, if you have not recited *bismillāh*, if you have not opened your umbrella of protection, and if you have not taken refuge in prayers, if you have not remembered Allah, then you are going to fall into trouble. So, in this way, when do calamities get averted? When we turn to Allah. And they are not averted when we turn our face away from Allah and do not turn to Him. So at this crossing, they are present. And the countless clashes that happen, they derive pleasure from it. They take great pleasure in it. So, in this way, when do calamities get averted? When we turn to Allah. And they are not averted when we turn our face away from Allah and we do not turn to Him. So at this crossing, they are present. And the countless clashes that happen, they derive pleasure from it. They take great pleasure in it. Just as, because you think that after death, a person will improve. Brother, there is no question of improving. He will become even worse. You understand? There is a big difference between our thinking and the reality. So they go there and cause a lot of... incidents. And they do things, and I want to explain it in a little more detail, because I am especially addressing my sisters, and then my brothers too, and I want to tell them what miracles and what effects these things leave behind. Look, in the world, ghosts, fairies, spirits, witches, demons, whatever all these are called, they are not different things. They are the name for this. Did you understand? It is only one thing. This is the vile form. These are its different manifestations, different states. You named it a witch, you named it a ghost of the world, you named it an apparition, you named it this, you named it that. Now what happens is that the supernatural acts that happen, the supernatural acts that happen in many places, that they show you things they do, great, great things, great miracles happen, big things happen. Indeed, they happen. Why do they happen? So if you are a believer in miracles and a servant of miracles, then accept them. But we are not servants of miracles. These are just the wonders they show, it is because of these forms. These are countless states. Just a small... a little bit, just reflect, and empty your mind for a moment of reflection and understand and listen to one thing I say. And that is, did the Prophet, *'alayhi-ṣalātu wa-s-salām*, in his noble *sharī'at*, not say that I am making *ghinā* (singing with musical instruments) forbidden? Tell me. *Ghinā*. *Ghinā* means singing with musical instruments. If someone recites with a beautiful voice, let him recite. But if he recited with musical instruments, then that is *ghinā*. Reciting with musical instruments is called *ghinā*. Today, whether it is a *na't* being recited, or praise of Ali is being done, or for anyone, for the Lord of the worlds, praise is being done, whatever is happening, it is all misguidance, it is error. Why? Because it is happening on a harmonium. It is happening on songs. And you tell me, how many *qawwālī* sessions happen where? You are seeing it. Why do these *qawwālī* sessions happen? It is because these forms are being nourished. They are getting food. This is their food. Because we were forbidden from this so that your *ḥissīyah* (sensory soul) does not get food, so that you incline more towards the *nāṭiqah* (rational soul), not towards the *nāmiyah*, not towards the *ḥissīyah*. That is why we were forbidden from *ghinā*, so that you start becoming pure right from here. Why do you get filtered through sieves? Why don't you filter yourselves beforehand? Are you understanding? Why don't you filter yourselves? Why do you go to such places? It happened to our elders as well, when they got into such situations, when they were taken there and got into a big problem, he was a *pīr*, and he was a *pīr*, and they went and got stuck, and there was a *qawwālī* session happening there. "Come on, Maulana, today there is going to be a *qawwālī*." There is going to be *simā'*. From *'ayn*, with a lot of *'ayn*, they produce more than Arabs. *Simā'*. A lot of *simā'* is going to happen. You should listen to it. So Maulana Fathullah sahib used to say, "Brother, what should I do? I want to listen very much. It's a very good thing. *Simā'*, what can I say, what an atmosphere it creates. But I don't have ears. I don't have ears." So the reality is that if you incline towards it, it pulls you towards itself. It is like an itch. It is not something that will leave you. Keep scratching, and the itch will keep coming. So this is pleasure-seeking. This is pleasure-seeking that happens through the eyes, that happens through the hands, that happens through the nose, that happens through the ears. This is pleasure-seeking, which you are seeking in different ways. But there are guards of the *sharī'at* on it. If you sought pleasure in the right way, then it is permissible (*jā'iz*). That is the legitimate child. And if you did it in the wrong way, then it is the illegitimate child. In this very world, you get stoned for it. So where will you go in the religion? So I am saying that all these vile forms, these are the ones that do all these things, they create all these illusions, and all these things are the calamity and trouble caused by them. Along with this, there is another thing too. What is that? *Raml* (geomancy), *Jafr* (a form of divination), all these things... these shops that are set up, they read hands, they read feet, they do this, they light wicks, and they tell you... "Let's check our accounts." Brother, what accounts? They will tell you your entire account. But I should know that the thing I am telling, God forbid, let no one tell it. This is the real skill. Let someone tell this. Yes. That complete theory is what one would call it, which tells from A to Z. What is this, that they tell four things and leave five? No, no. The skill is that which tells from top to bottom. That theory is yours. That thing... it is a system, an arrangement. And that philosophy is called the philosophy of the Āl-i-Muḥammad, *'alayhimu-ṣalātu wa-s-salām*. What is this, that you take one part at a time and start explaining it? So now look, these shopkeepers that are there, you go there, and you are amazed. "What he has told! The one who told it!" Oh. He has amazed me. "From my childhood, since I asked about my birth..." The moment I said my date of birth, and with the date of birth, he drew my birthstone. And with that, he started, and the whole story unfolded, and until the end, he did not take a breath. He explained every single thing. Why wouldn't he explain? When he has four or five hunted vile forms sitting with him, then if he doesn't run his shop with these forms, then how will the poor man run his shop? Are you seeing? So this is a skillful thing. A skilled person, this skillful thing, for God's sake, do not consider it spiritual. A cobbler's job is only to repair a shoe. And another, a blacksmith, will only repair an iron thing. This is a skill. So this is also a skillful thing, and that skilled person... and what is that skill? That they keep such vile forms under their control, they tame them. How do they tame them? I will tell you that too. But after taming them, what do they do? They get such work done from them. They get this work done and tell you. "Well, how did they know? All these things, how did they know it? In his time, how did he tell that this incident had happened? His past is this, his future is this. This thing will suit him, this will not suit him." How did he tell this? The reality is that this vile form, which has left the body, since it has left the body, because it is a spirit, at least even if it is a bad spirit, it is a spirit. It has left the body, so now what will happen? That in the universe, whatever is happening, it is happening by the plan of the Imam, *'alayhi-ṣalātu wa-s-salām*. Who is the God of the time? The Imam of the time. By the plan of the Imam of the time, the sun is rising, the moon is also setting, the stars are also coming out, the clouds are also raining, everything is happening, it is happening by the command of that same Imam. Not a leaf will move. "*lā tataḥarraku dharratun illā bi-idhni-llāh*" (Not an atom moves except by the permission of Allah). Every particle cannot move without the permission of Allah. That Allah, where did He come here to give the command? Allah has already commanded whatever He had to. Now the Imam's command is running in the universe. This is the God of the time. Now these particles are all moving. Now, if you have taken that movement in the wrong way, then you have fallen into trouble. Meaning, what is the state? That if we have tried to benefit from *Raml*, *Jafr*, etc., what will happen? Because these have left the body, the plan of the Imam that is running, that today a cyclone is to come here, and in East Pakistan, now Bangladesh, 2 million people are to be finished in one tidal wave. So they must be finished. If this is the plan of the Imam, then it is clear what will happen? These vile forms will come to know. You will say, "Brother, how did they know?" Brother, since they have left the body, that is why they come to know. You will say, "Brother, why did the Imam not put a restriction on this?" He cannot put it. It doesn't happen like that. They become aware of it. After becoming aware, what do they do? They go and tell. That is why so many things are true, and so many things are false. Because they have been telling lies their whole life, so what will they do? They will tell four true things, and you have bet on that very number, and you have won a lot. And after that, finally, you are completely bankrupt. So these are the kind of people who do this. They will make one person win, and after making a hundred win, one time they will... they will turn you away from the path of life. The loss will be such that you will turn your face away from life itself. You will think of suicide, there will be no other option. This is the state of these vile forms. And these vile forms, which I said is one thing, which has different names, and they have different functions. Now, among the different functions, one function I left out, I will explain that. What is that function? The work of the evil eye (*nazar*) that happens, they also do it. It is absolutely a true thing. The evil eye is not a wrong thing. It is absolutely a true thing that the evil eye occurs. From the evil eye, a green plant also dries up. From the evil-eye, a mountain also breaks into pieces. And a person becomes thin. He doesn't die. They cannot kill him with it, but they can make him sick and all that can happen. The evil eye can do this. You will say, "Brother, how does the evil eye work?" The reality is what happens is that if, suppose, you are wearing some good clothes, or with a good voice, or in any matter, you are going before someone, and that person, without remembering God, without saying *māshā'Allāh*, without saying *subḥān'Allāh*, he... either he clapped or he said, "How nice are the clothes you are wearing! How nice is what you have said! How nice is what you have done!" The moment he said "nice," that Satan wants nothing more than for a person who turns away from God to turn away. Immediately, what will that Satan do? It will align its gaze with his gaze. As soon as the gazes met, it became a satanic gaze, and the evil eye was cast. So this is how the evil eye is cast. Did you understand? The evil eye is cast in this way. And the evil eye is a true thing, it is not a wrong thing. But if, against the evil eye, what is there? If at that very moment, if you are facing such circumstances, at that very moment you have said *subḥān'Allāh*, *māshā'Allāh*, or you have remembered Allah in any way, that God of the time, then what will happen? Your purification will happen. And if you have not remembered, then clearly you need the help of prayers. Then take the help of prayers and ward it off. But the thing that has an effect is this. In fact, I will tell you more, that it has other miracles too, it has other wonders too. I am going to make you aware of those wonders. These are the vile forms that, after leaving the body... now what remains in that body? The *nafs-i-ḥissīyah* and the *nafs-i-nāmiyah* have remained, which has been buried. And this vile form has left. Now about the vile form, there are more details, and there are... now I have to tell you its abode, I have to tell you its prison, I have to tell you the place from where it is released, I have to tell you its rides, and I have to tell you its stations. So many things are still remaining. Because this is a very interesting thing. It is an interesting thing, and it is a thing of lesson (*'ibrat*) too. Along with that, we have to take a lesson too. And we have to seek refuge in Allah, and most of all, we have to prostrate in the court of Allah, that the Lord of the worlds has kept us on the straight path, on the *ṣirāṭ al-mustaqīm*.

Regarding the last lesson, I had explained that the fate of those outside of Islam—that is, other than Muslims—the kafir, the mushrik, their fate is indeed very bad. But as for the Muslims, I had said that their fate is of the category of Jahannam, but they too are not able to escape this punishment, because if they have adopted the stance of a Nasibi towards the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and his Ahl al-Bayt, or made comments on them, then they too will have to suffer the consequences. And they too will have to endure severe hardship, both at the time of their death and after their death. So no one is exempt from it. When we understand that the world of Islam cannot escape it, then besides Islam, the other religions that exist—be they the Shah-e-mutahhir, or the people of Musir-e-mustakbir, or, you could say, the other religions in the world, be it Buddhism, or Confucianism, or so-and-so, Judaism, or Hinduism, or the Hindu faith, or any other kind of religion—all these people of different religions, what are they? What is their specialty? They are believers in shirk and kufr, in ilhad. All of them will receive punishment. And they will have to endure severe torments. Now, what happens is that just as there are degrees within iman, in the same way, there are degrees within kufr. There are levels within it too. There too. You will see so many Hindus, you will see so many mushriks, so many worshippers, so many who do not bring iman in Islam, you will see them too, that they too do believe in one God. There are many who do not believe in God. So, by believing in one God, will they attain success? It is not so. They will not attain success either, but the difference is that it does make some difference. Among those who are successful and those who are unsuccessful, a difference certainly does arise. Now, the thing is, in reality, what is it? That, look, every person has to revolve on their own axis and also revolve in their surroundings, just as this world revolves around the sun and also on its own axis. Meaning, every person has to render their accounts here, and secondly, they also have to receive their accounts, so that based on the accounts they have brought, their progress will also take place. Meaning, Allah Ta'ala, as He had said that, *`aduwwun ba`dukum li-ba`din `aduww* (You are enemies, one to another), which the Quran Majid says, that you descend into this world as enemies to one another. So, it became known that this shirk, this kufr, and this ilhad, or you could say, the Shah-e-mutahhir, Musir-e-mustakbir, Nazir-e-mustakbir, they will never live together in harmony. Clashes will keep happening between them, wars will keep happening between them, in thoughts, in ideologies, and in it. In every single thing, a difference will remain. So, that is why the Quran Majid said what? *Kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihun* (Each party rejoicing in that which is with them). Every group is happy in its own place. It thinks that we are successful, we are right, and so on. But in reality, not every group can be right. The reason for that is that the right path will be only one. The straight line, I have always explained to you, sir, that the straight line will be only one, which joins two points with the shortest distance. The one that joins two points with theshortest distance is only one straight line, and what is that straight line? It is the line of Ruhaniyyat. Our din, our mazhab is the correct din, the correct mazhab. And its truthfulness, its proof is this, that in comparison to our ideology, when we say, through the Quran, that *haatu burhanakum in kuntum sadiqin* (Bring forth your proof, if you are truthful), if you are truthful, then bring your proof. They cannot bring any proof. And they cannot present such an ideology that encompasses the entire universe, that encompasses physicalities, spiritualities, intellects, sensibles, every single thing, and explains every single thing. No such ideology could be presented in the world. Please, come here. So, no such… just move forward a little. Please move forward. So, no such ideology has been presented in the world to this day. So, I said to you that in terms of kufr and shirk, it is necessary for all of them to face punishments, and they will have to endure punishments. They will have to endure the punishment of the grave, they will have to endure the punishment of death, and they will have to endure the punishments after that, the details of which you will hear. So, I was telling you that a non-Muslim, or you could understand it as a non-Sulaymani, who goes, that person has not been given the straight path. So it is obvious that they will have to suffer some punishment here. Now, the matter of more or less is different, and where is this increase or decrease happening? The increase or decrease happens only in this regard: that the person is a believer in Allah, a believer in the Prophet, or a believer in the Prophets, or a reciter of the Kalima La ilaha illa Allah. There is some reduction in it, but not a reduction of the kind that, in terms of Sulaymaniyyat, one is completely removed from this realm of darkness, is purified from it, and crosses over. That thing, that supremacy, they cannot achieve. And they cannot achieve the progress that a Sulaymani has. As for the fact that since we have achieved it, then we are indeed the saved ones, we are indeed the people of Paradise, we are indeed on the right path, we are indeed on the straight path. But what is this? What is the difference that arises? That if you are on the straight path but did not walk, then where will you get the destination? If you remained on the straight path, but you did not do the things you were commanded to do and did not refrain from the things you were commanded to refrain from, then you, while giving your accounts, while suffering in this world, it will take you a very long time to reach your destination. But you are certainly standing on the right path. For this, I give you this much guarantee, and this guarantee exists, from Allah and from the Prophet of Allah, that we are on the right path. So, I was telling you that a non-Sulaymani's situation is such that they lack the third nafs. I had told you that the third nafs is what? The Natiqa. They do have the Nafs-e-Namiya and the Nafs-e-Hissiya, but since they do not have the original nadamat, they do not have the third nafs, which in reality does what job? It does the job of a pilot. It takes our nufus on the straight path. The nafs that takes the Nafs-e-Hissiya and the Nafs-e-Namiya from here is the Nafs-e-Natiqa. Since the Natiqa does not exist—why does the Natiqa not exist? Because they did not show nadamat. Now you will say, they didn't show nadamat, but they did have some conception. Yes, they did have a conception. Either they had the conception of Shah-e-mutahhir or the conception of Musir-e-mustakbir. They certainly did have some conception. And nature has preserved their conception. Now you will say that this too was in the Mudd-e-Nur? No. The means of preserving their conception is lower. It is below the celestial spheres. Theirs is a means where their deeds and so on are preserved. And to each one, his destiny—the nasib-jusi, whatever his form is, whatever his thought is—that is given to him, that this was your thought, take it. This is your thing, take it. This is justice from Allah Ta'ala, that no one's thing is changed for another's. It's not that this one's goes to that one, or that one's comes to this one. It's not like that. This is justice and fairness from Allah Ta'ala, that as you think, so you will become. How is Allah? As you are. So, you should keep this absolutely in your mind. And this ideology, na'udhu billah, na'udhu billah, na'udhu billah, of the Muslim world, in which kufr has been mixed. In Islam, kufr has been mixed. That is *Al-khayru was-sharru min Allah Ta'ala* (Good and evil are from Allah the Exalted). That good and evil are from Allah's side. The fact that they attributed evil to Allah is the worst thing they have done, because of which the entire Islam has been ruined. For this very reason, what happened? All their ideologies changed. Obviously, you will be doing it with your heart and mind. When your heart and mind are doing that planning, then what will happen? That this one will straight away enter your chest. What? It is a spirit, it can enter the chest. These ribs cannot stop it. They enter the chest and go near the heart and say, "Oh, you have to hit this much? It's better if you hit with full force. It's better if you kill his whole family. Then neither will the root remain, nor will the issue remain, nor will so-and-so remain, nor will so-and-so remain. If you have to finish, then finish the whole family. What will be gained by hitting just one?" So, they whisper such things. And the whispers they put in our chests are that when you become a Momin... …only this much? This should also be done. Such a planning should be done that the one in front becomes silent. He should not even make a demand from us. He should not even call so-and-so. Some such planning should be done. All these conspiracies that are there, from what are they born? From this very surat-e-khabisah. It is this surat-e-khabisah that is wandering in thousands and lakhs. And from this… when they leave from here, I have told you about their haunts. I have told you about their rides. And after the rides, I told you that... I also told you that they have a passion for staying in graveyards. I also told you that. And about the sound of their crying, I also told you anin. When they leave from there, now they have fulfilled all their desires, they have tormented people, they have harassed them, whatever they felt like, they have fulfilled all their desires. And after that, what happens? They try to leave this realm of darkness. They don't want to wander. And they want to leave this realm in some way. "What is this? We are just lying here all the time. After all, we have no purpose in that." "Our body has been buried. When we go to the grave, nothing is gained. The graveyard is in that state. And all our brothers, wherever they are, are all wandering." All… it's a vagabond state. It's the state of a cut kite. They are suffering. They are wandering. No one is there to pick them up, no destination. No pact, no this, no that. So, in the end, what is to be gained by remaining in such a state? It is better to leave this realm. When they try to leave this realm, they make a collective effort. And in this collective effort, great things come to pass. Now I am leaving all those things because the topic will become even longer. But if there had been a chance, I would have explained it to you. That when nature wants it, then surely floods come. Nature wants it, then great storms blow. Nature wants it, then earthquakes come. Nature wants it, then… but when nature wants such a thing, then with whom does it work? It works with these very ones. These are the ones. These are the surat-e-khabisah that bring earthquakes. But why? When the owner of a garden tends to the garden, he plants very good flower trees, very good fruit trees, then he definitely puts up a fence. "Brother, why are you putting up a fence?" He is putting up a fence… so he has to dig the ground, he has to do so and so… "No, but you will say that the owner of the garden is wise. He is putting up a fence for the protection of the flowers. He is putting up a fence for the protection of the fruits." So the fence has to be there. So in the same way, you will have to know that these… their existence is also in its place. It is useful. In what way? That the work nature has to take from them, it takes. And it takes it. And after taking it, it throws them into a corner. That the communities upon communities, neither did the story of Nimrod remain, nor the story of 'Ad, nor Thamud. The nations were wiped out, destroyed, their signs did not remain. So, when God had to wipe out, it was finished in a second. And when He had to keep, then Allah kept, and Allah kept him. So anyway, they wander and try to leave. When they go towards the heavens, then nature also wants that their wandering should happen. "Let's see their cleverness too. Let's see their flight too." "Let's see how they fly." When they go up, then below the moon… I had told you about Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon. These are the seven planets I had enumerated for you. And with the seven planets, I had told you about the seven heavens. And after that, I told you about the sphere of the constellations and the sphere of the spheres. This was the realm of the heavens. But below the realm of the heavens, there are two stars whose shells do not exist, who do not shine. They are not visible. Only two stars. And the whole world accepts this too. So many scientists there are, so many astronomers there are, they all believe that there are those two stars, whose name is what? Rahu and Ketu. Their name is Rahu and Ketu. And in our language, what is it called? Ras and Zanab. Ras means head, Zanab means tail. Ras and Zanab. The Zanab is very bad. It is more bad. The Ras is not that bad. Anyway, these two, these two stars that are there, that are below the moon's sphere, they come below the moon. And they are not visible, they are non-luminous. So these two stars, why has Allah made them? Every kingdom that will be formed, it will have some necessities. And what are those necessities? One of the biggest necessities is a prison. That a prison should be made so that those who commit crimes… "Oh brother, why do you think like that? Make such a kingdom, it's better that you don't even think of a crime." Can it be like that? Oh brother, if there is a kingdom, there will be a crime too. If there is a crime, there will be a prison too. So, in nature's prison… nature also had to make a prison. And which prison did nature make? It made this Ras and Zanab, below the moon's sphere, a prison. And these are two big prisons in which these surat-e-khabisah are tied up. They are imprisoned there. And they are imprisoned. And when are they imprisoned? When they have fulfilled all their desires. Their accounts are settled. If yes, they are caught without reason, then the angels of God will catch them and throw them in. And if they are not caught without reason, they have fulfilled their desires and are coming away, then come on. If they come straight away, it's good. Otherwise, the angels are also present to beat them. And they catch them and imprison them. And these are imprisoned in Ras and Zanab. And they are imprisoned in a countless state. This imprisonment that happens is such an imprisonment, such a hard imprisonment, that don't even ask. They cannot move from there. They cannot go anywhere from there. There, those same surats are wandering. And they are wandering there. But there is a time when all the doors of that prison are opened. And they are given complete freedom. That "Go wherever you want in the world. Do whatever you want." Just as on the day of Eid we give freedom to our children, or the country gives freedom to its prisoners. In the same way, in Allah's nature and in God's law also, such days come for them, in which they are given permission that, "You do whatever you want. Go, you are free from prison today for two days." But after that, you will be caught again. And which days are those? They are the days of the lunar and solar eclipse. They are the days of the lunar and solar eclipse. On which they are given freedom. For this very reason, what happened? That if Muslims say, or Hindus say, or Brahmins say, so don't you... they also say, so anyone can say anything. From that, a true thing, if it comes out of someone's wrong mouth, he does not become truthful. A wrong person, if he is saying a true thing, he does not become truthful. He has said it. Just as there are many who speak a lot in their sleep, but the reality is that those who are people of reality are saying, you should understand that on these days of lunar and solar eclipse, what should you do? You should worship. It's not that you, if a pregnant woman is there, she should lie down. And so-and-so should be done. Or oil should be given in charity. All sorts of superstitions in the world. There are all sorts of superstitions in the world and it's going on. This should also be done, that should also be done, so-and-so should be done, the sun should not be looked at. And it should not be like this. Oh brother, all these... yes, of course, if science says that the eyes get damaged by looking at the sun, then why do the eyes get damaged? The reason is that these surat-e-khabisah come out and attack. That is why they forbid, "Brother, don't look." And they have become blind. Thousands, not lakhs, have become blind. So it is obvious that at such a time, what should you do to yourself? You should keep yourself in a state of prayer. For this very reason, we have the lunar and solar eclipse prayer. That you should remain in a state of prayer. You... the rain will fall. The storm will come. You keep your umbrella. You take your umbrella. You turn towards Allah in a state of prayer. So it became known that these two days are their days. When they get out all their heart's desires, their heart's steam. And they create a lot of mischief. They create a lot of mischief. And when they descend from the sky, what is the condition? That just as there is a special season for fishing, then a lot of fish are available, then you see, you cast the net, and they are caught. That is the condition of these. For this very reason, what happens? You will see that all those who do ramal, jafar, and such things, all those who do the work of Satan, all those who do these practices, they do their practices on this very day. The reason for that is that this is the season. They have come in countless numbers. You cast the net, and they are caught. So, they also know with which net they should be caught. And they... because they are of the same kind. For this reason, they easily come into their hands. They come into their hands. And after coming, they become Muhammad Sher. And they become Peer Sarkar. And they become so-and-so. They, after coming into their possession, show new spectacles. They deceive the world, they make fools of them. And these spectacles happen. "Oh, what happened? You go to that dargah. Oh, the sick person is immediately..." "Either the sickness will go or the sick person will go." "Brother, what is this? The madman got cured." Oh brother, the madman got cured, but the other sicknesses won't go. You will immediately get relief. That's true, brother. So this is the condition. That we are being taught. "Brother, you must go. That dargah… what tasawwufat!" "Oh." "The tasawwufat of the dargah, don't even ask." "Oh brother, they would be." We have no argument with that. That they would be saints. They would have worshipped Allah too, they would have done so-and-so too. But what from that? That their ilhaq is not there. They are not on Sulaymaniyyat. If there is a ticket, it is a Sulaymani one. But if you bring this whole pile, what is it? If it is not Sulaymani, then it is nothing. If it is not Sulaymani, it is nothing. So, what is to be gained from this whole pile? So, they do all these spectacles. And all these, all these magicians, those who do ramal, those who read palms, or those who speak, or those who make prophecies, or those who turn the tasbih and speak, they may turn the tasbih this way or that way, but they are giving you the opposite result. And why are they giving the opposite result? And they are speaking the truth. So many things they say are true. The reason for that is that these who are there, as I told you, these surat-e-khabisah who are there, they have a lot of accumulated knowledge in their bags, in their pouches. Now, if they are talking amongst themselves, then what is it? "I have had ten hunts today." "Oh." Just as one hunter tells another. That is their condition. "I have had ten hunts." He says, "I have had twenty." He said, "I have had twenty-five." Someone said, "I have had a hundred." So, as many as have hunted are there, but after death, they themselves have been hunted. They themselves have gone. Now they are taking them along, "Come, you also do our work." Now they will also make them do their work. So, exactly the same is their condition. That these, all the... this kind of work, all these people who do these businesses, they are all artists. They are artists. Because their art is more. And this... the skill they have is very little. The show they put on is a lot. Just as it happens, right? A lawyer's situation... there is no lawyer here, right? A lawyer's situation is that in front of him, there are piles of books. Books are like this. So that the client who comes, the moment he comes, he is impressed by the books, that this lawyer's mind is very sharp. He has filled so many books in his mind. Now, what will he not argue? So they make the first impression. So, in the same way, what is it? That first of all they make an impression. And after making an impression, they do it in such a way. So, on their suggestions. For this very reason, Allah Ta'ala says in the Quran Sharif, that *yuhina ba'duhum ila ba'din zukhrufal qawli ghurura* (They inspire each other with adorned speech as a delusion). That these, what do these Satans do? They whisper in each other's ears. And their qawl is a false qawl. "Oh, don't go by their qawl. Look, look, don't be deceived. If they speak the truth 25 times, then with one lie of theirs, they will ruin you completely." What is to be gained? And why do they speak the truth 25 times? The reason is that they are in the world of life. They have died. The surat-e-khabisah in the form of which they are wandering in the world. And the plan of Imam alayhis-salam that is going on, the angels that are appointed, on the rising and setting of the sun and moon, on its changing, on the movement of the heavens, on the falling of the rain, every single thing that is happening in the world, in all these things, the plan of Imam alayhis-salam that is going on, they are watching it carefully, they are seeing it. They are seeing it. Now they have come and said, "Look, a storm is coming." "What a thing he said! Exactly at the minute and second he had mentioned, the storm came." But why wouldn't it come, sir? If he told the truth once, he will also lie ten times. This is their nature. And they have told lies. That is why you have gone astray. And they... so, for this reason we have been forbidden from reading palms, from looking at hands. And from having recourse to them. And from not going to them. From a distance, greet them. "Oh brother, you are good, we are good." "Your dargah is very good, but for God's sake, keep us in our place. We don't want to do so-and-so." We don't say bad things to anyone, and no one should say bad things to us. That is the best thing. So, all these are matters. And you are seeing that a fair is going on there, which the Prophet has forbidden. These are the followers of the Prophet's name. They are the reciters of the Prophet's kalima. They are sitting as the Prophet's teachers. They have done the work as murshids. They have spread guidance, and the condition is that the harmonium is playing there. The tabla is playing, the harmonium is playing. What is it? "Brother, it has to play for 24 hours." "Why 24 hours?" "Brother, the sahib-e-qabr cannot sleep." "The sahib-e-qabr cannot sleep, he needs singing for 24 hours." What is this? Now, what is this, after all? Oh brother, did the Prophet, peace be upon him, na'udhu billah, na'udhu billah, establish this? In the time of the companions, in the time of the Prophet, in the time of Ali, did you ever hear such singing? When it is not in the Shari'ah of Muhammad, then how did this singing become lawful? You, by taking the love of Ali and the naat of the Prophet, or by taking the naat of the saints, you think that all this has become lawful? No. This is like putting poison in a pitcher of milk. Bad is bad. Good is good. So anyway, this is the condition of the surat-e-khabisah, that for them... I have told you about their days of leisure too. Their days of leisure and activity also... they celebrate. And how they bring calamities. And how they are imprisoned. And how they trap people and how they torment people. Anyway, for them, a period has been appointed. Which the Quran says, that *amhilhum ruwayda* (so grant them a brief respite). That for them, a period has been fixed. So for Satan, there is a period. And when is that period? Until Qiyamah. Until Qiyamah, he will keep tormenting you. *illa 'ibadallahil mukhlason* (except for the sincere servants of Allah), the Quran says, "Except for those servants who are of ikhlas." He cannot torment them, Satan. But he will surely torment others. So, those who have taken refuge, it is obvious that they have remained on the right path. Those who have not taken refuge, their thoughts are bad, their character is bad, their actions are bad. Whatever thing they think of, it will be wrong. Whatever they say, it will be wrong. And they will keep getting trapped. And they will keep getting trapped. From that... there is no gain in criticizing them. As it is said, "O camel, which of your parts is straight?" Nothing is straight. Whichever part you touch, it's crooked. The whole structure is crooked from top to bottom. So anyway, from them is God's refuge and from God's is salvation. And `audhu billah min dhalik (I seek refuge in Allah from that). Allah has said for this very reason, *fasta'idh billah* (seek refuge in Allah). When you take the name of Allah, turn towards Allah, then you should seek refuge from them. So, seeking refuge from whom? *minash-shaytanir-rajim* (from the accursed Satan). *shayatinul insi wal jinn* (Satans among men and jinn). Now, you have neither seen Satan, nor raised him, nor what, nor what. This Satan who was from the time of Adam, is he still tormenting from then on? And is his mention still going on? Oh sir, this Satan, his progeny exists. And in every era, it exists. And in every era, not one, but thousands, lakhs exist. And who are they? Those who are dying, their conceptions are. Who are wandering in the atmosphere. And if you are bad, then they will come and torment you. How is God? As you are. If you have sought the refuge of Allah, then you will get the refuge of Allah. If you have not sought the refuge of Allah, then for God's sake, you will not get the refuge of God. And they will surely keep tormenting you. Did you understand? How they torment, and how it happens. So anyway, a period has been appointed for them, and that is the eve of Qiyamah. And I will tell you that in Qiyamah, after they are released from jail, what happens. I will mention that along with the story of Qiyamah. At that place, it will be a suitable topic. For now, what I wanted to mention to you was just this: how the wandering of these conceptions of filth happens, where their works are, where their haunts are, and what their character is like, how they mislead, how they lead astray, and how they... *yuhina*, Allah Ta'ala says, *yuhina ba'duhum ila ba'din zukhruf*... they whisper in each other's ears. They whisper. This very thing comes and says in your ear, that "Do my chehlum. Do my so-and-so." They said it, and that's when the custom of chehlum started. There is no chehlum, malum, in Islam. There is no chehlum, no dasma, no chah mahina, no woh tha... there was nothing. These are all our created things. Not the first jume'rat, not the second jume'rat. These are... because the elders established it, they became silent, that, "Brother, the day of jume'rat has come, let's go, read Fatiha, do so-and-so, and go." But from this, it doesn't mean that you make it a part of religion and make it a shari'ah. No, there is nothing like that. There is nothing like that. Yes, the day of death that happens of the elders, their Urs is there. That is a matter of respect in its place. But it is not that the day of everyone has that importance. And that... you read Fatiha in your own place, there is no harm. But to fix it for everyone, this is not a proper thing. This is not a proper thing. The matter of the elders is different. So anyway, what I was saying is that these shayatins who are there, in what ways do they lead astray, in what ways do they mislead, I have given you some examples of that. I hope that from these few examples, you have understood many more examples. You must be understanding very well that a lot of what happens, all the mischief in the world, the fitna that happens in this world, and all the bad things that happen, in all these things, who are the ones who work? These very ones. If God allows me to speak, then the epidemics that spread, what are they? These very things. If there is an epidemic, it is these. If there is anything, it is these. If there are germs, it is these. If there are viruses, it is these. Everything is these. Did you understand? Everything is this one thing. This is the name of one thing. If you want to save yourself, then everything will be saved. Otherwise, if you did not seek refuge in Allah, then it is obvious that you will be trapped in their net. …that a…

I had mentioned this in the context of the ruh (spirit), that the evil apparition, the one we call the tasawwur-e-khabith, or evil apparition, I had mentioned its possibilities and stations, where they reside, what their state is, where they ride, and what kind of harm they inflict. And in the end, after they are exhausted, they are caught in the kuzatain (the two prisons) at night. But as long as they remain in the world, they cause a great deal of corruption. One might think, why are they left loose? What is gained by leaving them unbridled? It would be better if Allah's police caught them. But what can be done? Your system of accounting is such that they are compelled to settle their accounts, and you are also compelled to give your accounts. They have been let loose for this reason, that there is a give-and-take with you, and that give-and-take of all things must be finished. And for this give-and-take, you have to be ready. So, some give-and-take happens. What happens? Sometimes your day-and-night accounting and give-and-take continues, but sometimes a robber comes and snatches your money from your hand and runs away. In the same way, these entities also resort to mischief. They engage in mischief, they do give-and-take, and they do mischief. In short, they create havoc throughout the world. But most often, what happens is that due to our own heedlessness, our foolishness, our ignorance, we start inviting them. We invite them. At the very least, it should not be that we are so foolish, that we have so little intellect, that we invite such impure spirits from which we seek refuge by saying "*'A'udhu billahi min al-shaytan al-rajim*" (I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan). We seek refuge, but we don't refrain from inviting them.

But we start inviting them. And I have told you how that invitation happens. The lines that we draw in front of our houses, and the various shapes we make and keep, through these they come. Or when you light an incense stick, lighting an incense stick over a picture has no meaning. It is wrong. What is this? This is puja (idol worship). It is a form of puja. If you have to light an incense stick, light it somewhere else, and its fragrance will spread. It does not mean you should offer flowers on a picture. This is... you have become worshippers of idols ('ubbad al-asnam), it has become idol worship. Absolutely not. Placing flowers... if you accidentally drop them, that is a different matter. But if you are intentionally placing them for this purpose, thinking that you are placing flowers... that is what happens. And performing aarti, which is prevalent among the Dawoodis today, is an extremely impure custom, a custom of the Hindus. Performing aarti, this thing of waving a lamp around, what is it? All these are their customs. What will happen from this? These impure spirits get a signal, and they get an invitation card. They say, "Come on, this person follows our ways, so let's go and set up our camp there." They come. Or, you were told that if you style your hair, first you should hide it. And if your hair is ever visible, your parting should be from the middle, not from the side. And you made the parting from the side instead of the middle. You were told to protect your hair; you started cutting your hair. You were told that if you keep your hair, you should braid it. You just tied it up... what you call tying it at the back. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said that this is the sitting place of Shaitan. This is Shaitan's seat. But you don't understand this.

So what will happen? It is obvious that this thing... the most beloved thing for them in a woman is what? It is her hair. So, from the hair, they will immediately start entering. And what other thing is there? I said that Shaitan's book is the mark of tattooing. These tattooed marks, the black dots they make, those who burn their hands and feet, and who make various pictures of snakes and other worldly nonsensical things, or get them tattooed on their chests... what is all this? This is all Shaitan's... these are writings, and on this, these people die, and they come, thinking, "Come on, this person follows us, this person understands us. This one is one of us." Do you understand? So, may God protect us from these things. We should not do such things from which... So, to adhere to such customs which we have been forbidden from... you are following those customs. What is it? A lamp is being carried with the bride. Hey, for what reason? That just as this lamp burns, she too should keep burning like a candle. Meaning, she should remain radiant. It doesn't mean, God forbid, that she keeps burning... she should remain radiant. If one took this meaning, it would be much better. But they don't take this meaning. What is it? That she should remain radiant. Like a lamp, she should be radiant. Hey, what does it mean to be radiant? What is your point in carrying a lamp? Now what happened is that they took it, and the lamp started to go out. "Oh, this is a bad omen! Do this, instead take a torch." So they started taking a torch. Why? So that it doesn't go out. Just as they started shining torches on the gods and goddesses, with globes, similarly, with our brides, we also started taking torches. This is all nonsense, and all this is imitation of the Hindus. And the Prophet said, "*Man tashabbaha bi qawmin fa huwa minhum*" (Whoever imitates a people is one of them). Whoever adopts the likeness of a people, his count will be among them. And "*tamutuna 'ala ma ta'ishun*" (you will die upon that which you lived). Your death will be in the same way as you spend your life. You liked Hinduism, so alright, your final reckoning will be done on Hinduism. As you sow, so shall you reap.

If we have, in our place, adopted the right path, then everything will have to be corrected. You will say, "I have taken the pledge of allegiance, now do whatever you want." This cannot be. If you have taken the pledge, then you must adhere to all things and also be aware of the Shari'ah. You might say, "I will remain ignorant, I will remain ignorant, Allah will forgive me." Hey, why did you remain ignorant? You will be caught for this from the very beginning. You will be caught from the beginning. That is why Mawla-e-Ka'inat said, "Whoever comes to me ignorant, I will break their nose, whether male or female believer." That is why it was said that one should seek knowledge even if one has to go to China for it. So, what we learned is that this thing is useless, and it is something that puts one in trouble. Shaitan misguides us, and in the same way, he comes through these tricks, and he will cause us harm. If we keep giving such invitations, he will surely keep coming and will continue to cause us harm. So, in any case, they keep creating havoc in this universe, and new uproars keep happening. The truth is, may God make me speak the truth, all the calamities, all the earthquakes, all those things... within the workshop of nature, even the natural calamities, as we call them, when they come, nature also works through them. Nature works through them. Storms blow, this and that happens. So why do we give the adhan? We give it for this reason: that these things are happening, and they are coming, but you should become safe in your place, so that your angels who have come for the adhan may stop them, and you may remain safe. And thousands of times such things have happened that when you gave the adhan, that thing was averted from you. Indeed, it happens. Why wouldn't it? When you take the name of Allah, why wouldn't it be averted? So, you should at least recite *La hawla*. You keep inviting them and also keep reciting *La hawla*. This makes no sense. You should seek refuge from it, and you should seek refuge completely. Because Shaitan... that is why the Prophet had said... see, this is a very great saying of the Prophet. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, says that Shaitan runs with your blood. Hey, what is this thing? Why did the Prophet say this? He runs within your blood. This means that our sensations, our emotions, our feelings... within them, various things come to us, and we bring out new ideas from our minds. And man is never satisfied in his place. "Oh, I should eat something better than this. This should be more delicious." Oh, you've used ten spices, now you need to use thirty-two spices. You have done this, now you have to do something of a higher level. You have bought so many cars, now you need to add one more. Now one has to sit in a plane. Hey, what is this? You have transportation, things to wear, a bed, a place to live, a house, food to eat, drink... whatever you have... in that, you keep wanting more and more, going beyond the limit. And that is because you... you don't see that you are putting yourself into so much trouble. And you are becoming more heedless of the world, and you are becoming more distant from the din. You are getting lost. This should not happen.

And what do these entities do while living in this world? For them, this is fun. The moment they see any person showing the slightest heedlessness towards the din, they grab their hand. "This is my person." That's it. "You've only stopped going to one Jumu'ah prayer." "Hey, what's the need to go to this Jumu'ah? We are among those who go on Eid." What... "Alright, it's over." So this Shaitan... that is why "*khatamallahu 'ala qulubihim*" (Allah has set a seal upon their hearts) that Allah will seal their hearts. Allah will seal their hearts, and they will abandon everything, stop coming, and as for the da'wat... "what da'wat?"... they will abandon everything. So all these things... their thoughts will be ruined, everything about them will be ruined. So I was saying that they cause a lot of mischief, they do a lot of things. But Imam, peace be upon him... and I had also told you that... the plan of Imam that is running in this world, they also become aware of that plan. And because of that, what happens? They perform many feats of spiritual power and they... tell people that today, on some border or on some person, they become dominant, and they reach them, and from their pouch, a few things, some information gets gathered. So they go to them and show new spectacles. "What a Mawlawi has emerged! He blessed the water, and as soon as the water was drunk, the sickness was gone." "What a thing he did!" So, why wouldn't it happen? Surely, because they possess this spiritual power. They can perform many feats. But what is it? It is temporary. They cannot stand against the kingdom of Allah forever. But they do show some spectacles for a few days. And after seeing those few days' spectacles, we who are of little intelligence, we become their devoted followers. "Ah, what a holy man, sir!" "Oh, what a great man, sir!" "What a divine man, sir!" They are all charlatans and extremely useless. But you consider them to be a great deal. You consider... but Imam, peace be upon him, who is the *Imam al-ins wa'l-jinnah* (Imam of mankind and jinn), who is the Imam of the jinn and humans... he, if... a child... if parents have children, and among the children, some are mischievous, they don't throw them out saying, "Go into the street, you are mischievous." Rather, they are pieces of their own heart... of the parents. They embrace them too. He is the Imam, but what is he doing? He is watching, that after all, these are children. But they are very mischievous. If these are impure spirits, then what should be done? They have become evil. So, even upon them, there is the invitation of the Imam.

Just as we are being invited, we are receiving the *da'wat ila Allah* (invitation to Allah), that you should believe in Allah, believe Him to be without partner, do not commit any polytheism... in the same way that the explainers of the din explain to us, they too receive an invitation. That look, you too should come to the straight path. And you too should do it. So you think that they would accept it? Indeed, indeed, among them... there are surely some who... Now, this thought also comes sometimes, you might think that after dying, now if a person wants to choose the path of friendship, then everyone must choose it. No, it is not so. There are very few, rare, who accept this invitation and, after accepting, say, "Get us out of this trouble. Get us out of this trouble." And its incidents... there are some incidents like this which are present with us in the Da'wat-i-Sharif, written down as well. There are also some incidents that have occurred during the time of our old maratib. Such incidents have happened. That these very same impure spirits that are roaming about... that one evil spirit comes, and after coming, it is honored with the 'Ahd-i-Sharif (sacred pledge). Now you will say that if it is honored with the 'Ahd-i-Sharif, then what? It has no hands, no feet, it cannot fast, nor can it pray. So has it become equal to a mumin? Now leave all these questions. Right now, you see that if it is honored with the 'Ahd-i-Sharif, then upon it, such services are assigned, such things are imposed, which, being equivalent to prayer, fasting, and so on, put it into such hardship... that it has to perform those services, and only then is it released. So, such surat-s (forms) upon whom the pledge of the Imam, peace be upon him, is taken, it is rare. And it happens. Are you understanding the point? Are you understanding my words? So, this very pledge-taking, mischievous surat, the evil surat, what do we call it? What do we say? *Surat-e-Mustakhdima*. *Surat-e-Mustakhdima*. Or we say *Jinn-e-Mahmud*. This is *Jinn-e-Mazmum* (blameworthy jinn), that is *Jinn-e-Mahmud* (praiseworthy jinn). In the world, there are only two types of jinn. One jinn is bad, one jinn is good. What they call *Jinn-e-Mahmud*, *Jinn-e-Mahmud* in the world, the term that has become common, that *Jinn-e-Mahmud* is only one thing. It is this: that it was a surat-e-khabith (evil form), but after taking the pledge, it became a good surat.

We call it *Jinn-e-Mahmud*. And we call it what? *Surat-e-Mustakhdima*. This is one aspect of being called *Jinn-e-Mahmud*. The other, in a different sense... those muminin who passed away and whose surat-s (forms) were released and joined the haykal (spiritual structure), those surat-s are also called *Jinn-e-Mahmud*. If Imam, peace be upon him, takes them out from his... for example, if there are young men in a country, they are included in the army. The old are made to sit in office administration. In the same way, distributions happen. So understand that some surat-s are assigned some services. The ones to whom services are assigned are called *Jinn-e-Mahmud*. So, in *Jinn-e-Mahmud*, there are two categories. What are they? Either those to whom Imam has given a rank, or those who, after being mischievous, took the pledge and became good. They became good. So they are called *Jinn-e-Mahmud*. And those that are bad are bad. So these two... the evil surat-s, the bad surat-s, are countless.
