Relationships were formed. This became the wife, this became the mother, this became the father, this became the son, this became the grandmother, this became the sisters, these became relatives. And these became friends. And these became the neighbors, they became the city dwellers, they settled in this city, they didn't stay in that place, they stayed here. And it happened like this, and it happened like that. Now, a world of things... the livelihood was like this, we didn't get to eat those things, and we got this thing. We got these fruits, we didn't get those fruits. We didn't get the mango of Hindustan here, in Kuwait we got everything. Anyway, a world of such things are going on. So what had happened was that there, in that 'alam-i niyyat (world of intentions)... that is the 'alam-i niyyat, this is the 'alam-i 'amal (world of action). In the 'alam-i niyyat, we made various intentions. And for making those intentions, there were different formulas, different factors. Those different factors, you could have chosen them with ease, you could have done it with ease. I have only hinted to you about mailan, istihsan, and qisas. What is mailan? What is istihsan? What is mailan and what is qisas? I had told you that istihsan is when someone is doing a bad deed, and you appreciate it, saying "How well he is doing!" "He is slitting a throat." "He is doing a very good job. It would be better if he cut it with a saw." There. Istihsan is that someone is doing a bad deed, and you have a great cooperative spirit in you, you also go and start helping. "Let me also help him. At least if he is slitting the throat, let me give him the knife." So what is this? This is mailan. And what is qisas? To do that bad deed yourself. You said, "Why should others... why don't I do it myself?" And you did that bad deed. So now, these three kinds of actions' matters are also getting entangled here in all matters. So you see that if we just take the matter of qisas, it has three divisions. Now in the matters of livelihood, you see, in how many things you get entangled. That how many things' ration runs out here, then you see that your temper gets frayed. "Brother, the ration has run out. That thing has run out." And if Khuda finishes the ration from there? You can't do anything. So many times, many things stop. "Brother, what's the matter?" It is known that "It is written on our forehead..." "On every grain of food, the name of the eater is written." There you go, someone said a grain, I don't know, this is just going on, "On every grain of food, the name of the eater is written." What ignorant person... it's just going on. Now the situation is, "Brother, you didn't have that in your [unclear], you didn't have that thing, so you didn't get it. What can you do about it?" Those living in Hindustan don't eat zaytun. You live here, you eat zaytun. What can you do? So, in any case, there are many things, so the matters of eating and drinking, all these things come. And in the same way, in the context of living, in the context of life, and in the context of the relationship between sister and brother, in the context of the relationship of wife, all these things... you will say, "Brother, whatever happened here, happened. The relationship was formed in that place, it was formed. It has happened." "This is in Allah's hand. The pair is decided from there." You are saying this to console your heart. It is decided, but it is you who decided it and then descended. Allah did not decide it. Allah is 'as you are, so He is'. As you decided, you came down. Then you are crying before Allah Miyan. Why? Because if it turned out well, you take the credit. If it turned out bad, "There is a judge to punish the unjust." "Brother, we have been crying a lot throughout our lives, and for this, the entire responsibility... `al-khayru washarru min Allahi Ta'ala` (Good and evil are from God Almighty). It is from Allah Ta'ala." So this, all these relationships, everything, we created them there. We created all the relationships there. We did all the deeds of action there. Now you will say, "Brother, these... we have only made relationships within our Sulaymani jama'ah and our brothers and sisters, or something else?" "Sir, your circle, just as your hand reaches from here to Germany and who knows where else, and you have trade, business, giving and taking..." "What work are you doing, sir?" "I am doing import-export business." There. "It's very good, a very good business." You see? The uproar was that I asked one gentleman, "What work do you do?" and that poor man's work was of burial. And his work was to give ghusl. What did I know? I was going to the Zayarah in [unclear], and I met him. And next to the graveyard was a mujawir. And that person was coming behind me in such a way, I thought he wanted to ask for something. "What's the matter?" I said, "What work do you do?" And he said, "I do this work, sir. Burial, giving ghusl." So immediately that joke came to my mind that "I do import-export work." So, fine. So, as I told you, everything that happens, happens there. Whatever we did there, we did. Now you will say, "Brother, if Allah Miyan had explained a little, if He had given us the paper, we would have studied for four or six days and then given the answer properly, we would have got good marks in the exam, as is given here." There, Allah Miyan might not have given time. You got time, sir, everyone got the same time as you got. Now what can you do about it, that you did as you weighed? Allah is 'as you are, so He is'. You did as you weighed. But you made many intentions. You didn't just make a few intentions. Your horizon was expanding very far. You had become very broad-minded. Broad-minded to such an extent that your sympathies for the Shah-i Mutahhid... may God have mercy... on the contrary, you sympathized with the Mustakbir and the Mustakbir as well. You... there... "Oh my. What good people they are." "Brother, these are kafirs, these are mushriks." "Just by putting on a bindi they become mushrik? No. I have already made them my sister." Now you... "Brother, don't make them." "No, no, I have made them my brother. I have made them my sister. I have tied a rakhi." There. "Brother, what is this rakhi for? What is this sister for? What is this brother for? Understand this." "No, you understand. You are not understanding my point." Now these are the things that have happened to us, alhamdulillah. They have happened quite a lot. I am repeating those things to you, so that you too, if such an occasion arises, should answer with a smile. So, in any case, such occasions arise. Now, what to do? The reality is that we, there, with the Shah-i Mutahhid, with the Mustakbir and the Mustakbir, with everyone, created a relationship. The relationship is in such a state, why? Because when we were falling, we were all jumbled up. Someone's foot on someone's head... "Abdullah, there is no one else," and we have to stay in a crowd, we have to fight and quarrel, in some way, we have to live with trouble. We have to live in graves anyway, so let's just think that trouble is trouble. Whoever's house it is, next door is next door. "He is a neighbor." "Although they are very bad people, but what to do? Allah has put us in the same trouble, for no reason He has made him a neighbor. He has not given me a good neighbor. If I had got a good neighbor, it would have been very good. This is one trouble for me." If you ask the other person, he will say that this is the biggest trouble. So, in any case, all these neighbors, etc., all these things, what are they? All these are matters from there. You will say, "Brother, what delicacy will there be? What factors will there be? Does Allah Miyan... such small things..." Brother, when you are taking a morsel from one plate, and you are also saying, reading a verse, "On every grain of food, the name of the eater is written," then tell me, how are the intentions from there? The intention for each and every thing. To be fair, to be dark... "If Allah had just changed the features a little, it would have been better." Have you ever been satisfied? Those who will be satisfied... A child was born, so they said, "It would be good if he had grandchildren." "If his grandchildren also had children, it would be good." No child was born, so they said, "It's very good that no child was born, but if this thing had happened, it would have been good." Because man is never silent. Either he becomes very handsome, or very... "If He had made me a Habshi, but at least I had got a PhD, it would have been better." There. Someone doesn't want to be a Habshi, but a PhD is wanted. That... and someone wants that, someone wants this. So, in any case, as much as being black, yellow, features, giving, taking, high, low, short, tall, fat, thin, all these things, the doer of all these things... was you. It was you. We were the ones doing it, no one else was. We were the ones doing it. "When the Qassam-i Azal distributed, he gave to each what he was capable of." What is capability? The capability you created yourself. As you do, so will you get marks on the paper. Now what will you do about it? You will say, "Brother, if the factors were known a little... if some practice was given here..." The factors can be known, but you should try to read. You should try to move forward. This is something that is a matter of mouth to ear. It's not like I am sitting here revealing secrets in a gathering. "Every secret cannot be revealed, O wise one." It cannot be so. This is... I have created a desire in you for this, that you, with more desire, should try to acquire this 'ilm. Don't make yourself capable in such a way, and worthy of it... as I had said, we are like that child who is born in a gold mine and a diamond mine, and has played with them, kicking them, and has considered the diamond as a kunkar. The result of playing with it all his life was that 'a chicken at home is just lentils', he considered it a stone and sat down. We are the inheritors of diamonds and jewels, but the result of being an inheritor is not that you will get it at once. You will have to get it gradually. Purity will be achieved gradually. You will get everything gradually, but you will not get 'ilm gradually? This cannot be. You will have to acquire 'ilm as well. For this, one has to strive a lot, one has to try a lot to acquire it. So, in any case, as I was saying, we did everything there, and here in the 'abode of action' we are... now the 'abode of action' is this, that you, first of all, the Lord of the worlds, when its... when the time for your appearance came... you had also intended this, when your appearance would be, at what time it would be. For this reason, the Prophet has said, "Every matter is bound by its time." It will happen according to its time. So now the time came, you appeared here. Now, when you appeared, what happened? Along with appearing, Qudrat created for you that entire taqdir which you had come from there having done. This is your taqdir. Now you have become bound by your taqdir. Now you are living your life. Now if you were to only walk according to the signs of taqdir, then man would become helpless. But you are not helpless. You see that you eat what you want, you cook what you want, you wear what you want. You have full ikhtiyar. So when there is a world of ikhtiyar here, then it is known that Allah Ta'ala has given both ikhtiyar and jabar. What is jabar? That which you have already decided. And what is tadbir? That which you are doing. This is tadbir. And at the time of doing tadbir, now this is a very deep matter, a very deep matter. I will want your attention, please understand it well and listen carefully. That deep matter is this: that to us, the Lord of the worlds, as much as there is the matter of jabar... as much as there is the matter of jabar... understand well... as much as there is the matter of jabar, and I have extracted this summary from all the books, and I am presenting that essence before you, that as much as there is the matter of jabar, there the Lord of the worlds has done what? He has appointed the mala'ikah. Do you understand? As much as our matter of jabar is, for which we are helpless... got typhoid, got this, had an accident, it happened like this, it happened like that, whatever thing we are helpless in, there the mala'ikah are appointed by Allah. The `mudabbirati amra` are appointed. The mala'ikah-i kurubiyyin are there, the mala'ikah-i safa are there, the mala'ikah... don't even ask about their forces. It's countless. When a malak descends with every drop of rain, then the question doesn't even arise. It's a countless force. So the mala'ikah have been appointed, so that "Look, lest it should happen that whatever, according to jabar, was their intention, that action should take place where it is supposed to." They are supposed to be struck here, they must be struck. This thing is supposed to happen, it must happen. This thing is supposed to be received, it must be received. All these actions, who are the doers? The mala'ikah are appointed. And as much as our ikhtiyar is, what is there? There, the book of Khuda and the rasul of Khuda are before us. They are guiding us, they are calling out, `da'iyan ilallahi bi-idhnihi` (one who invites to Allah, by His permission). The callers by the command of Allah... the Rasul is calling, 'Ali is calling, Hasan is calling, Husain is calling, the A'immah are calling, the du'at are calling, the voice of all is one, they are giving hidayah and saying, "Come to Khuda's side, come to our side, understand, this is the correct path, this is the correct way. Look, this is good, this is evil, this is that..." Why are they explaining this? So that we do not do any wrong within our ikhtiyar. Did you see? Within ikhtiyar, because you have the ikhtiyar, whether to cut fruit with a knife or to cut someone's throat, this is the ikhtiyar. So you have been stopped, that "Look, don't cut a throat with a knife." They taught both din and dunya. This is why the Rasul came, this is why the anbiya' came, this is why the awliya' came, this is why the A'immah came, this is why the du'at came, and they gave hidayah for this reason. So did you see? This was the matter of jabar, this was the matter of ikhtiyar. So as much as jabar was, in that, the mala'ikah are appointed, that it will happen. That is a matter of your taqdir. But this is the mercy of Allah Ta'ala, that Allah Ta'ala, in the matters of jabar too, if we have done some black and white, then here we have got stuck. We... so then Allah said, "Look, I am putting one thing before you. There is a page that you have made black and white. And you have drawn lines on it, and now those lines... whoever the comprehender is of those lines, he will understand them. A computer person will understand it in the context of a computer, in that context he will understand. Every expert will understand it in his own context. So you have made it black and white. I am putting that page before you. And now, to erase or not to erase from it is not in your power. But in your hands too, there is a power. To erase is my work, to keep is my work. `yamhullahu ma yasha'u wa yuthbit, wa 'indahu ummul kitab` (Allah eliminates what He wills or confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book). Allah erases whom He wills, and keeps whom He wills. But if you want to erase, I will erase. If you want to keep, I will keep. But now you don't know what you have done and what you haven't. So it's better that you keep reciting the daily du'as, you keep doing istighfar. You keep wanting everything, you keep asking every question." You will say, "No, brother, I have a bank balance of 4 lakh rupees. I won't give it for the Salwa." For the Salwa... "Brother, is it my house being built? It's the Jama'at's house being built, the Jama'at will manage." "It's a huge [unclear]." "What do we have to do? We have two days left, we are in the beginning, and we are not getting the funds for the Salwa." "What a sad thing." So you see, this... so what do you want? That somehow this thing should happen. So you saw that somehow this thing... So there you always want that Qudrat... this is why the mala'ikah have been appointed, that in jabar, the thing that is to happen will happen. So Qudrat has given a rubber in your hand. He has given a rubber that this black and white which you have done, the intentions you have made, you cannot go up and erase those intentions now. Whatever you have done, you have done there. But, O my people, if you want to reduce the things from there as well, then you will have to recite the daily du'as. And for this reason, I am giving a rubber in your hand. Take this rubber and keep rubbing it. Close your eyes and rub it, the lines will be erased. Qudrat, whichever line it wants to erase, it will erase. Your troubles it will remove. And what is that rubber? It is du'a. The du'as that we recite, the saheefah we read, the recitation of the Quran we do, especially the du'as we read, what is this du'a? It averts qada. Brother, du'a averts death. Du'a averts calamities. When the Nabi says it, he does not say it wrongly. So it means that this you... what do you know how many things you have erased with du'a? You say a lot. When your child is saved after falling from a height, then, "Which good deed came in handy?" You see? So the good deed that came in handy is your own good deed. But you had recited those du'as, so that good deed came as a result. To the extent that Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq says that if this du'a, suppose, is not accepted here, never be disappointed. It can never happen that Allah Ta'ala will reject your du'a. These du'as will be found by you on the day of Qiyamah. And it will be successful. You will say, "Brother, when there was a need in the world, at that time Allah Ta'ala did not make it successful, and He is giving its reward in the hereafter. What is this?" The time will be a little longer... Now, if He had given it to us there, it would have been good. And now Allah Ta'ala is giving us in Qiyamah, what is the use of that reward? Yes, sir, but what will be the situation? That man will need the reward of du'a the most at that time. And for this reason, we countless people, at the time of Qiyamah... meaning, our own qiyamah, at death... at the time of death, we will make this very du'a and will say this, "O Lord, have mercy on us, and these things that we are seeing, these things of happiness that we are seeing, where have these hasanat, these good deeds, come from, O Lord? I didn't do so many good deeds." So it will be said, "O person, these are your du'as which were successful, but the reward was kept for today." He will say, "O Allah Ta'ala, you have shown great mercy that you have given it for today. On this day, I only want provisions. I wish this was not a small provision, but a very large provision. I wish He would not have accepted any of my du'as, O Lord, I accept everything. That none of my du'as would have been accepted in the world, and they would have been kept for the day of Qiyamah." So innumerable people have said these words. That's why Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq has said that this will be the du'a of a mu'min, that "I wish he would not have accepted any of my du'as, and would have kept them for the day of Qiyamah, for the day of death." So the matter is actually this, that this, as I have said about jabar and qadr, that whatever jabar is, that is our... what is that? There the mala'ikah are appointed. Lest some discrepancy should occur. Yes, in that, discrepancy Allah is the doer. Allah is powerful in this way, `innallaha 'ala kulli shay-in qadir` (Indeed, Allah is over all things competent), in this way, that if you wish, Allah will also wish to change it. But you should want forgiveness. And to the extent that the Prophet says that if you do not want forgiveness, then I will destroy you and create another qaum who will sin and then ask for forgiveness from me. So what does this mean? Does it mean, God forbid, to sin? It means that you should want forgiveness. You are sinners, you are people of nadamah. You have fallen and fallen, and you have repented. When you have repented, it means that you had made a mistake. And for the mistake, you will have to ask for forgiveness, and you will always have to ask for forgiveness. So it means that these two things are necessary, there is jabar and there is qadr. So what we do there, we get its reward here. And we are getting its full effect, and we are... well... being bound by it. And those things are happening to us. You keep coming out of the room, you will never get a knock. But that same door, which is supposed to give you a knock, and your foot... your foot gets swollen, you are troubled. But at the time that retribution was to happen, it happened. At the time that thing was to happen, it happened. Everything is bound by its time, it is to happen, it will happen. Brother, when death is bound by time, life is, then will your retributions not be? Will your accounts not be? Everything is bound by time. And I too am bound by time, that alhamdulillah, the funds for the Salwa will be collected, and the work of the Salwa will be done. This is Khuda's work, and Khuda's work is not going to stop, Allah Ta'ala is the one who will bless it. It doesn't matter if someone gives or doesn't give. But it is that I will not be taking a good impression with me. I am repeatedly saying and warning, but the attention that is needed has not yet been given. So I am requesting your attention in this matter as well, that this is a golden opportunity, and if it goes out of our hands, then the golden opportunity will not come again. We have to do it, we have to do it quickly. So this was not a parenthetical statement, but an interjectory one that I said to you. But now what is to be said is that now you see that, "Alright, we understood this, that we have come into life, so we, whatever we had intended from there, we have reaped its fruit here. Now tell us, what is the matter of qismat after this?" So, I would want your attention, that we, here in life, are doing dual work. One is that we, whatever we had intended from there, we are fulfilling it. The other is that in the world of ikhtiyar, we are offering namaz, we are fasting, we are giving zakat. According to the nisab... "Brother, whatever it is, just give it. Whatever has to be done..." "Just put it in the hisab, brother, what's the use of thinking?" Zakat for Allah Miyan is being given only. The hisab is in the account. Hisab in the account, money in the envelope. And you have given it. "May Allah, for Allah's sake, may Allah accept." Allah will accept it just like that. Allah is 'as you are, so He is'. With whatever intention you have given, Allah has accepted it with that same intention. So it is known that this is the absolute decision of Qudrat, and it will happen. This is the absolute. So it continued like this. Now the point is that what you are now doing in the world of ikhtiyar, this is becoming a fruit for you for the hereafter. `innal akhirata khayrul laka minal ula` (And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]). Your hereafter is better than your first life. Why is it better than the hereafter? Because you got to know here. So my brothers and sisters, you know now what the reality is. So it is known that now we will do more 'deeds of action'. We will fast, we will offer namaz, we will do this and that, so that we can reap more fruit in the hereafter. Because this... now in the same way, as you intended there, and its fruit you got here, now you will intend here, and in the coming birth, in the coming life, after a thousand years, as I have told you, when you will appear, then the fruit you will get will be of this life. So it is as if... another explanation I will give with an example, and I hope the example will be clear. And that example is like this: that I have put a machine, science has made it very easy, and it's a tape recorder, you see. And in the tape recorder, I have put two tape recorders together. And one tape recorder's reel, I have started it new. And the other tape recorder's reel, I have... started it. Now there are two tape recorders, two reels. One reel is filling up, one reel is unwinding. Do you understand? The one that is unwinding, those are our intentions which are playing here. And the tape that you are filling, these are the intentions for the future which you are making. What you have already done there, you have heard here. Now you are doing both things here, you are filling and you are also listening. You are filling for the coming life. You are listening for this life. What you are listening to is the echo of the dome, 'as you say, so you hear'. This is jabar. And what you are filling, you are going to hear that in the coming life. So you, I hope you have understood from this example, that this is our life of jabar and ikhtiyar, and these are the kinds of crossroads, that you are like this. There are many incidents, incidents of the A'immah, incidents of the du'at, which come in this context. But how far can they be narrated? They are very detailed. In any case, as much of the philosophy I had to present, and the qismat which I have presented before you, I have presented it with brevity, that we are the architects of our destiny, and destiny also goes where it wants. And it connects in this way. That whatever we are filling, we will hear it. For that reason, while filling, one has to fill with understanding. And what we are hearing, we are helpless in that. What has been filled is what we will hear. Now, to erase or not to erase this is not in our power. This is in the hand of Qudrat. And for this reason, we want forgiveness, we recite du'as. After the Prophet, people came and asked the Imam, "O Rasulullah, what about reciting the Holy Quran or reading a du'a? These du'as, we have written them, the A'immah have written them, the du'at have written them, people have written them. This Quran is the word of Allah, it is anwar-i zakiriyyah, it has come from there, it has come to the Prophet, it has descended on the heart of the Prophet. So about this..." You said, "Which thing is more excellent?" He said, "Both things." They said, "O Rasulullah, please tell us, which is the most excellent?" You said, "Du'a." "Du'a is more excellent." "Why?" "Because Allah Ta'ala likes the words of our nadamah." "But this is His own word, the Quran. He does not like it that much?" "He likes it, but relatively not as much. He likes the words of our humility more. He likes our humility more. That's why He likes du'a more." For this reason it has been said that du'a averts qada. Brother, the subject of du'a is quite long, when does it... but what... where... can it be narrated? But tomorrow and the day after, there will be a lesson for two days. Insha'Allah, Qiyamah is also approaching, and the narration of Qiyamah is also approaching, and that has to be narrated, otherwise you will say that you did not even do Qiyamah. So we must go through Qiyamah. For this reason, insha'Allah, its narration will also come. Insha'Allah, tomorrow and the day after, both days there will be a lesson. And the time will also be a little extended, just as it got a little extended today, it will be extended a little. And, insha'Allah, I will try to finish it. But I hope that you have understood this thing, what is the matter of qismat, and what our du'a does. There is only one rubber in our hand, only one thing, only one reward, only one weapon, with which we can mend all our things. And the one who has used it, has used it. So it is known that may Allah Ta'ala give us the tawfiq to understand these sciences which are from the Ahl al-Bayt, and above all, from the door of Maula-i Ka'inat we have received them, and by its grace we have understood all this. And we should understand this, we should act upon it, and we should remember it, and we should raise our children in this way, so that they remain on the religion of truth, on the Sulaymani Jafariyya religion. Wa akhiru da'wana anil hamdulillahi rabbil 'alamin, as-salatu was-salamu 'ala rasulih, Sayyidna Muhammadin wa 'alihi ajma'in.

and fate goes where it wants. We ourselves are entitled to this and responsible for it. So, this means we are the ones who bring about and enact predetermination and free will (jabr o qadr). And whatever deed is happening here in the world, the deeds we are performing, the responsibility for them falls on us. So, Allah Ta'ala gives us reward or punishment according to our intentions. So, this means that we ourselves are responsible for all our deeds. We are the architects of our own fate, and Allah Ta'ala has no [role] in this. But it is a favor from the Lord of the Worlds, it is His grace, it is His vast mercy above all else, that He, the Lord, has arranged it such that no matter how many [sins] you commit, no matter how much you blacken your pages [of deeds], it is better that there be something to erase the blackness of your deeds. And He opened a door of forgiveness. And how did He open that door of forgiveness? Through supplication (du'a). For this reason, He commanded, `ud'uni astajib lakum, innal-ladhina yastakbiruna 'an 'ibadati sayadkhuluna jahannama daakhireen` (Call upon Me; I will respond to you. Indeed, those who are too arrogant to worship Me will enter Hell in humiliation). Call Me, I am the one who accepts your supplication. Those who are arrogant, those who are prideful, they will always be made to enter Hell, and they will remain in Hell. So, Allah Ta'ala, by saying this, has made the matter clear. And He showed that supplication is such a thing that, `du'a taruddu al-qada` (supplication averts fate), `du'a taruddu al-bala` (supplication averts calamity), and `du'a taruddu... ahh... taqumu an-nadam` (supplication establishes remorse). So look, all these are the crafts of nature. Otherwise, ten thousand angels are appointed, the air and sea forces of Allah are all present. Then, 'whom Allah protects, who can taste them,' it is like that. Who can interfere there? But in that Hazrat-e Imami, where countless believers are present, but they are present, so you look at it with great longing, 'If only our deeds were also so good that we could also reach there.' Yes, you don't reach there based on your deeds being good or bad. You are inferior, they are superior, it is not like that. Rather, in some cases, they are inferior to you there. Many people there are inferior to you. The real matter is that a sweeper, a cleaner, can enter the king's palace, but a prime minister is not granted permission to go. So don't understand from this that if you did not reach Hazrat-e Imami there, you have become very weak. But if you have filtered your body, then just as you have become worthy of entering the era of unveiling, in the same way, you have become able to enter Hazrat-e Imami. So, some people were told, those whom our du'at, our manasik pointed to, they certainly went to Hazrat-e Imami. As was said for Maulana Fazal Ali Sahab, as was said about Yasin Sahab who was the qadim of Bombay. What did he say? 'He will not come into this world,' Baba had said. So it is absolutely certain that he went. Now he has no connection with this world here. Sometimes this kind of thing happens; it is not always like that, that groups after groups are going, it is not like that. But it definitely happens. So these... these are the blessings of unveiling, these are the mercies, from which many blessings we will enjoy. You see, there are such pleasures, such fruits; if you get them from somewhere... they come, you eat them; if they don't, then nothing. But there, the situation is that everything is present everywhere. It is not that mangoes are only in India, it is not like that. It is happening in the whole world. Everything is happening everywhere, so everyone is getting everything. So there will be no shortage of anything anywhere. And the greatest thing of all, the greatest thing of all is that everyone will be a believer. Not a single disbeliever will be there. As they say in Urdu, for a cough, there's nothing to apply. Like that, there will be nothing. Not even one, sir. If it's not there, it's not there. He said, 'Where will this be now?' Those who are in stones and minerals, in mines, in mountains, in rivers, after all, what are they? They are all from there who will come, they will all go. And we will just... come. Who will be on the veil of manifestation? Who will be on the scene of witnessing? We will be. We will be there, and it will be our era. Because this era of unveiling... when we have endured hardships, now we will also take its reward. So anyway, this is the era of unveiling, in which the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, will send our noble residues in such a way; this is his justice, this is his equity. I will explain it to you tomorrow. But I am telling you that this will be the action upon it, and we will see the era of unveiling. And these... these things our... we will get all the blessings, and our soul which is released, it will acquire pleasures in this way and will benefit from the sciences and arts and all things. Progress will continue in this way. Now remains the matter of punishment; this was about reward. The state of reward is for the believers. Now, the state of punishment, and I had explained the state of punishment, how the state of punishment is. I hope you have kept it in mind. And those who fear punishment will surely keep this in mind. Why wouldn't they? Even if it is anyone's punishment, punishment is punishment, it is something to be feared. The punishment begins from the grave, and I had said it will begin from death. And how will it begin from death? The sensory soul gets trapped in the physical soul. This is the greatest punishment. And they, with the vegetative soul, and those who have not accepted the da'wah, they have been buried with the sensory soul itself. This is the greatest punishment, the punishment of the grave. Now what will Munkir and Nakir ask? This sensory soul, this vegetative soul itself will question them. Now they are buried with this itself. And even the believer is not free from the vegetative soul. If, say, he has such good deeds, then he is freed. If not, then he is imprisoned with it for at least three days. The negligent believer or the believer with shortcomings, for him to be... to be freed, it will take him three days. And for three days, that too if he has chosen, if he has eaten the food of ziyarat, food is very important. Don't think that just by having the food it is so. This common idea that is going around, 'Brother, it is better to give a scholarship instead.' These are all wrong things. All these thoughts... remove this short-sightedness. I am telling you the inner matter. That it is a special thing that you are leaving behind. And along with it, reciting the Fatiha, and reciting Yasin Sharif, reciting the noble Qur'an, will be a cause of betterment for them, and they will be freed. When they are freed, it is obvious that now they will progress. But I was talking about punishment... I was talking about giving punishment to those who deserve punishment. I have told the reward to those who deserve reward. I told you how they will be included in the haykal. I told you this reward, the spiritual one. I also told you their recompense, their prize. That in the era of unveiling, how your situation will be and how you will be in comfort... in the gardens of paradise. Both these things. But how will the disbeliever get punishment, how will the disbeliever get punished, all this has to be told to you. So I was telling you, and I have already told you, that whatever happens to the disbeliever, meaning those who are not Sulaymani, all of them, according to their respective ranks, from where will their punishments begin? They will begin from the grave itself. After the grave, the second stage that comes, which stage is that? That second stage I explained to you, in detail, is the darakat (lower levels). In the darakat there is raqs, raks, naks, waks, 'aks, and daks. These are the seven lower levels. The first lower level is that of the human form, which is of the Abyssinians. The second, third, fourth, fifth lower levels are all of animals. Which is the second lower level? It is of the monkey and the bear. After that is of predators, meaning beasts of prey. After that is of the insects of the earth, and at the very end is of birds, and after birds is of vegetation, and after vegetation, the seventh lower level is of minerals. After traversing these darakat, where will he be taken? To the peripheries (atraf). Polar... he will be taken to the poles. The north and south poles, and at the poles, they will be given punishment. There, they will be... big... meaning, they will be joined. They will be given punishment after being joined, and they will be punished there in the form of huge animals, and they cannot even move from their places. They are in such a condition. From the snowfall... and all... they are given punishment in the form of such animals. And this punishment is only given to those who are sentenced to death. Meaning, the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, for whom he will decree that the punishment of Saqar, this... the punishment of hell is necessary for them, they will be given the punishment of the peripheries. Otherwise, they will not get the punishment of the peripheries. And for whom the Qa'im will say, 'No, they have received the punishment of the darakat, that's enough,' they will be turned back. Because everything is in the hands of the judge, and the Qa'im, he is the God of the time, the Lord of the time. And whatever he is saying, that decision is the final decision, a divine decision, a decision of judgment. And he will make this decision that now, with the darakat, it is over, so now what will happen? Now they will ascend on a good path. Vege... in minerals, what... now they will become gold, they will become jewels. And then they will come into vegetation, they will become good things, they will become edible things, they will become vegetables. And after that, when they come into animals, they will become such animals that will be permissible (mohallil). Under your knife, they... they will be slaughtered, and after that, you will eat, and sperm will be formed, and then the temperament will become balanced, and the mill of nature will turn, and with that, they will manifest as human beings. So anyway, they will come again like a blank piece of paper, they will come in a straight... way, like a plate, and the matter of inscribing upon it is that the da'wah of the du'at will be presented to them. If they accept, good. If they don't accept, then as their case will be, so will be their punishment. So anyway, I... I was telling you that those people for whom the Qa'im says, 'Brother, for them is the punishment of Saqar.' Those who opposed the prophets, who opposed the Imams, who opposed the Messengers. Will they be let go just like that? No, they will not be let go. So they will be caught... I will explain all the details of that tomorrow. But right now I am explaining that somehow, the entire army of God will catch them and will take them and put them where? In hell. What are the entrances to hell, how they will be taken, all those details are for later. But I am saying that they will have to reach hell. After enduring the punishment of the peripheries, when will they have to reach hell? When the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, manifests and commands that they should now be punished. When they are given the punishment, not until then. When the matter of giving them punishment comes, and when they are taken into Saqar, then, God forbid, God forbid, God's refuge, that... that punishment for which Allah Ta'ala has said 'a severe punishment' (`'azabun shadid`), `zaqum wa 'azabun alima` (the tree of Zaqqum and a painful punishment). Oh, such are the foods that get stuck in the throat. What a severe punishment it is, O Lord. What we call... mental teasing. This is the most severe punishment of the Lord of the Worlds, which will be in Saqar. And I told you regarding Saqar, how is that Saqar made? It is like a pot, a pot that has been placed upside down. Its mouth is at the bottom and its base is at the top. So it is closed from the top, open from the bottom. And it has 70 valleys. It is very large, such a large part, although we have the dimensions. But the point is that it is so large, so vast, that entire cities can fit in it. Those who have to endure the punishment are also many. Entire cities can fit, entire mountains can fit. A lot can fit inside. And how is it made? It is made from the components of sulfur. It is all... from gunpowder, from lime, from alum, from potash, it is made from such things that are explosive and bursting. From such things, all of it... is made. Meaning, the potter and the clay of the pot are one and the same. As the soul, so the angels. If you burn there, if you live there, it will be in such a way, just the kind of environment you wanted, that is the environment. `tamutuna 'ala ma ta'ishun.` (You die upon what you live). Your death will be upon what your life is. So as you lived your life, so will be your death. Now you have gotten a place just like that. Now you live in that place. Now in that state, what will be the condition? Now listen carefully. That they, God forbid, God forbid, there they will be given such a severe punishment that as soon as they enter, when... as soon as they enter, right upon entering, Allah Ta'ala will... a normal human being, the way a human is, has one head, two hands, two feet, the way a human is, He will not keep them in that state. He will immediately make him abnormal. And he will have three heads, ten hands each, understood, some different... strange feet, in some such strange way he will come into that state. The situation is that he is writhing in this way. Some images must be coming to your mind. The idols of temples must be coming to your mind. Yes. So now... what is the real matter? Now these three heads and four hands, why are all these things coming? The real matter is that when they are beaten there, and after being beaten repeatedly when they come back there, then after coming, because even then they do not want to be corrected, they go and whisper in someone's ear. `yuhi ba'duhum li-ba'din zukhruf al-qawl ghurura.` (They inspire to one another decorative speech in delusion). They go and inspire in the ear, meaning they speak. And what do they say? 'Brother, make an idol of us.' 'Brother, what kind should I make?' He says, 'The reclining Buddha is done, let's have a standing Buddha.' Brother, standing is done, let's... let's have a sitting Buddha, let's have a lying Shiva, give us four hands, give us ten hands, put a snake around our neck, and put a lotus flower in our hand. There you go. Take the lotus flower too, put the snake around your neck too. Whatever you said, do it. They all come from there and say this, and they keep doing it. And these idols keep being made. They are made of gold, they are made of everything, they are even made of cow dung. And they are made of everything, they are also made of sweets, sometimes when they get hungry, they eat them too. They are made of everything... they make everything. Now, if all these are being made, how are they being made? These are all the forms from there. And our elders said a great saying, a very interesting one, and what did they say? That if you want to see their forms, in one place, you want to see everything in one glance, that if one tours paradise, one should also peek into hell. May God not take us there, but brother, what are they like? So they said, 'If you really want to see the tour of hell and you are so fond of it, then go see Ellora-Ajanta.' What an excellent art gallery it is. What an excellent art... you are sitting there, thinking and thinking, amazed. What are you thinking? So he said, 'Just look.' So now, what is there in all this art? This is all the art from there. This is all the art from there, and all this is... the craftsmanship from there. They suggest all this from there, and they do all this. Otherwise, who are the ones doing it? They say, 'It's inspiration.' What things came that set a wave in motion. On stones, such things... have set a wave in motion, don't even ask. So now who are the ones setting this in motion? They are the same ones. They came and whispered, they said, 'Look, I am Lakshmi, I am... whatever god or goddess I am, I am the owner. My words should be worshipped accordingly.' Now in Diwali, other worship is also happening, so they are also being worshipped. So all these things are from there. They go there... after going there, this becomes their condition. Now look at the condition that... the condition is that each picture is newly terrifying, that someone has one eye, someone has two eyes. You make a Cyclops with one eye, there they have already become Cyclops. And the condition is that... they start to feel terrified looking at each other. And in a state of terror, what happens? They are already... suffering, and they have gone and gotten stuck. And along with being stuck, just as someone is troubled by heat or cold or some other thing, they are already... all... all conditions are troubling them. So, 'war has come, war has come,' what do they do? They start fighting with each other. And when they start fighting, the situation is that they grab each other and break someone's head, break someone's hand, break someone's foot. And here they break, here he... he dies, here he is alive. Here he dies, here he is alive. Here he dies, here he becomes alive. `la yamutuna fiha wa-la yahya.` (They will neither die therein nor live). The Qur'an says, 'Oh, hell is that in which they will neither die nor live.' Meaning, here they died, here they became alive. `la yamutuna fiha wa-la yahya.` (They will neither die therein nor live). They neither die nor live. Here they die, here they are alive. This is their punishment, that they keep tasting the punishment of death at all times. So they are killing each other, scratching, shedding blood, beating, drinking. And the condition is very bad. And the condition of some, which the Majestic Qur'an has described, keep reading the details in the Majestic Qur'an. In it, it is said, `subbuhu` (pour over him), they will be made to drink such a vile thing that a person can't even... how will he take the name? They will be made to drink such blood and other things. And they, hot... going there... this has no meaning. The meaning of fire there is that the light of the sun shines there at night. At night, the sun's light, its rays come so powerfully that because of them, they are set ablaze. And they burn to such an extent that their bodies... the burning, the smell of burning skin begins. This happens from the sunlight. And in the daytime, they start to burn from the light of the moon. Did you see? In the daytime from the light of the moon, at night from the light of the sun, they are afflicted, and this heat is so intense that in it, God forbid, God forbid, in a very severe punishment, their life is, they have to endure it. These were some different kinds of punishments, and after the situation, there are different valleys. Obviously, according to the fragrances, they have different valleys. And its last valley, whose name, God forbid, God forbid, it is forbidden to even take its name, such... such a bad valley it is, whose name is Tabut. And it is the worst valley, and it... there, such people will be punished who opposed the prophets, who opposed the Commander of the Faithful 'Ali, who opposed Imam Husayn, who opposed such... such elders, they will be taken there. They are, except as Allah wills, only a few people who are understood, known and understood. They... may Allah Ta'ala save us all from this punishment of hell, and may He give us salvation from it for the sake of the Imams, for the sake of the pure Ahl al-Bayt. Anyway, they will have to suffer all these punishments, and they will have to endure the punishment. Why? Until Khalidin (eternity). Khalidin, they will remain forever and ever, and that... what does remaining forever mean? It means that they will have to complete the duration of a grand epoch. Until a grand epoch, they will have to endure this punishment, and when they have endured this entire punishment, then from there... but let me tell you one thing, it will become more interesting. And that thing is that one will go into this hell, but who will be its... standard-bearer? Who will be made to enter hell first? That is Shaytan, whose name is Harith bin Murra. Harith bin Murra, who came at the time of Adam, was the son of Murra, Harith, he will be the first to be made to enter hell. And this... what is the real matter? That he is constantly going, constantly being beaten, constantly taking a beating, but he does not leave his devilry. He does not leave his devilry, and they say that he is constantly going and constantly doing devilry and is constantly reaching his place... [unclear]. So this is Harith bin Murra, whose... whose devil's progeny is who? The one who will sit in his place and who is his offspring. Just as the offspring of a good person is who? Those who follow his goodness and are called his offspring. Similarly in evil, those who follow in his footsteps, all of them are his... his offspring, his progeny, the progeny of Shaytan. So the progeny of Shaytan will continue in this way, and continually, their... will continue, and the divine punishment will continually surround them. And until the last breath, meaning until a grand epoch, they... 360,000 times 360,000, meaning a period of 400,000 years, and one epoch (kaur) of 400,000 such periods. Calculate it this way, calculate it that way, it is necessary for them to complete the duration of a grand epoch, and when divine things are imposed upon them, punishment is imposed, then no one can save them from the punishment. Now, after coming out of this punishment, obviously, the Lord of the Worlds will quickly bring them. So they will first be minerals, then vegetation, then animals, and after animals they will come in the form of humans, and the da'wah will be presented to them again. If, in a state of free will, they have done their work correctly, then good. If they did not do the work, then they will go again. So anyway, the one who makes these decisions... whose job will it be? It will be the job of the Hazrat-e Qa'im, peace be upon his mention, that when the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, makes his decisions. Now, regarding the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, what I have explained, you must have understood that... I will mention him tomorrow, how his session will be held and the court will assemble, and all this justice and equity will happen. But what needs to be told is that the weeks of our Imams that have been happening, seven weeks have passed, I said the first week was of the mutammim, the second was of the khulafa, the third... so this... of the a'imma, in this way the weeks I told of the mutammim, so there were weeks of seven each. So if there are seven weeks, then seven times seven is forty-nine. So our Imam today is the 48th Imam. And the Imam who will come after him, who will he be? He will be the 49th Imam, so this means that it ended with the 49th Imam. But what is the real matter? That this is the end, the conclusion. But the 50th and 51st, the count of these two is separate from them. What that means is the Hazrat-e Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, and the one who comes before him, the Mahdi, peace and blessings be upon him. The Mahdi who will come before him, about whom it is all famous that he... the promised Messiah who has come, who will come in the shadow of Jesus, so-and-so will come, what they are saying, in reality, he is the Mahdi who is to come before the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him. So the one who is to come before the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, is the Mahdi of the end of time, and he will be on the front of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. And the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, will come on the front of 'Ali. So just as I am telling you today, that if you go to know, in the era of the Prophet, look at the time of Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib, whose era is the era of Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib? The era of the Prophet's grandfather. Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib's two sons, Maulana Abu Talib, Maulana 'Abdullah. Abu Talib, the father of 'Ali, and 'Abdullah, the father of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. Now, just as the picture was set here, the picture is here in the same way. Our Imam today is the greatest Imam, the highest Imam, such that no Imam comes in comparison to him, except for the Imam of the first week, leave Imam Hasan, Imam Husayn etc., leave them. After leaving them, all the Imams who have passed, greater than all of them is our Imam today, who is opposite the grandfather of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. But you know his name, it is Maulana Muhammad bin 'Ali, salawatullah 'alayh, and he is on the front of Maulana 'Abd al-Muttalib. Now you will have two sons, one son will be opposite Maulana Abu Talib, the other son will be opposite 'Abdullah. The son of 'Abdullah, in reality, will be... who will he be? The Mahdi of the end of time. And the son of Abu Talib will be the Riser of the Resurrection. Now what is it? Since it is the end of time, for whom are we waiting? We are not waiting for the Resurrection, but rather we are waiting for the Mahdi. We are waiting for the Mahdi, and what does the wait for the Mahdi indicate? The Qur'an says, `inna as-sa'ata aatiyatun baghtatan` (Indeed, the Hour is coming suddenly). That... `ayna mursaha` (where is its mooring?). You do not know where the Resurrection will be moored, and you do not know that the Hour, the Resurrection that is to come, it is to come suddenly. So the matter that is sudden is all that of Maulana Mahdi-ullah, salawatullah 'alayh. His coming will be sudden. And the coming of the Qa'im, peace and blessings be upon him, that is a known and understood time, hour, everything, the day, the date, everything is fixed. Nothing is hidden. You will ask, 'Brother, is there any difference between the two?' God willing, I will explain it to you tomorrow, otherwise there will be no topic left to speak on tomorrow. So I am leaving this, that between the Qa'im and the Mahdi, how much... what is the distance, and how will the manifestation of the Mahdi happen, and what work will you do at that time, and how will the manifestation of the Qa'im happen, how will he establish justice. But even before that, I have concluded this matter, that those who are given... punishment, how will they suffer the punishment, and those who are given reward, how will they receive the reward. `wa akhiru da'wana an al-hamdu lillahi rabb al-'alamin wa-s-salatu wa-s-salamu 'ala rasulihi-l-karim...` (And the end of our supplication is that all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds, and peace and blessings be upon His noble Messenger...).

Alhamdulillah, for this matter, thanks are due to Allah that we have at least reached *Qiyamah*.

Regarding *Qiyamah*, I was explaining to you that this is such an affair from Allah that has existed in every era and at every time, and there is no soul (*dhi nafs*) that can deny it.

The matter is, as Allah Ta'ala has said in the Quran Majid, `man amana billahi wal-yawmil-akhir wal-mala'ikati wal-kitabi wan-nabiyyin` (he who believes in Allah and the Last Day and the angels and the Book and the prophets). Look, the conditions for bringing *iman* (faith) have been threaded by Allah Ta'ala into a single verse. He said: "Bring faith in Allah," and along with it, He says, "in the Last Day" (*yawm al-akhirat*). And after that, in the angels (*mala'ikah*), in the books (*kutub*), and in the prophets (*anbiya*), He has set the conditions for bringing faith. So, faith must be brought in all five things, in which the second condition, after Allah, is faith in the Last Day. So, the Day of the Hereafter, meaning the Day of *Qiyamah*, and in Quranic terminology, what has Allah Ta'ala described *Qiyamah* as? In countless verses, in many different places, Allah Ta'ala has mentioned *Qiyamah*, and in several chapters (*suro*), entire chapters have been described concerning *Qiyamah*. The Day of Recompense and Punishment (*roz-e jaza o saza*), the words with which Allah Ta'ala has described it—what are they? It is called *yawm ad-damdamah* (the Day of Overwhelming Calamity). It is called *batshatul kubra* (the great seizing). Elsewhere, it is called *yawm al-qiyamah* (the Day of Resurrection). Elsewhere, it is called *yawm al-hisab* (the Day of Reckoning). Elsewhere, it is called *sa'ah* (the Hour), meaning that there is a time, an hour that is coming. `As-sa'atu atiyatun` (the Hour is coming). So, it is known that *Qiyamah* is an inevitable affair (*labudi amr*) from Allah, and it is a day of recompense and punishment that is coming, and it cannot be averted.

You see, in every era, every nation, every community (*jama'at*), every group (*jirge*), every individual—there is no one who has not held the belief that they must be saved from recompense and punishment (*jaza o saza*), or that they will not have to give recompense and punishment. You see that a student has to go through an exam. Every person, within their own sphere of action, has to go through an exam. So then, it is obvious that this life itself cannot be an exception. He too will certainly have to give an exam, and he will have to give an account of the good and bad of this life, of piety and vice.

This is another matter. `Innal-hasanati yudhhibnas-sayyi'at` (Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds). That our good deeds wash away many of our wrongdoings. But this does not mean that your good deeds will be counted and your bad deeds will be left aside. No, good deeds are in their own place, and bad deeds are in their own place. That too will be counted, and this too will be counted. The meaning of *Munkar* and *Nakir* is just this, and both are going to be counted. It is another thing that the mercies of Allah Ta'ala, along with our good deeds, will remove our misdeeds.

So, to have faith in the Day of *Qiyamah* with different beliefs, with some additions and subtractions, with differences of opinion, with some additions and subtractions in understanding, all nations, all religions, and all the people of the world, every school of thought has considered that *Qiyamah* is coming, and a day of recompense and punishment will occur. Regarding this. And you see that they, whether they are Hindus, Buddhists, Jews, or Christians, all have believed that indeed that day is coming. Someone called it *parlok* (the other world), someone called it the Last Day, someone else said that this is Doomsday. But the confession of the day of *Qiyamah* has been present in every nation, in every group, in every school of thought. So it is known that no one can deny this, and everyone is waiting for it. And its best examples are before you, that a *Qiyamah* has just passed recently. A *Qiyamah* passed recently, and you see what a dread it was. A thought would come to mind, and a dread would set in. Then again everyone is quiet, thinking nothing will happen. But it certainly happens that a dread sets in.

So, when Allah Ta'ala has said that it is a day of dread, and called it *faza' al-akbar* (the greatest terror), it means that there will be such a severe seizing, it will be a day of such a severe seizing that people will cry out. So, this is an inevitable affair (*labudi amr*), and it is a day coming from God that is related to recompense and punishment. Now, the question remains, when is this day coming? How is it coming? What is going to happen on this day? Who are the ones who will carry it out? Who are the ones who will establish *Qiyamah*? And in what way does *Qiyamah* take place? The answers to all these things, now we will see them in a sequence. First of all, you see that this Quran Majid that is in our hands, it contains the original truths of all things, from which we derive the essence. `Wa la ratbin wa la yabisin illa fi kitabin mubin` (and no moist or dry thing but that it is in a clear record). There is no wet or dry thing that is not in the Clear Book. So, regarding *Qiyamah*, all the details are present in their entirety. But who is there to see those details? Who is there to understand those details?

Today, those who play with words, who are they? The literalist Muslims (*zahir-parast Musalman*). Muslims who are only literalists, who play with words, who look at words. They have become so enamored with the words that they are counting *alif*, counting *be*, counting *se*, counting *te*, to the extent that charts are being made that so many hundred thousand *alifs* have come, so many hundred thousand *bes* have come, this has happened so many times, and *hamza* has come so many times. Brother, with these hundred thousands and two hundred thousands and three hundred thousands, what will happen in the end? What do you want to do?
