Whatever its meaning is, take that same meaning. Brother, `ya laytani kuntu turaba` (Oh, I wish I were dust!). On that day, the disbeliever will say, "I wish I were dust." Now, interpret its meaning as literally dust. Now, this means the disbeliever on the day of *Qiyamah* will say, "I wish I were dust." Now, the meanings that are given in the commentaries and translations, if you read there, it is written that "I wish I were dust." Brother, there should be some meaning, some point to it. What is the meaning of wishing to be dust? If it were that the disbeliever would say, "By God, today I have got this day of *Qiyamah*, I wish I were a believer (*momin*)." So the meaning of *turab* is *momin*. Because they had such enmity with Abu Turab, they turned their face away from *turab* itself. This was the enmity with Abu Turab. Did you understand? So they cleared the matter of *turab* itself, so that Abu Turab would not even be mentioned. So, this is the kind of aversion that caused this to happen.

Anyway, I was telling you that what do literalist Muslims think about *Qiyamah*, what do they see? We will proceed a little from there, then we will know what it is. After saltwater, there is the pleasure of freshwater. So, the state of saltwater is necessary. That sip, you will have to drink it a little. And what is that state? That first of all, those Muslims who describe it and paint such a picture that another *Qiyamah* befalls *Qiyamah* itself. The situation is such that even one who is not dying will die.

Their first claim is that Hazrat Israfil, who is the chief of the angels (*sayyid al-mala'ikah*)—one is Jibra'il, one is Mika'il, and one is Janab-e Israfil—Israfil will come with his horn (*pungi*). And that horn, now Janab-e Israfil, the horn of the chief of the angels, is said to be one in the east and one in the west. One horn is here, the other is there. And it will be blown, so now imagine what kind of horn that is and what kind of angel is blowing it. Anyway, now Janab-e Israfil will blow the horn (*sur*), and as soon as the horn is blown, what will happen? All the people will rise from their graves, dusting off their shrouds (*kafan*). The raising from the grave (*ba's-i qabr*), that is, being resurrected from the graves, is that they will rise dusting off their shrouds. Look, this was the matter, because there they had to rise dusting off their shrouds, so what did they do? They took great care while burying. Because now they have to rise. Ultimately, they have to rise on the day of resurrection (*hashr*), so they took great care and placed slabs (*kadiyan*) beforehand. They said, "No, build a grave and lay him to rest comfortably inside." And let there be no such thing that the shroud gets even a little bit dirty. These are clear words. The words are clear that I am saying to you: the shroud should not get dirty. Please, lay him in such a way that the shroud does not get dirty, because if he rises there in the resurrection (*hashr*), what a matter of disgrace it will be, coming before Allah with a dirty shroud. So how can the shroud get dirty? Now the situation is that the dirt that is being given, one person is taking that dirt in his hand. Brother, what is this? So he says, "No sir, I will collect all the clumps of dirt and whatever there is and place them near the head of the occupant of the grave. So that you can keep counting that I have collected the dirt from all over." So that you do not put dirt on the shroud. So this is the precaution.

And when the wailing started, now you see that you had only tied the groom's headdress, now other people started decorating it. How did that house start getting decorated? That grave started getting decorated, and in such a way that now, if the poor deceased is in this state, and he has to remain in the grave forever, then if he ever feels hungry, what will happen? Just look, you just see the idea. So now some sweet pudding (*phirni*) was also placed there. They said, "Brother, in this darkness, how will the poor soul manage?" So a lamp was also lit. So how many such people are there, such classes, such schools of thought, even today, that you see they light a lamp. They place sweet pudding. Just look at the grave, look at burying the dead, and look at them placing pudding inside. What will they do? So, originally, when all these things were there, that's why they said that they will rise dusting off their shrouds. They will rise dusting off their shrouds, that's fine, sir. What will happen after that? They said, "After that, in the scales of deeds (*mizan-e amal*), on the balance, the deeds will be weighed." Now, for the deeds of all communities, of the entire nation (*ummat*), to be weighed, you see, the fruit of a whole lifetime, and a balance to weigh it, its pans must be in the east and west. Such large pans are needed after all, to weigh all the deeds, a big balance is needed. And when they sit, brother, who will hold the balance? Allah will hold it. Whatever there is, it is Allah, and in the pans of the balance, the deeds are being weighed. Fine, they were weighed. And after that, now the third stage is the bridge of *Pulsirat*. This is the stage of *Qiyamah*. The *Pulsirat*, the bridge of *Pulsirat* is sharper than a sword and thinner than a hair. This is so common that it is on everyone's tongue. I think everyone must know it. Sharper than a sword and thinner than a hair is the path, the *Pulsirat*, and one has to cross the *Pulsirat*. Now, the situation is that if the path is sharper than a sword and thinner than a hair, then I think we should practice balancing our whole lives so that we can cross it well on the day of *Qiyamah*. Now look at the situation, and the amazing thing is that I will say only this much, I will add only this much to it, that one should learn balancing, but balancing while sitting on this animal, on goats, if one learns that too, it would be even better. This is because, in these commentaries, Muslims write that we, the goats that we are slaughtering on the occasion of Eid, these very goats will be useful to us for riding on the *Pulsirat*. Now you see, on the *Pulsirat*, and then a ride, and the ride is of goats, and they are riding on the goats, and crossing, and the path is sharper than a sword and thinner than a hair. And if the foot ever slips, then it's this way, or that way. That is, if one goes this way, it is hell (*dozakh*), if one gets through, it is paradise (*jannat*). So now, this is the belief of Muslims, this is the idea of Muslims. And after that, they have taken it to the extreme with *khatam-hum misk* (their seal will be of musk), which is worth hearing. They said that, brother, this will happen, but along with it, the sun will come down to one and a quarter spear-lengths (*sava neze*). Brother, how many inches is a spear-length, at least tell us that. Is it a yard, a meter, God knows what it is. And only Allah knows best what kind of spear-length this is of theirs. The sun is going to come down to one and a quarter spear-lengths, and after coming down to one and a quarter spear-lengths, what will the situation be? Even now, when the sun shines and glows, you see what our condition becomes in May and June. We are in a bad state from the heat, and what will be our state when it comes down to one and a quarter spear-lengths, only Allah knows best.

So, this is the creed of the Muslims. The people of truth (*Ahl-e Haqq*), the people of faith (*Ahl-e Iman*), the people of the esoteric (*Ahl-e Batin*), those who take from the door of Ali, and who benefit from you, and who take grace from the Imams, they can never go astray. They have explained that look, the blowing of the horn of Israfil (*sur-e Israfil*) is absolutely a reality. But what does it mean? The horn of Israfil, its blowing, the breath of the spirit (*nafkh-e ruh*), that is its essential meaning. To blow. That is, the coming of Allah's revelation (*wahi*), the receiving of divine support (*ta'idat*), this is the meaning of the blowing of the horn of Israfil. That is, the Lord of the Worlds, the Tenth Intellect (*'ashir-e mudabbir*), and the Intellects after it, all of them will give support to the *Qa'im* (`alayhis-salatu was-salam`). They will give aid. This is the blowing of the horn of Israfil.

Alright. Now, what is being resurrected from the graves (*qabron se ma'bus hona*)? Being resurrected from the graves is our subtle bodies (*rihiyat*), our body's waste matter (*fuzalat*). I have already told you in detail, and you have come to know how our subtle bodies, how our waste matter develops and how it progresses. These developments keep happening, and this has been described as being resurrected from the graves. Rising from the graves. This is the matter, isn't it? Your subtle essence is going, you are going. This is being resurrected. And as for being weighed in the scales (*mizan*), that is the scale of the intellect (*mizan-e 'aql*). That it will be weighed in the scale of the intellect. That is, when the Imam `alayhis-salatu was-salam` gives you a place in his spiritual body (*nasut*), when he gives a place in his divine reality (*lahut*), he will give you those places of which you are worthy. Allah is like a body. If you are worthy of becoming the nose, then become the nose. If you are worthy of becoming the eye, then become the eye. And if you want to become a nail and a hair, then become a hair. So, whoever has deeds of a certain kind will get a place of that kind. And after that, now this has happened. Now the matter of the *Pulsirat*. What in the end will we understand the *Pulsirat* to be? The *Pulsirat* is this life of ours. This life of ours is itself the *Pulsirat*. It is such a crossroads, don't ask. At any moment, we can stray. At any moment, we can dare to commit a sin. At any moment, we can go from here to there. We can be on a good creed, and we can go to a bad creed. So, this is the *Pulsirat*. From this *Pulsirat*, we have to walk straight and upright. And since we have to walk straight, that's why you have to recite daily, and in every *namaz* you have to recite *Alhamd*, and in every *Alhamd* you have to recite this verse: `ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim` (guide us to the straight path). O Allah, keep us on the straight path. O Allah, straight... brother, you are on the straight path, why are you reciting it again? At any moment, we can stray. At any moment, we can dare to commit a sin. At any moment, we can go from here to there. We can be on a good creed, and we can go to a bad creed. So, this is the *Pulsirat*. From this *Pulsirat*, we have to walk straight and upright. And since we have to walk, and walk straight, that's why you have to recite daily, and in every *namaz* you have to recite *Alhamd*, and in every *Alhamd* you have to recite this verse: `ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim` (guide us to the straight path). O Allah, keep us on the straight path. O Allah, straight... brother, you are on the straight path, why are you reciting it again? No, sir. This life is very difficult. At every moment, we do not know what temptation comes and what happens, and what we get caught in. That's why one has to say `ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim`. So it is known that this is the matter. And as for the sun coming down to one and a quarter spear-lengths, within this there is only this much truth: that the sun's heat must increase, and that too at only one moment. And that will be by the command of Janab-e Qa'im, who is the Lord of the Age (*Rabb-e Waqt*), who is everything of his time. When he makes his appearance (*zuhur*), by his command, this sun will increase its heat, and at a specific moment, which I will mention to you. So it is known that these are the kinds of matters.

Now you see, regarding *Qiyamah*, what we think is that *Qiyamah* will happen and *Qiyamah* is coming. Indeed, we think so. But you see that *Qiyamah*, you, do you not do your accounting every day? Do you not do a monthly accounting? Do you not do a yearly accounting? So *Qiyamah* is also of several kinds. There is the *Qiyamah* of the day, the *Qiyamah* of the night, the *Qiyamah* of the week, the *Qiyamah* of the month, the *Qiyamah* of the year. *Qiyamah* is also of different kinds. That is why the Prophet said, `man mata faqad qamat qiyamatuhu` (whoever dies, his resurrection has taken place). Whichever person passes away, his *Qiyamah* has taken place. Did you see? As soon as the person died, his *Qiyamah* took place. The Prophet says, `man mata faqad qamat qiyamatuhu` (whoever dies, his resurrection has taken place), his *Qiyamah* took place. So does this mean that *Qiyamah* has happened, you will understand that all the *Qa'ims* who are to come, their *Qiyamah* has happened? No. Brother, it is a matter of understanding that his *Qiyamah* took place, now his accounting has begun. This *Qiyamah* has happened. And the second is the *Qiyamah* of the cycle of concealment (*dawr-e sitr*), the *Qiyamah* of the cycle of manifestation (*dawr-e kashf*). This is a minor *Qiyamah*. It is of 7,000 years, or 47,000 years, 50,000 years. What will these *Qiyamahs* be in that grand count? They will be like a dot, these *Qiyamahs*. Let's talk about the *Qiyamah* of the *Dawr*, of the *Kawr*, and of the *Mawr*. The *Qiyamah* of the *Dawr* is a *Qiyamah*. The *Qiyamah* of the *Kawr* is one. The *Qiyamah* of the *Mawr* is one. How does the *Qiyamah* of the *Dawr* happen? First of all, know this, that the *Qiyamah* that is coming now, what kind of *Qiyamah* is it? I told you in "The Past Duration of the World," from the saying of Mawlana Imam Ja'far as-Sadiq `alayhis-salatu was-salam`, you told the past duration, how did you tell it? That one *Mawr-e A'zam* has passed. We are in the second *Mawr*, and in that second *Mawr* too, 399 *kawrs* have passed. We are in the 400th *kawr*, in its first *dawr*, at the end of the *dawr-e sitr*. So it is known that this first *dawr*, the 400th, is ending. So we are not ending the *sitr*, but we are ending the *dawr* as well. So it is known that our *Qiyamah* is not the *Qiyamah* of the *sitr*, but it is also the *Qiyamah* of the *dawr*. So how does the *Qiyamah* of the *dawr* happen? In the *Qiyamah* of the *dawr*, this happens: that this entire world, nothing at all will change. Nothing will be overturned. There will be no change in even a single thing. Only this much will happen, that the direction (*simt*) will change. The direction will change, east will become west, west will become east, north will become south. Now you will say, "Brother, this is also a very big thing." Indeed, it is a big thing. But what does it mean? What does north becoming south mean? It means that what is dry land will become sea, and what is sea will become dry land. The place where there is water will now have dryness, mountains will come, and where there are mountains and dryness, there water will come. This change is going to happen, and this change happens where? At the *dawr*. Now, let's come to the *kawr*. For the *Qiyamah* of the *kawr*, Allah Ta'ala Himself says, `idhash-shamsu kuwwirat, wa idhan-nujumun kadarat` (When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness], and when the stars fall, losing their luster). `idhash-shamsu kuwwirat`, when the sun becomes dark. Read the Quran. When the sun becomes dark, when the stars (*nujum*), these stars begin to fall. So it seems that the *Qiyamah* of the *kawr* is a great *Qiyamah*. And this breaking of the celestial bodies is no small matter. And this destruction in the universe, how will it be? It will be a destruction within the entire cosmos. And this will happen in the *Qiyamah* of the *kawr*. And after the destruction, how will it be? Again, in the same way, as I said, the world will be created, the twenty-eight will be created, and these plants, minerals, and animals will be born, the sky and the earth will meet—all these things that I have described to you, all those things will happen. Just as it has happened, so it will happen. `Ma kana sa-yakunu wa ma takhtash-shamsi bi-jadid` (What has been will be, and there is nothing new under the sun). Nothing under this sun is new. What happened, will happen. Just as it happened, it will be repeated in the same way. Just as they say, "History repeats itself." It is the same thing. So all things will always be repeated. So this is the *Qiyamah* of the *kawr*. Alright, what happens in the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*? In the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*, this happens: that not just your universe will be destroyed, but the universes will be destroyed. Did you see? You don't have one universe, you have universes. He is the Allah of the worlds (*'alamin*). `Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-'alamin` (Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds). He is the Lord of the worlds. So all the universes are going to be destroyed. And which day is that? That day will be the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*. In the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*, there is complete destruction. And I told you that he is the *Sultan*. `Fa-bi-ayyi ala'i Rabbikuma tukadhdhiban` (Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?). `La tanfudhuna illa bi-sultan, fa-bi-ayyi ala'i Rabbikuma tukadhdhiban` (You will not pass except by authority. Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?). O humans and jinn! If you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority. Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny? O humans and jinn, can you exit from these regions of the heavens and the earth? Then he says that no, no, you cannot exit. You will have to exit because of the *Sultan*. So that *Sahib-e Mawr* who will come, he will take all the *sahiban-e akwar* within his embrace. He is the one individual from where, after progressing, ascending to the spiritual world will happen at one time. And when will that progress happen? When the *Sahib-e Mawr* comes. We will have to remain in the waiting place until the *Sahib-e Mawr* comes. But, if a person, you understand, is living a sick life, he will say, "Brother, for God's sake, O Lord, if you give me death, it would be better. What is there to gain from this life? What is to be gained from this crawling life?" If I got four days, but they were in health, that would have been better. So in the same way, Allah wants from you that whatever you do to purify yourself here, do it for a thousand years at a time, but do it with excellence and pass and get out. It's not that you get stuck in the worldly whirlpool, somewhere in thorns, somewhere in this, sometimes in dust, sometimes in fire, sometimes in air, here and there. You should not be left behind, and you should remain steadfast in your spiritual progress. And by progressing, you should go to the realm of purity (*safa*), and remain in the state of purity, that is much better. So it is known that this is a matter of these progressions. So, in the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*, this is what happens: that there is a complete destruction, and those *sahiban-e mawr*, they take all the souls of the cycles from here. I have explained this to you in great detail.

So you have seen the *Qiyamah* of the *dawr*, the *Qiyamah* of the *mawr*, the *Qiyamah* of the *kawr*. And the *Qiyamah* that is coming now is the *Qiyamah* of the *dawr*. The *Qiyamah* of the *dawr* is coming, and it's not that these celestial bodies will break, the sun will come down, or the moon will break, or such and such will happen, or you will see chaotic situations. No such turmoil is going to happen in this world, as has been said. Nor is the sun going to come down to one and a quarter spear-lengths and scorch you. Nothing of the sort is going to happen.

However, you are attached to the Imams, and the Imams are your guardians (*kafil*). We are holding on to the hem of the Imams, and they are the ones who will take care of us. We have prostrated at the door of the knowledge of the Prophet (*bab-e 'ilm-e nabi*). We have bowed there, and they are our guardians, and they are the ones who will take care of us. And without Ali, not even a leaf can move. Not a single particle can move except by the permission of Allah. Why? Without the authority (*wilayat*) of Ali and without the authority of the *Ahl al-Bayt*, nothing is going to happen. So it is known that we are attached to their hem, and indeed, that will happen. Now, from this chain of Imamate, that same Janab-e Husayn, that same Hasan, that same Ali, that same Fatima az-Zahra, their descendants are continuing, the lineage of their beloved ones is continuing. Now you see, Imam Zayn al-'Abidin is coming, after Imam 'Ali Zayn al-'Abidin, Muhammad al-Baqir is coming, Ja'far as-Sadiq is coming, Janab-e Isma'il is coming, after that Mawlana Muhammad bin Isma'il is coming. This chain continued, Mawlana Mu'izz came, they... Tayyib came, and the chain continuing, continuing, our present Imam, Mawlana Muhammad [unclear] Ali, may Allah's blessings be upon him, may thousands of blessings and peace be upon you from Allah. Your blessed self, who is in the station of Mawlana 'Abd al-Muttalib, as I told you, your rank is the greatest, because you have the status of the grandfather of the *Qa'im*, and what can be said of your exalted rank. What a wondrous rank you have, for which the tongue is inadequate to describe. I swear by God, the tongue is inadequate to describe your exalted rank. Now, your two sons, and they will be in whose station? In the station of Janab-e Abu Talib, Janab-e Ali... and Janab-e 'Abdullah. And their two sons will be in whose station? One will be in opposition to the Prophet, Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, and one will be in opposition to the Commander of the Faithful, Ali. The one who comes in opposition to the Prophet is the *Hujjat-e Qa'im* (Proof of the Qa'im). And the one who comes in opposition to Ali is the *Qa'im* himself. And the one who comes before them, who is he? He is the *Hujjat-e Ula* (First Proof), he is the *Hujjat-e Thaniyah* (Second Proof). Who is this *Hujjat-e Ula*? He is the first proof, who will appear with the name *Mahdi*, who is in the station of the Prophet `alayhis-salatu was-salam`. And by God, his rank is very high. With whom should I compare his loftiness? Allah Himself has made him the most lofty, so now there is no need for anyone to compare his loftiness. He is very lofty, the person of Mawlana Mahdi-billah, may blessings be upon him. When he makes his appearance (*zuhur*), for that, the Quran has mentioned. Now, for us, *Qiyamah* is that we had not understood *Qiyamah*. Now we started reading the Quran, and you started seeing that `innas-sa'ata atiyatun baghtatan` (the Hour is coming suddenly). That *Qiyamah* will come suddenly. How have the elders of our past said this, that the day of *Qiyamah* is appointed, the time is appointed, the day is appointed, and the minute and second are appointed. How will this be?

So, in the end, how will it be? Then Allah Ta'ala says it will come suddenly, so what kind of thing is this? The matter is that everything that exists has two levels. One is this surface, and the other is that surface. The first surface is this, the second surface is this. Or this is the first surface, this is the second surface. So the first surface of *Qiyamah*, from where the duration begins, and that period which begins from it, is the *zuhur* of Janab-e Mahdi. And the *zuhur* of the *Qa'im* is the second surface. And the first *zuhur*, which is the *zuhur* of Mawlana Mahdi-billah, may blessings be upon him, regarding that *zuhur*, Allah Ta'ala has said that it will be sudden (*baghtatan*), that *Qiyamah* will come suddenly. It will come so suddenly that dread will spread, and people will not understand what to do and what not to do.

A very revered brother of mine gave a very good example, that when such a *Qiyamah* was raging and the stars were aligning in such a way, everyone said, "Brother, what should we do? Should we do this, should we do that?" So he said a very good thing, that at that time a wise man said that the best thing is for us to do our own work. Do our own work. So it is known that this is the correct thing. So what is the right work to do? It is that we must always keep our return to Allah and return to Him. Whatever *namaz* and other things we have to perform, we have to perform them. These are the duties of our station, which are upon us. Until this yoke is removed from our necks, this yoke will remain. So I was telling you about Mawlana Mahdi-billah, may blessings be upon him, who is in the station of the Prophet `alayhis-salatu was-salam`. His *zuhur* is sudden, and it can happen at any time, it can happen at this very moment. It will happen, and it will be sudden. And if it happens suddenly, in what way will it happen? That is, what is *zuhur* called? Brother, what does it mean to become apparent? What does it mean to become apparent? Does it mean he is hidden? Is he hidden in some cave, like the twelfth Imam is hidden in a cave? He is not hidden like that. Brother, your Imam is hidden like that, why doesn't he come out? I asked, why doesn't he come out? He said, "You... why don't you ask this question: if ice can stay in a thermos, why can't our Imam stay in a cave?" Look what a great answer. After all, he was a Shia scholar, so the answer... After all, if ice can stay in a thermos, then our Imam... he can't stay in a cave? And when God put the companions of the cave to sleep, then what was wrong with keeping the Imam in the cave? So I just said this, that brother, I have understood, it's a very good thing, it's very good. You keep him in such a thermos. But my point is that when your... this Imam, who is 'Askari, Allah knows best, whoever he may be, but now this... the one who is to come as the *Qa'im al-Qiyamah*, you have said that he is the greatest guide, he is the greatest one, he is the one who will establish *Qiyamah*. So why didn't Allah give the Prophet the life of Noah, make it so long that he himself could appear? After all, why is your twelfth Imam stuck there? So anyway, what answer will they give? What answer will they give to this? Anyway. So what I mean to say was that the one who is going to appear before the *Qa'im al-Qiyamah*, he is the *Mahdi-billah*, may blessings be upon him. Whose name is the name of the Prophet, whose father's name is the name of the Prophet's father, and about whom the Prophet had said, that personality, that one who is the God of his time, who is the Subduer (*Qahhar*), the Compeller (*Jabbar*) of his time, is coming. Coming as a *Jabbar*. Now look, sometimes there is a *jamali* (beautiful) state, sometimes a *jalali* (majestic) state is manifested. From Allah's side. You have seen the thunderclaps, have you seen the clouds thunder, have you seen the great commotion and storm of rain? So one says, "O *Jabbar*, O *Qahhar*." And if good sustenance starts to come, then "O *Razzaq* (Provider)." And if sometimes you like something, you say, "O *Jamil* (Beautiful)." O Beautiful, O *Jamil*, or say whatever, "O *Ra'uf* (Compassionate)," "O *Rahim* (Merciful)." But the words *Jabbar* and *Qahhar* do come out, that when one sees that the wrath of Allah is thundering, there is coercion (*jabr*) and there is wrath (*qahr*). So seeing his *qahr* and *jabr*... So now is the time for the *Jabbar* and *Qahhar* to come. And the *Mahdi* is coming as that *Jabbar* and *Qahhar*. And as soon as he appears in this world... what does *zuhur* mean? I have just clarified to you. *Zuhur* does not mean this, rather, he is also present. To be recognized (*pachhanvan*). That is *zuhur*. He said, "I am the *Mahdi*." That's it, understand that now the *zuhur* of the *Mahdi* has happened. And that too, he will say it from such a place from where wrath comes, from Cairo (*Qahirah*). This wrath will come from Cairo. That is, as soon as the *zuhur* happens... now you will say that if he takes his sword and comes out, today there are atom bombs and the whole world's... bombs have come out. Brother, this is the personality who is coming, who is the representative of Allah, who is coming as the God of the age. Now, the one in whose grasp is godhood and lordship, who has authority over the winds, who can make it rain whenever he wishes, who can destroy the trees, who can bring destruction in a minute, in a second. That personality is coming. He will command that the force of gravity should end. Now you see, as soon as the force of gravity ends here... I am giving an example, only Allah knows best what he is going to do. As soon as the force of gravity ends here, it's over. As soon as one thing ends, everything is over. Your entire science has been reduced to ashes. It's gone. If this air pressure ends, where is your science? Where is your science? Now the situation will be that now they have been caught, and they have been seized, and even great nations which you see, such nations whose influence was paramount, and who are doing power balancing, but all will be left behind. Did you try to read God's book? You were others, the Muslims themselves did not read God's book correctly. Brother, it was written in it that `innad-dina 'indallahil-islam` (the religion with Allah is Islam). With Allah, the religion is Islam. How did you understand this Islam?" He said, "Sir, we left Islam because we didn't understand what Islam is. What is Islam?" It's a true thing. Islam... they didn't show it. The Muslims presented Islam in such a way, don't ask. I gave you an example yesterday. Their shari'ah has been reduced to doing wudu and tying their hands. From today, the religion is Islam, and besides Islam, no other drum will be beaten. Be careful, no one dares to take any name other than Islam. `Qulu la ilaha illallah`. Now there is no question of `tuflihu`. That was the Prophet, who was compassionate and merciful, he was the mercy to the worlds, who had said, "Say `tuflihu`, O people, and you will prosper. Just take the name of Allah, that `la ilaha illallah`." Now, this is the *Qahhar*, this is the *Jabbar*. Now the matter is of the sword. Now the matter is of the mouth, now the matter is of wrath, now the matter is of coercion. You will have to accept. There is no way out other than accepting. And this is that you accept Islam. `La ilaha illallah`. Until now you hadn't recited it, it hadn't gone down your throat. You had recited it many times, you had turned the prayer beads, but it hadn't entered your heart. Now you will have to recite `la ilaha illallah` correctly. Now you... So, let there be some mystery. So, some things are not to be known. So anyway, a time will come which is appointed. And that time is appointed. Look, this time is not appointed. But the time of Janab-e Qa'im is appointed. And that is such a time that, don't ask. Fine, I will count the days for you, it's a good thing, it's not a big deal, it's the occasion of Eid al-Adha. That one whose slaves are Ali, whose slavery even all the Imams feel honored in, that personality is coming. Janab-e Qa'im. The establisher of *Qiyamah* (*Qa'im al-Qiyamah*), the master of *damdamah* (*sahib-e damdamah*), the master of *faza' al-akbar* (*sahib-e faza' al-akbar*) is coming. And what can be said of his procession, his royalty, his kingdom, his sovereignty. Where is he coming from? He is coming from Ma'arif. Look, Allah Ta'ala has already named that place Ma'arif. Ma'arif means signs. Brother, from where the signs of Allah are going to rise, that place exists even today. And from that same village, from that same settlement in Yemen, who is coming? Hazrat Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam`. And here, Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam`'s *zuhur* took place. And what does *zuhur* mean? The one who will announce it will be Janab-e Mahdi himself. That who is the *Qa'im*, what is the *Qa'im*? A day is coming, a din is coming, the master of the din is coming, and he is your master. In whose heart I am going. And Janab-e Mahdi will himself set out on a journey. And after traveling, he will directly reach where? In Ma'arif, which is the region of Yemen. And Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam`, what can be said of his majesty? With what pomp and show, what can be said? Brother, the one with whom all the elements of nature are with folded hands, what do you ask about his royalty? What do you ask about his royalty? And here the situation is that at whose signs the sun, moon, and stars rise and set, at whose signs they become low and high, they are the ones who are coming in his entourage. So what will be the state of his royalty? What will be the loftiness of his exaltedness? He is the *Qa'im*. The state of *Qa'im* `alayhis-salatu was-salam` is that the procession is coming out. You will think that there will be a large crowd, that is, at least a gathering of three or four hundred thousand. O people, I will address you, I will speak to you." And your procession will go directly to where? To the Baytullah al-Haram. The same center of God, the same house of God. `Inna awwala baytin wudi'a lin-nasi lalladhi bi-bakkata mubarakan wa hudan lil-'alamin` (Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Bakkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds). He reached there. After reaching there, he performed the same prostration. Why? It is his place of prostration too. After all, from where did the great Kayumarth come? Janab-e Qa'im is where? Janab-e Kayumarth, the great one, came from here. That is his place of prostration. He prostrated in that Baytullah. He performed the circumambulation (*tawaf*). They are the ones who claimed the right. They sat in the place of right, they usurped the right of Ali. They will be brought to justice. And from there, coming out directly, where will your direction be? You will say, "Now to Mina." To Mina, to Mina, to the desire (*muna*). As soon as they reach Mina, this is the plain of resurrection (*maidan-e hashr*). This is the plain of Karbala, this is the plain of resurrection, this is the plain of *Qiyamah*. Now what can be said of this plain of *Qiyamah*. Just look at the recognition of Mina. Look at that land. Oh. Now what is the situation? The situation is that whoever the people are, Adam's enemies, whether it is Pharaoh, or Haman, or Qarun, whether it is that Nimrod, whether it is anyone, Ghud, Suwa', Ya'uq, or whether it is Sahrebuta, whoever it may be. According to that age, they have to be born in this world, and in that way, they have to reach that age. So now it is obvious that if you call a few years, a few years of *Qiyamah*, if it is a matter of 70-80 years of age, then these people should be born. And they have been born. How many have been born? Yazid has also come, Shimr has also come, Qarun... only Allah knows best. But they have to be born. Whether it is in Syria or Iraq. Now, neither the parents know that Yazid has come, nor does Yazid know that he has come as Yazid. Neither the parents have a chance to be happy, nor does the child have a chance to be happy that in whose house I have come. Did you see? The arrangement of providence. Now he has come. Everyone has been born. After being born, the situation is that when you herd a flock, when you herd goats, you see the shepherd, quietly, you see what the situation is. What does he do? To herd the goats, he takes one goat ahead, so that all the goats follow behind. And if they don't, then he goads them with a stick. He prods them with a stick, he hits them in such a way that in no way do they... they walk in step with the flock.

Now what will happen? The situation will be that these accursed ones, whose ancestors were opponents of the saints, who opposed the imams, who opposed the prophets, who opposed the pious, who opposed the *du'at*, they are all coming. And they don't know who they themselves are. Who they are, where they are going, from where they were born. No one knows. They don't know anything. They are coming, all of them are being dragged, dragged along. Providence is bringing them, and they are coming. In a completely unconscious way. In an unconscious and oblivious way they are coming, and how are they coming? They have to come to that plain of *Qiyamah*. And *Qa'im* `alayhis-salatu was-salam` in that field... and Hazrat *Qa'im* `alayhis-salatu was-salam` is standing leaning against a tree, and Janab-e Mahdi is with him, and those 313 individuals are standing in your ranks. There cannot be a number greater than that. That's all the people there are. We might say, "Brother, let us also reach your presence." That is for whom Allah has written, they reached. For whom Allah has not written, they did not reach. If a call for war is made, then you see how the situation is, what the situation is. Who is ready to go to war? Anyway, those 313 individuals are the individuals whom Janab-e Qa'im has kept with him. And in front of Hazrat Qa'im, they are coming. Slowly, slowly, being dragged, they are coming. And as they come, when all the people gather, providence has already made the arrangement. All will slowly, slowly gather, and that day will be the day of Ashura. As soon as the day of Ashura comes, all of them will be gathered. All of them will be gathered. Pharaoh will also come, and Yazid will also come, Shimr will also come, this one will also come, that one will also come, the caliphs will also come, so-and-so will also come, everyone will come. No one will be left out. Everyone has arrived at their place. Now, after arriving, providence will lift the veil. Providence will lift the veil from their eyes, and it will be shown who you yourself are. Now, as soon as they... first, there are two kinds of veils. One is the veil on Janab-e Qa'im. The second veil is on their eyes. First, the veil will be removed from Janab-e Qa'im. Or first, the veil will be removed from their eyes. So, it is that first their veil was removed, so they understood who I am. "Oh, I am so-and-so, I am so-and-so, I am 'Amr ibn al-'As, I am Marwan, I am so-and-so." And as soon as he saw, and along with that, he looked at Janab-e Qa'im, and when he saw Janab-e Qa'im, who was it? The caliphs are seeing Ali. Mu'awiyah is seeing Hasan. Yazid is seeing Husayn. Pharaoh is seeing Moses. Did you see? The mirror is one, whose image is being seen? This is the manifestation. This is called mirror-work. This is the mirror-work of providence. And that Nimrod who was there, he is seeing Abraham. And that Qabil who was there, he is seeing Habil. That Shaytan Harith al-Murrah who was there, he is seeing Adam. And Sahrebuta who was there, he is seeing Jesus. "Oh, I... Oh, I crucified him! Oh, I myself have come today." Sahrebuta trembled like this, and was terrified like this. Everyone is trembling and terrified in their state, because they have recognized themselves and they have recognized them. And there, the *Qa'im* is one being. And why are they being seen? Brother, the *Qa'im* is the temple (*haikal*). All the temples are gathered in him. He has become the great mirror by taking on the forms of everyone. Everyone's form is being seen in that mirror. And all are seeing their own form. "Oh, oh, they have come. Husayn has come. Oh, Ali has come. Oh, the Prophet has come." Abu Lahab and his wife are seeing the Prophet. And Umratul Khaybariyyah, that woman of Khaybar, Zaynab, who had given poison to the noble Prophet, she is also seeing the Prophet. So anyway, all are seeing. All are seeing. And seeing, they are trembling and terrified, "O Allah, what *Qiyamah* has come." "Brother, we had opposed him." Because with full memory, they have been given it. That what was your memory and what opposition did you do. You opposed the saints. Brother, let's assume that who... what great thing is a prophet, who can extinguish the light of God? That candle which God Himself has lit, what can extinguish it? But they thought it was Husayn and killed him, they thought it was Ali and killed him, Ibn Muljam struck with the sword. They thought it was Janab-e Prophet. They whipped, they threw on the sand. Will they not be punished today? Today Husayn will also be punished, Karbala will also be punished, Uhud and Khaybar will also be punished. And punishment will be given for every place today. Today everyone is to be punished. The Day of Recompense and Punishment. The recompense is that they were joined in the temple of the *Qa'im*. This is the recompense they got, that you are in the highest paradise, you have reached God in the spiritual realm. And you, sitting in the window there, are watching paradise. You will say, "Brother, I wish we were also there." Brother, you will be there. Although you may have become a point, a dot, but you are watching from those chambers of paradise, from those gardens, you are watching, you are seeing. "Allah's mercy..." So what are those chambers of paradise? These are the windows. This is the scene from the temple, you are watching, you are seeing. This is the scene to see. This is the scenery. And after that, you will see whose day it is today, it is the day of *Qiyamah*. Today is the day of piety. Today is the day for sins to be destroyed and ruined. Today is the day for Shaytan to hide his face. Today is the day for Shaytan to be annihilated. And he will be annihilated. And what will happen? After that, Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam` will start turning towards each one. But where will he start from? You will think he will start from Adam. Or from Janab-e Jesus, or from... no. The matter will start from Ali. Because after the *Qa'im*, if there is a rank, it is of Ali. So it will be asked, in whose place did who sit? How did they sit? How did you sit? How did you sit in his place? Brother, in the place of the great Ali, in the place of the great news (*naba' al-'azim*), you came and sat. Didn't you understand? And the one who explained to you, did he not show you the Prophet even after his death? Did he not show you in the mosque of Quba? Did he not show you the scene in the Prophet's mosque? Then why didn't you understand? At that time also it was explained, afterwards also the proof was given, but... And today... Alright, I forgot to mention one thing to you. And what will that announcement be? And that announcement will be a very great announcement. And that announcement will be that, "O people, my beloved, my *Hujjat*, Janab-e Mahdi, made you Muslims by force and coercion. But I say that the true religion is indeed the religion of Islam. But I remove my yoke of authority from you, and I remove the yoke, and go, whichever religion you want to be on, your religion is blessed for you. `Lakum dinukum waliya din` (To you be your religion, and to me my religion). And everything started running in its own place. As soon as it started here, the *Qa'im* said, "Be careful, don't move now. Be careful, who dares to move. Now the proof is complete. I have completed the proof against you. I have shown you the religion, and after forcing you, I... and after that, now you have gone back to it again. And in this way, now you go to the plain of *Qiyamah*, and there they will be asked, "How did you oppose Moses, O Pharaoh? How did you oppose Jesus, O Sahrebuta?" All these things will be questioned, and everyone is being questioned, and every person is trembling and terrified and understands that this is Jesus who has come, this is Moses who has come, this is Adam who has come, this is Ali who has come. Every person is seeing his own Imam. Every person is seeing his own Imam. Even our 49 Imams who passed, in the time of every Imam, whoever was the unfortunate one, he is seeing his own Imam of the time. Why? Janab-e Qa'im is the mirror. They are seeing, everyone's manifestation is happening. And they are seeing and trembling and terrified, and in this very state they will be, in this very state of astonishment, that Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam` will signal to the earth, to the earth, "Earth, be careful, let no one move." These are my prisoners. The feet will get stuck. No one's foot will... brother, our feet get stuck in the mud. Brother, this is the *Qa'im*. The *Qa'im* will make them stand still. The feet will not be able to move from the ground. Everyone's feet are stuck there. After that, the order will be given, "Now it is done. Now you, 313 individuals," he will say to them, "Yes, now it is your time. That now you slaughter them. Kill them. In the same way, kill the big ones, slaughter them like camels. And the situation here will be that there will be blood and blood. That land which has always been red, that land where thousands of camels have always been slaughtered, on that same land, these will be slaughtered. And they will be slaughtered, and everyone will be cut down, everyone will be killed. And all of them will be... done. When it is done, at that time we will offer praise, and we will thank Allah Ta'ala. Janab-e Qa'im `alayhis-salatu was-salam` will be in a state of *namaz*. And at that time, those 313 individuals will also perform *namaz* with you. And after performing, at that time you will signal, to the sun. "Sun, now it is your job." As soon as the sun is signaled, the sun will start showing its intensity. And with the intensity of the sun, what will happen? Now you see that the heat of the heat will increase. As the heat increases here, the order will be given to the demons (*kudatain*). *Ras* and *Zanab*. They will be given the order, "Yes, *Ras* and *Zanab*." Open the doors. And release all those prisoners who are imprisoned. Now you see, who are those prisoners? You must remember, I hope you haven't forgotten. Those *kudatain*, *Ras* and *Zanab*. *Ras* and *Zanab* are their evil souls. Vile forms, which after dying, after their exit, remained in the graveyard for forty days, then as I said, they remained in the latrine and other such places. They remained in thorny trees, in barren fields. They remained in the fields, and then in the latrine. And after coming out from there, they sometimes took rides, and after coming out, the demons caught them and imprisoned them in their... prison. So now these imprisoned ones, who are *Ras* and *Zanab*, as soon as the doors are opened from there, all of them were released. And after being released, when they fall, their form has also been described, that they will fall in the form of a camel's neck. And with this falling, they will come, so every form that is coming, it will come upon its own body. The one whose body it is, `tahdhib khud apne khanzar se khudkashi karegi` (civilization will commit suicide with its own dagger), yes. This will be the matter. To die by one's own self, to burn in one's own fire. Their own form will annihilate them. That it was that same fire, that was their form, that was the vile form, that was their creed, that was the wrong creed. That same creed fell upon them. And with the falling, they caught fire. And with the catching of fire, what will happen? Every particle is burning. All the hostile ones, whose bodies were created, they are all burning. And after burning, when they become ash, the wind will be commanded, "Wind, now go." And as soon as the gust of wind starts blowing, the wind will, just as a sweeper sweeps to one corner, in the same way, the wind will sweep. That is what it is doing, and how is the sweeping happening? It is continuously gathering it in one place, and gathering this ash, it is bringing it and in the Atlantic Ocean, there is a door of that, of Jahannam. Jahannam has four doors. Of which three doors are on land. One door is in the water. The door that is in the water, its name is Barhut. Perhaps this is the Bermuda Triangle, or that place which is mentioned. And the others are, one is Hadramawt. That Hadramawt which is here is *Hadhir Mawt* (death is present). Yes, death is present, please come. *Hadhir Mawt* is that Hadramawt. And after that is Sa'iq. God forbid, from Sa'iq. After Sa'iq is Dayr. These... these are three places. And out of these three, two places are volcanoes. You will think that Japan's volcano is the biggest, so it will be there. No. There is no need for that, that is just a subordinate. A very small volcano, but it is there. So anyway, its location and places are there, the names I am saying are also there. But these three places are on land, one place is in the Atlantic Ocean. This will all be... Janab-e Qa'im will signal that enter through the path of Barhut. All this ash, the entire wind, gathering it, will sweep it away, and into the sea, through the path of Barhut, they will go to Jahannam. And when they go to Jahannam, now, the scene after going to Jahannam, I have already described it yesterday. That what their condition will be after going to Jahannam, that they will be brought back to their original state. And as soon as they come to their original state, they have three necks, three forms, eight, ten hands each. Look, they have become gods. And the situation is that they are clawing at each other, eating, tearing, and hitting. These will be their habits, these will be their traits, and in this way they will spend their time there. So this is the divine punishment. Rather, the situation will be that when they enter, those who are already present will say, "O Allah, from where have you sent this new army? We were already in torment. From where has this new army come?" "From where has this calamity been created?" "From where has more... more been sent upon us?" And what is the state of Jahannam? Jahannam cries out, the Quran says, `hal min mazid?` (Is there any more?). `Hal min mazid?` "Brother, my stomach is not getting full. The matter is worth considering. My stomach is not getting full, O Lord. You have put so much fuel, what is this fuel? This is just one day's supply for me. My stomach is not getting full from this. `Hal min mazid?` Is there anything more for my food? I need more. My stomach has not been filled with this." So the Muslims say that upon `hal min mazid`, what will happen? Look, a little... pick up the books. Just see the joke. That they say that Allah will, when Jahannam starts crying out, `hal min mazid, hal min mazid`, "Send some more, send some more, I am hungry," then Allah will put his foot in. Meaning, the matter was such that... that it is something strange, that if Allah speaks, it's over. Allah will put his foot in, then Jahannam will be quiet. Now Allah has put his foot in. So is Allah going to get his foot massaged? God forbid. What is the meaning, I don't understand. Anyway, which thing that comes to their understanding, will you understand? Anyway. This is an exemplary moment. It is a very exemplary moment. May Allah Ta'ala give us a lesson, that they will have to go through such harsh conditions, and the punishment of Allah Ta'ala is very painful, very severe. And Allah Ta'ala says, `dhu quwwatin matin` (Possessor of power, the Firm). Allah Ta'ala is very powerful. Severe in punishment. And `ghadha'an dha ghussatin wa 'adhaban alima` (and a food that chokes and a painful punishment). Brother, he will give them such food there in Jahannam that will get stuck in the throat, and it will be a very severe punishment from Allah. May the Lord of the Worlds, for the sake of the Ahl al-Bayt, grant us salvation from all these things. May the Lord keep us away from these tests. May he keep us on the straight path. May he keep us attached to the hem of the Imams. And above all, our Mawla, our master, our Da'i of the time, our father, Mawlana Sayyidna Sharfi, may Allah prolong his life and grant him health, may he make us his devotees. This entire... all the knowledge, whatever has opened my tongue before you, without his command, without his support, not even a leaf can move. Believe me, that these are his views, these are his blessings, these are his graces, that whatever I could present before you. But remember it, understand it, and make it a principle of your life. And this... this... I will consider it my fruit only when you make it beneficial for yourself. And for the betterment of religion and the betterment of the hereafter. `Wa akhiru da'wana anil-hamdulillahi Rabbil-'alamin, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulihi Sayyidina Muhammadin wa Ahl-e Baytihit-tayyibinat-tahirin, wa sallama 'alayhim ajma'in.`

It becomes like this. Is there a question? The meaning of *ḥawl* and *quwwah*? *Ḥawl* and *quwwah* have various meanings. Its *ta'wīl* (esoteric interpretation) is that *lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh al-ʿalīy al-ʿaẓīm* (There is no might nor power except with God, the Most High, the Most Great). So, *ḥawl* is Mawlana Hasan, and *quwwah* is Mawlana Husayn. One is Hasan, and one is Husayn. But neither is there Husayn, nor is there Hasan, [rather] there is Ali al-Azim (the Great Ali). Meaning, Janab Ali al-Azim is greater than them. In this way, there is a Hadith of the Prophet that *al-Ḥasanu wa al-Ḥusaynu Imāmā ḥaqqin qāmā aw qaʿadā wa abūhumā khayrun minhumā* (Hasan and Husayn are two Imams of truth, whether they rise or sit, and their father is better than them both). Janab Hasan and Husayn are both Imams of truth, whether they establish their right through uprising or not. And the father of them both is better than them both. So he is explaining the ranks (*marātib*). Janab Hasan and Husayn, in their respective ranks, are all in their own places. But Ali is, rather, very high. *Khayrun minhumā* (Better than them both). He is better than both. The *ta'wīlī maʿnā* (interpretive meaning) is varied. That is also there, and this is also explained.

The middle part of the *Mabda'āt* (the Beginnings/Origins), it is better to understand that well. *Tawḥīd* (monotheism) etc., is a necessary thing, but many people do not understand it properly. What is the meaning of *hū* (He), and what is the meaning of *ʿālam-e-rūḥānī* (the spiritual world). And after that, the meaning of *tawḥīd* that has been explained... that the *ḥudūd-e-rūḥānī* (spiritual ranks) and *jismānī* (physical ranks), their *maʿrifat* (gnosis/recognition) is more necessary. Because the *maʿrifat* of Allah cannot be attained. So, the *maʿrifat* of the *ḥudūd* should be there. And whether it is *rūḥānī* or *jismānī*. And in this, *jismānī* means *siflī* (lower/terrestrial). That is, from the Imam up to where you are sitting, your *maʿrifat* should be correct up to there. It should be correct. And in the world of intellects (*ʿuqūl*). What are the *khawā'im*? What are the *jusas*? And what are *uẓbuʿayn*, what is *uẓbuʿ*? All these... the *khawā'im* are also varied. They are not *qā'im*, they are *khawā'im*. The status of each one is different. So, the rank of each is different. It is according to their era (*dawr*), according to their period. So, it is necessary to understand this whole thing. And besides that, whatever middle *mabda'āt* there are that are related to us. *Mabda'āt* means that how did our coming happen and what is our going. Our... how a person comes into being... from where does he come? *dawla-e-ʿālam* means that from mineral, plant, animal, etc., traversing through these, we come straight into the human form (*khāwand-e-insānī*). One does not suddenly come into the human form just like that. Whether it is descent (*tanazzul*) or ascent (*taraqqī*), it happens gradually. From mineral to plant, from plant to animal, from animal to human. These are the paths of progress. And then, he is brought to the *khāwand-e-alifiyyah*. So, *khāwand-e-alifiyyah* is a standard thing where a human is brought and made to stand. And then the *daʿwat sharīf* (noble mission) is presented. *daʿwat-e-hādiyah* (the guiding mission). If he accepts it, then his matter is settled. If not, then it is a matter of going down.

So, for this, the method that has been established, the *ʿāshir-e-mudabbir* (the Tenth Intellect, the Governor), who is the *mudabbir-e-kā'ināt* (Governor of the Universe), he first thought about how I will lift up this entire world that has fallen below. So in his intention (*qaṣd*), in his intentions (*irādah*)... in *Kanz al-Walad* and *Anwār* it is mentioned that he had these intentions. And in those intentions, it was that I will lift them up through *lāhūṭ* (divinity) and *nāṣūṭ* (humanity). There are only two paths. One is through the way of man, by becoming *ashraf al-makhlūqāt* (the noblest of creatures). Progress will not happen through any other path, except that of man. And the second thing is, through *nāṣūṭ* and *lāhūṭ*. One is *jismānī* (physical), and... *hayūlā* (prime matter) and *ṣūrat* (form). Through these two things, his progress will happen.

So what is *lāhūṭ*? What is *nāṣūṭ* called? This is a philosophical term. And it is also used by us. *nāṣūṭ* is that which has physicality (*jismāniyyat*). Meaning, it has density (*kathāfat*). The Imam who is seen, he is called *nāṣūṭ*. The Imam who is seen is the *nāṣūṭ-e-sharīf* (noble humanity). Whether you call it a sheath (*ghilāf*), call it *nāṣūṭ*, call it Imam, call it *Imām-e-Mubīn* (the manifest Imam), these are all its names. But *lāhūṭ* is the thing that is not seen. It is *imāmat* (imamate). It is *haykal* (temple/form). And... there is *imāmat*, there is *haykal*, and there is *lāhūṭ*. These three terms are for it, which are unseen, not visible. And that is greater. So how is *lāhūṭ* formed? Or how is *nāṣūṭ* formed and how is *lāhūṭ* formed? And it has various stages (*madārij*). *Madārij* means that there are statuses. That *nāṣūṭ* is either *ẓillī* (shadowy), or *ṭabīʿī* (natural), or *khāṣṣ* (special). These are all different. We have studied this in *Maḥāsin* here. The *Mabda'āt* has also been done many times. So what is it? Do you remember anything? What is *nāṣūṭ-e-ṭabīʿī*? *Nāṣūṭ-e-ṭabīʿī* is, how is it formed (*takwīn*)? It is better to understand this whole thing well.

*Ṭabīʿī* means natural, the standard one. There is a *ṭabīʿī nāṣūṭ* which is brought here. That is, the one who comes as our Imam. So, what is *ṭabīʿī*? What does it consist of? What thing is formed? It is the *riḥiyyat* of the believers of the islands (*jazā'ir*). Remember this. The *riḥiyyat* of the believers of the islands, it is formed from that. The *riḥiyyat* of the believers. Now, among believers there are ranks. Then there are various things. The *ḥudūd* have one, this one has another, that one has another. So, the specification to be made in this is that, for example, the believers of the islands... I said believers. From the believers, the *nāṣūṭ-e-ṭabīʿī* is formed. Upon which all the difficulties come for the Imam. The calamities happen. The difficulties that happen, they all happen to the *nāṣūṭ-e-ṭabīʿī*. And *nāṣūṭ-e-ẓillī* is higher than that. *Nāṣūṭ-e-ẓillī* is also not visible. And its guardian, or you can say holder, is *Umm al-Dhakr* (Mother of the Male/Memory). That is, the mother of the Imam. The mother of every Imam, she takes care of the *nāṣūṭ-e-ẓillī*. They have a special thing. Now you see, the mother of one Imam is the wife of another Imam. The mother of every Imam is [the wife] of another Imam. So it is a special domain. Now these *baṭūlāt* (chaste women, like Fatima al-Batul)... this is called *baṭūlāt*. They are so pure, so chaste, that they are not like common women. When you study higher realities (*ḥaqā'iq*), you will know what their statuses are. Some of these *baṭūlāt* are such that they are greater than the prophets. It is written. That they are greater than the prophets (*anbiyā'*). *Anbiyā'* doesn't mean every prophet. It's not about our prophet. *Anbiyā'* includes Zakariyya, Yahya, Sham'un. From the ranks of all these, Mawlatina Aminah, Mawlatina Khadijah, Mawlana Fatima bint Asad, and Janab-e-Khadijah, all of them are high. But they came in the form of women for specific reasons. So this, whatever is formed, the *nāṣūṭ-e-ṭabīʿī* is formed from *riḥiyyat*.

And *nāṣūṭ-e-ẓillī* is... the *ḥudūd* of this place, the higher *ḥudūd*, the *afāḍil* (excellent ones). And the believers there, the *ḥuḍarāt* who are with the Imam. The degree level goes up. And the believers there... the *nāṣūṭ-e-ẓillī* is formed from them. And that stays for a specific time. That is called *Umm al-Dhakr*. *Dhakr* means that the male, the Imam is the male. His mother takes care of it. And the third is *nāṣūṭ-e-khāṣṣ* (special humanity). The *nāṣūṭ-e-khāṣṣ*... its inception or beginning does not happen here. Meaning, its existence is not in this world. It is so high, so pure, that it... because it is formed from the *ḥudūd* of all the *ḥuḍarāt*. *ḥuḍarāt*, *ḥudūd* means the *duʿāt* who are there. It is formed from them. They are pure from the beginning. So, the *riḥiyyat* that emerges from them... What is *riḥiyyat* called? *baqāya al-nāmiyah*. Its definition is *baqāya al-nāmiyah* (the remnants of the vegetative faculty). The *nāmiyah* that is in our body, that *baqāya al-nāmiyah*... Meaning, the *nāmiyah* is sometimes buried along with it. Because not every person is pure. So at the time of death, our *ḥissiyyah* (sensory faculty) leaves, but the *nāmiyah*... I am talking about the believers, not the common folk. So, the believer's [nāmiyah] remains. A little bit. How much remains, that is in Allah's hands. When that comes out after three days, it is called *baqāya al-nāmiyah*. And its name changes. It is no longer *nāmiyah*, it becomes *riḥiyyah*. Like a fragrance, or like the wind. And it goes to various places. It goes to the moon. From the moon, it goes to Mercury, from Mercury to Venus, from Venus to the sun, from the sun... it returns after reaching Jupiter. It is not mentioned for Mars, etc. It returns from Jupiter and then stops in the moon. And it resides in the moon until the Imam thinks that now that son of mine should be born who is to become my successor. At that time, those things from there... signals come from the Pillar of Light (*ʿamūd al-nūr*). In the world of souls (*ʿālam-e-arwāḥ*). In the world of souls, from the Pillar of Light, some things come into motion, and here, those things from the moon come down into the *ḥuḍarāt*. They won't be able to go anywhere else. This is Allah's promise, and it is that those things will come down from there and come into the *ḥuḍarāt*. And the Imam and his wife eat that, and the child that is born from it is the future Imam.

Then there are many details about it, how they receive it, what it is, in what form they receive it, all those things. This *riḥiyyat* is, in a way, a thing higher than our *fuḍulāt* (waste matter/excess). This is the middle part to understand, what are *fuḍulāt*, what are *riḥiyyat*, what are *ṣughrāt*. Because the ascent (*irtiqā'*) in prayer (*ṣalāt*) is because of this. What thing is it? Which thing... the more pure it is, the more it will emerge. The one with density (*kathāfat*) will remain. So, our *fuḍulāt* remain behind. The parts of the body that are dense, the vegetative things, remain. The higher things that we have, they emerge. And that is *riḥiyyat*. Higher than *riḥiyyat* is *ṣughrāt*—the concept (*taṣawwur*). What is your creed (*ʿaqīdah*)? What is your concept about religion? That is the highest thing. And that concept emerges in the form of the *ṣūrat-e-rūḥānī* (spiritual form). And that itself is the most comprehensive thing, that is your true capital that you take from here. Everything else is left here. So the *ṣūrat-e-rūḥānī*, how is it formed? And in *Maḥāsin*, it is in great detail. Anyway, this *nāṣūṭ-e-khāṣṣ* is a high thing, which is not visible, and it is formed from the *ḥudūd* of the *ḥuḍarāt*. *Ḥudūd* means the very high *duʿāt*. It is formed from the *duʿāt*. And then it goes and... Then there are things higher than *nāṣūṭ-e-khāṣṣ* as well. Many other matters. They are in great detail. What that thing is, higher than it. Is there anyone? *Nāṣūṭ-e-khāṣṣ*... *khāṣṣ* itself is a thing that is not visible. It is that high. It is so high that it is not a visible thing and it is very... there is something higher than that. What is it? It is *nāṣūṭ-e-kullī* (universal humanity). *Nāṣūṭ-e-kullī* is a higher thing than that. And that *nāṣūṭ-e-kullī* is not given to every Imam, but to some specific Imams. And it is the essence of various Imams, which is given in the form of *nāṣūṭ-e-kullī*. So there is *nāṣūṭ-e-kullī*, *nāṣūṭ-e*... there are other such stages. So now, above this is *lāhūṭ*. And *lāhūṭ* also has various statuses. We generally say as a whole that there is *lāhūṭ* and *nāṣūṭ*, that's it. Now if... as you learn during the lesson, for your knowledge, *nāṣūṭ* are also of various types, *lāhūṭ* are also of various types. But, *lāhūṭ* and *nāṣūṭ*. These are the two ladders. One will go through these. The physical part is through *nāṣūṭ*, and the spiritual is through *lāhūṭ*. Within *lāhūṭ* is *imāmat*. *Imāmat*. Our concept, the creed that we hold, this thing is called *ṣūrat* (form). And this *ṣūrat* itself is the real thing that we will take from here.

And at the last moment, the *ṣūrat-e-rūḥānī*, how is it formed? How does it happen? At the time of death, our *nafs-e-nāṭiqah* (rational soul), the *nafs-e-nāṭiqah* is not a thing of this place. The *nafs-e-nāṭiqah* has come from there. When did it come? When we are present for the oath of allegiance (*ʿahd*). At the time of the oath, the leaven of regret (*khamīr-e-nadāmat*), the regret that we felt there and came, that part of our regret is received at that time when we say the name in the oath for the first time. That's it, we have become believers. That ray that we received, we have to keep increasing it. It is in great detail in *Maḥāsin*. We have studied it twice here. It keeps growing and growing. Now, when the time of death comes, this *nāṭiqah* for the whole life influences the *ḥissiyyah* so that the *ḥissiyyah* rises from here. That's it, its job is that the *ḥissiyyah*... what is *ḥissiyyah*? It is our 'I'. The 'I' should be... the self (*dhāt*). To lift the self. So the *ḥissiyyah* wants to pull, and the *nāṭiqah* pulls the *ḥissiyyah*. Plus, all our deeds, whether we have given *zakāt*, kept fasts, performed Hajj, all these things become one bundle and remain, and its name is *ṣūrat-e-rūḥānī*. And this *ṣūrat-e-rūḥānī* goes to our *ḥadd-e-ʿālī* (higher rank). This is a special concept, only for the followers of the Ahl al-Bayt. No one else has this concept. That our progress will only be through the *ḥadd-e-ʿālī*. After the *ḥadd-e-ʿālī*, we will go to their *ḥadd-e-ʿālī*. This, gradually, happening step by step, they will reach the Imam. They will go to the *bāb al-abwāb* (gate of gates), and from the *bāb al-abwāb* to the Imam. This is the way of the religion. This concept, this concept is the highest thing. Now *ṣūrat-e-rūḥānī* is a very special thing. That how is ours formed? It will be known at the time of death. When death occurs, then it will be known what kind of *ṣūrat-e-rūḥānī* has been formed. And everyone at that time... you have also studied in *Maḥāsin* that when death occurs, at that time... some people's deeds are not good, some are a certain way, so and so. Now after that... this is called intercession (*shafāʿat*), the Prophet's intercession. The Imam of the Time (*Imām al-Zamān*) sees what their situation is.

So it has been explained that it is black like coal. When we take the oath, a spark falls. And then we fan it. And it becomes intense. Just as you blow on coal, it becomes an ember. It becomes like that. And for some, they didn't pray, didn't fast, nothing happened. So it keeps dimming. Dimming, dimming, dimming, it comes close to being extinguished. Now in that state, he died. So what is the recompense for his being a believer? The Imam of the Time sees that. And if it is his will... that his intention was sincere, he is so and so, he didn't see any of these things, he looks at the stages (*adwār*), the previous life (*sābiqah*), many things. So at that time, if his intercession is received, it immediately becomes a full ember. And from here, he gets elevated. So for everyone to think that after death we will go straight... there are many valleys in between. We stop, we can't go, these things happen. But if by Allah's grace... why do we make supplications? Intercession of Allah... that Allah may include the deceased in the group of the Prophet and the progeny of Muhammad. So that he may get elevated from here. So this elevation is... these things are taken away, and his deliverance (*rustgārī*) is through this. If not, then he gets stuck. He gets stuck.

This is to be known. And the *ṣūrat-e-rūḥānī*... see, we have one... "O Allah, marry me to the *ḥūr al-ʿīn* (fair-eyed maidens of paradise)." So, *ḥūr al-ʿīn*... *ḥūr al-ʿīn* is famous, it's a common discussion that there are *ḥūr al-ʿīn*. Men will get *ḥūr*. What will women get? Women will get men. So the word *ghilmān* (youths) has come. But the real matter is that *ḥūr al-ʿīn* is your *ṣūrat-e-rūḥānī*. That you... at the time of death, if you are made to feel by Allah that look, this is your final... this is the situation. This is your progress. To meet the *ḥūr al-ʿīn* is to see the *ṣūrat-e-rūḥānī*. And in that... then there are other things. That at the last moment, which forms are seen? Mawlana Ali will be seen. The Prophet will be seen. The Imam of every era will be seen. And he who is beneficial to you, or who has taught you. Meaning, the *ḥadd-e-ʿālī*. The forms of all these will be seen then. And from that, the person feels joy. At the time of death, the radiance that comes on the face is because he sees all these things. And in it, a little bit of *nāmiyah* is remaining. That *nāmiyah* has been close to the *ḥissiyyah*. So there is a little bit of sense (*ḥiss*) as well. Understand? The *ḥiss* leaves. The *ḥissiyyah* leaves. But for someone, it is possible that the *ḥissiyyah* also remains. There are such people who are very deficient in their deeds. That remains. So the *ḥissiyyah* and *nāmiyah* are a little bit together. So there, the things of sense and growth both remain. So for them, at that time, these things...

Anyway, this *nāṣūṭ* and *lāhūṭ*... what is *nāṣūṭ-e-ẓillī*, what is *nāṣūṭ-e-ṭabīʿī*, there is *nāṣūṭ-e-khāṣṣ*, *nāṣūṭ-e-kullī* is higher than that. And then there are *lawāḥid*. *Lawāḥid* are different. If, for example, it is *nāṣūṭ-e-ẓillī*, you are believers, so it is in the account of believers. You who are *ḥudūd* of a high rank, the *duʿāt* etc., they are... they will go with the *ẓillī*. And the people there who are *duʿāt*, the *ḥuḍarāt*, they are in the *nāṣūṭ-e-khāṣṣ*. So according to that, your *ṣūrat* also has different measures. The *ṣūrat* of each one is not on one level. The *ṣūrat-e-rūḥānī*. That is why the *ṣūrat* of the *Muqaddasīn* (the sanctified ones) is what we... that their... Now if we talk about the *ṣūrat* of every believer... what was the *ṣūrat*? So, *muqaddasīn* means people of high rank, we talk about them. So if you look at it from that perspective, then there are different levels in *lāhūṭ* as well. They became *lawāḥid*. They became *lawāḥid*. Now listen, this is the last point. *Lawāḥid* means that some are such believers whose arrangement of *lāhūṭ* happened on the scale of *sharīʿat* (exoteric law). He just read the *sharīʿat* and died. He prayed, and it was over. No reading or writing anything. He kept doing deeds. There was no study or anything. Some are such that they studied a little *ta'wīl*, this and that, and it was over. After that they... Some studied some *ḥaqā'iq*. So there, *lāhūṭ* is also separate for *sharīʿat*, separate for *ta'wīl*, and separate for *ḥaqā'iq*. This is a very deep matter. It is not told to everyone. I am telling you because it is... this also happens. So they are of different types.

A question was asked... yes. Yesterday, I was coming... a question has come. What is the difference between Hu and Allah? What is the difference? The question is: what is the difference between Hu and Allah? Please explain this. Hu is... that is the level where Parwardigar-e 'Alam (Lord of the Worlds) created the ruhaniyat (spiritual beings).
