Yesterday, there was a mention of the world of intellects (*'alam-e-'aql*) and the world of the soul (*'alam-e-ruh*, spiritual). That the expanse of the spiritual world is from the First Intellect (*'aql-e-awwal*) to the Tenth Intellect (*'aql-e-'ashir*). This is called the spiritual world. And if we go below that, that is, after *Tabu bi-tawbatihi* and *Labbu 'l-nida'*, then the world of life (*'alam-e-hayat*) begins. As I told you yesterday, the spiritual world is a separate thing, then there is the world of life, then the world of the body (*'alam-e-jibra'il*), and then the world of the physical body (*'alam-e-jism*) in which we are sitting. So it's not that we think there's a spiritual world and a physical world. That's not it, there are three or four levels, and different things are contained in them.

Now, have a little conception, you see, of the spiritual world, which is the Tenth Intellect. The moment he repented, when he was told that his mistake was this, he at once repented. *Taba wa anaba*. His mistake, it was pointed out to him that your illusion (*wahm*) and supposition (*guman*) was that I and you, that is, my companion, are equal, that is, the first and second *munba'ith* are equal, and for this reason, you... and you, were considered at fault and you stopped. When he accepted this, he repented at that very moment, *taba wa anaba*, and reached the station of the Tenth Intellect. These are the ten intellects. And with every intellect, with every intellect, there are countless essences (*zawat*). And the number of their army, no one knows except God. How many are with the seventh intellect, how many with the third, how many with the fourth. Only one sketch is given to us by the First Intellect, that is the circle of oneness (*da'irah wahdah*). He is a single individual. There, the circle is such that there are no individuals. The first *munba'ith*, there too the circle is contracted. He is alone, at the end of the end. And after that, the seven intellects that have formed, there are countless essences in them, and no one knows their number.

But it is stated that the largest of them, the group, the disobedient one, was with the Tenth Intellect. And in it, I had divided it, that *Tabu bi-tawbatihi*, the one who at that very moment, with his repentance, they also repented. *Tabu bi-tawbatihi*, that is, with the repentance of the Tenth Intellect, a group, meaning the entire army of 100%, out of that, 15% came out and after that, the *labbu 'l-nida'* came out. *Labbu 'l-nida'* and this have a difference, you see, that *tabu bi-tawbatihi* are those who saw him and did it. And *labbu 'l-nida'* are those who were invited and then they separated. And the third are the *kallamam*, who had a delay of the twinkling of an eye. A *twinkling of the eye*, there was a delay, and for that reason they were called *kallamam*. And in the future, when the chapters of doctrines open, in the very end, there are the stations of the *Imam-e-mustauda'* and the *Imam-e-mustaqarr*. What are the stations of the *Imam-e-mustaqarr*? There, all the *Imam-e-mustaqarr* are from the group of *kallamam*. There are *mustauda'* also, but the *Imam-e-mustaqarr* are, and I am not going into its details.

Now, the Tenth Intellect is the Adam of the spiritual world. And with them, at the time when *la nasma'u wa la nuti'* (we will not listen and we will not obey) was being cried out, Hazrat... Muqaddas says that there, one... the one who initiated it. The one who incited. When there is a commotion, there is one inciter for all the people. And he said, "Hey, don't accept." He who incited is Iblis, the spiritual Iblis. And the one who gave him the satanic quality (*shaytaniyyat*), the one who did the work of inciting, is Shaytan. So Shaytan and Iblis are separate. In this regard, Iblis is the one who, out of ignorance, said the word. And Shaytan is the one who is a rebellious instigator. And in that regard, in the future, when we go, with us, in the era of Muhammad, the first caliph is in the rank of Iblis, and the second caliph is the inciter, he is the real one, and he is Shaytan. The translation in books comes that Iblis is in the rank of the first, and the second is Shaytan.

Anyway, now, there, what happened? That Adam of the spiritual world, they repented, and with them, three groups came out. Now it happened that on God's part, as I told you, in them, density (*kathafat*) and darkness (*zulmat*) began to spread. So, with the first leap (*jast*), length (*lamba'i*) came into them. When length came, they became more terrified, and in the opposite direction, they ran. When they ran in the opposite direction, width (*'ard*) was created in them, breadth was created. And when they made the third leap, depth (*'umq*) came into them. When these three dimensions came, at that moment, they were not fit to live there, in the spiritual world. The command was given to them, "*Ahbitu*." (Descend!) That is, "fall down, go down." Just like the word from the Quran, "*Ahbitu*." When they were thrown, at that moment, one individual in it at once... agreed to accept. And with him, twelve separated and twenty-seven separated. Twelve and twenty-seven. He who is, he is Adam the Lesser (*Adam-e-Bida'*). And with him, twelve are the *naqib*s and twenty-seven are the *hujjat*s. These individuals also remained there, in the world of life, or rather, they went higher. So now, you see, if there was a report of the world of life, then I would have told you, that the map of the world of life is... where is this world of life? It is below the world of intellects. Below the Tenth Intellect. Now, there was no mention of "below" and "above" there, but to explain, one has to say this, that the world of life is below it. So in the world of life, what is there? There is the Spiritual Pillar (*Ta'ud al-Ruhani*), that is, the Spiritual Kaaba (*Ka'batullah al-Ruhani*), which we call the center (*markaz*), which we call the heart (*qalb*), that is the world of life. Center. And near it, there is the Pillar of Light (*'Umud al-Nur*). *'Umud* is what they call a pillar. Pillar. Now, all these essences... you see, the degree is decreasing. Now, at the time when this *la nasma'u wa la nuti'* was being cried out, and a disturbance was being created in the intentions of the people, *labbu 'l-nida'* and *kallamam* etc. had all gone up, after that, they were ordered to be thrown. You see, with the command of *ahbitu*, those who went up, they were the twenty-seven, twelve, and one. And after that, the one who... the whole rest of the group, at that time, with the execution of the command of *ahbitu*... when it was being executed upon them, at that time, a group agreed to accept. And they started to show regret, "Oh, we should have accepted." We accept. Our mistake. That regret, but what happened? The *du'at* say that they said this at a time when the execution had begun. They were being thrown out. They were not fit to live there. They are called the regretful and the forgiveness-seekers (*nadim wa mustaghfir*). And after that, the second, as was told, is the group of the insistent and the arrogant (*musirr wa mustakbir*). They were absolutely stubborn, "We will not accept. You go, do whatever you want." And the third, a group that was in the middle, it was the group of the doubtful and the bewildered (*shakk wa mutahayyir*). They were in doubt, "Hey, this group is saying this, the regretful ones, are they right or are they right? Whom should we support?" So now, the whole world, all the creation that we see, if you... as you look, there is a separate world of plants, a separate world of animals, which they call the animal world, or there is the world of minerals, and of humans. But if an 'alim, an 'alim looks, he will divide it this way, that the doubtful and bewildered are from the *musirr* and *mustakbir*, and these are the *nadimin*. So now, those from above, who are being thrown, the division was made by the eternal divider. On that day, the division was made on that day by the eternal divider. Each one was given what appeared to be its due. Each one was given according to its intention. And the *nadim*, they were of a high rank. They had accepted. Meaning, we Sulaymanis are from them. But in which group we are, that will come later. So we, who are the *nadimin*, they were given a place in the stars. In the world of *jirmani*. See, now two levels are left, two stages were mentioned. The world of life has happened, the world of the spiritual, that is, the higher intellect has happened. The world of *jirmani*, that will be called the area from the all-encompassing sphere to the surface of the moon. The moon is the final limit. *Qamar*. And above it are the seven planets. Above the planets is the sphere of constellations (*falak-e-buruj*). Above the sphere of constellations is the all-encompassing sphere (*falak-e-muhit*). And the all-encompassing sphere is the final limit of the physical. And above it is the world of life. So now, should this be called physical or *jirmani*? Its sections have been made again. That from the surface of the moon to the all-encompassing sphere, this is the world of *jirmani*. *Jirmani* because *jirm* is what they call... gems shine. Just as these are shining ones, meaning, the stars that are placed in the sky. So the *nadimin*, all of them... now see, the *nadimin*, all of them, from them this world of stars was made. What is this... when the creation was beginning. It has begun. These *nadimin*, from them the stars... above, the entire sky, the space, was made. And this lower part (*safrah*), that is, where we... what we call the earth, if we go to the very core of the earth, where its center is, there, up to there, the solids (*salabat*), that is, the rocks and whatever... diamond is there, these are all the things, this *safrah* is made from the *musirr* and *mustakbir*. All... the lower earth. The first earth and below it. This is from the *musirr* and *mustakbir*. Now the *shakk wa mutahayyirin*, from the sphere of the moon, here, up to the surface of the earth, they were placed. And how were they placed? Above, there is the sphere of fire, the sphere of air, the sphere of water, and the sphere of earth. In these, all the *shakk wa mutahayyirin* were shut in. They were placed. Now see that the *nadimin*, their intention, according to that, they were made shining. And the *musirr* and *mustakbir*, you see them, they are rocks and... solid, dark things. And the *shakk wa mutahayyirin*, who were in doubt, "Should we go here or there?" they were placed in the four spheres. Now you see, fire... the Messenger of God said, fire burns upwards. That is the nature of doubt. A person in doubt is consumed. He's always in turmoil. "Should I go there or here?" A state of anxiety, a state of doubt. So it is in fire. It is in air, with the cyclones, etc. It is in water, with the waves that rise. And here, with the dust storms that rise. These four spheres, in them, the *shakk wa mutahayyirin* consist. Now, from this, a change has come. As the world progresses further, a slight composition has taken place. As the beginning took place, I'm just giving a brief sketch. Now from there, when they were thrown... so what happened? The sun has its own station, the moon has its own station, Venus has its, Mercury has its, all these... the Great Administrator... now see, the Great Administrator is, as I'm telling you, it's like a master of a factory. The master has not even seen the factory. He is sitting in his own place. He is sitting. Who is running it? The General Manager is running it. So... the General Manager has also become so high that he is always in meetings, and he has appointed a manager. The manager sahib is also sitting in his office, and he has appointed someone as the in-charge. In the same way, here, the matter of the Tenth Intellect happened. The Tenth, whom we are calling, he has become elevated, and below him, his subordinate, the last individual of the *labbu 'l-nida'*, he is now the administrator of the world. And after that, there are other... they have gone further. Now the discourse is that the Adam of creation, who is in fact the Tenth Intellect. Now his plan is working. How to... "*Man kasara 'azmuhu fa-'alayhi jabruhu*." (He who breaks a bone, upon him is its mending.) The one who breaks the bone, he has to fix the bone. God Almighty's command was that you have broken everyone. Now you have to reform everyone. Now, to reform, the whole world has been created. For us... for our sake, crores of years have passed. But there, with God, there is no one day of the year. Not even a moment. And for years, the work is going on. Why? Because we, there, were luminous and *khuksani* essences. There, we made a mistake, that we also supported him. When the Tenth Intellect was not being accepted, we also did this. Now the *nadimin* are there, the *mutahayyirin* are there, or the *musirrin* are there, that is... a person himself should assess from which group he is, with that glasses, and then look at the whole world from that perspective, then you will understand what a Christian is, what a Parsi is, what a Hindu is, what we are, and those who are in the heavens, and on earth, the other things, the world of stars, from which group? Now see, this *nadimin*, we think this is one group. That's not it, it has fifteen groups. It has further sections. The *du'at* have explained this with great detail. In the book *Jam'u 'l-Muntazam*, when it is asked, it is explained. So there, one by one, the groups have been taken out. That the first group is this, the second is this, the third is this, the fourth is this, the whole fifteen are listed. And they... in the morning lesson, you would have read... the first *nadim* who is... In the morning's... the lesson we are reading, it has come that who is the first *nadim*? It's the all-encompassing sphere (*falak-e-muhit*).

The all-encompassing sphere is the most virtuous thing in the entire world. All the lower planets and also, below it, we who are there, that is, our... the believers are there, the infidels are there, the *ma'dhun* is there, the *da'i* is there, the *mukasir* is there, the *hujjat* is there, these are all the ranks. But the ranks that have been given in it, the first, second, third, all fifteen are explained in the lesson. Our work is not for them, it's a matter of the future. And after that, the *du'at* say that the *shakk wa mutahayyirin* that there are, their groups have been taken out. How many groups are there? Twenty groups. One, two, three, four, the numbers are written with the names. And the *musirr* and *mustakbir* that there are, they are divided into thirty-five groups. So 35, 20, and 15. This is, there are 70 groups. They are 70 groups. And Muqaddas has said that these 70... now you see, a *shakk wa mutahayyir*, if he is there, then in it, there will be one part which is the highest of all, and that will be the one who has the capacity to become *nadim*. The middle one. Or, say, the highest of the *musirr* and *mustakbir*, he will be similar to the lowest of the *mutahayyirin*. It will be like that, won't it? The three levels are there. So their highest will be that. So in this way, you take out a cream from within those 35, that which one is the highest of all, and is moving towards progress. And another, take out a cream from the *shakk wa mutahayyirin*. And another, take out a cream from the *nadimin*. So these three, the cream that will come out, so 70 and these three, 70... Now you see, the Prophet, the hadith he has given, and in the books of hadith it comes, and it is read out, that the Prophet's hadith, which is also... after the Holy Quran, is the third book, and it is not easily understood. Whoever reads the translation and thinks they have understood, that doesn't mean anything, its meaning is not there. The Prophet says, "After me, the community (*ummah*) will be divided into 73 sects." My community will be divided into 73 sects, and only one sect will be the one that attains salvation (*najat*). Now you tell me, today, have 73 sects been formed? You take it out and see, how many have been formed. Shia, Sunni, so-and-so, this... there are more than a hundred. So the Prophet's hadith, did you falsify it? What will you say? The Prophet's indication was not towards this, but these sects that are in the world, the 70 into which they are divided, their one-one... take out one-one... and they become three more, and 70 and three become 73. And in that, the correct, upper part of the *nadimin*, that is the one that will leave this world. It will have real salvation. What salvation we will get is that we will go one rank higher. One step higher. But the real one who will attain salvation, that is a matter of the future, and that is the most virtuous part of the *nadimin*. And what is that most virtuous part? It is the all-encompassing sphere. So the all-encompassing sphere... now you have understood that all the stars, the planets, it is below the seventh *qamar*, above the *qamar* is 'Utarid, above 'Utarid is Zuhra, above Zuhra is Shams, above Shams is Mirrikh, above Mirrikh is Mushtari, above Mushtari is Zuhal. These seven are called planets. And its... this is the solar system, and it is related to us. Today, science is discovering eight, nine stars, it has no relation with us. For us, what is related to the system of life, the system of *da'wah*, is these seven planets. These seven planets are effective. Now for 90 years... in the lessons of the *du'at*, it is explained... seven *da'im* prophets came, seven *mutaqq* prophets came, seven seas, seven this, seven that. In various places, the mention of seven has come, that is why it has been kept. So these are the seven planets. And above the seventh, Zuhal, there is a sphere of constellations (*falak-e-buruj*). The sphere of constellations is that which has been divided into 12 parts. And this is what we call the Zodiac. Those who read palms or their birth charts, etc., which month it is, when is your birth, based on that, the zodiac sign is taken out, all that is within the Zodiac. And that is... so its every section is a constellation (*burj*), and the whole sphere is called the sphere of constellations. This is the eighth from the bottom, the second from the top. And above this, at the very top, is the all-encompassing sphere which has covered everything. Now at the time when that all-encompassing sphere... by God's will, when the creation of the world was to take place, that is, the beginning, at that time, the all-encompassing sphere moved. It made one revolution. One revolution of it makes several revolutions of the inner ones happen. And the sphere of *qamar* revolves... and the *qamar* is *qamar*, what is the sphere? So... you see, *qamar* is a planet. The place where it revolves, the orbit, is called the sphere. The place from which it emerges and it revolves, that is the sphere. So we are talking in terms of the spheres (*aflak*). That from the all-encompassing sphere, down to here, there are nine spheres. And these are the nine months in which the creation of a child takes place. Seven are of the planets, and two are above. In nine months, the child is fully formed. This whole system is all God's. Everything is prescribed, a whole... in a sense, it's computerized. What will happen in the first month, what in the second, what in the third. Yesterday, I told you, and its exegesis, Inshallah, will come later and there will be more discourses on it. So anyway, this... the group of the *nadimin* is the one that was placed in the heavens. After that, in the spheres, the *mutahayyirin* were placed. And below it, this lower earth, or the solids that are there, in that, all the *musirrin* were placed. When this happened, then neither was there Adam, nor the progeny of Adam. No human had this form. All this was, in the form of a ball, it was thrown down, *ahbitu*. In the form of a ball, it came down. Now after coming here, then the forms of minerals, plants, animals, etc., were given to them. How were they given? That now, as I told in the morning's lesson, and in it, Inshallah, I will explain it further. Now just two or four things are about the world of life, that in the world of life, the Kaaba that is there, the Spiritual Kaaba, in it, these... when we were falling, that is, the *nadimin*, at that time, we showed regret, "Hey, we accept." So this regret was liked by God. It was pleasing. "They are regretful." You see, regret. The one who sins, he is regretful. So that regret, our... our leaven of regret. Leaven is what they call, that a small piece of it, you put it in the milk, and the whole thing becomes yogurt. The leaven, a small piece that was there, our leaven of regret, that leaven was deposited there, in the Spiritual Kaaba. Which is called *ta'ud*. *Ta'ud*, or the Spiritual Kaaba, or the center, or the heart, or the world of life, it was placed there. And next to it, there is another thing in the form of a pillar, where our rational souls (*nufus-e-natiqah*) are. All of us believers who are coming, our rational souls are attached there. To the Pillar of Light. Like a pillar... around it. Why? Because we had shown regret. That is why we have come as Sulaymani. We have come as children of Sulaymanis, as grandchildren, and this chain is continuing. And since when is it continuing? You have no idea, the moment your eyes close, then again, when they open, you will find yourself in the same place. But God Almighty knows that this chain is continuing. When will it end? When will the door close? When will the next door open? The whole account is clearly laid out. So see, our regret is there...

So we are better than others, and better than many. What does “many” mean? The *nāzimīn* are in a rank that is better than us. We are one of them. And which one are we? That is a separate matter, as to where our seat is, which of the fifteen we are, what our number is. So remember this, that all the groups in the world that have been formed – the Parsis and Hindus and all these that are mixed in it, the *mushrikīn* who are there, and the groups of *kuffār*, and the *ahl al-taslīs* – some are *mutāhirīn*, some belong to this, so wherever there are *mutāhirīn*, it is much better to take from them, because you can eat *ḥalāl* food from their hand. You can eat meat from their hand. This is what it is. If they are neighbors, then take care of them. This and that. All these various obligations come from this connection. In any case, it is that the *musirrīn*, who were the insistent ones, where the group was falling from above, at that time we came as per the will of God, this very thing happened, and from there, when we were thrown down, we were a *nūrānī* and *rūḥānī* *jamā'at*. We were completely pure, luminous, *ṣāfī*, and spiritual. From there we were thrown down, and just as a cannonball is launched with great force, and there are known things in artillery, that one has to shoot it… it was thrown. It fell from above, and after coming down here, we were scattered into different things. We were divided into different things. So now, you should look at the whole world from that perspective, that today this whole world is seeing that what is the matter that a tree grows, one tree of a certain type gives its fruit, and the other tree dies. Or there are animals, one animal dies, another starts giving milk. Everywhere, something or the other is happening. What is this thing after all? What system is at work? So if you reflect with a cool mind, you will realize that there is a superpower. There is a single being who is running this system. And that same one is the *Khāliq-i 'Ālam* (Creator of the Universe), the same one is the *Mudabbir-i 'Ālam* (Governor of the Universe), who is running all this. And a talk has already been held about this, that *'Aql-i 'Āshir* is our town planner, he is the one who created the entire world. And how did he do it? Where they were falling, there was an intention from them. When you make a building, any thing, first there is sketching, first its map is made. In their thought, first it came into thought and then it was drawn on paper. From there, where this matter came into the mind of the great one, that now… `man kasara 'aẓman fa 'alayhi jabruhu` (he who breaks a bone, it is upon him to mend it). That due to their mistake, all the people have to suffer, so a command came from God Almighty that you are the one who has spoiled them, and now you must… `man kasara 'aẓman fa 'alayhi jabruhu` (he who breaks a bone, it is upon him to mend it). The one who breaks the bone, it is incumbent upon him to join it. He thought, what planning should I do, in what way should I establish a system so that from here, the world turns back and then returns to the spiritual realm. So for this, in this, the intentions that were made, one of them was the first intention that the celestial spheres (*aflāk*) should be made to revolve. This revolution of the celestial sphere started the cycle. From that, the cycle of day and night began, and from that same, months and days and years were formed. The second thing is that this thought came to their mind, that *Lāhūt* and *Nāsūt* are two, two methods through which I will make man progress from here. The third thing is that man, who stands on two feet, as we are standing, this man will progress in the form of a human only, not as an animal or an angel. He is *Ashraf al-Makhlūqāt* (the noblest of creations), and in this very way we will move forward. This is the highest weapon. Among minerals, plants, and animals, he is called *ḥaywān-i nāṭiq* (the speaking animal). It is a branch of animal, but it is a speaking animal. In this way, the speaking animals that are seen all over the world, in comparison to them, we are the original *nāṭiq*. If they have received *nuṭq* (speech), then we have received *nāṭiqah* (the faculty of reason). Remember this, that however many are living as humanity, meaning they have been made human, they have… in comparison to animals, you see, the animal and the human, what is the difference? Nose, eye, ear, hand, foot, all these things, the parts of the body, are almost similar. There is a lack of one intellect. They have *quwwat-i tamīz* (the power of distinction), you have an excess of intellect. Now this, which is the thing that has been given to them, is that man has been given *nuṭq*. In comparison to an animal, a human has been given *nuṭq*. And *nuṭq* is now, you see, great scientists, great professors, they are... all people have been given *nuṭq*. And their intelligence, which is there, has been given based on intentions. They are very intelligent, they have done very great works, everyone in the world is doing them. But *nuṭq* has been given. No one has *nāṭiqah*, which is our thing. *Nāṭiqah* cannot be obtained by anyone until he comes into the *dā'irah* (circle) of *walāyah* (guardianship). This is that he should not become *halqa ba-gosh* (obedient) and accept the Imam of the time. So this, in whose destiny it is, from where it has come, he will come from there. If he comes from a different religion, he will leave that and come here. Many people have come to India, have come to you. And there are many who have left. They have turned back and left. Destiny, everyone has their own destiny. He was born in a Sulaymani home and left, went outside, into the home of a stranger. Girls have been brought, boys have also gone, everything has happened in every way. So what is this? The intentions we made in the world of spirits, the deeds that were done, the intentions that were made, there we have been appointed here. Anyway, it is that here now, from that perspective, you should see the world. This is a plant, this is an animal, this is all this. But this is the exoteric. In esoteric terms, according to rank, this is the plant section, this is the animal, this is what they see. But an *'ārif* sees it and says this is *shākir-i mutlaqīn*, this is *mustaqirrīn*, and this is *nāzimīn*. Whatever is higher, the stars that have been placed, the planets that have been placed, the suns and stars that have been made, the gems, that is what is called *nāzimīn* in esoteric terms. And all the spheres, the sphere of fire, one of water, of air, and of earth, that is, of soil, these four spheres, all the science of geology tells, the science of spheres tells, and this is what? It has been placed among the *shākir-i mutlaqīn*. And below it, the crust, which is the hard part of the earth, and below it, up to the Earth's core, there, all the *musirrīn* have been filled. Now when do they come out, when are they locked back in, this is like a prison, it is of this kind, and as it will be explained to you, which durations they have to serve, what kind of release they get, what their relationships are, where they have to go. In any case, the gaze of an *'ārif* sees this, that in these three parts, which things are divided. And *halāl* and *harām* is that very thing, that which is a nearby thing, that has come within human reach, it is valued, and the thing that has gone far away, its… just as we have, for *istinjā'*, use this thing, don't use that thing. So why? What calculation has been made for this? That all the Prophets who have brought a *dīn*, they have a system, they have a vision, they see which thing is suitable to clean this filth. It has come to be a human after millions of years. But some things are such that they are very close, so it has been stopped. No, this should not be used. A bone, a fruit pit, and these things that have been forbidden, they should not be used. In any case, these are small matters. The point I was making is that the *mu'min-i mustajīb* is the first level, when one accepts, he enters *īmān*. And after that, he keeps progressing, then he becomes a *mu'min*. Then there are ten levels. After that, he becomes a *kāshif*, from *kāshif* he becomes a *ma'dhūn*. There are two levels in *ma'dhūn*: *ma'dhūn-i maḥdūd* and *ma'dhūn-i muṭlaq*. *Ma'dhūn* means permitted. That is, one who has permission, who can conduct the *da'wah* in the islands, who are our representatives, delegates, that is a rank. *Ma'dhūn*. Higher than that is the rank of *dā'ī*. And the status of a *dā'ī* is so great that he has governance over three islands. Everything. And what kind of governance is this? This governance, I will tell you, that this governance is such that it is not political, like it is in the world today. Rather, they have *milkīyat* (ownership). I will tell you next time. They have *milkīyat*, by which they are made masters. And it goes further, that there are *tālī-i bāb*, then after *tālī-i bāb* is *ḥujjat*, after *ḥujjat* is *Bāb*. Then there are the four ranks of *Bābīyat*, then one reaches the rank of *Imāmat*. And above the Imam, then up to *Jussīyat*, there are many stages. There is *Imāmat-i Rūḥānī*, *Nuṭq-i Ilāhī*, and after that is *Hujjīyat*, *Hijābīyat*, *Kashfīyat*, *'Ādīyat*, *Samadīyat*, and after that is *Khiyālīyat*, *Fatrīyat*, *Jaddīyat*. Above *Jaddīyat* is *Qā'imīyat*. Above *Qā'imīyat* is *Jussīyat*. *Jussīyat* is the last point. This is the last link, after which the soul will leave the celestial sphere. Until then, you will keep revolving. All the great humans, great *dā'īs*, *ma'dhūns*, *kāshifs*, all of them are revolving, making their own progress. They are moving forward in their ranks. God knows how much has happened. So now you see that this is… we have to see in this light that we who have come as Sulaymanis, who have a special status. And you should always see that the entire population of the world, which is crores, our population of *da'wah*, if we include Najran and its surroundings, is less than four hundred thousand. It is not more than four hundred or five hundred thousand. Najran's population is about two to three hundred thousand people. The rest of the world, you can see. We are three to four hundred thousand in total. How many are we? We are not even equal to the salt in flour. But that same salt gives flavor to the flour. So you, in that sense, our community, who we are, the Sulaymanis, this is the real essence of the world. And why is it the essence? Because the Prophet's *dīn*, the divine constitution that you have brought, the constitution of life that you have brought, the *Da'aim al-Islam* that you have brought, we are the only true followers of it. Now you ask that this is… apart from this, they also have the *fiqh*, so-and-so also has the *fiqh*, the Sunnis also have the *fiqh*, the Shias also have it. There are many great *mujtahids*, great scholars, professors, and such. Everything is there, but if you look, just like our body, the body is great and performs great functions, it sees, hears, eats, performs actions and so on. As soon as the soul leaves, it is of no use. They take it and immediately, the father buries his son, the son buries his father, that it shouldn't be kept even for a day, bury it quickly. Why? Because the essential thing has left. So the soul is the essential thing. In the same way, among all the religions, the entire soul is the love of *Amīr al-Mu'minīn*. If someone does not have the love of Mawlana Ali in his heart, he is neither a Sulaymani nor is he on the path of truth. The first and most obligatory thing is the *walāyah* of *Amīr al-Mu'minīn*. All the *namāz*, *roza*, *ḥajj*, *zakāt*, *ṭahārat*, and *jihād*, all these pillars of religion that are there, the pillars of Islam, in them, the *walāyah* of *Amīr al-Mu'minīn* is both the first and the last. If that is not there, then nothing is anything. So just remember that the station of Hazrat Ali, I will slowly tell you, as many people already know, but many who are new, I have to tell them too, what is the position of Hazrat Ali? You, regarding the caliphate, you have heard only a little bit, many things. I will explain the fundamental matter so that you can compare, that today when you... for example, great people, if ten liars speak against one truthful person, the ten liars cannot defeat the truth. Their words have no truth in them, and the truthful one is truthful. Even if there is only one. So it is the same example, that today, the world of Islam, the Sunni sect, the Shia sect, those people who hold their beliefs, even if they are very large in quantity, they are small in quality. They do not have the system of life, the system of death and life, and besides that, the foundation of their *dīn* is wrong. The foundation of *dīn*. And you all know what the foundation of *dīn* is, that the Prophet established Islam on a great platform, for such people who were ignorant, *jāhil-i muṭlaq*. And the history of the Arabs is there, that they used to bury their daughters alive, and they used to drink wine in this skullcap. In such a bad environment, if you read the history of Islam before Islam, the era of ignorance was such that these kinds of customs were there. He gradually, gradually, gradually brought them onto a great platform, that you bring Islam, and believe in God. At your hands were Abu Jahl, Abu Lahab, and Abu Sufyan and other such harsh people. So you said that I cannot leave this. All the people came to you and said, "We will give you so much wealth, we will make you the king here, we will give you so many women, we will give you all things. You just leave this *kalima*." `Lā ilāha illallāh` (There is no god but Allah). We worship other gods, you can also worship your god. This is it. You said, "No." `Lā ilāha illallāh`. Tell them there is no god. There is no god until... there is a negation, then there will be an affirmation. And you said that if they put the sun in one of my hands and the moon in the other, even then I will not leave this path. With great difficulty, with great effort, you established this mission. And on a great platform, he brought all such people. And after that, the world continued. But the real station begins at Ghadir Khumm, when you made *Haydar-i Karrār*, *Mawla 'Ali Murtaḍā*, your successor. From there, the circle of faith begins. There is a big difference between Islam and *Īmān*. Every Muslim is not a *mu'min*, and every *mu'min* is a Muslim. You should know this. So we, Alhamdulillah, we are also *mu'min*, and because we are in the circle of *Īmān*, and we also accept the Prophet's Islam. `Ashhadu an lā ilāha illallāh` and `wa Muhammadur Rasūlullāh`, we recite both. And this recitation is a proof that we, in this way, are truthful. Our Prophet is the verifier of all the prophets. Isa, Musa, and whatever, Daniyal, Yahya, Musa, Samud, Lut, however many are named in the Bible, we say *'alayhi al-salām* (peace be upon him) to all of them. We say *'alayhi al-salām*. But we do not follow anyone except the Prophet. We follow, that is, we are in the *ummah* of Janab Muhammad Mustafa. We consider him our Prophet. Now see, when you talk to Christians, they do not accept our Prophet. We accept their Prophet. But we do not follow them in this way, that their time is over. God gave them a period of 600 years, there the era of Janab Isa ended, and the era of the Prophet began. In this way, Isa, if you say that why don't you follow our Isa, then you, why do you follow Musa? Musa also brought a great shari'ah, he brought the Torah. When the era of Musa ended, Janab Isa, superseding it, brought his own shari'ah. In the same way, the Prophet, superseding all the shari'ahs, brought a new shari'ah, and such a comprehensive shari'ah that until the Day of Judgment, it will not be changed, nor will any part of it be subject to change. Today, scholars, great people, ulama, fuḍalā, whoever they are, they bring up issues in this. This is a flaw, this is a small thing that if it changes, Islam will be ruined. In the matter of divorce, in the matter of shari'ah, in the matter of 'iddah, in the matter of inheritance, they find a fault in everything. This is only a flaw of the mind. It is a flaw of our mind. That we have not been given that much training, but we are looking at the higher thing. The Prophet, `i'tirāḍ barā-yi i'tirāḍ`. I had mentioned in the sermon before this that *Da'aim al-Islam* is our constitution book. In reading *Da'aim al-Islam*, which thing should we focus on correctly? That we have to learn this, not to do `i'tirāḍ barā-yi i'tirāḍ` (criticism for the sake of criticism), that who wrote *Da'aim al-Islam*, to examine it, or say that we are reading this to see what he is saying. They are saying, on this basis, we will see, in Christianity it is like this, what do you have? Compare and see. This comparison, this is all `i'tirāḍ barā-yi i'trāḍ`, this is all, all the angles are wrong angles. The correct angle should be that you read *Da'aim al-Islam* with sincerity that I will follow this. If you are appointed, then you should accept it in the same way. And after that, your progress will happen, and you will leave the circle of Islam and enter the circle of *Īmān*. When we become Sulaymanis and come into Sulaymaniyyat, then after that, what are the steps of progress? The progress is that your life here, how long is your life? Those who are 30-40 years old have passed, and there are more. 50, 60 years, 70 years, 80 years. After 80 years, you yourself wish to die, rather than getting caught up in the entanglements of old age. It is better to go than to live. The world that I am seeing, there are many old people, you ask them, they say, what has the world become, our childhood was like this. That's how it is. So the standard of life is 70-80 years, which is nothing. The eternal life which is ours after death, now you have to strive for that, to know that. You go to any other religion and ask, to Musa's shari'ah, that is, ask the Jews. There are great bishops sitting. Or ask the Christians, or ask the Pandits, or the priests who are there, ask them, that after all, what happens after death? Why does death come? How does the body go and how does the soul go? Where do we go? Why did we come here? We came here, and why did we live? And why were we brought at the time of going? Why were we brought to be given a send-off? At the time of coming, we came crying. And the world, everyone was laughing. We were crying, the world was laughing, happy that you have been born. And now when you are going, the world is crying, you are going laughing. So we, this is the theory of the world, that to settle in the world, to live, everything, every single minute detail is already prescribed, it is prescribed for your body. Only the rope of choice is in our hands, that how we become. Do we accept or not? Those who do not, they have become very big caliphs, big muftis, big rulers, big ministers. But we have no respect for them until they come into Sulaymaniyyat. And this is what I have told you, that the Prophet said that… `hattā yalija al-jamalu fī samm al-khiyāṭ` (until the camel passes through the eye of the needle). This is when it is said that it is impossible. Until a camel passes through the eye of a needle. A camel is, that it passes through the eye of a needle, that is a special thing, and what was that? I have mentioned this in the sermon before this, that a camel, it is not possible that it can pass through the eye of a needle. But it will have to pass. That is, all of humanity that we are seeing from heaven to earth, they will have to come to this very place and make progress. First, they will become human, all the minerals, plants, animals, and after becoming human, after coming to this form, this invitation will be presented to them. Here, after coming here only, from here… this is the eye of the needle, the `'Urwat al-Wuthqā` (the firmest handhold), this is the needle’s eye, one must pass through it to reach there. In any case, it is that we, as you see the ranks, from *mustajīb* to *Imam*, there are ten ranks. And in one sense, there are seven ranks. We complete the seven ranks and what happens? Our soul also progresses, our body also progresses. We take both the exoteric and the esoteric along. There are many groups in the world that are only exoteric. Some are such that they are esotericists. We take both the esoteric and the exoteric. Because we have both a body and a soul. The soul is that which is esoteric, the body is that which is exoteric. So how can we do it? If your soul leaves, you become a corpse. All these that you are seeing today, they have the soul of *īmān* gone, they are just walking with their physical bodies. Those who say "Islam, Islam," they do not have the real soul. They do not have the *walāyah* of *Amīr al-Mu'minīn*. Therefore, all of them have their souls gone from inside. They just have the *kalima* `Lā ilāha illallāh` on their lips and they have become Muslims. So to be a Muslim is one thing, to be a *mu'min* of *īmān* is another. This is the difference between a *mu'min* and a Muslim that I am telling you. Now see, this is the progress. Today, as we have seen, that this is our life which is passing. But a time comes when our end comes. Death comes. Now death, this is no small thing. You see, people about death… they do, that death, oh my, what a disaster death is. This is that people fear death, they are terrified of it. Hazrat Da'i Sahib once, some ladies from Hyderabad came and said, "Hazrat Sahib, tell us something about death." He said, "I am ill, I cannot speak much." They insisted, "No, just say a little something about death." He said, "I will tell you one sentence. People fear death. Everyone fears it." And it is a reality. `al-mawtu ḥaqqun` (death is a reality). So now you see that if any person is told that you are going to be finished tomorrow, now see… let alone tomorrow, I say you are going to be finished today. If he is told that he will be finished tomorrow, that his death will come tomorrow, then half of his life will leave him today. Half of his life will leave him. But this is a strange blessing of God. If, during that time, the person in front of him says, "You are not the only one dying, we are all going to be finished in this group," then the half-life that had gone, it will come back. "Oh, I am not alone, everyone is going." So this is the contentment of this life of ours, that we see death as a `rayḥān al-mawt`, not `bayān al-mawt`. It is a fragrance. For us, it is a sweet thing. For a *mu'min*, it is a very sweet thing. For an unbeliever, it is bad. And why is it bad? Because their whole life is bad, and after death is also bad. So the badness after death, I will explain it in four or eight lessons, but for you, I will briefly explain… I will begin the topic of the *jism-i mu'min*. *Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim*. See, our… our body, you yourself can understand that it is made of *nāmiyāt*, genetics, and in this body, there is bone, there is blood, all things are there, and from this, a whole structure is made, and it is called a human. But this is that just as a machine, running and running, gets worn out, in the same way, a human, by God's decree, it is decided how long his period is. There is a specific period. The period of everyone is appointed. Although I have told you about the lifespan, that there is a specific part of life in which death occurs. But that it goes back and forth, someone dies at 25, someone at 75, someone at 100, these different ones that are there, what do they mean? Its meaning will also come gradually. Now see that we, who are born with a human body, you are not just the body. You have a heart that is ordering you to lift a thing, to move it, to act. So what is the heart? The heart is also a lump of flesh. Today science says that it is a pumping thing. So you, there is some other thing as well that is animating it, and what is that? It is our soul. Now the soul, you go and ask, ask the Sunnis, ask the Shias, whoever you ask, they will not be able to tell you where it resides, what it is, and how much it is, and whether it is one or two or four, what is it? So the one telling will tell you, or not, that is not known. You go and ask. We have been told that the soul is divided into three parts. Three types of souls we have that are given to a *mu'min*. And what are they? There is *nafs-i nāmiyah*, *ḥissīyah*, and *nāṭiqah*. This is a special kind of power. *Quwwat-i nāmiyah*, *quwwat-i ḥissīyah*, and *quwwat-i nāṭiqah*, these three things. I have already mentioned *nāṭiqah*, that this is what one gets at the time of the *'ahd* from the *ahl-i 'ahd*. There is an attachment that happens when we take the covenant. In any case, I am telling you that besides this, we also have a body. And the body is subservient to our soul. As the soul desires, we do that. To pray, not to pray, to fast, not to do this, we do it. So the body also endures hardship. The scale is also true, the bridge is also true, and death is also true, hell is also true, paradise is also true. To acknowledge all these things, this is the name of *īmān*. You are in the levels of *īmān*, so Inshallah, I will explain a little more when the next sermons are there. Inshallah, tomorrow there will be a sermon. *Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim*... ...Lesson seven. ...[prayer recited] The previous lesson's topic was the *jism-i mu'min* (body of a believer). As a recap, we are not one, but three: *nāmiyah*, *ḥissīyah*, and *nāṭiqah*. *Naḥnu* (We) refers to these three. *Nāṭiqah* is our deposited essence in the spiritual world, which we receive upon our spiritual birth. Besides this, there is *ḥissīyah* (which we call our "self") and *nāmiyah*. The body also exists. The body is rewarded after death, not punished. We are confident of our reward because we are attached to the *Ḥabl Allāh al-Matīn* (the strong rope of God). He explains the continuous chain of Imams, one after another, father to son, a *sunnah* (practice) of God that will never change (`lan tajida li sunnatillāhi tabdīlā`) or be altered (`lan tajida li sunnatillāhi taḥwīlā`). He gives a detailed exegesis of the verse about the two seas meeting (`maraj al-baḥrayni yaltaqiyān`), identifying them as the chains of Prophethood and Imamat. They met at the marriage of Ali and Fatimah. From them came forth the pearl and coral (`yakhruju minhumā al-lu'lu' wa al-marjān`), who are Mawlana Hasan and Mawlana Husayn. The Prophet's hadith: "Hasan and Husayn are two rightful Imams, whether they rise or sit, and their father is better than both of them." He explains how Hasan "sat" (made a truce) and Husayn "rose" (in Karbala). Their father, Ali, is superior to both. He asks what makes Ali superior. It is his status as *Wasī* (successor) to the Prophet. The Imamat started with Hasan. He returns to the main topic of the lesson. The *fuḍlāt*. He draws a diagram of the body of a believer. The body will progress, but it is a solid object that cannot enter the spiritual world. It must change its form. He uses the analogy of ice melting into water, then into steam (gas). Similarly, our body, through acts of worship (*riyāḍat*), is heated by the fire of *īmān*. The heart is the leader of the body's organs. He describes the heart's chambers (*tajāwīf*) and the scarlet blood (*dam-i sarwīzī*) surrounding it, which is our life force. This is a liquid form. When this blood circulates rapidly, it produces vapors (*bukharāt*), which is the *ḥarārat-i gharīzī* (innate heat). This is our *jān* (life). When this heat leaves the palms, the person is dead. So, the *ḥarārat-i gharīzī* is in a gaseous form and is more capable of becoming spiritual than the solid body. It is the next stage of progress.

A spark that falls on a coal… you see how it falls. And that spark, if you make it... if you blow on it... it will become an ember and a flame. This is our system. And from this, it... the light is born.

Anyway, this... this is our system of da'wat (mission). The next topic will also come up in my speech.

Now, there, when Allah's plan was that the world should be adorned so that the purpose of creation, which is mankind, who should... so that he should be created. Then `'Aql-e-'Ashir` (the Tenth Intellect)... as soon as it came to `'Aql-e-'Ashir`, you will have understood that just as you have understood about Allah that what is `Tawhid-e-Rabb al-'Izzat` (the Oneness of the Lord of Honor), in the same way, you have also understood about `'Aql-e-'Ashir`, that our final boss will be our `'Aql-e-'Ashir`. Now, the plan of `'Aql-e-'Ashir` was to adorn the world in such a way, to do this, that then mankind would come into being and... this all, these are all its effects.

Here is our first... as many as... these seven planets, they have special `mudabbirin` (governors/planners). By `mudabbirin`, it is meant that, look... we, whom we consider a `sayyara` (planet)... that there is the moon (`qamar`). The moon's surface, the outer surface that we are seeing, this we call `sadaf`. We call it `sadaf`. Mother of pearl. What is visible. Inside it, and further inside, are its `lata'if` (subtleties). `Lata'if`. Today, science is saying that inside it there is helium gas, and such-and-such gas is present, this is there... all these are the `lata'if` that are in between. And in between that is the center point, which is... that center (`markaz`) which is... that is `ruhaniyyat` (spirituality). Its switchboard is that. From there, the `tadbir` (planning/providence) begins.

So, those `mudabbirin` are... there is one `mudabbir` for each planet. Now, Allah's plan was that these very ones... just as it happens in a class... the class teacher goes away, another teacher comes. The teacher goes out, he says, "Who... who..." two children who are... the whole class knows that they will take charge. So just as... in the same way, here, the first `sardari` (leadership) was given... to `falak-e-Zuhal` (the sphere of Saturn). Zuhal (Saturn) was told to cast its `ta'thir` (influence) upon the world. It is Allah's will, but the `tadbir` is being done by `'Aql-e-'Ashir`.

A `murabbi` (guardian/guide) was made, first `falak-e-Zuhal`. You know about Zuhal's `tadbir`, that Zuhal is a harsh star, and it is number one among the `nahsayn` (the two inauspicious ones). What are the `nahsayn` called? Among the stars, there are types. Two are `sa'dayn` (the two auspicious ones), two are `nayyirayn` (the two luminaries), and two are `nahsayn`. Mirrikh (Mars) and Mars... Zuhal. These two are counted as bad stars, their influence is bad, so they are called `nahsayn`. And the two `sa'dayn` are `Zahra` (Venus) and `Mushtari` (Jupiter). And the two `nayyirayn` are the moon and the sun. And one, `'Utarid` (Mercury), is left, the seventh, which is called `munshi-e-falak` (scribe of the sphere), it has its own separate system.

Each one has a different `ta'thir`. So the first `ta'thir` was that of Zuhal, and Zuhal began to cast its things from above. So how? Through that `ta'thir`, what happened was that the entire world was covered in ice. The whole world was covered with ice. He says that there was so much cold and so much harshness that all was covered with ice... the whole world. Now, how was this `sardari` given? Look, Zuhal was given `sardari` for 1000 years. In many books it is said that 1000 years were given to Zuhal individually. After that, in the second thousand years, Zuhal was joined with Mushtari. In the third thousand years, Zuhal was joined with Mirrikh. In the fourth thousand years, Zuhal was joined with the sun, with Aftab. In this way, 7000 years passed. This is called the `dawr` (era) of Zuhal, `dawr-e-Zuhal`. So Zuhal is bad anyway. Where Mirrikh was joined with it, it became even worse. And where the sun or Zahra is, there is a combination of good and bad, and things become separate. So in the first thousand years, the entire world was completely covered with ice. Then the `dawr` of Mushtari came, and in that `dawr`, in that whole thousand years, the ice began to melt. And the whole thing melted, then it became level. In the third thousand years, Mirrikh came again. Mirrikh and Zuhal, both are `nahs` (inauspicious) stars, and a great mist descended upon the whole world, and the whole thing was covered. Then when it was the turn of Shams (the sun)... Shams... its time... Shams is a good `sayyara`, and in its time, various things began to appear. Now look, this is a very detailed... I am not going into the details, I am just giving a hint. That... the matter of humans has not come up yet. First, `jamadat` (minerals), `nabatat` (plants), and `haywanat` (animals) have to be formed. First the world has to be adorned, then the resident will come. First the house (`makan`) is adorned, then Hazrat Insan comes. So... there... the things that are... this surface that is, the surface of the earth, in it, in the time of Zuhal and in the time of Mirrikh, potash was formed. And all these things... from which bombs are made... sodium, and this is... its mines were prepared. In their time. And in the time of Mushtari, good things were prepared from them. This is a very long detail, in which time gold was made, in which time silver was made, in which time this... all the mines. And just as it happened in the `ma'dan` (mineral kingdom), in the same way it happened in the `nabat` (plant kingdom) too. In the `nabat`, first greenery appeared in it. During Zuhal, etc., thorny bushes, thorny plants, their thorns, they were created. And then after that, in the time of Mushtari, greenery and small vegetables etc. were created. And after that, growing and growing, in the time of the sun, good things were created. So... there is a whole book on this, `Tuhfat al-Qulub`, if you read it, you will know the full details, that in which era what things were created. So it happened in minerals, in animals, and this... in animals, which, which animals were created? Fruit-bearing trees, which were... in this era, these were created. Bushes are there, plants are there, animals are there, all the birds and beasts, when were they created? All these were being done. And for Hazrat Insan, the `khamire` (leavens/ferments) were being prepared. For mankind. In this way, 7000 years of Zuhal's era passed, 7000 of Mushtari, 7000 of Mirrikh with it, 7000 of this... 42,000 years passed. And this is the detail, this is the breakdown. After 42,000... now the final, the turn of the moon (`qamar`) came. When the moon's time of control came, then with the moon, this came, this came, this came... in the final years, in the thousand years... now, what was this? That in each of the moon's 7000-year periods, in every thousand years, the `khamire` started to be prepared. `Khamire` were being prepared in the world, that is, for your existence, those necessary things, the `sulale` (progenies/lineages) were being prepared. The `sulale` from which man is made, that was being prepared everywhere. It came into minerals and plants, and from there it changed rapidly and began its preparation to reach us. And when the final time of the moon came, at that time, the creation of man was decreed. Now, about the creation of man... it is said that, look... after all, a man is born from a man. Without that, how will it happen? So this matter that is being discussed, it is of the very beginning of creation. Before that, the world did not even exist. And it is in another book that `Kayumarth-e-A'zam`, the very first human who graced the world, his name was `Janus`. `Jussa-e-Ibda'iyya`. You will not understand `Jussa-e-Ibda'iyya`... `Kayumarth-e-A'zam`. So look, there are two ways of creation. Everywhere you look, the `kulliyat` (universals/principles) are different. This has a different `kulliya`, that has a different `kulliya`. Its application is on that... Malthus's theory is different, this theory is different. Similarly, it has been told to us that what we have been seeing... what is our memory? 100 years at most. What do you remember about the previous life? You have no memory. So now, the method is this: one is to be born from a mother's womb, which we are familiar with. The second method is that `khudda` (pits/cavities) were created in the earth, and humans were made from them. They were created from them. This is called `khudda`. `Khudda` means pits. And the shape of the pit is exactly like the `rahm` (womb) in a mother's belly. Exactly that shape. The shape that the `rahm` has, that shape was created. Now, in various places... the description that has to be given, it is of the Ka'ba. The most noble of the `khudda` were at the Ka'ba. Then at Madina-e-Munawwara. At Masjid al-Nabawi. In Jannat al-Baqi'. At Masjid al-Aqsa. In Jerusalem. All these venerable places that are counted today, they all have signs of the `khudda`. And that is why our head bows there, we go there... We do `tawaf`. So these, like a mother's womb, `khudda` were created there. Now how did the `madda` (matter) come into it? So look, there, all the... when the `ma'dan` (mineral) phase ended and it was transformed into the form of `nabat` (plant). How was it transformed? The `ma'dan`, until the earth is ground up and does not bow its head and come near the plant, it cannot become the plant's food. To become the food of the plant, the soil around it has to be completely soft. So that it can become its food. So until it is ground up... 'being ground up', remember this. 'Being ground up' means it bows its head. It then goes into the plant, that is, it moves forward on the path of progress. And the plant, until it becomes a tender shoot and bows down, the goat or halal (permissible) animal does not go near it. And that goat or the animal that we... through `zabiha`... that, until it bows and becomes ready for the knife at our feet, it does not become the food of man. Now that same thing, the animal, then becomes man's food. Now what happened here? That plant... came into the animal, and the `haywan`... `mahmuda` (praiseworthy) animals were created. Various kinds of animals. Now those animals... the `hudud` have described this in `Ganj al-Walad` etc. in high places. Those animals were `mahmuda` animals. The best... I mean, today's time is not like that, where one is eating this, one is eating that, now we see that the food is... the most noble were the `mahmuda` animals. And their death... there was no hunter. No one to slaughter them, no one to beat them. They died a natural death. After dying a natural death, `bukharat` (vapors/exhalations) rose from them. Those `bukharat` were the most noble `bukharat`. And they were the `tamhid` (prelude/preparation) for man to be created in the future. So how did they come? Those `bukharat`... these `khudda` that were there, they came and settled near the `khudda`. They came to the bottom (`penda`) of it. And after coming, the heat from the earth reached them. Just like if you put water in a vessel and heat it from below, steam starts to form and it starts to boil. That heat from the earth below reached it, and it went straight up and hit the roof of the pit. Then it became water. Now this water went up, it came down, it went up, it came down... He says that this happened many times. And this water was our body (`tan`). Just as a man's `mani` (semen) is, in that way this water became oily. How? It had the form of water, and an oily quality came into it. Stickiness came into it. And it got heat from below, and coolness from above. Where it got coolness from above, water would fall down from above. Then it got heat from below, it went up. This up and down motion, this fluctuation started, and becoming thicker and thicker, a stickiness came into it, and from it, the `surat-e-insani` (human form) was created. And when did this happen? When nine months, as we have here, when our nine months were complete, there the human `takhliq` (creation) happened inside the pit. It had no mother, no father. The pits themselves were its parents. There, the creation of man took place. And it has been said that... all the... I am telling about the creation at the Ka'ba. `Khudda` happened everywhere, but at the Ka'ba, the most noble `ruhani`... was given... there, 28 pits were made. And the 28 pits are... say that... how did they happen? ...the number 28 was everywhere, but the one we are describing, in those 28, one individual (`fard`) who was the very first, he was the `afzal-e-bashar` (most excellent of mankind). He is called `afzal-e-bashar`, he is `Jussa-e-Ibda'iyya`, he is `Kayumarth-e-A'zam`. The first individual of the whole world is called the most excellent person (`shakhs-e-fazil`). He was one. And with him were 27 others. So the count of 28 was complete. So how did it happen? 12, 12, and 3. And this count, remember, is with every Imam. Wherever the Imam's cabinet is, this is the count. So how? 12 will be one kind of `du'at`, 12 will be another kind of `da'i`, one will be a `mukasir`, one will be a `madh'un`, one will be a `Bab al-Abwab`. 24 and 3 is 27, and the Imam himself is 28. This structure has existed in the world from eternity (`azal`). And there's more above this, but let's leave that. That this structure was here, that one was there. So this count of 28 was completed. Now, it has been told here that this creation that happened... the form that was created, the man that was created, it was the entire male species (`mard-zat`). All 28... in the count... all of them were `mudhakkar` (masculine), men were created, women were not created. So in one pit, when one year passed over them... so how did the year pass? After all, they needed sustenance. Where would the sustenance come from? There was no one to take care of them, no one to look after them. That child, the naturally born child... I mean, at the beginning of the `dawr` (era), this kind of creation happens. I'll tell you this in the future, if Allah wills. So what happened to that child? He began to roll around in that same pit. The water that was left over became his food. Just as here, when a child is born, we first massage it with oil, and from its pores we provide it nourishment. Before that, we give these things. Just like that, he started rolling, and his nourishment happened there. When he became one year old... one year old, he was able to stand. And `du'at` say that that child... the naturally born child... it was not the child of weak parents. That naturally born child, because of that, his height was the same as our four-year-old child. 1 is to 4 ratio. Just as a one-year-old child here is not much, but a four-year-old child, whatever height he has, whatever strength he has, that is what happened to the first creation. And after that, what did he do? He came out of the pit. Now, hunger. There, it's not like with us where first milk is given, but when the age of milk is over, he will eat food. He came out. The whole world is adorned. There are figs, pomegranates, and all these things. So the fresh fruits, he started plucking and eating those fruits, and his nourishment was from that. Now from here... the creation of men happened. And after that, the water that was left in the pits remained there. Even after this happened, it remained. Now it is said that then again, the `khudda`... this is the second round (`nishist`). The second batch (`khep`) happened. And in it again, the same boiling (`ubal`) was created from below, and the water went up, down, up, down... and then the second form was created, and all of them were women. So in the first batch were men, and in the second were women. That is why it is... why are women considered weaker (`kamzor`)? Because their creation happened from the leftover water. `al-rijalu qawwamuna 'ala al-nisa'` (Men are the protectors and maintainers of women). The Qur'an says that `rijal` (men) are stronger (`qawi-tar`) than women. Why are they stronger than women? Because they were created from fresh water. And since women were created from the leftover water, they have a weakness and are called `nazuk` (delicate). After both were done, from these pits, 28 men were created, and then 28 women were created. 28 men were created there, 28 women here. They were created there, there... like this. This is the beginning of creation (`shuru'-e-afrinish`). Now after that, the men who were created from the pits, they went forward and married the women from the other pits. From here, the world's population began. Because these who were there, one who I am calling Imam, `Jussa-e-Ibda'iyya`, he was the Imam of the time. And his was the `tadbir` (plan). What kind of `tadbir`? The `dawr-e-kashf` (era of unveiling) began. Whenever the world has begun, it has begun with `kashf`. `Dawr, kawr, mawr`... this count will come up later. Insha'Allah, I will tell you, what the `dawr-e-sitr` is, what `kawr` is, what `mawr` is, what `nawr` is, and then जाकर... This happened at the beginning of creation. These women and men were created, and through the act of marriage, the population began to grow. From there, the system of `da'wat` started. Now, towards the system of `da'wat`, we will spend a couple of days... our time will be spent. And after that, there are many other things. All this that is happening is the description (`bayan`) of the `mabda'` (origin). This will go on for eight more days, and then after that, the description of the `ma'ad` (return/eschatology) will begin. Because it's possible that... our... 17th, 18th... when the Laylat al-Mubarak comes. Until then, perhaps I will finish this. Because then it will be very late. After the prayer... it will be done. So I want this to be finished by the 17th or 19th. The `bayan` of Hajj is longer. If you all want to sit, want to hear... the `bayan` of Hajj will take three or four days... a majlis is held in Madina Sharif so that those who have to go for Hajj in the future can get information. Anyway, this, the woman and man were created. So Allah's proposal (`tajwiz`) was this... that now this `Kayumarth-e-A'zam`, who is the Imam of the time, he was ordered to go and spread the `din` (religion). To their respective places, he sent a Nabi (prophet) and an Imam. This `Kayumarth-e-A'zam` was from the lineage of the `Mustaqarr` Imams. From here, the Imamate became widespread. It is said that on the first day, we created the Ka'ba... this was that Ka'ba. This `shakhs-e-fazil` (excellent person), he was the very first man. Through him, the `nasl-e-insani` (human lineage) continued, and after that, no other human lineage remained except for this one. `Wahidan ba'da wahid, waladan min walad ila yawm al-qiyamah` (One after another, son from son, until the Day of Resurrection). Every lineage will be destroyed, will end. But this lineage, which is of the Prophet Muhammad (S), it has been continuing from him. Whether it is a `dawr` or `kawr`, it is continuing. Now a `kawr`'s duration is so long that you will find it difficult to imagine. One `kawr` is of 16,000 crore years. 16,000 crore years is one `Kawr-e-A'zam`. Now how will you remember this? And in that, this lineage continues. For us, this much is enough... this is the duration. Then another `kawr`, a third, a fourth. Now, `dawr, kawr`, their stages (`manazil`) have also been fixed. What the first `kawr` is like, the tenth, the twentieth, the 400th, the 100th... their capabilities, their ranks, those are also in higher books... that also continues. Anyway, that this creation that I am telling you about, it happens at the beginning of a `kawr`. Now, we, in whichever `dawr` we are in, this is in the belly of the `kawr`. And here, the creation of man does not happen like this, but as it happens from the mother's womb. Now, look, yesterday I had said, this is the `ibtida'-e-da'wat` (beginning of the da'wat). That Allah's system (`nizam`) is that just as `ma-ba-al-aql al-awwal`... the first of creation... this `amr-e-kull`... is ours. This very teaching, to call people towards Allah, this is the institution (`idara`) of `da'wat-e-Hadi`. Just as `'Aql-e-'Ashir` or `Mumba'ith al-Awwal` had made a `da'wat`, here too we have a special institution which we call `da'wat-e-sharif`. That `da'wat-e-sharif` is what? To call towards Allah. The one who is its head, he is the one who calls towards Allah. The institution of `da'wat-e-sharif` is based on this very foundation. And this, the system of `da'wat`... its head, the highest personality, he is the Imam of every era. Now, look... the system of `da'wat` will come. That Nabi, Rasul, Imam, Wasi, Awliya, Qaim, Mahdi... what are these different posts? Their responsibilities. And whom should we consider great, whom small, what is `mustawda'`, what is `mustaqarr`, what is `nazr-e-ashraf`, what is `nazr-e-adwan`? All these stages, when we were in the `alam-e-hayat` (world of life), and our intentions (`niyyat`) were being divided... what were we doing? A `niyyat`... we were knitting. Various `niyyat` formed. We were split. Like pieces, we were scattered to many places. So at that time, the `niyyat` we were making... what happened? Today, what have come as our `jazbat` (emotions/sentiments), they were our `niyyat` there, that with whom we fixed our gaze (`nazar milaye hain`). Hazrat Muqaddas used to explain this very well, that with whom we have fixed our gaze, from what angle did we fix it? With love (`muhabbat`), or with hatred (`nafrat`), with revenge (`intiqam`), or with what? The `jazbat` that have come in us... that we, whom we saw only with the emotion of love... whether she was a woman or he was a man... only love. He has come here as a brother. Brother or sister. The ones who are our... from the same mother's womb, the children who are born. The relationship of a sister and brother is of absolute, unbreakable love. Now, if we fight amongst ourselves here, that's a different matter. But there, they are of one and the same. Brother means a companion. Why? Because from one single pit... where man and woman were created, there, from one mother, the brother and sister are. So this emotion of love, which is purely love, is only between brother and sister. In contrast, the mother has a different group, the father has a different one, all are different. I'll explain two or three things. There is one emotion which is hatred and love. Both are anti... The gaze of hatred and love that fell upon both, that is the husband and wife. The husband and wife have come in this. Hatred and love, not just love. And here the same thing happens, that every wife sometimes has hatred, sometimes love. They meet, then they separate. This is all the eternal system from there that is descending from above. And similarly, we see our Imam of the time, our Mansub of the time, our Da'i of the time... when we... we weren't in small rooms, we... the two Imams of whose time we fixed our gaze with... here they have become our Imams of the time. We are their `ummat` (community), we are born in the time of the Imam of the time. Now this is a different matter, that two, three Imams of the time... our gaze reached... that's how it is. Now look, from here... this is a slightly difficult `bayan` (discourse) coming up... that we, who profess the `dawr-e-Muhammadi`... for us, 'Isa 'alayh al-salam and Musa 'alayh al-salam... their `bayan` will come when it comes. But we have to take care of our own `dawr`. That Janab-e-Paygambar (S), Janab-e-Qaim, Janab-e-Mahdi, Janab-e-'Ali... what kind of system should we see for them? There, the gazes (`nazrein`), he used to say, the gazes are... when we are looking at the Murshid-e-Haqiqi, there, everyone was making a `da'wat`. And I have told you that the Ka'ba... this four-sided structure, where it was in the `abstract form`... I mean, here we say Ka'ba... the spiritual Ka'ba has a four-sided shape, but the `mawqif` (station) inside it... are those who are `wahidan ba'da wahid, waladan min walad`. And those around it, the `hawali` (environs), are all the `mustawda'`. `Du'at`, `anbiya'`, these... `hudud-e-din`, who are `mustawda'`. This is a subtle point, remember it. The `hawali`... the `Ka'ba-e-ruhani` is separate, and its 32... those around which we do `tawaf`... they are `mustawda'`. There, what happened? This `mustawda'` and `mustaqarr`... there, different gazes fell. These gazes... where we were at the beginning, with `'Aql al-Awwal` or `Mumba'ith al-Awwal`, there was a difference of gazes. How? That `nazr-e-ashraf` (most noble gaze) belonged to `Mumba'ith al-Awwal`, who was looking at the `cause`. And one was looking at the `sabab` (reason), and one was looking at the `anjam` (result). `Mumba'ith al-Awwal` and `Mumba'ith al-Thani`.
