The word *jaza'* (recompense) comes in two ways. *Jaza'* comes for punishment, and *jaza'* also comes for reward. *Wa-'lam anna qawman kathiran lamma nazaru ila ma azharahu Allahu ta'ala 'ala yaday 'Ali ibn Abi Talib salawatullahi 'alayh min al-mu'jizat al-bahirat wal-af'al al-ha'ilat* (And know that many people, when they looked at what Allah the Exalted had manifested at the hands of 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, may Allah's blessings be upon him, of dazzling miracles and astounding actions). And this, that many communities, when they saw towards that which Allah had manifested through the hands of 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, meaning the miracles that 'Ali ibn Talib had, which were miracles such that they were astonishing... astonishing. And such actions that would confound the intellect, the actions that he had, of Amir al-Mu'minin, *fa-ghalaw fih* (so they exaggerated concerning him). So they committed *ghulu* (exaggeration). They raised him above his status. *Wa-wadduhu annahu ilah* (And they loved that he was a god). And they claimed that you are God. *Alladhi yakhluquhum wa yarzuquhum* (The one who creates them and provides for them). And such a god who creates and gives sustenance. *Wa-annahu lam yalid wa-lam yulad* (And that he was neither born nor does he give birth). And this, that Amir al-Mu'minin, that no one created him, nor does he create anyone. *Wa-lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad* (And there is no equivalent to him). And that he has no equal, no partner. *Wa-dhalika minhum... la'anahum Allahu... dalalan wa-kufran* (And that from them... may Allah curse them... is misguidance and disbelief). So Allah Ta'ala has cursed them for this... as misguidance and for their disbelief. *Wa-bu'dan* (And as a distance). And He has distanced them from His mercy. *Wa al-sahih alladhi tajibu i'tiqaduhu* (And the correct [view] which it is obligatory to believe)... And the correct thing is, what is it? That the correct belief in this matter is this, that *anna Muhammadan al-Nabi salawatullahi 'alayhi wa-'alihi afdalu 'uqul al-'alam al-tabi'ah* (that Muhammad the Prophet, may Allah's blessings be upon him and his progeny, is the most excellent of the intellects of the world of nature). The correct conception is that Rasulullah, *salawatullahi 'alayh*, that you, in the world of nature, meaning in this world, the intellects of the world of nature that are there, you are superior to all of them. *Ji. Wa-ashrafu 'alam al-hudud al-din* (And the noblest of the world of the *hudud* of religion). And... what does *'alam al-tabi'ah* mean? Will *muhtajib* not come? No, not *muhtajib*. Intellects of the world of nature means those who are in the world of nature with this quality that they become intellects, one day. Right now they are in potentiality (*bil-quwwah*). Are you talking about the veil? Yes, the veil's matter. One day they will become intellects. So their state is that right now they are in potentiality, but one day they will become intellects. So they are the intellects of the world of nature. Just as there are intellects of the spiritual world, in the same way, this is their state. That the intellects of the world of nature... *ji haan*. That you are the most excellent among them. *Wa-ashrafuhum* (And the noblest of them) in the world of the *hudud* of religion. Meaning, in the *hudud* of the world of religion, the most noble and honored is Rasulullah *salawatullahi 'alayh*. *Wa-anna al-mu'jizat allati kana yuzhiruha Amir al-Mu'minin salawatullahi 'alayh min ta'yid al-'aql al-awwal* (And that the miracles which the Commander of the Faithful, may Allah's blessings be upon him, used to manifest were from the support of the First Intellect). And the miracles which Amir al-Mu'minin *salawatullahi 'alayh* used to manifest were from the supports of the First Intellect. *Wa-annahu lam yasil ilayhi illa bi-wasitat al-Nabi* (And that it did not reach him except through the mediation of the Prophet). That those supports which were received by Amir al-Mu'minin from the First Intellect, they could not be received or were not received except by the mediation of the Prophet. The Prophet became the mediator. For everything. Even after the Prophet's passing away? Yes. After the Prophet's passing away too, the Prophet remained the mediator. He will always remain the mediator.

One time Jibra'il came to you, to Rasulullah, and said, "O Rasulullah, convey my *salam* to Amir al-Mu'minin." Convey my *salam* to Amir al-Mu'minin. So the Rasul asked in surprise, "*Ma ana Amir al-Mu'minin?*" (Am I not the Commander of the Faithful?). Am I not the leader of the faithful? "*Ma ana Amir al-Mu'minin?*" (Am I not the Commander of the Faithful?). Am I not the leader of the faithful? So Jibra'il said, "O Rasulullah, *anta sayyid al-anbiya'i wal-mursalin*" (you are the master of the prophets and the messengers). You are the master of the prophets and the master of the messengers. *Wa khatam al-nabiyyin* (and the seal of the prophets). And you are the seal of the prophets. *Wa 'Ali ibn Abi Talib huwa Amir al-Mu'minin* (And 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, he is the Commander of the Faithful). So 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, he is Amir al-Mu'minin. So saying this, he left. Then جناب 'Ali came to you. So you... Rasulullah said, "*Wa alaykum as-salam ya Amir al-Mu'minin*." (And peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful). So he said, "O Rasulullah, *anta Amir al-Mu'minin wa ana khadimukum*" (you are the Commander of the Faithful and I am your servant). You are the Amir al-Mu'minin, and I am your servant. So he said, "No, Jibra'il just came, and he said such and such. I also asked him a question, and he gave this answer from Allah's side, that *anta Amir al-Mu'minin wa ana sayyid al-anbiya'i wal-mursalin wa khatam al-nabiyyin*." (you are the Commander of the Faithful and I am the master of the prophets and messengers and the seal of the prophets). So, the title of Amir al-Mu'minin came to you from Allah's side through Jibra'il. *Ji haan.* And look, every Imam is Amir al-Mu'minin. Every Imam of the time is Amir al-Mu'minin. But when "Amir al-Mu'minin" is said without a name, we understand it to mean whom? Hazrat 'Ali ibn Abi Talib. *Ji haan.*

*Wa-madatuhu lahu li-annahu... ...wa mu'allimuhu wa murabbihi wa muraqqihi ila tilka al-rutbah* (And his substance to him because he is... and his teacher and his nurturer and the one who elevates him to that rank). And the *maddah* (substance) that you received, Amir al-Mu'minin, from the First Intellect, that *maddah* was received by you... by جناب 'Ali... through the Prophet. Because the Prophet, peace be upon him, is your *hadd* (limit/rank). He is your *hadd*. And he is your teacher. He taught and educated you. And he is your nurturer, the one who nurtured you. And the one who elevated you to that rank, to the rank at which you are established, the one who brought you to that rank is who? Janab 'Ali... Janab Nabi. And *mustakhlifuhu ba'dahu* (and his successor after him). And he is the one who made you the caliph after himself. *Fi ummatihi* (in his community). In his community. *Wa-huwa hujjatun... ...fi hayatihi* (And he is a proof... ...in his lifetime). And you are his *hujjat* (proof) in his lifetime. *Ji haan. Wa-kanat martabatuhu... al-'aql al-awwal al-sabiq fi... ...waqtihi* (And his rank was... the First Intellect, the preceding one in... his time). And... and the First Intellect, the First Intellect, just as it is preceding in its time, who is that? That is Janab Nabi. Meaning, the rank of Janab Nabi, just as in the spiritual world it is of the First Intellect, so in the physical world, the Beloved of the Universe, Nabi, peace be upon him, has it. *Wa-martabatu Amir al-Mu'minin fi al-din* (And the rank of the Commander of the Faithful in religion). And the rank of Amir al-Mu'minin in religion, *ma'ahu... li-martabat al-munba'ath al-awwal fi 'alamihi* (with him... is to the rank of the first emanation in his world). Your rank, Amir al-Mu'minin's, is the rank of the *munba'ath al-awwal* (first emanation) in the world of religion. *Wa-al-Nabi mithlu al-dhakar fi al-din* (And the Prophet is like the male in religion). And the example of the Prophet is that of a man in religion. *Wa-Amir al-Mu'minin ma'ahu mithlu al-untha al-qabilah minhu* (And the Commander of the Faithful with him is like the female who accepts from him). And Amir al-Mu'minin, with you, is the example of a woman, that the woman accepts the man's affairs. *Wa-al-Nabi mithlu al-sama'* (And the Prophet is like the sky). And the Prophet is the example of the sky. *Wa-Amir al-Mu'minin mithlu al-ard* (And the Commander of the Faithful is like the earth). And Amir al-Mu'minin... he is the example of the earth. Meaning, Rasul, peace be upon him, who is the sky, from the sky the water that descended, pure and clear, Amir al-Mu'minin absorbed it. And became the bearer of all qualities. So, he became the container of those things. As the Quran Majid says, *wa-ta'iyaha udhunun wa'iyah* (that a retaining ear might retain it). That an ear that listens attentively and an ear that retains, it retains those things. And Amir al-Mu'minin said, *tilka al-udhun ana* (that ear is me). The ear which has been mentioned, that is me. And... here... it is in the Quran that people started calling you *udhun* (ear). Meaning, Rasulullah would tell you the secrets so much that you had become, as it were, the ear of Rasulullah. So its mention has been made in the Quran Majid. So Allah Ta'ala says, *udhun khayr* (an ear of goodness). He is an ear of goodness. And whatever things Rasulullah said, Janab 'Ali memorized them. After Rasulullah's passing, Janab 'Umar ibn al-Khattab said that I wish Rasulullah were alive, because some questions came to my mind which I forgot to ask, and those things remained. So Amir al-Mu'minin said, "What were the questions?" So he said that the dreams we see, why are those dreams true and false? So Amir al-Mu'minin said that when a person sleeps, when his sensory soul separates from his body, so in that state when it is separating, and it tours the heavens, in the middle, when it is touring the heavens, the dreams that come to him at that time, they are true. And when it returns towards his body, then those dreams are false. He said this. So in this way, there were also three or four other questions. So he asked in surprise. So you said, "O 'Umar ibn al-Khattab, do you remember this question from that gathering in which we were present, where we were invited? And Rasulullah was present. And the Sheikh of that place had asked this question. But you forgot, and I remembered." There were three or four such occasions of yours where you mentioned that in this way, you did not remember, but I remembered.

The substance that Maulana 'Ali is getting from the First Intellect is direct, so isn't 'ayn becoming a medium in the middle? No, no. All... all are... it's not being received directly. Nothing is being received directly. It is mentioned that Nabi is the intermediary. Nabi is the intermediary. The famous sermon of 'Ali, *ana al-awwal, ana al-akhir* (I am the first, I am the last), that also relates to 'ayn. It relates to 'ayn in its own place. But in the present life, the one closest to Nabi... the last intermediary... is Nabi, peace be upon him. Because all the intellects became intermediaries. But the last intermediary was Rasul, *salawatullahi 'alayh*. *'Allamani Rasulullahi... min makhnun 'ilmihi alfa bab* (The Messenger of Allah taught me... from his hidden knowledge, a thousand chapters). That Rasulullah taught me from the hidden knowledge, from the treasured knowledge, a thousand chapters. *Wa-inftaha li min kulli babin alfa bab* (And from each chapter, a thousand chapters opened for me). And from every chapter, a thousand chapters opened for me. Janab 'Ali said this. And at the time when you were born, Rasulullah... Janab 'Ali, so when Bibi Fatima bint Asad, *'alayhas salam*, took you and from the Kaaba... from the place where the crack had appeared, and she came out from there, Rasulullah met you. And he... he rushed towards Janab Rasul. Janab 'Ali. So Janab Bibi Fatima said that, "O Muhammad," whatever name she would call him by, because he was not the Rasul then, "O son, this child, for three days, has neither drunk my milk nor opened his eyes." So the very first thing he did was, he looked towards you... his gaze was towards you. So at that time, this was the first meeting of Janab Nabi and Janab Wasi. At that time, Rasulullah said that *khassastani bin-nazr... wa-khassastuka bil-'ilm* (You have singled me out with your gaze... and I have singled you out with knowledge). You have singled me out, that you did not even look towards your mother. And you fixed your gaze on me. So *khassastani bin-nazr, wa-khassastuka bil-'ilm* (You have singled me out with your gaze, and I have singled you out with knowledge). So I have also singled you out with knowledge. *Ana madinat al-'ilm wa 'Aliyyun babuha* (I am the city of knowledge and 'Ali is its gate). So the word 'Ali, you said at that very moment, within three days. That "I am the city of knowledge, and its gate is 'Ali ibn Abi Talib." Even though his mother had named him Haidar. Yes.

*Fa-lamma intaqala al-Nabi salawatullahi 'alayh sara Amir al-Mu'minin salawatullahi 'alayh ba'dahu qa'iman fi 'alam al-din* (So when the Prophet, may Allah's blessings be upon him, passed away, the Commander of the Faithful, may Allah's blessings be upon him, after him, became the one standing in the world of religion). So when Rasulullah passed away, then Amir al-Mu'minin, after you, became the one established... the established authority in the world of religion. *Maqama al-'aql al-awwal* (the station of the First Intellect). So your station became the station of the First Intellect. Just as the Prophet, peace be upon him, had the station of the First Intellect in the physical world. *Wa-hujjatuhu... maqama al-munba'ath al-awwal* (And his proof... the station of the first emanation). And your *hujjat* (proof)... so her station became that of the *munba'ath al-awwal*. And who is your *hujjat*? Bibi Fatima Zahra. As he says in the *du'a*, that *hujjatu ba'liha wa khalifatu abiha* (the proof of her husband and the successor of her father). You are the successor of your father. Meaning, in whichever stations the footsteps of the Rasul will fall, in those very stations, the footsteps of Bibi Fatima Zahra will fall. The very first whose footsteps will fall in those stations will be Bibi Fatima Zahra. She became the successor of the Rasul. And the successor of the Rasul is not Janab 'Ali. Rather, the successor of the Rasul is Bibi Fatima Zahra. And you are the *hujjat* of your husband. And the greatest *hujjat*. *Ji haan.*

And your station became the station of the *munba'ath al-awwal*. After the Rasul. *Fa-alladhi yajibu an ya'taqidahu* (So that which is obligatory to believe)... and this, that the matter which one must believe is *anna... sara al-Nabi wa-Amir al-Mu'minin salawatullahi 'alayh fi manzilah wahidah wa martabah wahidah la fadla li-wahidin minhuma 'ala al-akhar* (that... the Prophet and the Commander of the Faithful, may Allah's blessings be upon them, came to be in a single station and a single rank, with no superiority of one of them over the other). And this, that when the Prophet, peace be upon him, and Amir al-Mu'minin, *salawatullahi 'alayh*, are in one station. *Manzilah wahidah*. *Martabah wahidah*, in one rank. *La fadla li-wahidin...*, there is no superiority of one over the other. *Minhuma 'ala al-akhar. Bal qad tasawaya* (of them over the other. Rather, they are equal). Rather, both are equal. Except, what is the difference? The difference is of precedence (*sabaqiyat*). There is no other difference besides the difference of precedence. *Ji haan. Kama qala al-Nabi* (As the Prophet said)... just as the Prophet says, that *ana wa-anta ya 'Ali ka-hatayn* (I and you, O 'Ali, are like these two). So he... *min yadi al-yumna wal-yusra* (from the right hand and the left)... you... that... your two... the fingers of the *kalimah* (declaration of faith), from both hands, he joined them and said, like this. Like this, he said. That... like this, he said, that just as this is the state, so I and you are like this. And... from the fingers of both hands, he said this. *Wa-qala: wa-la aqulu ka-hatayn* (And he said: and I do not say like these two). And he said, "I don't say it like this." Meaning, his little finger, the *kalimah* finger, and the big finger... he said, "Not like this, but like that," as I just showed you. Like that. *Ji haan. Wa-ja'ala al-musabbihah wal-wusta* (And he made the forefinger and the middle finger)... you... your index finger and the middle finger, he joined them. In which what happened? *Sabaqa ahaduhuma 'ala al-akhar* (one of them preceded the other). That one goes ahead, and one remains behind. So what is the purpose of that? That... Janab Nabi is saying that the finger that is ahead, that is Abu Talib, peace be upon him. And the small finger is you. So he is saying that in any world, in any stage, I was never ahead of Janab Abu Talib. He, Abu Talib, peace be upon him, always remained ahead of me. That is the indication. And I remained behind him. *Ji.*

*Fa-qad ghala* (So he has exaggerated). If someone has said this, that this... if this conception is not there, then people have committed *ghulu*. And *qassara fi al-thaniyah* (and he has fallen short regarding the second). And... one was raised, one was lowered. *Fa-la ta'taqid illa hadha* (So do not believe except this). And do not hold any belief except as we have told you. *Wa-la'natullahi 'ala man ya'taqidu khilafahu* (And the curse of Allah be upon the one who believes contrary to it). So the curse of Allah is upon him who acts contrary to it, or holds that conception.

The lesson ends here. Should we take it up to here?

Should I get the book? Yes, get the book, let's read a little. You get it. I was thinking that... Tanvir and I had typed it in Baroda. It's in the *shari'ah* of Sayyidna Sulayman bin Hasan, but it's a very beautiful book, *Kitab al-Zahirah*. So I'll see, I've requested the PDF. It must be the first book. And there are two or three other books that they have sent the list for, which we had typed. So... Insha'Allah, we'll see which... This will finish in seven days. Yes, it will finish in one session. Yes, it will finish in one session. *Bismillah. As-salamu alaykum.*

This is a balance, sometimes we'll read *muqaddamat* (introductions), sometimes *ta'wil* (esoteric interpretation). And *shari'ah* too... *Kitab al-Zahirah* has that special quality of *shari'ah*. This book should be read again. Yes, this is a book to be read again. Insha'Allah.

*Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. Allahumma'shrah bi'l-Fatihah, hadiyyatan wasilatan saniyyatan zakiyyatan marziyyatan, ila ruh Sayyidna Mu'ayyad... Musa Shiraazi qaddas Allahu ruhahu wa-'alla darajatahu, wa-adafa 'alayna min barakatihi wa-baraka ta'yidatihi wa-ijazatihi. Wa-taqawwam minna 'an ifadatihi wa-istifadatihi bi-ahsan ma yakun. Bi-jah Sayyid al-Mursalin wa-Sayyidina Amir al-Mu'minin wa al-Quran al-'Azim wa Ahl al-Bayt al-Tayyibin al-Tahirin, salawatullahi wa-salamuhu 'alayhim ajma'in. Al-Fatihah.* *Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim...*

*Wa bi-niyyat Sayyidi Maulana Mufaddal Saifuddin, Da'i al-Mutlaq fi al-Jaziratayn al-Hindiyyah wa al-Siniyyah. Li-sharaf al-Hadrati al-Fakhri al-Nabiyyil al-'Alim al-'Alim al-Khaliq al-Sharafi. Usama al-Din Maulana Ghulam Husayn bin Sayyidi Mansur al-Muqaddas walid Mansurullah bin Mulla Rahmatullah bin Mansur al-Muqaddas, ratab Allahu ta'ala maqamahu al-ma'ali wa-ja'ala yakfuzuhu wa-yahfizuhu wa-yahmihi wa-yumittuhu wa-yubqihi wa-yufshihi min sharri jami'i al-amrad wa al-asqam wa-sharri al-awja' bi'l-abdan wa-sharri ghayri al-ilman, wa-min sharri nahw sa'at al-kusufat wa al-tathlithat wa al-tarbi'at wa al-muqabalat, wa-yudim al-nasr 'ala a'da'ihi wa-yahfuzuhu min waqti al-'umr. Wa-yadum al-wafd wa al-iqbal wa-yahmihi fi himayat al-abdan wa-tash'sha'niyyatihi wa-muqam al-ard wa al-hayati wa-fi 'yani muqam al-darajat. Wa-yushkuruhi ya'qub fi ziyad al-da'wah wa-yudumuhi fi khidmat al-awdat. Bi-jah Sayyid al-Mursalin wa-Sayyid Maulana Amir al-Mu'minin wa-Ahl al-Bayt al-Tayyibin al-Tahirin, salawatullahi wa-salamuhu 'alayhim ajma'in. Al-Fatihah.* *Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim...*

*Wa 'alaykum al-salam*. *Wa 'alaykum al-salam*. *Assalamu 'alaykum*. *Wa 'alaykum al-salam*. *Assalamu 'alaykum, Mawlana*. *Wa 'alaykum al-salam*.

*A'udhu Billahi min al-Shaytan al-Rajim* (I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan). *Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim wa bihi nasta'in, salla Allahu 'ala rasulihi Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Muhammadin wa barik wa sallim* (In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, and in Him we seek help. May Allah's blessings and peace be upon His Messenger, our master Muhammad, and upon the family of Muhammad). *Wa hadha haqiqatu al-ibtida'i wa al-ma'ad* (And this is the reality of the beginning and the return). Page 46. Page 46. It is in the middle. *Wa hadha haqiqatu al-ibtida'i wa al-ma'ad* (And this is the reality of the beginning and the return).

The last, fifth line. *Wa hadha haqiqatu al-ibtida'i wa al-ma'ad* (And this is the reality of the beginning and the return). So this is the reality of the beginning and the return. That is, the reality was explained of what the beginning was, that the beginning occurred, and in what way it happened. And the return was also mentioned, that... the return was also mentioned, that... the return was also mentioned, that in what way the praiseworthy return occurred. That in what way the return of the believers happened.

Then now, what is being done is, in the end, the unpraiseworthy return. How did the evil return happen? *Fa qad kashaftuha laka ayyuha al-akh musarrihatan mujarradatan min ghayri ramzin wa la isharat* (So I have unveiled it for you, O brother, explicitly and plainly, without any symbol or indication). So, O my brother, I have unveiled to you, meaning, I have made apparent, every matter with clarity and by explaining it fully, without any secret, without any indication. Meaning, I have clarified every matter. There is no hidden matter said in symbol or indication, but rather it has been clarified. *Wa hadha al-kalam la yakshifuhu wa la illa al-du'at* (And this speech is not unveiled except by the Du'at). And this... And this... And this is a speech that is not unveiled, not explained, except by those who are the great *Du'at*. The great *Du'at* are the ones who unveil this matter which we have mentioned to you. *Kama a'lamuna* (As they informed us). And those people... those great *Du'at* have informed us of these matters. *Hududuna* (Our Hudud). And they are... they are our *Hudud*. *Fa jazahum Allahu 'anna* (So may Allah reward them on our behalf). So may Allah grant them the best reward. *Afdhal al-jaza'* (The best of rewards). The best of rewards. *Kama kafahum Allahu bi-l-husna* (As Allah has sufficed them with the best). And may Allah the Exalted suffice them completely with the best of rewards.

*Fa-fham dhalika wa inna nashrahu al-qawl fi ma'ad al-mukhalifin* (So understand that, and indeed we shall explain the statement regarding the return of the opponents). And know this matter, that we will now explain to you that statement which is about the return of the opponents. Meaning, the opponents who opposed the *Awliya Allah*, the *A'immah*, and the *Anbiya'*. *Al-dallin* (The misguided ones), who went astray. So how will their return be? *Li-taktamila suratuka* (So that your form may be completed). So that in your form, the concept may be fully established. *Wa ta'lu darajatuka* (And your rank may be elevated). And your ranks may be elevated. *Bi-ma'rifati dhalika* (Through the knowledge of that). Through the knowledge of that matter. Because knowledge is of two types. One is, as it is mentioned within *La ilaha illa Allah*, that one is the knowledge of Allah, and the knowledge of *la ilaha*. The knowledge of *illa Allah* is there, but with *illa Allah*, the knowledge of *la ilaha* is necessary. Meaning, along with the knowledge of the *Awliya Allah*, the knowledge of those who are other than the *Awliya Allah*, who are the opponents, is also necessary—what did they do, and how will their return be? That too is necessary. So, he says that so that your ranks may be elevated. *Dhalika, fa-tastahida fi a'mal al-khayr* (That, so strive in the deeds of goodness). And you, along with this knowledge, should strive in good deeds. The deeds of the people of good. *Li-tulhaqa bi-jumlatihim* (So that you may be joined with their company). So that you may be joined with the company of the people of good. *Al-sharifah* (The noble one). Who are very noble people. *Fi hadhirat al-quds* (In the sacred enclosure). And whose abode was in the sacred enclosure. The sacred enclosure means, what is in *Bab al-Abwab*. If we look in our physical world, the sacred enclosure is that great enclosure, that is, the well, in which all of them will go and gather. That is *Bab al-Abwab*. That the forms of all the islands, the gathering of the forms of the 12 islands, happens near *Bab al-Abwab*. So that has also been called the sacred enclosure. And *fi jawari Rabb al-'alamin* (in the vicinity of the Lord of the worlds). Those who are in the vicinity of *Rabb al-'alamin*. *Rabb al-'alamin* is the Imam of the Time, *'alayhi al-salam*. They are in the vicinity of the Imam of the Time, *'alayhi al-salam*. *Tastanibu a'mal ahl al-sharr* (You avoid the deeds of the people of evil). So that you may remain safe and... the deeds of those who are the people of evil, from their deeds. *Fa-taslamu min al-wuqu' fihi* (So you may be safe from falling into it). And you will be safe from falling into their evils. Falling, that you may fall completely into it and become like them. *Ajaran Allahu wa iyyaka min al-wuqu' fihi bi-mannihi wa karamihi 'azza wa jalla* (May Allah protect us and you from falling into it, by His grace and generosity, the Mighty and Majestic). And we seek Allah's protection, and for you too, this is a protection, that you may fall into those punishments, by Allah's grace, meaning His forgiveness, and by Allah's generosity, *'azza wa jalla*.

*Thumma inna al-mukhalif li-l-haqq al-mu'adi* (Then indeed, the one who opposes the truth and is hostile). So, the one who is an opponent of the truth, the one who is an opponent of the truth, and who is hostile to the truth, *yahsunu 'indahu min 'adawat al-haqq* (it becomes good in his view from his hostility to the truth). To him, because of his hostility to the truth, what happens? That he acquires the deeds of the people of evil. And the deeds of the people of evil which he is doing... the evil people's deeds he is doing, *suratun zulmaniyyah* (a dark form). So a dark form of his is created. Just as a believer's luminous form is created, his dark form is created. *Fa-idha kana 'inda mawtihi tajarradat lahu tilka al-zulmah* (So when he is at the point of his death, that darkness is stripped away for him). And that dark form separates from him at the time of his death. Now, he is actually calling the dark form... that form is not like a form. It is his vile concept. And what is his sensory soul, it spreads within his body. His sensory soul spreads within his body. And what is his concept, his vile concept, that he has enmity for the people of truth, from that, a concept was formed for him. And that vile concept, you call a dark form. So, it is stripped away, meaning it separates from his body at the time of his death. *Fa-afza'athu wa ar'abathu* (So it terrified him and frightened him). *Wa-stahashaha minha wa-rta'a* (And he felt alienated by it and was terrified). And it frightens him and it distresses him, and it makes him feel alienated, and he... and he becomes terrified. *Wa dhalika awwalu 'adhabiha* (And that is the first of its punishments). And this is the first punishment that is given to that dark form. Yes.

*Wa asluha min akhbathi tilka al-zulmah al-habita* (And its origin is from the foulest of that descending darkness). And what is its origin? Of this dark form? It is that darkness which had fallen at the time of the sin. At the time of the sin, the darkness he had created for himself there, in the world of beginning, by not listening to the *'ashir* and not repenting, the darkness, his state he had created, that is a part of it which he is receiving here. *Min 'alam al-ibtida'* (From the world of beginning). Which he had done in the world of beginning. *Wa hiya zulmatun 'atiyyah, al-ra's wa al-dhanab* (And it is a powerful darkness, the head and the tail). And this darkness which he has acquired in the world is also its *ra's wa dhanab*. Meaning, it is a part of it which... what is in the darkness of *ra's* and goes into *dhanab*. *Ya'mal magnatis li-hadhihi al-suwar* (It acts as a magnet for these forms). Meaning, from these very dark forms, from these vile concepts, a part is formed which is called *ra's wa dhanab*. Yes. And this becomes a magnet for those dark, vile, satanic forms. Yes. *Li-ma baynahum min al-munasabah* (Because of the affinity between them). Because within them, this *ra's wa dhanab*, within it, and this, its satanic, vile forms, there is an affinity. As the person is, so are his angels. Similarly, this is also a matter of the same kind. *Wa hiya markazun laha* (And it is a center for it). And this becomes a center for them. Who? This *ra's wa dhanab* and Rahu and Ketu, which are beyond the orbit of the moon. Meaning, they do not enter the orbit of the moon, but are... rather, they are under it. Meaning, the sphere of the moon, they are under it, not above the sphere of the moon. *Wa hiya markazun laha* (And it is a center for them). And this becomes a center for them. *Fa-tuqimu hunalika* (So it resides there). And these vile, evil forms, they stay there. That becomes their residence. *Wa takunu minha al-ahzan al-mudirrah bi-l-'alam* (And from it come the harmful sorrows to the world). And remaining there... because in life they have done all sorts of mischief, they have troubled the *Awliya Allah*, they have adopted stubbornness, so there too, coming there, they try to trouble especially the believers in the world and to perplex them. Yes. *Wa yasiru ba'da dhalika ila...*

Is *ra's wa dhanab* also a sphere, or is it separate? Is there a sphere of *ra's wa dhanab* formed or is it separate? No, sphere means there is a place. A non-physical place which is not visible. The two... the place of *ra's wa dhanab*, the two places, they are not visible. They are conceptual, but they exist. No, but does its sphere form or not? No, it's not a sphere. It's not like the spheres of the planets.

The world is so old. Those who are in the lower ranks... those who are in the ranks of the lower ones, maybe they are ascending from being *musirr* (insistent upon sin) gradually. Yes, absolutely. Because *qudrat* (Divine Power) also wants that there should be progress, that the *musirr* and the wretched should enter the fold of faith. This is what *qudrat* wants, and it keeps happening. In the *adwar* (cycles), in the *aqwar* (eras), this matter keeps happening that those who are from below... but they have to be raised with great services. He will mention that those who ascend, they are entrusted with very great services. And after those services, when they ascend, they reach a very high station. Because the services they have are encompassing entire *adwar*. They are not for a year or two, but they have to perform services for entire *adwar*. Due to which, a great deal of luminosity and transparency develops within them. Therefore, when their return happens in the human form, they reach a very high station. Some of our *du'at* have also mentioned that those who are *du'at* now, were once *musirrin* and *mustakbirin* (arrogant). Yes. And then later, when their return happened after many years, they were established in the rank of a *da'i*.

*Thumma yasiru ba'da dhalika ila barazikh 'adhab al-adna* (Then after that he proceeds to the isthmuses of the lowest punishment). Then they are taken to the isthmuses of the lowest punishment. As you know, there are three punishments. There is *'adhab al-adna* (the lowest punishment), *'adhab al-awsat* (the middle punishment), and *'adhab al-akbar* (the greatest punishment). Yes. So, *'adhab al-adna* is the punishment of the physical world itself. That in the physical world, they are taken into *ra'h wa khundar*. *Ra'h wa khundar* means, the very first punishment is in the human, physical state. The Habshi, etc. Then, the second punishment is the bear, the monkey. After that, there are wild animals, then birds. In this way, they are taken into punishments. He has mentioned which are those levels.

The final level is that of the mineral. Mineral. Yes, the final level is mineral. First, there is the human level, then the animal level, then birds, then... those that are predatory animals. And then after that is the mineral level. And at the end, there is tar, in which the *da'wah* is not presented. Because every time a form changes, meaning one level... from one level to another, meaning they are descending in punishment, at that time, the *da'wah* of the Imam of the Time is presented to them. And if they accept, and this happens very rarely, the matter of acceptance. They don't accept much. But if they accept, then they ascend. From there, their ascent happens. And if they don't accept, then they descend. And descending, they go into another punishment. To the extent that at the time of every form, the *da'wah* is presented to them. Yes. This is a mercy of *qudrat* upon them. But when they once come into the punishment of tar, at that time no argument is presented to them and there is no *da'wah*. Then they go from the lowest punishment to the middle punishment and the greatest punishment. Yes.

When the lava comes out, it is in a liquid state. Yes. The souls that are... being returned... to human form. That is, it is a very harmful state for them. No, for them it would be a good thing, wouldn't it? For them, it is good because they can be released from the punishment of rock. And go out from the vicinity of the fiery mountain. And then that fiery mountain, when it erupts in different places, from it, *namaz* (minerals) are formed. Then, when the *namaz* are eaten, they ascend from that.

They say that when lava comes out, afterwards, the land becomes fertile. Yes, yes, yes. It means they are ascending, they are ascending.

This eclipse, the lunar eclipse and the solar eclipse, it is also because of the vile forms. Yes, it is because of the vile forms. What happens is that when the lunar or solar eclipse occurs, these vile forms gain mastery over the plan that the Imam is carrying out. They become aware of the plans. So, because of becoming aware, their mischief increases a great deal. Whatever plans the Imam is carrying out, those plans are happening in a hidden way, however they are happening. Now, they become aware of those plans. And *qudrat* also wants that the reward for the good deeds they had done should be given. So, *qudrat* wants that their account of rewards should be settled. So, they become aware of the plans of the Imam, and because of being aware of the plans, they cause trouble. They trouble human beings, especially the believers, in this matter. And that's how this matter happens. Therefore, it has been said that during the eclipse, a person should be engaged in prayers and all the... prayers are also offered, supplications are also made, etc. But, that lunar eclipse, as it happened once that Hadrat Ibrahim, who was the son of the Messenger of Allah, he passed away, and at that time there was a solar eclipse. So people started speculating that because of... the sun... because of Janab Ibrahim, this solar eclipse has happened. This... so when Janab al-Nabi heard this, he said, "It is not so, that the solar eclipse has not happened because of my son's death. The solar eclipse is one of the signs of Allah, and it has no connection with my son's death." Yes.

At that time it happened that you yourself wanted to enter the grave, but Mawla al-Ka'inat stopped you. That "O Messenger of Allah, you do not descend, I will descend." So Janab Mawla al-Ka'inat descended into that grave, of Janab Ibrahim. And Janab Ibrahim became a ransom for Imam Husayn. Yes. That is, Janab al-Nabi... Janab Jibril had come to him and said that Allah the Exalted says that what matter do you prefer, that the trial be placed upon Janab Ibrahim or upon Husayn? Because one of the two has to be sacrificed. So you said that I make Ibrahim a ransom for Janab Husayn. Yes. So this happened. And it happened that you... you said that at that time your tears were flowing. Janab Ibrahim... because he was four years old, Janab Ibrahim. And... and he was born from Janab Mariyah al-Qibtiyyah. So you loved your son very much. So when... when... so you started hiccuping. Tenderness arose. So the hypocrites were also there. Because the number of hypocrites in Madinah had increased a lot. As long as he was in Makkah, there were no hypocrites. There were disbelievers and polytheists, or Muslims. The abundance of hypocrites arose in Madinah. So the hypocrites said that "O Messenger of Allah, you had forbidden us from weeping over the deceased, so you said, 'Look, my weeping and my state is a natural state. I have not performed mourning. I have not torn my clothes. I have not created a commotion. This is a natural thing, that in grief for my child, my tears have flowed and I have started hiccuping.'" So you said this. Yes.

And a large gathering assembled for you, for Janab Ibrahim, which was the gathering of the young children of prophets. The young children who passed away at a young age among the past prophets, their gathering assembled with you, with Janab Ibrahim. It came to Ibrahim bin Rasulullah. And then you took care of them. Then later, that gathering came to Bibi Fatimah.

And this is what is called *khulasatu al-jawhar al-islami* (the essence of the Islamic jewel). That it came to Janab Fatimah, in your sermons there is that you are the *khulasatu al-jawhar al-islami*. That you are the essence of the Islamic jewel. And it happened in this way that this gathering came to you, and those people who passed away in the presence of the Messenger of Allah, before the *wilayah* of Janab 'Ali. Meaning, before the *wilayah* of Janab 'Ali was presented by the Messenger of Allah. So those who passed away before that, their gathering also came to Janab Bibi Fatimah. Yes. And that is why she is called *khulasatu al-jawhar al-usmani*... and in that gathering, who is the highest form? That which is the *khulasatu al-jawhar al-islami* gathering, in it, the highest form is that of Mawlana Hamzah.

*Thumma ila al-'adhab al-akbar* (Then to the greatest punishment). Then they will be taken towards the greatest punishment. And the greatest punishment is an extremely severe punishment, the punishment of rock. Yes. *Wa rubbama anna minhum man takunu dhunubuhu qalilah* (And perhaps among them are those whose sins are few). And among them, those whose sins are few, *wa tujibu da'wata ba'd al-anbiya'* (and they answer the call of some of the prophets). And who have accepted the call of some prophets, *fa-yuslimu* (so they submit). And they have accepted Islam. *Wa yuqimu wa yukhdamu kama huwa mujarradun fi ma'unat al-awliya'* (And they are established and served, just as it is stripped in the assistance of the awliya). And... they remain in this way and perform service, just as they are stripped in the assistance of the *awliya* Allah. *Wa takhlisuhu min ma waqa'a fi shiddah minhum thumma awfa* (And his salvation from what he fell into of hardship from them, then he fulfilled). First, they were in a great deal of hardship. In enmity towards the *awliya* Allah. Then later, after repenting, they were saved, they were liberated. And then when they... when they are given various services, in those services, they spend their time. And then, when their services are completed, *wa-stahaqqa al-majazat alladhi yaliq bi-l-sahik* (And he became deserving of the rewards that are befitting of the grinding). And then they... to raise them, what does *qudrat* do? It grinds them. *Sahik* means to crush. It crushes them. *Thumma ja'a fi barzakh al-su'ud* (Then he came into the isthmus of ascent). And it brings them into the isthmus of ascent. *Al-mahmudah fi al-ma'adin wa al-nabat wa al-hayawan* (The praiseworthy one, in the minerals, plants, and animals). And how does that happen? That it brings them into the state of minerals, plants, and animals. *Ila an yahsul fi surat al-bashariyyah* (Until he obtains the human form). Until he comes into the human form. Meaning, into the human body. Those who have to be raised. *Thumma yastajibu* (Then he responds). Then he... coming into that human body, he accepts. He accepts the call. *Wa yas'adu fi fada'* (And he ascends in the space). And then he ascends. He accepts the call of the truth and ascends. And in that way, their ascent happens. Meaning, the ascent, unless a person comes into the noble *da'wah*, through the people of the noble *da'wah* only does it happen. There is no other way. There is no other way for ascent, except that one accepts the call of the Imam of the Time. Other than that, there is no way. Meaning, prayers, Hajj, zakat, etc., are of no use. They are not accepted. Yes, it's another matter that these things bring one closer to the *da'wah*. But until a person accepts the *da'wah*, becomes honored by the people of the noble *da'wah*, he will never progress further. So, in our lives, the deeds that we do, among those deeds, which is the noblest deed? It is our noble *da'wah*. That which we consciously accept as the noble *da'wah*, is our most high and blessed deed. Yes.

But Hadrat, when Janab Ibrahim received the gathering in his childhood, at the time of his passing, he wouldn't have had the noble *da'wah*, nor would he have had consciousness. No, but... that is another matter. But those people, although they passed away in childhood, their ranks are very high. Their ranks are very high. Although they passed away at a young age. Just like Janab Asghar. Yes, Janab Asghar bin Imam Husayn. Their ranks are very high. They have the ranks of great *du'at*.

*Wa hadhihi jumlatu al-qawl fi al-tasawwur* (And this is the sum of the statement regarding the conception). This is the sum of the statement. *Thumma narji'u ila al-qawl fi ma'ad jism al-dhidd wa nafsuhu* (Then we return to the statement regarding the return of the body of the opponent and his soul). Then we return to how the return happened, that of the body of the opponent, the enemy of the Ahl al-Bayt, and his soul, how does its return happen? *Wa dhalika annahu idha faraqahu al-tasawwur* (And that is, when the conception departs from him). Now, when his conception departs from him... *qabla jismihi* (before his body). That is, one is his body, and his *riyah* (spirit) does not come out. Because his matter is not that. And his... his body is whatever it is. And his sensory soul has spread within his body. Therefore, he is feeling the punishment. And whatever has come out is his vile conception. So, when his vile conception departs from him, *wa qubira jismuhu* (and his body is buried). And his body is buried, *ba'da an tashayya nafsuhu* (after his soul has spread). After his soul spreads within it, *fihi digradation hai* (it is a degradation). That the soul, which is a high thing, for it to spread within his body is extremely reprehensible.

But sir, this is about burial. What about those who are cremated? Yes, cremation, that state is the same. That is, they are in even greater punishment. That *qudrat* wanted to put them through a natural process, but instead of that, they have hastened their own punishments. Meaning, that punishment... they have put themselves into punishment. Into the punishment of fire.

*Fihi, fa-inna nafsuhu tashi' fi jismihi* (In it, for his soul spreads in his body). Because his soul spreads in his body. *La yufariquhu ghayru al-tasawwur* (Nothing departs from it except the conception). And nothing comes out except his conception departs from it. *Wa baqi nasib min...* (And a remaining portion of...). And its remaining portion, meaning, what is in the form of vapors from his body, the air that is coming out, *alladhi kana yastanshiquhu* (which he used to inhale). Which he used to breathe. *Wa yusamma nafs hawaiyyah* (And it is called an airy soul). And it is called an airy soul. Just as for the believer, they are called spiritual souls (*nufus ri'iyyah*), for them, they are called airy souls (*nufus hawaiyyah*). *Tufariqu ajsam al-hayawan* (It departs from the bodies of animals). And this also comes out from the bodies of animals. *Kulluha 'inda al-mawt* (All of them at the time of death). That at the time of death, the vapors that come out from their bodies, they are airy souls. Whether it is a human being who is a disbeliever, a polytheist, or an opponent, or an animal. At the time of death. *Fa-idha dufina* (So when he is buried). And when he is buried, *intanna* (it rots). So a stench arises from it. *Wa tamargha fi al-turab* (And he writhes in the dust). And in the dust, he writhes, meaning, he tumbles over and over. *Fa-lahiqa kullu qismin minhu min al-amhat* (So every part of it from the mothers joined). Then every part... is joined to its mothers. *Bi-bukhar al-safra' min al-nar* (With the vapor of yellow bile from the fire). And what is in their body, the part of yellow bile, it goes to fire. *Wa al-dam bi-l-hawa'* (And the blood to the air). And the blood that is in them goes to the air. *Wa al-balgham bi-l-ma'* (And the phlegm to the water). *Wa al-sawda' bi-l-turab* (And the black bile to the dust). Meaning, the four elements, in them, the parts of their body go. And that too, gradually, not quickly.

*Wa dhalika awwalu 'adhabihi kama anna...* (And that is the first of his punishments, just as...). This is... it's not written here.

*Wa kullu dhalika mahfuzan min qudrat al-mudabbir* (And all of that is preserved by the power of the Planner). *Thumma yajtami'u ma yas'adu minhu fa-yakunu mataran fi jumlah ghayra* (Then what ascends from him gathers and becomes rain in a different form). And then all these things, He preserves. *Qudrat*. And then He gathers them, to the extent that they ascend and, becoming water, they ascend. The rain's. *Fi jumlah ghayrihi wa yalhaqu ma yanhillu minhu ila al-turab* (In a different form, and what dissolves from him into the dust joins). Then they descend onto the earth. *Alladhi baqiya minhu fa-yakunu minhu nabatun* (What remained of him, so from it becomes a plant). And it is eaten.

I don't know where this came from. Anyway. *Ma ashkaliha min al-suwar al-najisah fi al-barari wa al-qifar wa al-mawadi' al-wasikhah wa al-bawali' wa al-sawaqi wa al-shi'ab wa tharaya al-nas fi manamiha, manawatihim. Wa yahdurruhum 'ala af'al al-khina'. Fi 'adawat ahl al-haqq. Wa hadhihi al-suwar hum al-jinn al-madhmumun wa al-shayatin wa al-'afarit al-mutamarridun al-darrun li-l-bashar* (What forms of impure figures in the wildernesses and wastelands, and the filthy places, and the sewers and streams, and the ravines, and the dreams of people in their sleep... their provocations. And it incites them to acts of lewdness in enmity to the people of truth. And these figures are the blameworthy jinn and the devils and the rebellious demons who are harmful to mankind).

*Wa dhalika awwalu 'adhabihi* (And that is the first of his punishments). And this is the first punishment that is given to them. *Kama anna surur al-mu'min yataraya suratuhu* (Just as the joy of the believer, his form appears). In contrast to this, the reward that is given to a believer, how is it? That his form is shown to him. At the time of his passing away, it is shown to him. It is shown. *Wa ishqraquha 'inda mawtihi* (And its radiance at the time of his death). And the radiance of the form occurs upon his body at the time of his death. *Awwalu thawabihi* (The first of his rewards). This is his first reward. That is, the believer's first reward. And as it has been explained, what did Sayyidna Muhammad Burhanuddin say in *Al-Anwar al-Latifah*? That when a believer passes away, there is a light that gives him comfort. So, he asks... the dying believer asks, "Who are you? When my loved ones, my family, my dear ones have all left me in this darkness, who are you who is giving me comfort?" Because of which, I am receiving comfort from you. So, it says that "In your life, the way you treated the believing brethren and the happiness that entered their hearts because of your actions, Allah the Exalted gathered all that happiness and gave it the form of a light. And I am that light, which is giving you comfort today." Yes. This... this is what that light says. And this is the first reward that is given to a believer.

*Thumma inna tilka al-surah al-zulmaniyyah tufariqu nafs al-mayyit* (Then indeed, that dark form departs from the soul of the deceased). And then that evil form which was his vile concept, it departs from the soul of the deceased. *Wa tahulu fi al-ufq* (And it roams in the horizon). And then in the horizon, it roams. *Yatlubu al-su'ud* (Seeking to ascend). And it wants to ascend as well. *Fa-la yumkinuha* (But it is not possible for it). But that is not possible for it. *Wa tatlubu al-ruju'a ila dhalika al-jism* (And it seeks to return to that body). And then it wants that if it cannot ascend, then it should enter its body again. Enter the body. Because its pleasure is from the body. That is, pleasures are from the body. So it wants to enter the body. Who? The vile concept. *Fa-la yumkinuha* (But it is not possible for it). This is also not possible for it. *Fa-tajulu fi al-hawa'* (So it roams in the air). Therefore, it roams in the air. *Wa hiya allati tusammaha al-'ammah al-munaf* (And it is what the common people call the munaf). And the common people call it *munaf*. *Ila an yuwafiq man yastahiqquhu* (Until it finds one who is deserving of it). And those voices that are heard... for 40 days, they are given a respite. These vile concepts, which... which want to ascend but cannot ascend, and want to enter their body but cannot enter, so finally, they roam between the sky and the earth. They roam and do whatever they please. So they...

The *hudud* have passed.

Then it happens that *man yastahiqquhu an yahulla fihi min imra'ah jahilah* (one who is deserving that it should descend into him from an ignorant woman). Then this, that they do such mischief that there are women who are ignorant, and who do not remain pure and clean, upon them they descend. They possess them. *Aw sabiyyin* (Or a boy). Or on children they possess. *Aw ma ashakalahu* (Or what is similar to it). Or people of this kind. So... *fa-yadhulu fihim* (so it enters them). And it enters them. *Wa yusra'u* (And he is thrown down). And it throws them down, meaning it possesses them. *Wa yasiru yantiqu 'ala alsinihim* (And it begins to speak through their tongues). To the extent that they begin to speak through their tongues. And in reality, that child or those women are not speaking themselves. This... this possesses them and makes them speak. *Wa tuwaswisu* (And it whispers). And it puts whispers into them. *Wa ya'muruhu bi-l-ma'asi* (And it commands him to sin). And it commands them to sin. *Wa rubbama zala 'anhu* (And perhaps it departs from him). And sometimes it happens that it separates from them as well. *Wa rubbama lazimathu ila an yamut* (And perhaps it clings to him until he dies). And sometimes it does not leave. To the extent that until their death, it remains in possession of them. *Dhalika al-masru', wa faraqahu dhalika al-tasawwur* (That possessed one, and that conception departed from him). *Wa sara ya'wi ma'a ba'di man yastahiqquhu* (And it began to take shelter with some of those who are deserving of it). And to the extent that it takes shelter. They become a shelter. In such women's homes, in such children's homes. And especially those children, it has been said, that those children who urinate and do not take ablution, and their feet are dirty, and in their homes they keep jumping around, so from their walking, impurity spreads in the house, due to which these things enter them. Therefore, it is said that children's hands and feet should be washed, after going to the washroom, and at night, while sleeping, their hands should also be washed. Because when they eat something, children, and they fall asleep just like that, the devils lick their hands. Of the children. Due to which, that... those children scream and shout and cry. So the reason for their crying, waking up at night, is that the devils are licking their hands. Due to which, this... this crying of children happens. Therefore, a pious elder... a woman from his congregation came to him and said that "My child cries a lot at night and troubles me a lot. Our sleep is also disturbed, and... in this way." So he said, "Look, wash his hands and feet and then put him to sleep." And that's what happened, that by washing his hands and feet and putting him to sleep, that state went away. His meaning was this, that the devils lick his hands and feet. Therefore, you should take care of this.

But Mawlana, there is a *du'a*, *Allahumma khalaqtani*, in it, it says that the devil runs in our blood, we don't see him, he puts whispers, he urges us to evil deeds, so then... He is already present within us. He is present, but *qudrat* also saves us, doesn't it? From all their evil and corruption, it saves us too. Our prayers, our deeds... From the prayers, it saves us. Our good deeds, our intentions, all these things keep us safe too. Otherwise, the devil is always in this pursuit, of how we can make mistakes and how we can fall into his trap and net. Yes. But this is the grace of Allah and His Messenger, that for us, such small prayers... look, the prayers of the Messenger of Allah are often not very big. His prayers are short, which a person can also memorize. So such prayers... how many prayers has he explained? That if you do this, you will be safe. If you do this, you will get so much reward. Up to this point, it was mentioned that the evil imaginations/conceptions (*tasawwurat-e-khabisa*) cause distress in various ways, and they wander (*jawlani*) in the air, and they are called *munaf* because of their loud cries and wailing, and it is said that they are called *munaf*. To the point that *an tahillu fihi min imra'atin jahilah* (that they enter into an ignorant woman). So they *hulul* (enter into), meaning they enter such an ignorant woman.

The *munaf*... is *munaf* the plural of *munif*?

The *munaf*... is *munaf* the plural of *munif*?

*Munaf*... here *munaf*... no, *munaf* is something else. *Munaf* means... uh... uh... the sound of screaming and shouting that comes out... in a state of panic, or in a state of fear, or in a state of distress, that is called *munaf*.

Yes, in this same context, the word *munaf*, is it the plural of *munif*?

*Munaf*... No, it's... with *'ayn*.

It's *nun-'ayn-fa'*.

That one has an *alif*. The *alif* comes first. Munaf has an *alif*. Munaf, right, Alim Shah Bhai's son, Munaf. That has an *alif*. That has an *alif*.

This one is *munaf*. *Nun-'ayn-fa'*. *Munaf*.

If you understand `munaf` to be from *alif*, it is from *anf*, meaning 'one with a high nose'. Meaning, honorable. From *anf*. From *anf*. Honorable. One with a high nose, as they say. And here, *munaf* means that screaming and shouting which is born of dread (*wahshat*). That is called *munaf*.

To the point that they *hulul* (enter) into such an ignorant woman, or inside a boy who remains dirty, or whatever else resembles it. And they enter into him and throw him down. And he begins to speak on his tongue. And it whispers to him... it puts whispers into him, and it commands him to sins. And sometimes it leaves him, and sometimes it clings to him until he dies. They remain mounted upon him. Just as the condition is. *Dhalika al-masruh* (That is the one who is seized/possessed). This is the one they throw down. *wa faraqahu dhalik al-tasawwur* (and that conception separates from him). Then that conception which is there, it separates from him, *wa saara ya'wi* (and it goes to take shelter)... *ma'* (with) ... and on the side. That conception then takes shelter, with its forms, *ma'a ashkalihi min al-suwar al-najisah* (with its forms from the impure images). The impure images that exist, with them, it takes shelter *ila al-marari wal-qifar* (in the deserts and wastelands), in the great plains, the deserts, there, and in the wastelands, and in such places that are dirty. Their shelters are there. Meaning these evil imaginations/conceptions (*tasawwurat-e-khabisa*) take shelter here.

They are left in confinement for 40 days, then they get loose. Then they enter people's bodies, they possess them.

Yes, in these 40 days, they are doing all these antics.

In this, what the author of the book has written is that they remain with a person until they die.

Yes, this also happens, this is also true. No, it means that for 40 days they do these antics, but those that *hulul* (enter), it can also be that they remain inside them until death.

Those that enter someone's body, they corrupt their faith, they... I mean, they incline them towards sin. So in that, then how will their reckoning be done? For whom this has occurred...

Then *minhum fihim* (from them, in them). Why did it go inside them? Because they had inclinations. The one they entered was not pure and clean. They had inclinations.

But being impure is one thing, and entering them and corrupting their faith is another...

No, it is for a time, but the one who is possessed (`masruh`), the one they have entered, they have inclinations towards them. Without inclination, nothing can happen. As the Holy Qur'an says: *al-khabithuna lil-khabithat wal-khabithat lil-khabithin* (Evil men are for evil women, and evil women are for evil men). That the good are for the good, and the bad are for the bad. If there were no inclinations, then it would not happen. It is because of the inclinations that all this has happened. And even the friends of Allah (`awliya' Allah`) could not escape these inclinations.

They mount the two knots (*ughdatayn*) then?

Yes. They mount the two knots after that. We will mention this as well. They mount the two knots.

And... and... and towards the bathhouses, and where wine is drunk, their shelters are there. *wa al-shi'ab wa tara'a lil-nas fi manamatihim* (and the ravines, and it appears to people in their dreams). And they also appear to people in their dreams. *wa yarizuhum 'ala al-af'al al-khana'* (and it incites them to wicked deeds). And it incites them to do evil things. `wa 'adawat ahl al-haqq` (and enmity towards the people of truth). And these images are blameworthy jinn. And they are devils (*shayatin*), and they are `'afarit` (powerful demons). `al-mutamarridun al-darun` (the rebellious, the harmful ones) who cause harm to humans. `al-muhdithuna fihim al-ahdath` (the ones who innovate events within them), and they make them commit many sins.

Some of them deserve to remain `min ajnas` (from the kinds) in the `barazikh al-'adhab` (isthmuses of punishment). And this is how they remain in various isthmuses of punishment. `fa awwaluha` (and the first of them)... and then what happens to them is that they endure the seven plunges, after death. These... whose death is a bad one, they face the seven plunges of punishment, which is also called `al-nahas`. So the first is being cast in the form of a `Zanj`. First of all, it is being cast in the form of a `Zanj`. Meaning, they come in a human form, those who are Abyssinian, etc. `wa man yushakiluhu` (and whoever resembles him), people like that. `fa idha ikhtaza bi-dhalika al-dhakaru wal-untha` (so when the male and female are nourished by that), and when any man or woman eats these things in which they have `hulul`, *zahar shay'un minhu* (something from it appears), *zahara dhalika khabithan* (that appears as something evil). *mathalu walidayhi* (like his parents). *wa yu'inu muddah ma yasta'iqqu thumma yamut* (and he is helped for a period that he deserves, then he dies). They remain with them for a period. *wa tashi'u nafsuhu fi jismihi* (and his soul spreads in his body). And then their soul becomes widespread in them. This is a regression. *wa hiyya al-'aqasur, awwalan tasiru fi-mithl al-'awdah, nafsuhu fi jismihi*. And then they walk a reverse path, until their soul becomes widespread in their body. *thumma takaththafat bil-ma'asi* (then it became dense with sins). And from sins, they become completely dense. *yasiru jisman lahu, thumma tamut* (then it dies). Then their death occurs. `wa tanhallu... marratan ula, wa tasiru nabatan` (and it dissolves... the first time, and becomes a plant), `wa taqtadihi man yastahiqqu al-liqa'a... 'inda... mathal al-nasnas` (and he is led by one who deserves the meeting... like the nasnas/ape-like creature). And until it becomes a plant. Until then they come in the form of monkeys. And the `langur` and bears, they come in their forms. `thumma tamut ba'da dhalika` (then it dies after that). And then their death occurs. `wa... tajzilu... wa al-sar'u alladhina yatlubun al-ruqa` (and the epilepsy for which they seek incantations). And the things that distance them are the *ruqa* (incantations), meaning amulets. And `aza'im`, which is a type of amulet. `wa qira'at al-Qur'an` (and the recitation of the Quran). `fa yahrubuna` (so they flee). So they run away from there. `wa yansarifuna` (and they turn away), and they turn their face away. `wa la tazalu kullu suratin minhum ta'wi fi al-amakin al-wahsha` (and every form from them continues to take shelter in dreadful places). But it continues to happen that every dreadful form enters dreadful places. Meaning their place is these filthy places. `ma sha'a al-mudabbir` (as long as the Director wills). `thumma yas'adu ba'da dhalika` (then he ascends after that). Then they ascend after that. `ila dhanab al-shay'` (to the tail of the thing). And they are towards the tail, meaning the two knots (`ughdatayn`). *wa hiyya zulmah* (and it is a darkness). *tusamma al-dhanab wal-ra's* (it is called the tail and the head). `al-dhanab wal-ra's`. `kharijan 'an nitaq al-falak` (outside the sphere of the celestial orb). They are outside the sphere of the celestial orb. And... [unclear] `wa yatadhi` (and it is nourished)... *muthl al-qurud* (like monkeys), *wa al-kilab* (and dogs), *wa al-khanazir* (and pigs). `wa jumlatun... wa yasir fi sa'ir al-suwar al-madhmumah` (and he goes into all other blameworthy forms). Until they also enter into various animals. Becoming an animal. `thumma idha istawfa dhalik al-ajal kana fi barazikh al-najasat` (then when that term is fulfilled, he is in the isthmuses of impurity). Until when they complete the stages of their punishment, `thumma fi al-nabat`. Then they come in the form of a plant. *wa yasiru nabatan* (and it becomes a plant). And they become such a plant that is *samman qatilan* (a killing poison), which is poisonous and kills. `murran` (bitter), `muhlikan` (destructive). `wa kullama istahala wa tahayyama sara ila asfal min dhalika` (and whenever it transforms and wanders, it goes to something lower than that). And in this way, they also come into things lower than that, until they complete the parts of the plant's `barzakh`. `thumma yarji'u ila al-ma'dan`. Then they enter into minerals, `ajmal al-madhmumah` (the most blameworthy minerals). `mathal al-zaj` (like glass), `kibrit` (sulfur), `al-hadid` (iron), and `al-usas` (lead), brass. They come in these forms. `wa ma shakal al-wurud... thumma idha istawfa ma yastahiqqu min al-ma'dan` (and what forms the flowers... then when it fulfills what it deserves from the mineral realm). Until they also complete all the stages of the mineral realm. `wa qada bi-isti'adatih marrah ba'da marrah` (and it is decreed by its repetition time after time). And one state after another. `wa husulu hululihi fi surat al-haywan` (and the occurrence of its entry in the form of an animal). And after that their coming is in the form of an animal. `ay yakunu bi-istihalah wa al-wiladah kama la yara ahl al-tanasukh` (that it be through transformation and birth, not as the people of transmigration see). In this way, not in the way that the people of reincarnation (*tanasukh*) have this belief (`aqidah`), that *inna al-nafsa tantaqilu min jism al-mayyit 'inda mawtihi* (that the soul transfers from the body of the deceased at his death), that the soul of the deceased leaves his body and enters the body of another. So this belief of the people of *tanasukh* is not our belief. We have a different belief. `wa anna dhalika dalal` (and that is misguidance). And that belief is a misguiding belief, and it is ignorance. `la yajibu i'tiqaduhu bal halik` (it is not obligatory to believe it, rather one is destroyed). That it is not obligatory to believe in it, rather the one who believes in it is destroyed, and its believer is cursed. `thumma idha istawfa min 'adhabi fi hadha al-barazikh` (then when he is fulfilled from the punishment of this barzakh). When their punishments are completed. `wa hiyya al-'adhab al-adna` (and it is the lesser punishment). This is the lesser punishment. These are seven stages of punishment, which are the lesser punishments. So, `inhalla min akhirha` (it dissolves from its end). Until they reach the stage of the final punishment. `'inda qurb qiyam al-qa'im` (when the rising of the Qa'im is near). When the rising of the `Qa'im` is near. At that time, they will have endured all the stages of punishment. `thumma yulhaqu bil-sa'ir` (then it is joined with the fire). Then they are ground. `wa al-nabat` (and the plant). They come into the state of a plant. `wa yughtadha bihi min jinsihim` (and people of their kind are nourished by it). And then people of their kind eat those plants. From among humans. `wa kharaja shakhsan bashariyyan` (and a human person came out). And from them that human person is born. From eating that plant, that person is born. Then, `wa yuhsharu 'inda qiyam al-qa'im` (and he is gathered at the rising of the Qa'im). And then that person is made apparent at the time of the rising of the `Qa'im`. `wa yuwaffaqu 'ala ma salafa minhu` (and he is confronted with what proceeded from him). And the `Qa'im` tells him what things have proceeded from him. `wa yubakkituhu 'ala af'alihi` (and He rebukes him for his actions). And He rebukes him for his actions. *thumma yudhbah* (then he is slaughtered). Then he is slaughtered. `thumma tahriquhu al-nar` (then the fire burns him). And the fire burns him. `al-nazilah min al-athir` (that which descends from the ether). And that fire descends from the pure ether. `thumma yuslaqu bihi ba'da dhalika ila al-sijjin` (then he is led by it after that to Sijjin). And when this happens, they are brought towards `Sijjin`. Meaning, towards `Sakhar` (the rock). `wa yakhludu fi al-'adhab al-akbar` (and he abides in the greatest punishment). And then the greatest punishment, which is the punishment of `Sakhar`, which is a severe punishment, they are kept there. For the duration of the Great Cycle. `wa huwa thalathah alf mi'at alf sanah wa sittin wa alf sanah` (and that is three hundred thousand, one hundred thousand years and sixty and one thousand years). And that is 360,000 years.

At that time, no one will express remorse?

No, at that time there is no remorse. Those who are to go to the greatest punishment, there is no remorse then. Remorse is during the time of the lesser punishment. There is remorse in every *karr* (cycle). At every *ghark* (plunge), there is remorse. Here, *jaffa al-qalam* (the pen has dried), the matter is settled.

360,000 years multiplied by 360,000 years.

`A'adhana Allahu min dhalika` (May Allah protect us from that). May Allah protect us from all these things, `bi-hawlihi wa quwwatihi` (by His might and His power). `'ahd sayyidina Muhammad wa aalihi al-sifat al-'alin`. `hadha la yakunu illa 'ala al-azdad al-kibar` (this only happens to the great opposites). But the other people who are sinners, who are wicked, and who are evil. `wa amma kafat al-hamaj al-ri'a'` (and as for the generality of the rabble). And the general rabble. Meaning the ignorant people, who joined the evil ones like sheep. `fa-la yasiluna ila tilka bi-'inayat Allahi ta'ala` (so they do not reach that, by the care of Allah Ta'ala). So they do not receive this punishment. They do not get the greatest punishment. `li-annahu la yujaza kullu 'abdin bi-qadr fi'lihi` (because every servant is not recompensed except by the measure of his deed). But the deceased from the rabble, the ignorant people, when he dies, his soul spreads in his body. `wa lam yufariqhu illa al-hawaiyyah` (and nothing leaves him except the airy self). But from this one, the airy souls (`nufus-e-hawaiyya`) depart. `allati dhakartuha` (which I have mentioned). `thumma yatahallalu wa yasiru min al-barazikh al-madhkurah` (then it dissolves and proceeds from the mentioned isthmuses). Then until he reaches the mentioned isthmuses, meaning towards the lesser punishment. `fi ma yastahiqqu minha 'ala qadr 'amalihi` (in what it deserves from it according to the measure of its deed). As his deed is. `ay yastahiqqu ba'daha aw kullaha, thumma yarji'u sa'iran ila al-istihalah wa al-wiladah ila surat al-bashariyyah` (that it deserves some of it or all of it, then it returns, proceeding to the transformation and birth into a human form). Then he is also made to ascend, into a human form. `wa yu'radu 'alayhi al-da'wah` (and the mission is presented to him). And the noble mission is presented to him. Meaning, the noble covenant (`'ahd-e-sharif`) is presented. From the Imam. `fa in istajaba` (so if he responds). If he accepts, then he becomes pure. `wa illa radda ila ma yastahiqqu bi-iktisabihi` (and if not, he is returned to what he deserves because of his earnings). If not, then he is returned to what he deserves. `marratan thaniyah` (a second time). A second time also he is returned. After receiving punishment once, if he doesn't accept, he is again put into punishment. `li-anna Allah ta'ala 'adil` (because Allah Ta'ala is Just). Because Allah Ta'ala is Just. `la yazlimu al-'ibad` (He does not oppress the servants). He does not oppress His servants. `wa la yukhlifu al-mi'ad` (and He does not break the promise). And He does not go against His promise. `wa al-gharadu kulluhu fi nash'at al-khilqah` (and the entire purpose is in the genesis of creation). And the whole purpose is to give genesis to creation. Meaning to be born again. `wa istikhlasuha` (and its purification). And to give them salvation. Slowly, by presenting the mission to them, they should be given salvation. `mimma waqa'at fihi min al-khati'ah` (from the sin into which it has fallen). From the sins they have committed, they should be taken out of it. `wa inkar... wa man khalusa fa-sa'ida` (and denial... and whoever is purified, he is saved). And whoever becomes pure, he ascends. `wa man aba wa 'anada al-hudud ittukisa` (and whoever refuses and shows enmity to the Hudud, he is inverted). And whoever refuses and shows enmity to the *hudud*, he falls. `wa habata` (and he fell). And he falls from his rank. `haris ayyuha al-akh` (be eager, O brother). O my brother, become greedy for action. `wa al-takhallus` (and purification). And in purifying yourself. `wa al-takhaffuf min al-dhunub` (and lightening of sins). And in lessening the sins. `wa la takhtar bi-al-dunya` (and do not be deceived by the world). And do not be deceived by the world. `wa hiyya za'ilah` (for it is transient). For it is a transient world. `wa 'mal kama qala amir al-mu'minin salawatullahi 'alayh` (and act as the Commander of the Faithful, peace of Allah be upon him, has said). And act as the Commander of the Faithful, peace of Allah be upon him, has said. `takhaffafu talhaqu` (lighten yourselves and you will catch up). Lighten yourselves, and you will catch up. Meaning, lessen the weight of your sins, so that you may become worthy, for your high rank. `fa-innama yantaziru bi-awwalikum qudum akhirikum` (for the first of you are but awaiting the arrival of the last of you). For your first ones are waiting for the arrival of your last ones. Meaning your former self, that which has already passed, is waiting for you, that you may join it. `fa'lam dhalika wa hadha sirr al-malakut` (so know that, and this is the secret of the celestial realm). May Allah protect you. `illa ma dhakartu` (except what I have mentioned). ...what I have mentioned to you. `wa Allahu 'alayka shahid` (and Allah is a witness over you). And... fear... be afraid completely of transgressing in anything. `wa Allahu 'ala ma naqulu wakil` (and Allah is a guardian over what we say). And what we are saying, Allah is a guardian over it. Meaning, He is a witness. `waffaqana Allahu wa iyyakum li-mardatihi` (may Allah grant us and you success for His pleasure). May Allah grant us success, and you, that we may do what pleases Him. `wa khatama lana wa laka wa li-kaffat ikhwanina bi-khayr al-khatimah` (and may He seal for us, and for you, and for all of our brothers, with the best of endings).
