(And praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds, and His blessings be upon Muhammad and his family, the seal of the prophets, and upon 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, the noblest of successors, and the Imams from their progeny, the pure, the good, may the blessings of Allah be upon them all).

Have you mentioned that there are such people who then ascend and become `du'at`? Have you pinpointed any, who the `du'at` were?

Yes, yes. It's mentioned in a book. If you become... then I'll pinpoint it. Right now it's not in my mind. But it is mentioned that they reached the rank of `bab al-abwab`. And it's mentioned how much service they performed. For one... for thousands of years they performed service. After that, such purity was created in them that they reached that rank. And this is also there, isn't it, that the `du'at`, `ma'adhib`, and `hudud al-da'wah` who serve with sincerity, they are given the recompense that in their future cycles (`karrat`), they will attain high ranks. So, what is the criterion for becoming `ummahat al-a'immah` (mothers of Imams)? The mothers who are of the Imams, it's a matter of great honor, isn't it, to become the mother of an Imam. And she is infallible, and she is `batul`, meaning she does not have menstrual blood. She is pure and clean. So, the cause for them to become so, who are these women who become like this? It is said that `qad sabaqathunna al-khidam` (service has preceded them). That they are people who have performed much service in the times of the Imams. Those who performed extreme service are given the recompense that they become mothers of this kind. For example, Sayyidna Muhammad bin al-Walid, or Sayyidna Muhammad bin Fawad, who performed such services. So this... I'm giving an example, that such individuals who perform service are given great recompense.

In the next cycle (`wahdah`), like Salman, was he... will Salman's story be the same, that he will come from Fars, will be a non-Muslim, and in this way...

No, the template will be the same, but their succession (`khilafat`) is established. The one with whom the matter happened, he had veils (`hijabat`). The higher veil ascends. And that higher veil is called `muhtajib` (the veiled one). Meaning he becomes so high that he becomes a veil for other veils.

In the next cycle (`wahdah`), their excesses (`fuzalat`) are there, which... those who...

The `fuzalat` that will remain... that's how they will ascend.

Yes, their `fuzalat` that remain, the purified `fuzalat` ascend. The `fuzalat` that remain, they become their veils (`hijabat`) and appear.

He was born a Parsi in Fars. So what about his parents? Where was he brought from, and then from there...

Yes, yes. He came out in search of the truth. He... he came in search of the truth, and then somehow he reached...

He was hidden since childhood.

Yes, yes. In the apparent, this is the story, that he came in search of the truth, and somehow... and then you see, in the entire Makkan period of Rasulullah's life, Salman al-Farsi is not mentioned. When did he come? He came to Madinah al-Munawwarah. He came around 2 Hijri. Two Hijri. And after coming, the progress he made was such that `Salman minna Ahl al-Bayt` (Salman is from us, the Ahl al-Bayt) was said.

He was very intelligent.

`Salman minna Ahl al-Bayt` was said. And he was brought as a slave. And Rasulullah... he was brought in a caravan as a slave. And Rasulullah freed him from slavery. That is, the Jewish man he was with, he made a deal with him, and 300 date palms... he planted 300 date palms, and then the Muslims planted 300, and then a lot of gold was also given. Gold was also given. And he saw the signs in Rasulullah, that he accepts a gift but does not eat charity. And on your back, there is the seal of prophethood. These three signs were there. So when you came, someone gave you a gift of dates. So you asked that person, "What is this?" He said, "This is a gift in your service." So you ate it yourself and also gave it to the companions. Then, two or three days later, it happened that a person came, he had brought a bundle of dates. And you asked, "What is this?" He said, "This is my `zakat`." So you recited the du'a, because the Qur'an commands: `khudh min amwalihim sadaqatan tutahhiruhum wa tuzakkihim biha wa salli 'alayhim inna salataka sakanun lahum` (Take, [O, Muhammad], from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them increase, and invoke [Allah's blessings] upon them. Indeed, your invocations are a source of reassurance for them). The term `salli 'alayhim` means "pray for them," not "send salutations upon them." That your praying for him is a source of tranquility for him. For whom is it a source of tranquility? For that person, for his family, for his form. It is a source of tranquility for all. So, he recited the du'a and asked, "What is this?" The man said, "This is `zakat`." So you distributed that `zakat`. So Salman was watching all this. Because the Ahl al-Bayt do not eat `zakat`. Zakat is filth (`mayl`). It is filth, and the Ahl al-Bayt are pure and clean, they do not eat filth. But, I was asked whether we can eat the meat of a `sadaqah` goat. I said, "Are you Ahl al-Bayt?" You can eat the meat of a `sadaqah` goat. Even if it's your own `sadaqah` goat, or a goat for a vow (`nadhr`), a person can eat it himself and distribute it to others. There is no problem with that. However, for the goat of `'aqiqah`, one should be careful that its bones are not broken. And the second thing to be careful about is that if she is the mother, the mother is breastfeeding the child, and it is not permissible for the child, the one for whom the `'aqiqah` is, it is not permissible for him. Now, that meat, the child will not eat because he is only a few days old. So if the mother eats it, it will reach him through the mother's milk. His share of the `'aqiqah` will reach him. Therefore, the mother should not eat it either. From this perspective. If the mother is not breastfeeding him, she can eat it. But mothers mostly breastfeed. So she should not eat it. Because it is not permissible for the child. Just as during Hajj, the meat of our obligatory sacrifice, we cannot eat it. One cannot eat it oneself. But if it's a voluntary sacrifice, a voluntary Hajj, then one can eat one's own meat as well. In a voluntary one. But for the obligatory one, it is necessary that... one has to be very careful during Hajj. That the meat of the obligatory sacrifice should be kept separate. One has to act according to that procedure.

I had two questions. Yes. You just mentioned that because of their good deeds (`hasanat`) and services (`khidmat`), they will become `Umm al-A'immah`. So, is it... for them or anyone else, is it possible for a man to become a woman, or a woman to become a man, in the cycles (`karrat`)? In one cycle he is a man, and in another cycle he is...

Yes. In one cycle a person came as a man. As you mentioned, through service, she becomes `Umm al-A'immah`. So is it... does this happen for anyone, that a man becomes a woman or a woman becomes a man?

No, it is a rare case. This... `istisna'` (exceptional) case... an exceptional case, it's a very rare case. But this... what happens to their case then... for cycles upon cycles... they will remain women, or... No, I haven't read about this, but the thing is, there is no degradation in them becoming a woman from a man. Rather, they have attained very high ranks. They have made great progress. As it is said for Sayyidna Sulayman bin Hasan, that in the next cycles (`karrat`), he will become Mawlatuna Zaynab. So, there are various such cases, through which their good deeds are fulfilled.

My second question is that we have learned about the believers, and then about the disobedient ones who were completely evil, `azdad`, or lesser `azdad`. They had stubbornness, of course. But what about a common Muslim who takes the name of Allah and the Prophet, prays... what will be their case?

Their... their... the common Muslims, even if they take the name of Allah and the Prophet, pray, perform Hajj, but if they have not taken the noble covenant (`'ahd-e-sharif`), what happens is that their soul becomes widespread in their body. And because of this spreading, they feel the punishments. And their evil conception, meaning the conception they hold of not accepting Sayyidna 'Ali as the successor or deputy of Rasulullah, and their love for others, all this is their evil conception. So that... that evil conception separates from them, and it wanders. Yes. But their condition is not like that of other infidels and polytheists. There is a difference between the condition of infidels and polytheists and the condition of Muslims. And among them, those who are noble Muslims, who have lived a pure and clean life, they are called `sulaha` (righteous) and `'afifa` (chaste). So these chaste people are given the opportunity to enter through the noble covenant. Meaning, they come and enter the lowest ranks of the believers and become part of the faith. And it happens very quickly. Their case is settled very quickly. From `sulaha` and `'afifa`, they very quickly enter the fold of faith.

When we were in Madinah al-Munawwarah for `hijrat`, at `jannat al-qiyari`. There, we used to enter `jannat al-qiyari` very easily. So Sayyidna sahib came, Sayyidna Husayn bin Hasan. And he also came and sat in the `qiyari`. So we were sitting in your vicinity. Me and Asad bhai. So then, a person who was perhaps ahead of us, in the row in front, he asked us, "Who is this Mawlana, who has such a luminous quality? And when he arrived, everyone stood up. And we also saw, what a luminous quality he has." Sayyidna Husayn bin Hasan. So we said, "Yes, he is one of our elders. And we study with him." I mentioned it in this way. Anyway, after that happened, after a little while, Sayyidna sahib asked us, `hadha min al-`afif` (this one is from the chaste). This person who was talking to you, he was from the `'afif`. Meaning, he was such a person that soon he would enter the fold of faith. From `sulaha` to `'afif`. Now, the `Da'i` makes these indications. He knows all these things. So there are various such states, `sulaha`, `'afifa`.

Hazrat Qaid Johar Mukhlesin had said in Kuwait, the one who had given the land... Yes, yes. About Hasan Molen. Yes, Hasan Molen. He said `sulaha` and `'afif` for him. Yes.

In the *hadith* it says that the contemplation a human being does, if his thought is correct, then his thought is greater than 50 years of his worship. If he is contemplating on the Divine Sciences, on the verses of the Holy Quran, and his thought, the direction of his thought, is absolutely correct, then his, that is a great worship. Because intellectual worship, the intellectual form, is greater than the practical form. And knowledge has great importance, that any Prophet, Allah Ta'ala did not make him ignorant. Meaning, knowledge became a cause for their making. Be it any Prophet, or any *da'i*, or whoever are the *hudud-e-'aliyah*, the thing of honor and distinction within them is knowledge. so they were incapable of perceiving it. And they are incapable of perceiving it. so he negated divinity from it. Thus, they negated divinity from it. From it, meaning the First Intellect itself negated divinity from its own self. and from the members of its own kind. and from the members of its own kind. That this divinity, which is the quality of bringing from non-existence to existence, it is neither in it nor in the members of its kind. and he bore witness of that for its Originator. And he gave testimony that this attribute, the attribute of divinity, belongs to its Originator. So through this act, it deserved to be named 'First'. And because of this act, because it adopted firstness, did it not, in this thought, therefore it was given the name First. and Precedent. First Intellect, that is. and Precedently. the First Precedent. In this way. And it is what is named the First Intellect and the First Originated. `Aql-e-Awwal` (First Intellect) it was called, and `Mubda'-e-Awwal` (First Originated). Meaning, the Originator, *Subhanahu*, is that Being who originated. And this is the originated. And among the originated things, it became the `Mubda'-ul-Awwal` (the First Originated). Meaning, it is the first person who kept a clean and pure thought. and by the First Originated, it became. and by the Pen. And it became the Pen. Yes. Then, indeed, there flowed to it... from its Originator, exalted and high is He... Yes. In the Holy Quran, an oath has been taken by Allah Ta'ala of the Pen: `Nun wa-l-qalam wa ma yasturun` (Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe). First, before the Pen, `Nun` is mentioned. Meaning, the Pen, which is the `Aql-e-Awwal` (First Intellect), the substance it received from the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`... it was given precedence. And then the `Aql-e-Awwal` was mentioned by Allah Ta'ala. Then, indeed, there flowed to it from its Originator, exalted and high is He... which was specified for it to the exclusion of the rest of the members of its kind. and such a substance, such a help, which became specified for it, leaving aside the other members of its kind. Meaning, it specifically received help. Yes. as a recompense for it... as a recompense for it. And this reward was given to it because of its thought and its firstness, this reward was given to it. for its professing of oneness (*tawhid*), its glorification (*tasbih*), and its acknowledgment of divinity. that the *tawhid* that was issued from it... the *tawhid* it professed of the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`, and its glorification, and it acknowledged divinity. Just as... `Shahidallahu annahu la ilaha illa hu` (Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him). So it acknowledged the Spirit... so because of that, the honor it attained, so that substance was made to flow upon it from the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`. for the originated. for the originated. So through that matter, it became aware of the knowledge of what has been and what will be. and because of which, because of this substance, it... it became aware of what has been and what will be. Meaning, it obtained this knowledge. Because of that substance which it received from the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`. You mean the previous... the previous one? The previous one, so what, what... The previous one, which previous one? Previous, meaning its... this... its... its... We are not talking about the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`. The knowledge it obtained from the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`... the attainment of that knowledge, its... its... the substance that it is getting, of what nature it is, it came to know that. `ma kana` from `wa-ma sa-yakun`. So... the knowledge that was to come, whatever was to happen, it had knowledge of that? Yes. So why didn't it... At that time, we who are stuck, having come into this... so why didn't it stop at that time? No, that would have... The `jabr` (compulsion) would have... That was a matter of `ikhtiyar` (free will). `jabr` would have happened, no? If it had stopped it, then `jabr` would have happened. Therefore, there was `ikhtiyar`. The three things that were given... But my saying this means that what was going to happen, it knew that this was going to happen. Yes, absolutely. That all this will happen, this mistake will be made and... so... the world will be created. Let alone the matter of the `Aql-e-Awwal`, for the `Ashir` (the Tenth) it has been said, `Zalika Taqdir-ul-'Aziz-il-'Alim` (That is the decree of the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing). In Surah Yasin. This matter was in its decree, of the `Aziz-ul-'Alim` (the Mighty, the All-Knowing). That this... this group that has denied and has not acknowledged... so what he said, `Ihbitu minha jami'an` (Descend from it, all of you), you all will have to fall. This that is... the `Alam-e-Latafat` (World of Subtlety) is, you will have to go into the `Alam-e-Kathafat` (World of Density), and after being purified there, here you will have to ascend through the intellect. So this that... so its knowledge, that this group that is, which... has acquired physicality, so in purifying this physicality, how many `mawr` will it take, and in a `mawr` how many `qawr` will there be, and in a `qawr` how many `dawr` will there be, and in a `dawr` how many `sitr` and `kashf` will there be, it obtained the knowledge of all those things. This is a matter of the `Ashir` (the Tenth). So this is much higher than the `Ashir`. It made no mistake at all. And it... directly... received it from the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`. No intermediary was there either. Its quality is very high. One thing is that... in the `arwah` (spirits) there was, there was also a negativity present in them? Yes, meaning... Positive is there... good, it is good... No, the three things... But there was negativity in them too. No, it wasn't negativity. The three, three things that were given to them... `Hayat` (life)... meaning `hayat` means in the most excellent state. In the most excellent state they were created, that there was no flaw of any kind. Rather, in the most excellent state, they were created. After that... `ilm` (knowledge) was given. That knowledge of everything was given to them. Of evil and of good. And power was given, that how they should use it. Their own... their own quality... power was given that how they should use this knowledge, their own life. Its complete... complete freedom was given by Allah Ta'ala. Because of that same freedom, their ranks were established. They moved forward, ranking happened, they became the pillars of the *da'wah*, because of this very thing. So these `arwah` that fell, they did not have this knowledge? They had it... that we will fall and this will be our state here. No, it... it... because the knowledge... the knowledge of all... Yes, that too was there... that too was there. Meaning, they were denying, denying the `Ashir` (the Tenth), it... they also had its knowledge, that if we deny, then... look in our own world, we are aware of all things, that we will get the reward for our good deeds in paradise, or our ranks will be high, or we will go to hell because of our bad deeds. Despite that, despite knowing, how many people do bad deeds? In our own life, look, no? That... we all know this. The... the evil... even among believers, you see, many believers who are... who adopt the path of waywardness. Don't they know? Don't they listen to sermons and advice? Don't they listen to gatherings? Despite that, waywardness is created in them. But that is because we have come into density, that's why all this... We have come into density, that's why all these things have come upon us. There it was a completely transparent matter. No, it was a transparent matter, but they had free will, no? Because of this free will, their ranks were established. Because look, among creations, who... who has free will? Only human beings have free will. And why do they have it? Because they were given physicality. There too, when they got physicality, when length, width, and depth came, and physicality came, at that time they had the choice of how to do it. And within that same choice, they also showed remorse, and they came into confirmation, and they also persisted. Yes. A small, small point arises here. When in the world of materiality, here a being of an Imam who is, he is the most noble for us. In the world of materiality. And we say that the being of the Imam is infallible, he cannot make a mistake at all, there is no possibility. So when the being of the Imam cannot make a mistake, its possibility is not there, then that is the World of Spirits. That is the World of Spirits. It is much higher. So there, there, the possibility of a mistake or not making a mistake, no question arises at all. No, but a mistake was made, no? They did not accept the word... they did not accept the word of the `Ashir` (the Tenth), despite his explaining. The delusion of equality that happened, that too is outside the realm of possibility, isn't it? No, the delusion of equality happened, so this... this that is... things were apparent on it. It... from it... just as it has been said, it had a delusion of equality, so a mistake occurred from it. It did not do it intentionally. Intentionally, its delusion of equality did not happen. And it did not persist in it. The `Munba'ith-e-Thani` (the Second Emitted one) did not persist in it. That whatever I did, I did better, it was not like that. It... it... its... when it realized that its rank was falling and that luminosity was not being created which is in my remaining intellects, then in the end, it... the ninth intellect's last person... from the last, last, last intellect, from the ninth, ninth circle's last intellect, it asked that what is the matter? I do not have this quality that is in you people. So then it said that this... you... the delusion of equality that you had, with your superior, from the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal` (the First Emitted one), so because of that this quality came in you. Yes. So therefore, it... when it acknowledged... its own mistake, it acknowledged it... and so it interceded for it. It interceded... with its higher... with the intellect before it. To the extent that its intercession, moving forward and forward, reached the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`. And the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal` forgave it. Yes. This has been said in the Holy Quran. It has been mentioned. Yes, sir, the `Aql-e-Awwal`'s, which is... the knowledge of `ma kana wa sa-yakun`, and the knowledge of the other intellects is... in that, just... in that, what is the difference? A clear difference. Of both? There is a very clear difference. The `Aql-e-Awwal`'s... the knowledge of `ma kana wa sa-yakun` and that of the remaining intellects, there is a very big difference in them. In appearance it is called the knowledge of `ma kana wa sa-yakun`, but each intellect's knowledge of `ma kana wa sa-yakun` is different. And it was distinguished by its honor, by its honor, and by the majesty and the greatness over the entire world of origination. and it became distinguished with that honor which it received because of that substance. And majesty and greatness were attained over the entire world of origination. On the world of origination, which... what is the world of origination? It is the intellects. Meaning, there is no such world in which Allah Ta'ala created the originated things. The world of origination, they are the intellects. Yes. Just as it is generally also that where is the spiritual world? It is conceived that it is upwards. The spiritual world is not upwards, rather it is all around us. All around us is the spiritual world. It is not that it is above us. and by that, it deserved... and by that, it deserved that the name of divinity should fall upon it. and it became deserving through that... In the world, they considered it above the throne, didn't they? It is not so. The spiritual world, what is it? the `Ashir`... above the `Ashir`... the `Ashir`... including the `Ashir`, above the `Ashir`, whatever there is, is the spiritual world. The spiritual world is that where there is the world of intellects. This other one who says that this `hayula` that is, which fell, it is equal to a dot in the World of Spirits. Yes. It is a dot. That World of Spirits is spread everywhere. And that dot is in the middle that is there. It is `hayula`. Yes. and it is that we are present in it. Yes, yes. And by that, it deserved... and it became deserving... the first... that the name of divinity should fall upon it, that the name of Allah should come upon it. for two reasons. for two reasons. One of them, one of them is that it became lost in love and bewildered in the perception of its Originator. that it became bewildered and perplexed, meaning stupefied, in perceiving its Originator. Meaning, what is the Originator like, what is it, since when is it, how is it, and why did it do it, in this matter, from perceiving it, it... it became bewildered within it. and it became incapable... and then after being bewildered, what happened? It became incapable of that thing. The incapacity to perceive Him is itself perception. The incapacity to perceive Him is itself perception. The great Amir al-Mu'minin says. The incapacity to perceive Him is itself perception. that to become incapable... Allah's... of attaining Allah, to become incapable of attaining is itself perception. Yes. In the Holy Quran also, that is, two aspects have been mentioned. `jahidu`... `jahidu`... One is `jihad`... `jihad` `fi-llahi`, `wa jahidu`... `jihad` is of two types, from the perspective of the Holy Quran. What word has been used for it? One is `jihad`... `jihad` is, and `wa jahidu fi-llahi` (and strive in the way of Allah), in Allah... do `jihad` within Allah. So what is `jihad` with Allah? It is the gnosis of the *hudud* of the *da'wah*. That is doing `jihad` within Allah. So for this reason the name of Allah came upon it. And the second reason, the second reason is that the entire world of origination (`ibda'`) was lost in love for it and was bewildered in its majesty and its greatness. that the entire `alam-e-ibda'` (world of origination), the world of intellects, was itself bewildered about it and stupefied at its majesty and greatness. with which it was specified. that which it was specified with, meaning the substance and the help from Allah that it was receiving... They were bewildered about the `Aql-e-Awwal` (First Intellect). Yes, about the `Aql-e-Awwal`, they were bewildered, the intellects of the `alam-e-ibda'` (world of origination). by what was of its action. that what did it do that this virtue was attained by it from the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`. And it is also named by divinity. not for its bewilderment and its longing... for the perception of the majesty of its Originator... to perceive the majesty of its Originator... and its incapacity, which returns from that. that its incapacity, it was making it turn back from its perception. So all that we have mentioned, the name of divinity fell upon it. and whatever we have mentioned, it is manifest upon it, the name of divinity. The name of Allah comes upon it. And it is eternal in its ultimate end, not eternal in its beginning. It is eternal in its ultimate end. and not eternal in its beginning. Now this is a thing to understand, that what does it mean? It is eternal in its ultimate end, not eternal in its beginning. Allah knows best what its meaning is. Then, when there appeared to him... when there appeared to it, for this great `hadd`, two forms from those forms, so he looked with his gaze, and he negated divinity from their two beings and from the members of their two kinds. And... for us, in the physical world, Rasulullah is at the station of the `Aql-e-Awwal`. Rasulullah... And therefore, just as from the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`... inspiration came upon the `Aql-e-Awwal` and substance came, in the same way, revelation came upon Rasulullah from Allah's side. Yes. And then from that revelation, the perfections you achieved... and then the perfections that Amir al-Mu'minin himself had, you could not attain those perfections directly. For every perfection, for every miracle, for every state, the intermediary was Rasulullah. Rasulullah was the intermediary for you in everything. The... Did revelation not come to other prophets? Yes, it did, it came to them... But not to Mawla 'Ali? No, it did not come to him. And Mawla 'Ali also, in every deed, he explained it through your intermediary. To the people whom he explained, it was, "I received it from Rasul." Yes, absolutely. And what love there must have been, Rasul to you and you to Rasul. Meaning, never any opposition is seen. And you also see what a perfection it is that whatever Rasulullah said for Janab 'Ali, that 'Ali is like this, 'Ali is like that, he is truthful, he is trustworthy, he pays debts, and he is brave. So, the Prophet did say this, but Janab 'Ali has to fulfill that word. And he has to uphold the weight of the Prophet's word. This was the real thing. And he showed it by doing it. That what the Prophet... what was said for you, that `Wa amma bi-ni'mati rabbika fa-haddith` (But as for the favor of your Lord, report it). That you should narrate the favor of your Lord. Meaning, your Lord is Janab Abu Talib, his favor is Janab 'Ali. Mention him. Therefore, Janab Nabi 'alayhissalam, for him, he began to narrate thousands, lakhs of hadiths. People were astonished. Yes. So, in that, Janab 'Ali fulfilled all those things. Whatever the Prophet had said, he proved it. So that the weight of the Prophet's word would not fall. So what a perfection this is. His... the perfections were latent in him, weren't they? Yes, the perfections were latent in him, in their own place. Yes, definitely. He was infallible from there itself, so no mistake could have... Yes, it could not have happened. And then his `muhtajib` (veiled one) was also, he had a great status, no? Because of his `muhtajib`, this quality was created in the veil. And this was the seventh manifestation of the Era of Concealment. Due to the seventh manifestation, the quality is also very high. Yes. And then this also happened, that all... you became the `miqat` (appointed time/place) of the first and the last. All the first ones who had passed. And then not just of this era, but of the previous era. Because this `Qa'im` who is coming, seven eras of manifestation and seven eras of concealment of yours are going to be gathered. So that gathering, seven eras of concealment and seven eras of manifestation's gathering, and this is the last concealment. Meaning, before this, seven manifestations have passed and six concealments have passed. And this is the seventh concealment. So in this concealment, the stations that are there, meaning the pure Imams, the stations that are there, the collection of all of them was with Janab 'Ali. And those stations... the word `maqam` (station) for whom does it come? It comes for three people. Imam, and `Wasi` (Successor), and Prophet. These three things, the station for... So as many stations as there are, in them the Imams came to you. The `Quwwam` and Imams gathered with you. And the Prophets, all of them, gathered with Janab Nabi. You became the leader of the `mustawdi'in` (the entrusted ones). For which it was said that the `Qa'im` of the family of Ishaq was a prophet, and the `Qa'im` of the family of Isma'il was Janab 'Ali. Yes. And you can imagine that of seven manifestations and seven concealments, including this concealment, from Janab Hunaif to Janab 'Ashir, and from Janab Hasan to the future `al-Qa'im`, that entire gathering was gathered with you. So what is the status and greatness of yours? And just as a `Bab-ul-Abwab` (Gate of Gates) gathers, so you became the `Bab-ul-Abwab` for the `Qa'im`, in that rank you stood. And that gathering, you will hand it over. Yes. You mean, he even gathered the `Qa'im`s of the seven manifestations and six concealments? Yes, he gathered the `Quwwam` (Pillars) too. What is meant is that the `Qa'im`s who... were partial. But he is also a `Qa'im`. You gathered the `Quwwam` too. Then, when there appeared to him, when there appeared to it, for this great `hadd`, two forms. in those two forms. For this great `hadd`, meaning for the `Aql-e-Awwal` (First Intellect), there was contemplation that how this quality came to be in the `Aql-e-Awwal`. from those forms. From those sources. so he looked with his gaze. So both of them looked like his gaze. Just as he had thought, in the same way, they thought. Yes. and divinity was negated from their two beings. And they negated divinity from their own being. Meaning, they acknowledged this fact that the power to bring from non-existence to existence is not in us. so this was a clean and pure thought. and from the members of their two kinds. and from the members of their two kinds, they also negated it, that our companions also do not have this attribute, that they can originate (`ibda'`). Yes. and they acknowledged for their two Originators. And both of them acknowledged, the two rising intellects acknowledged for their Originator that this attribute is in their Originator. and they both bore witness for him. and both of them bore witness for him, meaning for the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`. by that, they professed his oneness and glorified him. and they glorified him, that is, they performed his glorification. and they acknowledged the Precedent over them both. And their own Precedent was also acknowledged, meaning the `Aql-e-Awwal`. that upon them... he has become superior to them. with virtue and honor. and with honor. that virtue and the honor of precedence have been attained by him. So by their action, those two were named Emitted ones. Therefore, these two were called `munba'ith` (emitted ones). rising ones. from the movement of the `Aql-e-Awwal`, emission was created in them. The forms that arose, were they individual? There was no other... no group with them. No, there was no group included. just as the `Aql-e-Awwal`'s also... the form is, it is one... Yes. Although, in the `munba'ithayn` (the two emitted ones), later additions were made. Yes. But the `Aql-e-Awwal`'s form, it remained a single form. Later also, meaning, no gathering was collected in it. The ascending intellect from below did not gather with it. This is why it has been said in the Holy Quran in Surah Ikhlas: `Qul huwa-Llahu ahad` (Say, He, Allah, is One). He is unique. Generally, `wahid` is translated as one, that Allah is one, but the correct translation is that he is unique. Yes. those two Emitted ones. because they both... because they both were emitted, following the First, in its action and in its deed. But one of them was precedent over the other. But this was the thing, that among them one was ahead of the other. Precedent. towards that glorification and that oneness. in that glorification that they were doing, and the oneness they were professing, and the sanctification they were doing, whose? Of the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`. In that, one was ahead. So he deserved by his precedence... that the `Aql-e-Awwal`, the Precedent... for him, a gate and a veil. Therefore, he became deserving, he who had gone ahead in glorification, sanctification, and oneness from the other, that the `Aql-e-Awwal`, he should appoint him as his gate and veil. so that he may address through him those who are below him and aid him with the substance. and he should help him with his substance, which had flowed to it from its Originator. that which he had received from the Originator, that substance. by which he was honored over the second emitted one. that because of which he became honored over the `Munba'ith-e-Thani` (the second emitted one). and all the members of his kind. and he knew by that what was and what will be. And this `Munba'ith-e-Awwal` (the first emitted one)... The `Aql-e-Awwal`'s knowledge of what was and what will be is different, and this `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`'s knowledge of what was and what will be is different. And it is what is named the Universal Soul. And it was named `Nafs-e-Kulliyyah` (Universal Soul). and the First Emission. and the First Emission it was called. and the Tablet. and it was also called `lawh` (tablet). Meaning, the pen is for the `Aql-e-Awwal`, and the tablet on which Allah... the `Aql-e-Awwal` poured its matter, that was the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`. So that is the pen, and this is the tablet. And the `Munba'ith-e-Thani` did not acknowledge the virtue of precedence of the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`. of the `Awwal`. that he is precedent. And he deluded himself that he was equal to him. And he deluded himself and understood that both of them are equal, equal. so that became a mistake. a mistake that he acquired. and he was delayed from his rank. and his rank fell. and it was a fall from his station. and he fell down. Then the `Aql-e-Awwal` called the entire world of origination (`ibda'`) to the oneness of their Originator and His glorification. And the `Aql-e-Awwal` gave the call, it gave a call to all the world of origination towards the oneness of their Originator and His glorification. This is how it is. The `Aql-e-Awwal` did not give the call. It never gave the call. Because if the `Aql-e-Awwal` gave the call, then because of its call, intellects would gather in it. The `Aql-e-Awwal` never gave the call. That is why it is said, so his call for them... the calling of the `Aql-e-Awwal` for them, meaning for its own kind, was through the First Emitted one. through the First Emitted one. Meaning, the `Aql-e-Awwal` is giving the call, but it is not giving the call by itself. Through the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`, it gave the call. Because it did not initiate the call. The initiation of the call happened from the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`. Therefore, all the intellects that have come into the world of intellects, their progress will be, and from the physical world, the intellects that will become, Imam, `Qa'im`, `jussa` becoming intellects, which will move forward, the return of all of them will be to the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`. Not to the `Aql-e-Awwal`. So two, two circles will remain. One, the `Aql-e-Awwal`, and one, the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`. All will merge into it, into the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`. They will merge into the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`. To the extent that it has been said that Shaytan also will merge into the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`, one day. And this is what in the Holy Quran, in Surah Fatiha, the last word is `al-dallin` (those who have gone astray). In `al-dallin`, the dot of the `nun` in `dallin`, it points towards Shaytan. that it will come into the circle. It will come into the circle. After misleading the entire community, it will ultimately repent. and will come into the circle. Meaning, in the last `mawr`. In the last `mawr`. It will gradually come into the Imam's `haykal`, etc., just as... just as it will be. But it will repent. In the end. It will be the last one to ascend, but... In the Imam's `haykal`... Yes, so... it will be alone. No, not alone. The others who will be with it... But this is that in the end, it will repent. Sir, at this station, what is the meaning of `da'wah` (call)? Is it only to acknowledge the `Mubdi' Ta'ala` and... that is it, right? Meaning, the meaning of `da'wah` is... Yes, meaning to acknowledge the `Mubdi' Ta'ala` and to acknowledge the `Aql-e-Awwal`. Yes. And the `Munba'ith-e-Awwal`, to acknowledge that this order has been established. It called towards that. Yes. Because, that is, those who denied the `da'wah`, from their denial, it becomes known what kind of `da'wah` it was. Because the deniers, what did they do? They said, "We neither accept you, nor those before you." So they denied the `da'wah` of the `Ashir` (the Tenth). But this happened, that those who fell, they did not deny the `Mubdi' Ta'ala`. That is why, that is why, in a disbeliever also, in a polytheist also, that particle of oneness exists. Because of which the hope is formed that he will come towards faith. Rasulullah also tried, that you, he tried that as soon as possible, they should come into the circle of faith. What is the Divine Power saying? That you... you cannot make anyone a believer. You cannot bring them into the circle of faith, until Allah wills. So Rasulullah also cannot guide anyone, until Allah wills. This has been made clear in the Holy Quran. whom He had made for him a gate and a veil. and He answered him from those forms which were preceded by the originated. The difficult topics that are there, the difficult topic is how the celestial spheres, attributes, and so on were formed from the `hayula`. That topic is a bit intricate. Is Shaytan identified as just one? Yes, the one who opposed the `Ashir` (the Tenth). He was one. He was one. Yes. And that was the spiritual Iblis. And those who followed him, all of them are in this world, they are behind him. Yes, they are behind him. And his agents were established. Just as among the followers of the `Ashir`, there were the remorseful ones, and among the remorseful ones there were Imams, `Quwwam`, and their followers, in the same way, of that Shaytan, that Shaytan, his... his agents were formed... his followers, in them, that quality was created. O Allah, make this reading of the *Fatiha* reach the soul of our master and our Mawla, `al-Mu'ayyad Fi-d-dinillah` Ibn Musa al-Shirazi, may Allah sanctify his noble and illumined soul. And make its blessings, ranks, and confirmations apparent to us. And accept from us this reading and this benefiting in the best way that can be. By the right of the master of the messengers and the successor of our master, Amir al-Mu'minin, and the Great Quran and the pure and purified Ahl al-Bayt, may the blessings and peace of Allah be upon them all. Al-Fatiha. Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim. By the grace of Sayyidna al-Mawla al-Musun al-Atlaq in the island of the Yemenite `da'wah`. For the honor of the noble, learned, and great Prophet, al-Haj Ashraf son of Husamuddin Ghulam Husain son of Sayyidna al-Mutlaq al-Muqaddas, and his father Sayyidna 'Abd-ul-'Ali son of Haybatullah son of Muhammad Husain al-Muqaddas `quddisa sirruhu`. May Allah elevate his station and may `al-Mawla Ta'ala` protect him and guard him and grant him success in fulfilling the desires of the `mumlakah` of his `shuyukh`. May `al-Mawla Ta'ala` make him triumphant over the people of his era. From the evil of the eclipses, and the misfortunes, and the divisions, and the calamities of the events and the passing of days and months. May He protect him and aid him and his affair. And may He cause the flag of the `da'wah` to wave, and protect him in the divine, spiritual protection. May `al-Mawla Ta'ala` lengthen his life and elevate his station and ranks, and may He make us and you among those who attain his `da'wat` and his service, and grant us and you the gnosis of his worth. By the right of the master of the messengers, Sayyidna, our Mawla, Amir al-Mu'minin, and the pure Ahl al-Bayt, may the blessings and peace of Allah be upon them all. Al-Fatiha. Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim.

*Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim*, and blessings of Allah upon His Messenger, Sayyidina Muhammad, and upon the family of Muhammad, and may He grant peace.

Then, the First Intellect (`'aql al-awwal`) called the entire World of Origination (`'alam al-ibda'`) to the Oneness (`tawhid`) of their Originator (`mubdi'`) and to His glorification (`tasbih`). Then, the First Intellect (`'aql al-awwal`) gave an invitation (`da'wat`) to the entire World of Origination (`'alam al-ibda'`) towards the Oneness (`tawhid`) of their Originator (`mubdi'`) and towards their glorification (`tasbih`). And his invitation to them was through the First Emanated Being (`munba'ith al-awwal`). And his invitation (`du'a`) was through the First Emanated Being (`munba'ith al-awwal`). He did not invite them directly. `Du'a` means `da'wah` (invitation).

And he had made him a gate (`bab`) and a veil (`hijab`) for himself. While he had already made him his gate (`bab`) and veil (`hijab`). So seven intellects (`saba' 'uqul`) from those originated forms (`suwar al-mubda'a`) responded to him. And when he made the call (`da'wat`), then they said "Labbayk" (Here I am at your service), they accepted the invitation, from those new forms, which were originated (`mubda'at`), seven intellects (`'uqul`) from among them. Each one of them after the second. And this happened one after the other. They kept happening one after the other.

And under each intellect from them, from those originated forms (`suwar al-mubda'a`), is a world whose number cannot be counted. And with every intellect is such a vast multitude from those originated forms (`suwarat-e-mubda'at`) that its number cannot be known or encompassed.

So that intellect is like an Imam for them. And that intellect, under which all these forms were, that intellect became an Imam for them. And the chief (`ra'is`). And they became its chiefs (`ra'is`). And the model (`qudwah`). And their, ah, their, the one whose example is followed. Due to its precedence over them. Because its precedence has been established over them. Just as in Surah Waqi'ah it is said: `al-sabiqun al-sabiqun, ula'ika al-muqarrabun` (The forerunners, the forerunners, those are the ones brought near). That those who were to precede have preceded, and they are the ones brought near [to God]. So precedence (`sabaqiyat`) is a great thing. Yes.

Just as it is said that in the beginning, the people who brought faith (`iman`), then those who brought faith later cannot attain their spiritual state, even though they may perform much more worship (`ibadat`), those who come later, and perform many more good deeds, they will do good deeds, but they cannot attain their spiritual state, which belongs to the early people of faith and the early community of believers (`mu'minin`).

And they are like followers (`atba'`) to him. One is `ittiba'`, `ittiba'` means to follow. And `atba'` means followers. They were his followers, for that intellect. And those who follow (`muqtadin`). And they were those who followed the example. With what, uh, with him. Of his, his. So the ranks (`maratib`) of the World of Origination (`'alam al-ibda'`) became nine. So, in this way, the ranks (`maratib`) of the World of Origination (`'alam al-ibda'`) became nine. The First Intellect (`'aql al-awwal`), the First Emanation (`anbiya' al-awwal`), and the seven responding intellects (`saba' 'uqul al-mujiba`) to the call (`da'wah`). That first, there was the First Intellect, then the First Emanation after it, and then there were seven intellects after that. And then this impression continued forever. Just as there was Rasulullah, then Mawla-e-Ka'inat, and then seven A'imma Tahirin. In this way.

Just as when we perform `tawaf`, uhm, then there are seven rounds (`ashwat`). And the `tawaf` of seven rounds (`ashwat`) is not accepted until two `rak'ats` of prayer are offered at Maqam Ibrahim. So offering two `rak'ats` of prayer at Maqam Ibrahim is superior to those seven rounds (`ashwat`), seven `rak'ats`, seven `tawafs`. So those two `rak'ats` that are offered at Maqam Ibrahim are for the First Intellect and the First Emanated Being. And the seven `rak'ats`, in one sense, the seven, seven `tawafs`, they are for the seven intellects. In this way.

Are you not talking about the `'Ashir` (the tenth) in this? The `'Ashir` is the one who is performing the `tawaf`. The one who is striving (`sa'i`), the one who is making an effort, he is the `'Ashir`. Their efforts are already completed. The First Intellect, the First Emanated Being, their ranks are already established. And the seven intellects, their ranks are established. But the one who is striving, in the `da'wah`, who is he? He is the First Intellect... no, he is the `'Ashir`. Who, in the spiritual world, made great efforts so that he... established the delusion of equality (`wahm-e-musawat`), and brought that group to the truth. And he explained a lot, to the point that he said that even I made a mistake, and I admitted my mistake. You too, admit your mistake. But they, the people did not, and the `mubda'at` did not, they did not admit their own mistake.

Then, when the Second Emanated Being (`munba'ith al-thani`) fell from his rank because of his delusion (`tawahhum`)… and so, and while, then when the Second Emanated Being, when his rank fell, due to his delusion of equality (`wahm-e-musawat`). So the intellects (`'uqul`) preceded him. There is no `waw` there, you should remove the `waw`. The seven intellects (`'uqul al-saba'`) preceded him. So the seven intellects (`'uqul`), they preceded him. Over him. By their response (`ijabat`). Because of their response, because of their accepting the invitation. And every `masbuq` (one who is preceded) acknowledged the merit of his `sabiq` (predecessor). And every person who came after acknowledged his predecessor. Acknowledgment is very important. The acknowledgment of the `masbuq` for the `sabiq` is an extremely necessary thing. Yes.

Just as, uhm, at the place of Sayyidna Da'ud bin 'Ajabshah, uhm, uhm, she used to study, who? Uhm... A Bibi used to study, what was her name... Yes. She was the wife of Jabir bin Fahad. Her name was probably Zaynab. Jabir bin Fahad, meaning the elder brother of Sayyidna Muhammad bin Fahad, Jabir bin Fahad. His wife was there, who used to study with Sayyidna Da'ud bin 'Ajabshah. And she was a very learned and virtuous woman. And at that time, she was studying `Simt al-Haqa'iq` with Sayyidna Da'ud bin 'Ajabshah, which in those days was considered a very high-level book of the `mubtadi'at` (beginners), which is in poetry, written by Sayyidna 'Ali bin Hanzalah. So when Sayyidna Da'ud bin 'Ajabshah intended to come to India, when you intended to come from Yemen, then this Bibi Zaynab requested, "Mawla, how will my studies continue now? The chain of my learning will break with your departure." So he said, "Study with your husband."

She was very surprised. That… So then… so then she requested that, "Mawla, you know that Jabir doesn't know how to read or write. So how will I study with him?" So he said, "You keep reading, and he will keep explaining to you. Because," he said, "`zannuhu afzalu min yaqiniki`" (his mere thought is better than your certainty). His merely having a thought about something is greater than your certainty. So this was the spiritual state. That is, because he has preceded you, his merely guessing something is greater than your certainty. Yes.

And the `munba'ith al-thani` connected with the last (`al-tasi'a`) of those intellects. And then in the end, what happened was that the `munba'ith al-thani`, who was the last, the very last intellect among those intellects, and it was the ninth (`tasi'a`). And it was the ninth intellect, which in that sequence, in the sequence of the seven intellects, it was the ninth intellect. So from the last individual of that last intellect, because the last, the last intellect which was, the ninth intellect, so within it too, innumerable intellects are present, under it. So from among them, the very last intellect, in the sphere of the ninth intellect, the last individual that was there, with him he connected (`bilgha`), and after connecting, he asked, `mustakhbiran lahu` (seeking information from him), and he wanted to know his own condition (`an halatihi`), "Why has my state become like this, that this spirituality (`nuraniyat`) is not being created in me? And what is the reason that he has fallen from his rank (`martaba`)?" So he informed him that the thing that caused you to fall from your rank was the delusion of equality (`al-musawat`) with your predecessor (`sabiqihi`). That he knew, he informed him, he made him aware that the thing that made you fall from your rank is the delusion of equality (`wahm-e-musawat`) with your predecessor. That is, that was the `tawahhum` (delusion). That is, the delusion of equality is the `wahm` which you entertained with your predecessor. That is, you considered the `munba'ith al-awwal` as your companion, and you thought that he and I are equal. Whereas no person, no individual can be equal. If Rasulullah also said this, that `al-Hasan wa al-Husayn imamani qama aw qa'ada wa abuhuma khayrun minhuma` (Al-Hasan and al-Husayn are two Imams, whether they rise or sit, and their father is better than them both), then despite this, despite calling Hasan and Husayn the rightful Imams, this is a noble pronouncement (`nass-e-sharif`) of Rasulullah, but the ranks of Hasan and Husayn are different. Yes.

So he who is ahead, has progressed, Husayn has progressed, but in terms of precedence (`sabaqiyat`), Hasan is there. Yes. `Sabaqiyat` is with Hasan. And the rank of `awwaliyat` (firstness) is a very great rank. The rank of `awwaliyat`, `awwaliyat` itself has a rank. The station of `awwaliyat` is a great station. Just as there were 124,000 prophets (`anbiya`), but the honor (`sharafat`) of `awwaliyat` that Adam received, no other prophet could receive. Just as Imam Hasan ibn 'Ali, `salawatullah 'alayh`, the `awwaliyat` that he received among the A'imma Tahirin, that honor was achieved, that, no one else received it. Although among the later A'imma, many were higher, `sabi'in` were higher than you, but the honor of `awwaliyat` is in its own place. There is Sayyidna Dhu'ayb ibn Musa, the honor of `awwaliyat` that he received in the cycle of the `ta'im`, no one else could receive it. Sayyidna Sulayman bin Hasan, who is the first in the cycle of the `qaim-i-dawr`, the honor of `awwaliyat` that he received, which, along with other honors, the honor of `awwaliyat` that was achieved, no one else could achieve it. So this honor of `awwaliyat` is a great thing.

And he who is first (`awwal`) is also the eighth (`athamin`). He who is first is also the eighth. Because after seven, the eighth one is the first of its circle. So the first person of any circle, he, that person, in the subsequent circle, is the eighth.

So he interceded for him with the one above him. So he interceded for him, for the one who was above him. And the one above him interceded for him with the one above him. And intercession was made for him by the one who was above him. Towards the one who was above him. In this way, the chain of intercession continued. Until it ended. And intercession is a great thing. Rasulullah said, didn't he, that "I have my, every, every single one was given an opportunity, and, but I kept my prayer (`du'a`) remaining for intercession (`shafa'at`), for the intercession of the `ummah` on the Day of Qiyamah. For whomever I wish, I will be an intercessor for him." `Wa'l-mustajabah`. Yes, yes. `Du'a-e-mustajabah`.

...until the intercession (`shafa'at`) reached the Second Intellect (`al-'aql al-thani`). Until the Second Intellect (`'aql-e-thani`). To him that intercession reached. The intercession that was being made for him, it reached. Which is the First Emanated Being (`munba'ith al-awwal`). Who is the Second Intellect? He is, in fact, the First Emanated Being. That is, after the First Intellect, the second intellect that came into being, was in fact the First Emanated Being. So he knew that the Second Emanated Being (`munba'ith al-thani`) had regretted (`nadima`) what had preceded from him. So he came to know this matter, that the `munba'ith al-thani`, who was there, he had become remorseful over that matter which had happened from him. And that he did not do it intentionally (`ta'ammad`). And he did not do it intentionally. That is, the mistake that was made by him, of the delusion of equality, was not done knowingly. But it happened without intention (`ta'ammud`). And he did not insist upon it (`asarra 'alayhi`). And neither did he insist upon it. He did not show stubbornness. So he accepted his repentance. So what did he do? The `munba'ith al-awwal` accepted his repentance. From his slip (`zallatihi`). From his slip, he accepted the repentance. And He forgave his mistake (`khati'atuhu`). And He forgave his mistake. And He extended to him from the eternal substance (`madda al-azaliyya`). And made it flow, the eternal substance that was there, that divine grace was made to flow towards him. Which was connected to him from his predecessor (`sabiqihi`). That substance which he had received from his predecessor. That is, from the First Intellect, the spiritual state that he had received, that substance was also started to be given to him, but not the whole of it, but a part (`juz`) of it. Whatever he had received from the First Intellect, a part of it was given to him. With which he had aided all of those intellects. That is, that substance with which he had served all the intellects. When they responded (`ijabatiha`). When they had accepted his call. And he added to it. So, because of it, that darkness (`zulmat`) was removed from him. So, because of which, that darkness which had happened from that corrupt delusion (`wahm al-fasid`), that darkness was removed. From the Second Emanated Being (`munba'ith al-thani`). From the Second Emanated Being.

And it became. And it is not mentioned here, but that darkness, what happened to it? Where did that darkness go? It went to the one who was the spiritual Iblis. It attached to him. Because of which, what happened? That which was the spiritual Iblis, this one became the spiritual Adam. That is, the `'Ashir` is also called the spiritual Adam. The darkness of the spiritual Adam, where did it go? That darkness came out and who became its magnet? It was that spiritual Iblis. Because of which, his devilishness increased even more. And when that... this darkness was received by him, he turned from Iblis to Shaytan. Yes. He became Shaytan from Iblis. And who is Shaytan called? The one who has become distant from the mercy of Allah. The one who has become distant from the mercy of Allah. He is called Shaytan.

Just as the `atba'` were created, so he… `quwwa-e-nis` [unclear] will not do it. That is, it will not be finished. It is for eternity. Yes, absolutely. That darkness now, with the spiritual Iblis, it merged, because of which he became Shaytan. And the power of Shaytan increased, the evil power increased. Yes. It was a thought, so to speak. A thought, as it were. It was darkness.

And he became... And he knew by that substance (`madda`) what was and what will be. And he was established in the tenth rank (`martaba al-'ashira`). The tenth rank was established. The second in distinction, and the third in number (`'adad`). And he was the third in number. Yes. That is, the First Intellect, the `munba'ith al-awwal`, and he was the third in number. And he became the tenth (`'ashir`) in rank (`rutba`). But when the rank was established, he became the tenth.

And he obtained, through that substance (`madda`) and all the preceding intellects (`'uqul al-sabiqa`), the second perfection (`al-kamal al-thani`). And that substance which he obtained, and all the intellects which had preceded him, he obtained the second perfection (`al-kamal al-thani`). The second perfection, and the second existence (`wujud al-thani`), by which they became eternal (`ta'azzalu`) and were protected (`'usimu`) and were made safe from transmutation (`istihalah`). Yes. And that is, their second existence came into being. That is, what was the first existence? The first existence was when the `mubda'at` were created, it was in a uniform state. That was the first existence. Giving knowledge, life, and power. And this was the second existence, because of which they attained eternality, and they attained infallibility (`'ismat`), and they became safe, they came into security from transmutation, that is, from spoiling, and from annihilation (`fana'`), from annihilation. And there remained from those originated forms (`suwar al-ibda'iyya`) a world whose number cannot be counted. And from that originated form, there was a world whose number cannot be counted or encompassed, who delayed in their response (`ta'akhkharu 'an al-ijabah`). That they delayed in responding. Yes. To the call (`da'wah`).

That is, the number and abundance of `du'a` is not the point, but reciting it correctly and understanding it and taking its effect within oneself, what `du'a` we are making to Allah. That is an important matter.

And the `du'a` of `du'as`, Surah Fatihah, how important it is. Many people recite it very fast and its tone is also not correct. Once it happened that a person's hand had become crooked in a battle, in a jihad. So he came before Amir al-Mu'minin and said, "Mawla, my hand has become crooked. Then he went a little further and it occurred to him to ask what `du'a` Mawla had recited. Just as we recite in `kalam-e-sharif`, where to stop and where not to stop, the meaning also changes. Yes, the meaning changes. Now, I, a Surah, Surah… Surah… is it… `Nashrah`. We don't get the correct... and then when we recite the `du'a` for finishing the `kalam-e-sharif`, then on that it is that I made this mistake and that mistake...

*Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim*. They gather at the *Bab al-Abwab*, which is the *falak-e-buruj* of the era. Meaning, they are not with the Imam. Rather, their final destination is at the *Bab al-Abwab*. And they gather at the *Bab al-Abwab*. In the same way, in the spiritual realm, the gathering of all the intellects will be at the *Mubda'-e-Awwal*. In the physical realm, the gathering of all the luminous forms will be at the *Bab al-Abwab*. And in the same way, all the stars that are visible or not visible, the gathering of all of them is happening in the *falak-e-buruj*. And the *falak-e-buruj* is the eighth sphere.
`maqsumatun...`
The *falak-e-muhit* is empty.
The motion that has been mentioned for the *falak-e-muhit*, that it completes one cycle in a day and night. But the *falak-e-muhit* is the highest. So which duration is being talked about here? Which day and night?
Well, that is not clarified here. Because with its motion, all the lower spheres are also moving.
No, it says here, that it completes one motion in a day and night. So what day and night should we imagine? The day and night in the world is 24 hours. But the duration of day and night for every sphere is different.
Here, the motion of the *falak-e-muhit* is with respect to us, it's our day and night.
[Faint voice from phone call] My final thought is... the *muhit* is moving, due to which all the spheres are moving in their own days and nights. The measure of the world's day and night is different, the moon's day and night is different.
Yes.
The measure of Jupiter is different. But each one's day and night is different. They are all moving due to it, from the *muhit* itself.
Yes.
The day and night is the distance from the sun, isn't it? The distance is different, so the length and breadth of the day and night is different.
Yes, yes.
So the point is that the *falak-e-muhit* is moving, in a day and night, meaning in 24 hours, it completes one motion. Meaning, from where it starts, it comes back there and its motion is complete. Yes. And it is certainly true that the spheres below it, their timings will be different. It's not clarified here. We have to understand it for ourselves.

And this, `maqsumatun ithna 'ashar qisman` (divided into twelve sections). And the *falak-e-buruj* is also divided into twelve sections. `kullu qism minha burjun` (each section of it is a constellation).
And it is also that every section that it is divided into has 30, 30 houses. The houses of every *burj*. Meaning, the partitioned *buruj*. Now when our *fudala'* (excellent ones) ascend, then from one beginning to the end, to go through 360, they have to traverse this entire path. For their purification.
In going and in coming. In this way, what happens? 720 years pass. And the temperament of the initiated one, in ascending and descending... meaning, from the grave, for the *fudlat* (impurities) to ascend, and then from the spheres to come to the earth, becoming a human... when they become human, they will come to earth, won't they? So that... that 720 years and 280 years. 280 years in ascending and descending, and 720 years in this way, that from the first *burj* to the last *burj*, the 360 degrees that are there of the *buruj*, they traverse them. And then, they come back to the first *burj*. So this going and coming of theirs happens in 720 years. And so that their purification happens. After being purified, they become translucent, and then they are brought [back].
What is this purification of?
It is of the *qasathat* (dross/impurities). Our calculations, our impurities.
And we have *qasathat* in this world as well... So what kind of *qasathat* is that over there? Because these are the dealings with people in the world, that is the *qisath*.
Yes.
So over there...
Meaning, what kind of purification?
No, it's not detailed, but our life is within the circle of *qisas* (retribution). Just as `wa lakum fi al-qisasi hayatun ya uli al-albab` (And for you in retribution there is life, O you of understanding). That in your *qisas* is your life. `wa sara falak al-tasi' khaliyan la shay'a fihi min al-buruj` (and the ninth sphere became empty, with nothing in it of the constellations). And the ninth *falak*, which is called the *falak-e-muhit*, is empty. It has no *buruj* or *kawakib* (planets). It is empty. Just as with the Imam, none of our forms gather. So with the Imam, not even a single one of our forms is gathering. And just as in the spiritual realm, with the *'Aql-e-Awwal* (First Intellect), no form gathers, no intellect came there. It is empty of that state. Yes.
And this *Mubda'-e-Awwal*, the forms with him... two *du'at* have given two explanations. One said they are 28. 28 means there is a grouping of 28 there. At the *Mubda'-e-Awwal*. At the *Mubda'-e-Awwal*, the *'uqul* that are there... when this... these divisions of *'uqul* were happening, at that time, the collection it had was of 28 *'uqul*. And that is in correspondence with the *kalima* `La ilaha illa Allah`. And someone said, one *da'i* said that there were 12. So what Sayyidna 'Ali bin Sulayman is seeing, he is seeing the *'uqul* in their totality, that they are 28. The Imam takes the *suwarat*...

The plans are of the *'Aql-e-Awwal*. The decision he is making is the *'Aql-e-Awwal*'s, even though the forms are gathering at the *Mubda'-e-Awwal*. Yes.
And when the Imam gives that entire collection of forms to his *farzand*, the *farzand* until then is an Imam, made of *riya'* (subtle matter). And the life he lives, what he eats, breathes, drinks, all of it is *riya'*. Yes. And after that, when he receives this collection, that collection is the *imamat*. So when the Imam, when the *imamat* joins him, then from potential he becomes actual. The child. Yes. And the Imam, upon whom be peace, passes away. And with his passing, the *Bab al-Abwab* also passes away and becomes the *qalb* (heart) of the Imam's *farzand*. Just as Mawlana Abu Talib, upon whom be peace, three days after his passing, Janab Khadija also passed away. Yes. For which the Prophet said that this year is my year of grief. You have... you... he called that year the year of grief, that two great personalities passed away, who had helped him and who had taken care of him throughout their lives. Why? They were the Imam, and she was his *hujjat*. Yes.
Because Mawlatuna Khadija is the *Bab al-Abwab* of whom? Of Bibi Fatimah al-Zahra. Yes.
`wa sara falak al-tasi' khaliyan` (And the ninth sphere became empty). And the ninth sphere is empty, `li-latafatihi wa sharafih` (due to its subtlety and its nobility). Because of its subtlety, because it is made from the highest part of the *nadamat* (repentance) of the repentant ones. `faslun. fa lamma taharraka al-falak al-harakat al-ula` (Chapter. So when the sphere moved the first motion...). So when the *falak* made the first motion, `ramat al-kawakib bi-ashi'atiha nahw al-ard` (the planets threw their rays towards the earth). So, there is one *kawkab* (planet) and one *falak* (sphere). Within the *falak* is the *kawkab*. *Falak* is the sky. And *kawkab* is, for instance, Zuhal. Zuhal has a *falak*, a sky, an orbit. And within it is Zuhal. Similarly, every *falak* has a orbit. So it says here that when the *falak*, when it casts its rays, and it cast them towards the earth, so `fa kana qad baqiya 'ala wajhiha shay'un min jins al-falak` (so there remained on its face something of the nature of the sphere). So after casting the rays, what happened? On the earth, some things of the nature of the *falak* remained. `fa jadhabat-ha al-kawakib ila dhawatiha` (so the planets attracted them to their essences). And those... when the rays were cast, the *kawakib* attracted them to their essences, meaning they returned again. The spheres cast the rays, and they hit the earth and then returned to them. `wa sayyarat lahu al-asdaf musharraqa` (and they made shells/casings for it, which were illuminated). And in this way, upon the spheres, which were non-visible, *asdaf* (shells/casings) were placed upon them. Meaning, a covering was placed on them. Yes. And the spheres are made from the most subtle parts of the *nadimin*. But when their rays fell on the earth and the *sakhra* (rock/dense matter), and from there vapors rose and became their *asdaf*, what happened to the *asdaf*? A negativity (*nahusat*) was created in them. As for example, Zuhal. The planet of Zuhal is very pure and clean. It is *tayyib* (good). But because of its *sadaf* (shell), negativity was created in it. So he is explaining the same thing. That `wa hiya allati yudrikuha al-basar min al-nujum` (and it is they which the sight perceives of the stars). And in this way, the eyes can see those stars. `fa-hiya kanat wahmiyatan ka-l-aflak la taraha al-absar` (for they were imaginary/notional like the spheres, the sights did not see them). Whereas in their original state, they were notional. Just like the spheres, the eyes could not see them. `fa ja'ala al-mudabbir ta'ala tilka al-asdaf bi-hikmatihi li-inarat 'alam al-zulmani al-jismani` (So the Governor, may He be exalted, made those shells with His wisdom to illuminate the dark, physical world). Then the *Mudabbir Ta'ala* (Governing Being, Most High) made those *asdaf* through this planning, that they became visible and illuminated the world below. `wa li-anna qudrat al-hawas al-bashar` (And because the power of human senses...). Now a different topic is starting. I had some notes on this, on the *mabda'-ma'ad*, which Mawla 'Abbas Saheb had written. So I thought I would read them to you so that the topic, which is the topic of the spheres, which is a bit complex, would become clear. So you write that, at the time of the *da'wat* of the *'Ashir*, three groups were formed. Right? When the *da'wat* of the *'Ashir* happened, three groups were formed. And this xerox has become so bad that the letters are smudged. And when the *'Ashir* gave the *da'wat*, due to their disobedience, three states befell them. Meaning, despite the guidance of the *'Ashir*, when they disobeyed, saying, `la nasma'u wa la nuti'` (we will not hear and we will not obey), "we neither listen to your words nor obey you. We don't accept you, nor those who came before you, except for the *Mubda' Ta'ala* (the Originated Being, Most High). So in that, no... all are in the state of the first perfection (*kamal-e-awwal*). So they saw the state of the first perfection and acknowledged it. But the second perfection (*kamal-e-thani*) which the *'uqul* and the *Mubda'-e-Awwal* had attained, they did not acknowledge that, due to which this state was created in them. And some among them were repentant (*nadim*) and were seeking forgiveness. Some among them were doubters (*shakk*) and were bewildered (*mutahayyir*). And some were stubborn (*hadd-dharam*), proud and arrogant. In this way, the three categories of *nadim*, *shakk*, and *musirr* (insistent/stubborn) or *mustakbir* (arrogant) were formed. Yes. This state continued. So it is said that this *isbagh al-wudu'* (performing ablution thoroughly), what is it? It is to perform ablution three times. So it was asked, can a person do it more than three times? Meaning, while performing ablution, can he gargle four, five, six times instead of three, or wash his face ten times while reciting the supplications? So they said, `la fadila lahu` (there is no virtue in it for him). There is no virtue in it for him. There is no virtue established in doing it after the third time.
Is it the same for *ruku'* and *sujud*?
No... `aqallu fihi` (the minimum in it is). At least three times should be done. Yes. But for that it is not said that one shouldn't do more than three. Meaning, not to do the *tasbihat* ten times, or eight or seven times, because then the followers will have to wait, and they will become weary. The fathers of Sayyidna Muhammad al-Jamali and Sayyidna Ahmad al-Jamali, who were their fathers, what was his name? 'Ali. 'Ali bin 'Abdullah. And he was a great *mansub*. Sayyid Ghulam Saheb appointed him. Yes. So, that Sayyidna 'Ali bin 'Abdullah al-Makrami, he used to lead such long prayers, he would recite such long *surahs* that it is said people would faint.
