I don't remember his name now. Shamsuddin... no, it wasn't Shamsuddin.
Wahid Bakhsh.
Yes, Wahid Bakhsh. Mulla Wahid Bakhsh. Mulla Wahid Bakhsh was his name. And he was a very loving person, a friend of knowledge. And the lessons of *Bab al-Muqaddas*, he used to remember them so well, and the things... he used to ask questions. He was a very simple-natured person.
So anyway. These all, from the realm of purity and light, due to density, fell down. Meaning, this *hayula*, which was divided into three parts, fell down. Because density had been created in it. Because density brings one down, and subtlety takes one up. Spiritual progress is attained through this.
Then the arrangement of the physical world. The wise governing *'Ashir*, from those who were the most pure and clean, who were the group of the *nadimin* (repentant ones), from them he arranged the seven spheres and the planets. Yes. This makes it very clear. These seven spheres and the planets were arranged. From the middle-level pure souls, that is... he... what did he do? The four mothers, meaning fire, air, water, and earth, were made. Yes. Meaning, these... these were made from whom? From the *shakkin* (doubters) and *mutahayyirin* (bewildered). And from the most dense, meaning those who were the *musirrin* (stubborn) and *mustakbirin* (arrogant), from them he made the *sakhra* (rock/foundation). Meaning, the core of the earth. The central part. Which is the center of the earth. The lowest part in the earth. This was the justice and wisdom of the *'Ashir*, which was in accordance with the intentions and consciences of these souls. Just as were their intentions, and just as were their consciences, in that way a place was appointed for them in the spheres, in the mothers, and on the earth.
Then what happened? The *falak-e-muhit* (encompassing sphere), this entire realm... and what is in the realm... whatever is in the realm, and the realm itself, it has encompassed it. The *falak-e-muhit*. That's why it is called the *falak-e-muhit*, meaning it has encompassed the realm, it has surrounded it. Just as the Imam encompasses all...
[Phone call ringing]
The *falak-e-muhit*... It is also called the gate of the spiritual world. Meaning, the door to enter the spiritual world. Because after this, after this is the world of life. The world of life. Meaning, when the *'Ashir* repented, then with his repentance, a large group repented. A large group repented with the repentance of the *'Ashir*. After that, what happened? The last person of that group, by the command of the *'Ashir*, gave the *da'wat* (call). Those who repented, that group was called `Ta'ibu bi-Tawbatihi` (those who repented with his repentance). They repented with his repentance. And then that last person of that group, when he gave the *da'wat* by the command of the *'Ashir*, another group was prepared, which was called `Labbu Nida'ahu` (those who answered his call). They said "Labbayk" (Here I am at your service) to his call. But the matter with all of them, the `Ta'ibu bi-Tawbatihi` and the `Labbu Nida'ahu`, what happened with them was that the `Ta'ibu bi-Tawbatihi` went with the *'Ashir*. They went with the *'Ashir*'s group. And they ascended into the spiritual world. They became intellects and ascended. With their group. But the `Ta'ibu bi-Tawbatihi`... they... in the spiritual world, they did not ascend with the *'Ashir*. Rather, for them, another world was created, which is called the world of life. And there is the *tamur* (repository), and there is the spiritual Ka'ba. And that spiritual Ka'ba is connected to the physical Ka'ba. Yes. So, this... this state happened. So after the *falak-e-muhit* is not the beginning of the spiritual world, but in between comes the world of life. Life comes.
Did the *qalam* then come down?
The *qalam*... yes, they came among the *nadimin*.
So they had to come.
Yes, they had to come. But among them too, among them too, what happened was that the first... the first... which Sayyidna Isma'il bin Hibatullah has written in *Kawakib*, that perhaps the first category, `lam tatasawwam` (they did not take form). Meaning, they did not come into the physical world. Meaning, physicality did not come to them. And they remained there. The first group that was there. After that, later on, from the groups, the spheres and so on were made. Yes.
This world of life, will we also call it the world of intention (*'alam-e-niyyat*)?
No, the *'alam-e-niyyat* is up there. The *'alam-e-niyyat* is... our... when our... when the *Mubda'* originated, at that time, what our intentions were. And our intention that was there, after the origination, we remained in a passive state. Then the *'uqul* affirmed the oneness of the Lord of the worlds, but we did not join them. We remained in a passive state. Until the *'Ashir*'s illusory equality came, and we also fell into that illusory equality. And thus, no intellect was such that it neither became one of the *'uqul* that entered the circle, nor joined the *'Ashir*'s illusory equality, but remained in the middle. It was not so. Only two things happened: either they went with the *'Ashir*, or they became intellects and ascended. Yes. So in this matter, what our intention was, with the *'Ashir*, our dealing that happened, in that, there were various intentions, not just one intention. All the consciences were different. Therefore, the state that befell us, we became *nadimin*, *shakk*, *musirrin*, in that, grouping happened. So our world of intention was established right there. Yes.
So, it is called the gate of the spiritual world. It is also called the world of sanctity (*'alam al-quds*), the gate of the world of sanctity. This *muhit*. Yes. Or there are other names for it too. Yes, it is called that.
The *tamur* is also that?
No, the *tamur* is different. The *tamur* is above. It is above the *falak-e-muhit*. It is in the world of life. The *tamur* is in the world of life. In which the forms of the *mohtajibin* (veiled ones) are present. Who are the *mohtajibin* of the Imams, their original essences are where? They are in the *tamur*. Yes. Who did not enter the spiritual world.
The Quranic verse, `wa kulli shay'in khalaqna zawjayn` (and of all things We created two mates/pairs). Where did this foundation of "two" come from?
I would have to look that up, I don't recall.
The Prophet's *mi'raj* (ascension) also, the Prophet's *mi'raj* was not to the spiritual world, nor to the world of life. Where did you go up to? To the *falak-e-muhit*. The *falak-e-muhit*. Your *mi'raj* was up to the *falak-e-muhit*. After that, you returned. Because once, if one goes beyond the *falak-e-muhit*, then one cannot return either. To enter there, one must become an intellect. Yes.
Then what? The *falak-e-buruj*. In this, the stars are seen. All the stars, which are countless. It has been divided into 12 parts, and each part has been given a name. And there are 12 names. The first name is Hamal (Aries). Its first name is Hamal. Then al-Thawr (Taurus). Al-Jawza' (Gemini). Al-Sartan (Cancer). These are four. Then Asad (Leo). This is the fifth. Al-Sunbula (Virgo), six. Then Mizan (Libra). Then al-'Aqrab (Scorpio), eight. Then... al-Qaws (Sagittarius), al-Jady (Capricorn), al-Dalw (Aquarius), al-Hut (Pisces). These are the 12 parts of the *falak-e-muhit*.
These are the Zodiac signs.
Yes, Zodiac signs.
I don't remember their English names. So these 12 parts were made. Then, below the *falak-e-muhit*, there are the orbits of the seven skies. Below the *falak-e-buruj*. Below the *falak-e-buruj*, there are the orbits of the seven skies. In each orbit, a planet moves. It is by this name that the *falak* is known. For instance, Zuhal. So it is called the *falak* of Zuhal. And it is the planet of Zuhal. The planet of Zuhal is in the *falak* of Zuhal. The first *falak* is of Zuhal. The second is of Mushtari (Jupiter). The third is of Mirrikh (Mars). And the fourth is of Shams (the Sun). And the fifth is of Zuhra (Venus). The sixth is of 'Utarid (Mercury). And the seventh is Qamar (the Moon). From the revolution of all these, the sphere of ether (*kurra-e-asir*), the sphere of air (*kurra-e-nasim*) came into existence. These all, the revolutions they made, so the *kurra-e-asir*, *kurra-e-nasim*, in which we breathe, that came into existence. And fire, water, air, and earth, these all came into being. Which are called the mothers. The governing being of the world assigned each planet to the governance of the physical world. Every planet governs the physical world. First was the governance of Zuhal. Then the helper of Zuhal was Mushtari. Then it was Mirrikh. Then Shams. Meaning, the governance of Zuhal is ongoing, but these became its helpers. And then it was Zuhra, then 'Utarid. Then in the seventh period, meaning in the seventh thousand-year period, under the governance of Qamar, the first human came into existence. When the governance of Zuhal is on, but in the governance of Zuhal, when Qamar became its companion in governance, then in that governance, in the seventh thousand-year period, that human came into existence.
Now these densities were falling. From this, four *awtad al-falak*... four directions were also established. Yes. Directions were later established. That is, *tali'*, *gharib*, *'ashir*, and *rabi'*, meaning East, West, North, and South. These four directions also came into being. And two poles, the North Pole and the South Pole. The density started falling. So the four... [text is cut off] and the pull of the two poles held it in the very middle. The sky encompassed it from all sides, like the white and shell of an egg encompass the yolk. These six directions are called *sitta jihat*. This... the four directions, up and down... a material world is encompassed in this. It is explained in this way, that right, left, front, back, and up and down. These all directions were established.
In the first thousand years, the governance was of Zuhal. And in it, vapors, rains, occurred frequently, and the entire earth became a vast ocean. In this, the substances for things were created that resembled the temperament of Zuhal. Iron, copper, Abyssinians, and farmers, laborers, and hardworking laborers, etc., these were created. In this way, it moved forward. So in the first thousand years, the governance of Zuhal continued. They were superior to all. At one point, Amir al-Mu'minin said, anal-yaqut al-ahmar (I am the red ruby). Anal-yaqut al-ahmar... wa Rasulullah salawatullahi 'ala al-yaqut al-asfar (I am the red ruby... and the Messenger of Allah, may Allah's blessings be upon him, is the yellow ruby). He said this.
Is there also a yaqut al-asfar (yellow ruby)?
There is asfar too. Meaning, the yellow... yellow ruby.
Yes, the yellow one.
It is aswad (black) also, it is more popular among the common people...
Shakhs wahid (one individual), and among the twenty-eight people, there is one individual who is superior to all of them in nobility and excellence, ma li-yaqut al-ahmar 'ala al-hajar (like the [superiority] of the red ruby over a stone). Just as there is the red ruby over a stone. Wa huwa zubdat al-'alam (And he is the essence of the world). And the one who is being talked about from the *jussa ibda'iyah*. Wa huwa zubdat al-'alam wa safwa wa khulasatuhu (And he is the essence of the world, its choicest part and its extract). And he was the *zubdah* (essence), the extract, of the world, and its *safwat* (choicest part) and extract. Wa hadha ash-sharaf hasil li-hadhihi ath-thamaniyah wa 'ishrin shakhs 'ala sa'ir al-bashar (And this honor was attained by these twenty-eight individuals over all other humans). And this nobility was attained by these twenty-eight people over all of mankind. Wa lil-wahid 'ala as-sab' wa 'ishrin (And for the one over the twenty-seven). And one [attained it] over the other twenty-eight... twenty-seven. Min ajli safa' an-niyyah (Because of the purity of intention). From his purity of intention. Because of it. That is, from the *jussa ibda'iyah*'s purity of intention, and when the fault occurred on his part, at the call of 'Ashir, so when he repented, he repented with great remorse, because of which this nobility was granted to him, even over the twenty-seven. F kana hadha al-wahid lahum huwa safwat al-'alam (So this one was for them the choicest of the world). And this one individual was the choicest of the world, and its *zubdah* (essence), and its *khulasa* (extract), and was the noblest among all of them. Fa-lamma zahara min tilka al-qudad ka-zuhuri abna' jinsihi (So when he emerged from those depressions like the emergence of his own species). When those depressions became manifest, just as the depressions of the sons of his species became manifest, his companions, so nazara dhatuhu bi-dhatihi (he looked at his own essence with his own essence). So he looked at his own essence, with his own essence. Min ghayri mu'allimin (Without a teacher). Without any teacher. Wa la mulhimin (And without an inspirer). And not with the help of any inspirer. Ila al-'alam (Towards the world). And... and so he looked towards the world and contemplated. Fa-ra'a sama'an mabniyyah (And he saw a constructed sky). And he saw that above him is a sky that has been made. Wa ardan madhiyyah (And a spread-out earth). And the earth is what has been spread. Wa asnafan min al-khala'iq mukhtalifah (And different species of creatures). And various kinds of creatures are there. Fa-'alima bi-fikratihi (So he knew by his intellect). So he knew from his intellect, wa hajama bi-dhatihi (and he judged with his essence), and he judged his essence 'ala al-khalqi (upon the creation), upon the creations. Inna lahum... (that for them...). That is, the process of his contemplation is ongoing. Inna lahu wa li-abna' jinsihi wa lil-'alam ka'afatan mubdi'an (That he himself and the sons of his species and the entire world have a Creator). That he himself, him, and जो the sons of his species, his companions, and for the entire world, there is one who has brought them into being, a Creator (*mubdi'*). Huwa bi-khilafihim (He is different from them). And He is different from them. That is, He is not from among them. That *mubdi'* is not from among all these; He is some other being. Fa-nafa al-ilahiyyah 'anhum (So he negated divinity from them). So he negated the divinity of all of them. Ke *nist* se *hast* mein laane ki quwwat (The power to bring from non-existence into existence) is not in any of them. Darja-i-'aql-i-awwal ke jaisa hunar hai (It is a skill like that of the rank of the first intellect). Yes. The same state is occurring. Wa 'anhum wa aqarra biha li-mubdi'ihi (And from them, and he affirmed it for his Creator). And he affirmed this matter that the attribute of divinity is in his Creator. Wa shahida biha li-khaliqihim (And he bore witness with it for their Creator). And he bore witness to it for his Creator. Fa-qama fi al-'alam ad-dani (So he stood in the lower world). And he stood in this lower world, in the world, maqam as-sabiq al-awwal (the station of the First Precedent). Just as the *sabiq al-awwal* had stood in the spiritual world. That is, just as the station of *'aql al-awwal* was in the spiritual world, in the same way, his station became in the world of... the world, in the lower world. Fa-ittasala bihi qistuhu min al-maddah wa at-ta'id (So his portion of substance and support connected with him). As soon as his intellect became pure and clean, so his substance and support became جاری (operative) from him. Now see, this became a principle that if there is a good intellect, the thought of a person, whether he is a *mu'min mustajib* (a responsive believer) or of the high *hudud* (ranks), then it is necessary that from the side of the *'ali 'alayh* (the exalted one), supports (*ta'idat*) become operative for all of them. This principle has been established. Just as it happened for the *'aql al-awwal*, just as it happened for the *jussa ibda'iyah*. In our world too, in this world too, if someone has a clean and pure intellect, and our thought is clean, and we are populating the world of our actions, then it is necessary that help and support from Allah should come to us. Yes. So this is a matter of principle. Yes.
The *ibda'iyah* who were born, they were born with their knowledge, they knew their own status, what they were.
Even then, just as Imams are born, the Imam also has to acquire knowledge, right? As it is in the Holy Quran, that, "We brought you forth from your mothers' wombs in a state where you knew nothing." So this thing is for the creatures, and it is for the Imams as well. So the Imams also have to study. It's another matter that they are *ma'sum* (infallible) from the beginning, they have studied, but a *tarikh* (history) is formed, a *sirat* (biography) is formed, and they have to study. Yes.
The one who becomes the *walid-i-tam* (perfect father), his son who will be from the *jussa ibda'iyah*, will he be greater than all the others who are born from the other pits?
No. The twenty-seven individuals... the twenty-seven individuals, the *jussa ibda'iyah* took the twenty-seven individuals, and his *haykal* (physical form) was prepared, and from here, the *takhlis al-'alam* (purification of the world) occurred. Yes. So they are superior. The twenty-seven individuals...
At the time of *imamat*, the child who is... is he the *khulasa-i-'alam* (essence of the world)?
His *takhlis* (purification) happened. The twenty-seven individuals departed from the world with the *jussa ibda'iyah*. And this one from the *jussa* is superior to those people who are born naturally. Yes.
This much honor he definitely has, that he was the first Imam. The *imamat* started from him. From the son of the *jussa ibda'iyah*, this *imamat* started. So the honor of being the first, which is attained, is a great thing. So he was the first Imam. That is, of the *dawr al-kashf* (epoch of manifestation) and of the *kawr* (epoch) itself, he was the first Imam. The *imamat*, until the day of resurrection, for as long as it continues, it will continue in his lineage. Whether it is the *dawr al-kashf*, the *dawr al-sitr* (epoch of concealment), the *dawr al-fatrah* (epoch of interval), the eras will keep changing, but the offspring will be from his lineage. This matter is settled.
And the one who will be of the *awwal* (first), whom they call *'aql-i-awwal*, he will also have other pits, right? He will take all of them?
No, from the pits that were born... No. He... the *jussa ibda'iyah* will gather the twenty-seven people. And from here, the *takhlis al-'alam* will happen.
From him too, people were born from the pits.
What the statement is for others, we will see, but the statement that has come is that for these *jussa*s... the *jussa ibda'iyah*, taking the twenty-seven individuals, from here the *takhlis al-'alam* will happen, and his *haykal* will be prepared. From the twenty-seven. And the twenty-seven are not ordinary individuals. They are *zubdah* (essence), they are cream.
For what period did they... did they progress?
No, that... I don't remember what... in what period... when... when did they depart from here... how long was the period, it is not mentioned in this. But this much is that, from here their *takhlis al-'alam* happened.
So, just as the station of *'aql al-awwal* was, his station is in this meaning in the world. Yes. Fa-ittasala bihi qistuhu min al-maddah (So his portion from the substance connected with him). And substance and support connected with him, 'ala yadi as-sabiq al-awwal (at the hands of the First Precedent). At the hands of the *sabiq al-awwal*. Bi-wasitati sa'ir al-'uqul al-ibda'iyah (through the intermediary of all the creative intellects). Through the intermediary of the creative intellects. That is, it did not happen directly. Directly, from the *sabiq al-awwal*, from the *'aql al-awwal*, the *jussa ibda'iyah* did not receive support directly, but in between, his... all the creative intellects were included. Through them, it happened. Yes. And through the intermediary of his rank, such that the one who creates it, such that the one who extracts it, from the world of nature. Wa sharafa bi-tilka al-maddah allati wasalatuhu wa abna'a jinsihi (And he was ennobled by that substance which reached him and the sons of his species). And because of that substance, he found nobility. And... and those things also reached all the sons of his species. Wa 'alima biha ma kana wa ma sayakun (And he knew by it what was and what will be). And this substance and support that he received, the *jussa ibda'iyah*, because of it, he came to know what was and what will be. That is, this state was granted to him. Just as *'aql al-awwal* was granted it, just as *muba'ath as-sabil* was granted it, just as the creative intellects were granted it. So, he too was granted it. Thumma abala 'ala as-sab' wa 'ishrina ash-shakhs (Then he turned to the twenty-seven individuals). Then he turned his attention towards the twenty-seven individuals. Alladhina kanu ma'ahu (who were with him). Such that those people were with him. Fa-da'ahum ila al-iqrar billahi ta'ala wal-wahdaniyyah (So he called them to affirm Allah Ta'ala and His Oneness). And he called them to the affirmation, that you should affirm Allah Ta'ala with His Oneness. Wa i'tirafi bil-ilahiyyah (And acknowledge His divinity). To acknowledge divinity. Wa nafi'u 'anhum jamian (And negate it from all of them). So, they negated this quality of divinity from themselves, that this quality of divinity is not in us. Fa-ajabu ila dhalika (So they responded to that). And they responded to his words with "labbayk" (here I am). Wa kana jami'u dhalika huwa ma'ana wa lillahi ta'ala (And all of that was its meaning, and for Allah Ta'ala). And, just as it had happened there in the spiritual world, that 'Ashir... it had happened that there were those who denied him, and... that state did not happen here. All twenty-seven individuals affirmed it. And as soon as he said it, they brought faith in him and denied divinity [for themselves]. And they acknowledged... the Creator, Allah Ta'ala.

No, no. He, as it is in other books also, that he was compelled, because he could not say anything else for the *mubdi' ta'ala*, so he gestured and said "huwa" (He). They are nine... nine intellects.

From among the twelve.

That in the Holy Quran, the *kalimah la ilaha illallah* (there is no god but Allah), which has five different intonations, what are the five intonations? *La ilaha illallah*, *la ilaha illa huwa*, *la ilaha illa ana*, *la ilaha illalladhi*, *la ilaha illa anta*. In these five intonations, the *kalimah shahadah* (testimony) has come. In this, here, the one that has come, `shahidallahu annahu la ilaha illa huwa`, in this intonation, so you will see that in the Holy Quran, how many of these *kalimat* (words/phrases) are there in total? Thirty-seven. There are thirty-seven *kalimat*. And thirty-seven *kalimat* are in thirty-six verses. It's repeated once. So it's in thirty-six verses. That is, in one verse, it has come twice. And that verse is this one. In `shahidallah`. It has come twice in this. And because of this, this verse has great importance. That's why its *tasbih* (glorification) is also done. The *tasbih* of this verse is also done, and there is great power in it, in this *tasbih* also, there is great power because in this verse, the *kalimah shahadah* has come twice. Secondly, that Sayyidna 'Abdullah bin... what is his name... al-Wazir... 'Abd al-'Ali bin... 'Abd al-'Ali, who is a Da'i in our presence. Just as in our Majmu' al-Ad'iyah, it has been mentioned, of all... the thirty-six verses. The thirty-six verses have been mentioned. And then a tradition has also been narrated, of Qadi Shurayh. That whoever recites this will attain ten states. So its mention has been made. So he too says that the person who recites this, for him these states will be achieved and his prayer will be accepted immediately. By its blessing. Through these thirty-six verses. And this is... in one verse, it is twice. Yes.

Yes.

The *jussa*s who were born.

Wa hadha tahqiq ma qala Allahu ta'ala (And this is the verification of what Allah Ta'ala said). These are different measures, aren't they? So for that, there are reasons for everything. Why did he come as a doctor? Why did he... why was he made poor? Why did he become rich? There are reasons for everything. But there, where He created, the justice (*'adl*) of Allah is established. This is also justice (*'adl*). Who will explain this? There, in one stroke, everyone was created. And they call it *dafat'an wāhidah* (in a single go). In one stroke. And then what is the third thing? That to each one... the thing that is being given to you, I am also being given. You are also being given. Each one was given things. And those three things that are there, its name was given as *'ilm* (knowledge), *hayāt* (life), and *qudrat* (power). Now, whatever capacities a person has—he has intellect (*'aql*), he has sources, he has money, he has such and such—through these I will... do my work. If you understand that and... keep concising it, it will be limited to *'ilm*, *hayāt*, and *qudrat*. The meaning of *qudrat* is authority (*ikhtiyār*). What are your authorities (*ikhtiyārāt*)? What is there? *Qudrat*. Second, *'ilm*. Third, *hayāt*. So its definition (*ta'rīf*) is... as I was explaining in the... cassettes, in those... I explain then, and also when I get a chance. So *'ilm* is... you know... there are many things that you know which I don't know. The things that I know, you don't know. The things that you know, they don't know. So it is limited. The knowledge that they know, you don't know. There must be many such things. So the *'ilm* of each one is deficient (*nāqis*) for the other. The *'ilm* that was given to everyone there was a complete, full-fledged *'ilm*. The *'ilm* that was given to him was also given to you. It was also given to you. Everyone was given equal *'ilm*. Everyone was given *hayāt*... Now what is the definition of *hayāt*? *Hayāt* is what we...

Right. This life... this is life. What kind of life is this? Today this and this, both these medicines... it will be over in ten minutes. It will be over. You see? These medicines are such that... both medicines... *as-salamu alaykum*. So the *hayat* that is, this is our deficient *hayat*. There, we will receive a *hayat* that is abundant. It is called the state of *afdal* (most excellent). And Hazrat Zain Saab has described it, that for every person, the day of his wedding is the most excellent day, a prime [time] he has. He understands for himself that, 'I have graduated, okay, that's the best.' This and that, he becomes everything, but the wedding day remains memorable. It's such a big thing. So, the state of *afdal*. It was in that state of *afdal* that Allah created [us] there. How did He create? With the *'ilm ma kana wa sa yakun* (knowledge of what was and what will be). He created [us] by giving the knowledge of everything. And the second thing, *qudrat-e-tammah* (complete power). *Qudrat-e-tammah* means a full-fledged power was given to you. Now, I, for instance, lift this... you will tell me to lift it... lift this sofa and throw it... you will say 'no'. So this is a *qudrah* (power). There is no power here. Every thing has a limit. There, everyone was given full and complete *qudrah*. Now here, the things we cannot do, there is no reasoning for it. But we are talking about that *ruhani 'alam* (spiritual realm) where everyone was made equal. But what happened then? That Allah Ta'ala wanted that, 'I have given everything, so I, the one who is the Creator... they should do my *ma'rifah* (gnostic recognition), they should recognize me, why I have given [this] to them.' To do that *ma'rifah*, the problem started. And it has been told, in many books... there are many books in which this has been discussed extensively and it has been explained. There were lakhs and crores of people. And Allah Ta'ala made everyone equal. Just like in a class, everyone... not everyone comes first. First number is only one. Why, brother? Everyone was given the same education, everyone had the same books, everyone came daily... but there is a mental difference. So that was the *ruhani 'alam* (spiritual realm). There, what happened, the fact is that... there was one individual who thought, 'These people, whom Allah Ta'ala has created, neither can these people create me, nor can I create them.' Look, today, in this era, this sentence seems very small: 'I cannot create them.' He saw... what he saw was that he saw his own species and he saw himself. And he decided that, 'Neither can I create them, nor can they create me. Rather, my creator is someone else.' That's it. The moment he thought this... if I had thought this... then the *nur* (light) that was in me, it started developing even more. You have it, everyone has it. But the one I have, I had the correct thought. The thinking was very quick. And my *nuraniyyat* (luminosity) began to increase. It kept increasing and increasing until it became so much that the others started looking, that 'Wow, look at his *nur*, how it is increasing.' He started looking, this one started looking. So now, look, regarding this, I have written in the context of science that... you can take any language and see... I mean the language of India or wherever it may be. That with every one, there is a singular and there is a plural. Singular and plural. If there is one, it is called singular. If there are more, they become *jama'* (*jama'* means plural). The Arabic language is the one such language in which, after the singular, there is the dual... there is the two, which is *tathniyah*, in Arabic.

Then... no... then... and then from three it starts. Two is a separate thing. One is separate, there is two, then three. From three, the plural begins. So I reflected a great deal, I have written a treatise, a book on this. I had sent it to Sayyidna as well. If it ever comes to reading, I will tell you. So those three things are, that is, that the plural, it starts from three. In two, it is a separate thing. Here also, in the world. So with me, its answer is... I mean the reasoning is this, that there, Allah Ta'ala... one... one thought... He created. Then He... and it was made clear, and it began to... and from them, the brilliance, the light began to increase. So everyone should have seen it. But only two saw it. And these two... that's why the rank of two came. After one, in any language, it is not the case that three comes. Whatever counting you take out, be it French or German or Spanish or whatever. After one, two has to come. What... the sound is... Be quiet for a bit... A place is being made... A lot of place is being received. Yes, yes... The noise from outside is coming more... It is... This... exactly like this. Namaz is going on... Ji... Did everyone understand? Ji. Did everyone understand? Yes, everyone understood. So this is what happened. And after that... two thought that, "Hey, what is this matter? Why is the brilliance increasing in them?" You also thought, I also thought. Your thought is different, my thought is different. Meaning, there should be a difference. You thought that, "Hey, what is this matter? It seems... they haven't come wearing... it seems they are alive..." So that seeing is different, and this thinking that, "Hey, for what reason is their brilliance increasing?" One is looking at the cause. One was looking at the cause, one was looking at the effect. Looking at the outward appearance. "Hey, what kind of... mashallah, what... are you a `fakir`... you are a `farhana`..." Looking at the groom... Now, the inner matter is that, "Hey, the groom is capable, he is a graduate, he is this and that." Looking at that is correct. So one of them... looked at the inner matter. With us, the thing is that one looks at the outward (`zahir`), and one looks at the inward (`batin`). One looks at the body (`jism`), one looks at what is inside. Or you could understand it like one was looking at the cause, one was looking at the effect. One was looking at the `illat` (cause), one was looking at the `ma'lul` (effect). This reasoning's... concept... the logic of it is... So in that, it is that... the person who... who was understanding the inner matter, who was looking at the cause, he jo hai... took the second position. He... Now I... After me, there were these... who... `Aql-e-Awwal`. Their name... the first creation that there was, its name is `Aql-e-Awwal`. `Aql`... they say... Do you know the meaning of `aql`? The meaning of `aql` is... it is called 'tying' or 'binding'. And the word `aql` which has come out in Urdu is this: that in Arabia, the she-camel that there is, they tie it. So with a small... stake or something... with a peg, they tie it and then let it go. So it will go that far, it will take that much of a circle, the diameter... it cannot go further than that. So `aql` is that... limited it is. Our `aql` also has a limit... that is called `aql`. There, the `Aql-e-Awwal` that there was... he was the first... being of Allah. The first of the entire world, of the universe, he was created. We are nothing. There was only one being, `Aql-e-Awwal`. He... thought correctly. And from him, his brilliance increased. Now when the brilliance began to increase...

Two men. Between the two men, one's thought had *barakah* (blessing), and one's thought was lesser. So we call them: one is *Mabda'-e Awwal* (the First Originator), and one is *Mabda'-e Thani* (the Second Originator). *Mabda'*... two rising stars. *Mabda'* means those who rise. There were two who were rising. One thought, 'There is some inner matter because of them.' The one who thought this became their assistant. The second one, who was looking at the external (*zahir*) in front of him... now what happens is, the one who has reasoning, their thought remains elevated. The one who is looking at the external is thinking, 'Oh brother, what am I getting, what's the difference... [unclear] is old.' He remained stuck in this thought. As he remained so, the world that was there had crores (tens of millions) of individuals. It was a world of every devotee. Other individuals moved ahead. So we are told that seven *'aqls* (Intellects) came into being, one after the other. And they spoke of such a thing, that neither has Allah... neither have they created me, nor have I created them, but rather He created... This is called *Tawhid*. Meaning, to believe Allah is one. And the seven *'aqls* that came to be, with each *'aql* there was a large group. How many were there? I cannot say. Very large groups. So this... the first individual... person came to be, then the second came to be. Then seven. All together, they became nine. When they became nine, at that time the one who had become stagnant, who had been left behind, who was among those looking at what's in front... who was only looking at the appearance... he started to think, 'Oh, these six, seven have moved ahead of me, and I have been left behind. What is this matter?' Now, their chance was gone. It's like we are buying a ticket, we've brought a cinema ticket. 'Brother, just a moment, I'll go have some tea.' After he comes back, he can't even take that seat, he has to go to the back. Go again... so just like that, there were those nine *'aqls*. See, *'Aql-e Awwal* (the First Intellect), *'Aql-e Thani* (the Second Intellect), that's two. After that, seven. The nine *'aqls* that came to be, after that, from the ninth *'aql*... within that, a thousand hundred... men... so the thousandth man was asked, 'Brother, what is the matter? I was there, I have come this far.' So at that time, he was told, 'You were not looking at the reason, you were not looking at the cause, you were only looking at this... You were thinking 'I'.' And what happened at that time was that the two who rose... seeing one, two rose... they were thinking, the others who were left behind, 'I and he are equal. We both rose together.' And this one has moved ahead. Thinking this, he was speaking of the inner matter. In him, that 'I' became stagnant. So this delusion of... and the delusion of equality (*masawat*)... what is called equality... just by two people speaking, does every person not become appointed (*mansub*)? He says, 'Brother, we were both made at the same time, we were of such-and-such a time, it was like this... we were together... made together.' It doesn't happen. So now, that one... one of them, he said, 'Brother, what is the matter?' He said, 'The delusion you had, that I and you are equal, that was your mistake. And for this very reason, you were left behind.' 'So what should I do now?' He said, 'Ask for forgiveness.' This word 'forgiveness' that has come, that for everything, to say sorry or, you see... to do that, to feel remorse (*nadamat*). That... what, repentance. So at that time, he said, 'Okay, I was making a mistake.' To whom did he say it? To the last person of that thousand. Now his... that application of his, it was now forwarded. It went up and up, and it reached all the way there. This is what we call *itisalaat* (connections/communications). 'Brother, now you are explaining, how are you explaining this? In spite of... I am explaining on behalf of the *Da'i*. Explaining to the *Da'i*...

So the *silsila* (chain) is from above. A *darḵẖāst* (request) was made to the one above, and they were forgiven. As soon as they were forgiven, *tāba wa anāba* (he repented and turned back), as it is said in Arabic. They were forgiven, and at that very moment, they became the tenth number. This one is at the tenth number. They are called the *'Āshiq*. *'ashar*, *'ashara* refers to ten. These ten are a description of the *'ālam-i aṣl* (world of origin), that they have come. Now, after that, they said, "Well, I have become [this], so the big group that was with me, they should also accept [this]." Now, what happens? Where there is a party system, you must have seen in the BJP, someone accepts, someone doesn't. The leader accepted, but it is not necessary for everyone to accept. Those people, they said, "We don't accept. You made a mistake, and we suffered. Now, what's to say that you are right?" They said, one group, 20 percent. You 30 percent. You, the remaining 50 percent. They said, "Okay, I accept." "Who do I accept with?" "I accept along with them." This is called *tābū bi-tawbatihim*. They repented, and their companions also repented along with them. That, "Whatever he is saying is right, he is our elder." What did you do? *Labbaw al-nidā'*. After that, when they accepted, 70 percent still remained. So I said, "Look, I made a mistake. Now you all should also accept." So they accepted based on my speaking. What did these ones do? They accepted after seeing. *Tābū bi-tawbatihim*. And these ones said that, "You are giving the *da'wah* (call). The invitation you have given, you have explained in it what you are saying, that it was a mistake and you have accepted it." "We accept." So they are the number after that. Now, those who remained, they said, "We don't accept." There, the *da'wāt* (calls) that were happening, in that, the *tābū bi-tawbatihim*, they all, with their companions, went up. A large portion of *labbaw al-nidā'* also went up. Now, those who remained, they said, "We don't accept." *Lā nasmaʿ wa lā nuṭīʿ* (we will neither listen nor obey). "We will neither listen to your words nor obey your words." This... Hazrat... [unclear] says that it was as if a slogan was being raised there. Now, there was no sound there, nothing. This is a matter above space and time. But to explain it, this is the point, that they were raising slogans: "We don't accept, we don't accept. Explain it, what should we do?" At that time, Allah Ta'ala... now who is Allah Ta'ala? The *rūḥ-i mudabbir-i wāḥid* who created the spiritual world (*rūḥānī 'ālam*), He made it once and that's it, finished. Now after that, every person, the one person who is, the owner of that abundance of lights (*kaṣrat-i anwār*), he doesn't sit and operate all these things. He stays sitting at home. He appoints a General Manager. The General Manager also doesn't come to the office there. He is on tour, for purchasing, etc. He appoints his manager. The manager himself doesn't come either, but there are section in-charges. So every in-charge is given a charge in his place. Wherever this happened, that the... Janab... the *'Āshir* who are, they who are the tenth intellects (*daswī̃ 'āql*), because of them, all these were led astray. All of them made mistakes because of them. Now, to them, Allah Ta'ala said, "Look, because of you, this matter has happened. So many people..." These ones got out. They went up. Now it is your job to reform them. Now what? If you ask them, they don't give any answer, "What... [unclear]... we don't accept." When they don't accept, then the slogan... [unclear]...

Right. So at that time, it has come in the Qur'an-e-Sharif that they should be thrown down. From the spiritual realm (*ruhāni 'ālam*), they should be thrown down. The word *qubūt* has come. So, throw them. They were told to do so. When they were watching from above… Now look, if I say, “Go, get out of here.” So, a command was issued, but I didn't physically grab your hand and throw you out. When you didn't listen, I said, "Fine, go, do what you want." So I said, "Do it like this." So when the execution was about to happen, at that point they understood, "Oh my, this has become very serious." So in the true sense… So when they were going down, from the 50 percent that were there, one group emerged from it. Now see, I am coming to that. One group said, "Oh, we have made a mistake. Now we are being thrown from above." So when they were coming down from above, at that time… Now you see, there is rainwater, there are other things, all these substances come into existence. When they were coming down from above—this is from when the world was about to be created, I am telling you—as they were being thrown down, at that time they said, "We accept. We repent. We express remorse that we have made a mistake." So that one group, which was 10 percent… Besides them, 40 percent were left. From that 40 percent, 15 percent said… That is, from the 40 and 15, it's 25. So 25 percent were saying, "We still don't accept." So them, we call *haddāram*, meaning *musirr*. *Musirr* means stubborn. "We will not accept, we won't accept. Do whatever you want to do." So that 25 percent… I am just giving a percentage as an example, this wasn't the case. It was a very large group that did not accept. One group accepted, at that very moment they said, "We have made a mistake, we accept." When did this happen? When the matter of falling came up. And one group in the middle, which was 15 percent, they didn't understand whether this person is speaking the truth or that one is speaking the truth, this one is right or that one is right. In this very state, they were thrown down from above. When they were thrown, then Allah Ta'ala has a system, He has a plan, that those who accepted immediately… although they also had to come into the world, but they had to accept Allah truly. So they were placed in the entire realm of the fixed stars (*sābit 'ālam*), the glittering realm, stars, constellations (*kawākib*), planets. They were placed inside that. The *musirr-o-mustakbir* (the insistent and arrogant), who were not accepting at all, they were thrown below the earth. The sulfides, phosphates, gold mines that you see, all these things… all of this is… this all happened when it was being made, I'm talking about that time. So they all got mixed up, above and below, it all happened. That is their place. And then, you will learn about all the planets and you will find out that below the constellations (*kawākib*), the planets, there are four spheres: fire, water, air, soil. Do you understand? There is the sphere of *nār* (fire), fire's sphere, air's sphere, and water's sphere. In these spheres, those who were in doubt were placed. Which ones? "Is this right, or is this right? Is this right, or is this right?" They were left in that state. They were just thinking. So because of this—as a simple real-world example, look—when they were about to be thrown, and they were placed inside the spheres of fire and water, if you look at fire, even today it is in a state of doubt. Whenever you light a fire, it will keep flickering. The flames are not stable like this. It's doubt. The air, the cyclones that are moving, this is a sign of its doubt. Water, the roaring, is a sign of the same. Soil is the last, in which the dust form comes about. This is also a sign of the same. So all these things…

...it was thought that along with this, the 'alam (world) should be created. And Allah's tadbir (plan/governance) would be that now, each being should hand over [responsibility] to the one below it. So the 'aql al-'ashir (Tenth Intellect), which was the tenth intellect, it remained very high above. But the tadbir, that town planning, was its... meaning, the complete mudabbir al-'alam (governor of the world) is that itself. Now, through itself, it appointed an in-charge to big departments below. And it was that, now, how should the 'alam (world) be created? Because Allah Ta'ala had now entrusted it, saying, 'You correct all these who are, these 50% who are falling.' They have been corrupted because of you, now you correct them. When they come up and down, then this entire world that is running today, this mill that is running... it is all running because of this cleansing. Now, in this, there are musir (obstinate ones) and mustakbir (arrogant ones), there are organizers, we are there, they are there. We are living our lives. Many have passed on after making progress, and many are still remaining. So in this, that which... I told you that there is the realm of stars, there are kawakib (stars/heavenly bodies), there are planets. Those planets, how many are there? From Saturn to the Moon. They are called planets. Otherwise, there are many stars, in the numbers of hundreds of thousands. But the planets, they are seven. Above these planets is another planet. A little here and there... these planets are like this: this is the Moon, and above the Moon, which ones are there? Mercury. Above Mercury is Venus. On Venus, the Sun. Above the Sun is Mars. On Mars... on Mars is Jupiter. Above Jupiter is Saturn. Saturn is the last one. It is the uppermost, and the Moon is the lowermost. Above this is another heaven, which we call the Zodiac. This which is the burj (constellation), right? The Zodiac, this is the eighth heaven. It is the eighth from the bottom, and the second from the top. This realm of the Zodiac, this is called the realm of buruj. Buruj means... constellation... this is the realm of buruj. Even above this realm of buruj is such a heaven, which is called muhit (encompassing). Muhit means that which has covered all things entirely. Like an onion's... the peel that it has, it covers everything. Inside it is one, inside that is another, in this way they all go. So from top to bottom, there are nine kawakib. Now look, look at the wisdom in this, you have this... that these are nine planets, all together. Seven are kawakib, meaning planets. Then there is the sphere of buruj, and above it, the sphere of muhit. Now, here, in the world, birth must take place. So how will birth happen? When [things] are dropped from the realm of substance above. They came here, into the mineral (ma'dan), the vegetable (nabat), the animal (haywan), and the human (insan). These four are the... creations. Nothing can become a vegetable (nabat) until something is extracted from the mineral (ma'dan). It will draw soil, then the plant will grow forward. The plant, an animal will eat it, and the animal's body will grow. The animal, you will slaughter and eat it, and your body will grow. This is the mill of creation that is running. So through this, Allah Ta'ala has established a system that there is a good and an evil. That which is going from top to bottom, we will call that haram (forbidden), and that which is going from bottom to top, that is halal (permissible). Now I will tell you, I am coming to it quickly. That when it came down from above, came down... and began in the mineral, or in the vegetable... so now vegetable, mineral, animal, all began to be born. So how did they come to be? All these kawakib that exist, they were appointed as in-charge. Now I will not go into its details.

Who was given the first opportunity? That now you, carry out the *tadbir* over the entire world. So what would your *tadbir* be? You all know the *tadbir* of Saturn. That its temperament (*mizaj*) is this: to freeze something. To freeze. It is to freeze. So it was given 1,000 years over the world. For those 1,000 years, it worked itself, by its self. So at that time, over the world, over the entire world, ice spread. Then when the second 1,000 years occurred, it took Jupiter along with it. This one remained the king (*badshah*), this one remained the minister (*wazir*). The second one came with them. As soon as it came along, because Jupiter is a good star, you may know. So all the ice began to melt. Meaning, goodness was created in the world. The third was Mars. Mars and Saturn are both bad. So then badness was created. And over the entire world, mist spread. This is one thousand years each. Then the fourth one came, which is the Sun. The light of the Sun, you already know that. So then all the ice and mist that was there, wherever the Sun passed, all this dew and everything is finished. That, you see, happened. After that, Venus came, this one came. So 7,000 years passed. This story, Zuhal (Saturn) remained the *badshah*, and its own 1,000 years, and it took these six, and passed 7,000 years. After that, Allah Ta'ala gave them an opportunity as well. To whom? To Mushtari (Jupiter). It, its 7,000 years. Then 7,000 years. Then 7,000 years. In this way, 49,000 years passed over the world. When 49,000 passed, what happened at that time? That the world, in all things, was cultivated. Plants (*nabatat*) also began to be born. Now, we have a complete detail of all that, in which year what plant was created, when vegetables came, this happened, that happened. The whole world was cultivated, but the human (*insan*) had not yet been created. Who is the real purpose of the universe (*maqsad-e-kainat*). *Lawlaka lama khalaqtu l-aflak* (Were it not for you, I would not have created the celestial spheres). O Prophet, if your being were not there, I would not have created the world at all. So the *maqsad-e-kainat* is the being of the Prophet. And the Prophet is a human (*insan*). So the being of the human (*insan*) was yet to come. So when the whole world was adorned, meaning, first you build a house, you get a flat, so-and-so, so all that is adorned, now just the opening has to be done. The opening has to be done. So that will be the arrival of the human (*insan*). When the human comes, that... But for the creation of the human, look, now even science has accepted it. So the human (*insan*) is a part of the creations (*makhluqat*), meaning, it is higher than the animals (*haywanat*). In a plant (*nabat*), there is a special power, the power of growth (*quwwat-e-numu*), growth. But it cannot walk. Animals (*haywanat*) can move around, they have cleverness. Cleverness, activity. But they cannot speak. They go 'hoo hoo,' like that, they make sounds but they cannot speak. There is a branch of the *haywanat* that is called human (*insan*). The philosophers say that there is a branch of the *haywanat* that is... and that is the human (*insan*). So the creation of the human (*insan*) was yet to happen. So in the world, wherever the most evil animals were finished. Look, this is very deep, what I am telling you, you won't even find it in that theory there. That when the best of the animals, they were called *haywanat-e-mahmudah* (the praiseworthy animals). Because now, a human cannot be born from a human, as is happening today. The mother and father got married and the children, a child was born. That did not exist. There was no mother, no father. So how would a human be born, how would it be? So the extract of the *haywanat* had to be drawn out. So the special *haywanat*, when they died their natural death (*taba'i maut*), because there was no one to hunt, no one to shoot, nothing at all. When they died their own death, at that time, their...

Those are vapors, in such a way in the world, it moved forward. Allah Ta'ala's plan was that in the world... Okay, did you understand? Did it come? No, no. [unclear] Muhammad, huh? Is it coming while writing? No no, it's coming perfectly. ...one... one more addition of detail in it. So that it becomes a bit conscious. So if... it is in this way, then Allah Ta'ala's plan was that when humans were to be created... and in the future, however many humans are born, it is from the mother... from the mother and father. And the mother has a rahm (womb), the father has a nutfah (drop). In that same way it happened... in the world. So here these two humans... how many humans are these? There is neither a mother, nor a father. So in the world, just like today... 'craters'... those are pits, aren't they? What they call them. In that way, at specific places in the world, such pits were formed. Look, for instance... The mother's rahm also, if you... ponder on it, the mother's rahm is just like this. It is like this. These pits were formed. Where did they happen? They happened in various places. Now, what we are saying is, where were the best pits formed? They were formed only in the Ka'batullah. In the Haram or in Makkah. So the best area in the world is the area of Makkah. They also happened there. When am I talking about? When the world was starting to... be formed. The world had not been formed yet. These 'craters' were formed. Now after that, these... vapors rose. The vapors fell here. They fell. The earth was hot. It started to boil it. After boiling, it rose. So where it boils from hot water, vapors rise again. The vapors went and hit here. Its roof. This crater. The roof was cold. From there, it again became water and went down. Then it became hot. Then it went up. Then it went down. Then it went up. Then it went down. Now this water, which we are calling vapors, this was water. This water, if you... really look at it in a 'kettle', when you repeatedly do it, an oiliness will start in it. An oiliness starts. Stick... a sticky-like substance... starts to form. So in the same way, just like today a man's 'semen' is. It's exactly that same process. This began to be produced here. Now, going up and down, up and down, it finally happened here. Inside the earth, those substances which... for a woman to be formed... the substance of a woman's rahm... that also has a water. And the man also has a water. A human is born only when both waters mix. So that which is from down here... and this falling from above... above, the man's remains above... and this which... this was formed, in it, humanity started to be born. And the human, every pit that was there, we call it a 'gudda' [doll/effigy], we call it a 'gudda'. And its shape remains like this. In this, one... one man was born. In this way, 28 pits were created in one... one... area. That was in Makkah. The second in Madinah, the third happened there in Baitul Muqaddas, Jerusalem. There are 17 there. Where they are by Allah Ta'ala, which place it is, what kind of system that is. But what I am now describing first of all, that first one, which was the highest and most noble, was in Makkah. And how many pits were formed? Only 28. 28 here, 28 there, 28 there... Many were formed. But what were formed in one place were 28. These 28, that is, the man's nutfah, the man's and woman's combined... that is, the women's, meaning with the help of the substance of clay, that combined, one human was born. When it was born, one year... passed for it. In a year's time...

...that the child is held, and he is looked after, and this is done and that is done. Now, there is no mother, no father. What will happen to the patient? So how will it be? It kept happening, kept happening, such a time passed that in our records, a child remained standing for a year... or rather, he remained standing for ten years. Again, the ground became hot. And then from here it rose up... vapors... then it came here. Then here... then up, then down. It formed again. So now, this remaining water was a bit weak. The first part that comes out... one part of it comes out well. That... what is it called... The first juice. The extract. Yes, the extract comes out. Now this was weak water. The creation that was born from that weak water were all women. How many were there? Opposite the twenty-eight, twenty-eight were created. From one pit, one such fetus that was made, from it, one male was born and with him, one female was born. From a single womb. They could not marry each other. Just as today, the children of one mother, who are brother and sister, cannot marry. It was like that. Now these people had... not only the hunger for food and drink, but also the hunger for sex. So what was to be done? They had learned to walk around. They went from here to there. There were twenty-eight pits there. They saw the women from there. The men from there saw the women from here. So you see, an interchange happened. And in this way, in the world, this... the human race spread. And as soon as it spread, this... the one I'm telling you about, the twenty-eight pits that were the most severe, in it was one individual who was the tallest. Tallest means that in the creation of this world, he was the man to be counted as the very first man. He is called Shakl al-Kull. And he was so tall that when he came here and touched it, he flew upwards. He was that... I will explain later how tall he was. Now the lineage that began, from that lineage... that is... the one who was such a tall man, with him were the people who were... they would all be people of a high caliber.

...the people who were with him, who lived with him, were big people. So we have... from the Imams also, that... [unclear] is not possible. Those people's birth... and the lineage moved forward. So what happened now? Here, where the Imamah was going on, the Imams came one after another. Today, the one who is the Imam at this time, with him it is necessary to have twelve Dai, and twelve Dai are in the world. These twelve Dai who are in the world, they are of a lesser rank. Their rank is less. And the one with the Imam is higher. Twelve and twelve. Together they make twenty-four. That which we... on Laylat al-Qadr or in Ramadan Sharif, when we pray twenty-four rak'at, we pray in the name of these twenty-four. Those who are the most behind... this is twenty-four. And in that, when we further divide it into twelve-twelve, that the Salat al-Layl prayer... you should pray it. The Salat al-Layl prayer has twelve [rak'at]. The Tahajjud prayer has twelve [rak'at]. And there too, with the Imam, there is one Mansus. Who is called a Ma'dhun. One is a Da'i. Two. One Bab al-Abwab. Three. Twenty-four and three... twenty-seven. And the Imam himself... twenty-eight. This pattern of twenty-eight should always be in effect. It should be there with every Imam. And what is its reasoning? That where the first creation took place, there were twenty-eight. Meaning, behind this, in the background, there should be some solid reason. And the reason is that when the first creation happened, there were twenty-eight. So when for the first time the world was created... it was in Makkah, and after that, it was in Jerusalem, it was in Madinah, it was at Jabal al-Rahmah, it was in Jannat al-Baqi'—all these are places. So now, this series that started... so that is called the beginning of a *Kaur*. This is something to be understood. This *Kaur*, which we call sixteen thousand crore years... where scientific verses have come, there it has been said that every child that is born is born from the union of a mother and father. But there is also a kind of creation... "Hey, you people don't know that We made you grow like a plant (*nabat*)?" So how, like a plant? There was water, and from the water, just as a plant (*nabat*) grows, in the same way, He made it grow. So one creation is that which does not happen always. This era that there is... if it has been four lakh years, if man has come into being... it is from the womb of the mother and father. In the future, too. But when sixteen thousand crore years are completed, then the whole world will end, and then the creation will happen in that way. This is called the creation of a *Kaur*. So remember this. From one *Kaur*, the second begins. Now what is a *Kaur*? That is...

...passing of a `mawr`. The birth of a `mawr` is a very big matter. The `mawr` is the biggest duration, within it is a `tawr`, and within the `tawr` is [unclear]. Now, the state we are in, it will now come to your understanding that the state we are in... You were saying, "you were going to tell us how much time has passed, so can you tell us?" I said, now the opportunity to tell has come. I could have told then, but I am telling now. And it is this: that since the world was created, that is, through the planets etc., the world that we have seen from the top of the `takht`, from that time, one `mawr` has passed. Now, one `mawr`, Mawli Sahab, I said it so easily. Now if you write it, you will have to put 25 zeros after it. One `mawr`. Mawlana Zainul Abidin said, who was the Imam, he said that, "Look..." his name was Umm-i Nida... "one `mawr` has already passed. From the second `mawr`, 399 `tawr`s have passed. 399 `tawr`s. And how many are remaining? Four lakh `tawr`s. Out of four lakh, 399 have passed. 399 `tawr`s have passed. The 400th `tawr`, when it was beginning, its beginning happens from what? How does the beginning happen? The beginning of a `dawr`... it happens from the `dass`. The `dass` begins, in other words, from the day. Then night came. Then day, then night, then day, then night. `Dass` by `dass`, `dass` by `dass`. So, one `mawr` has passed. 399 `tawr`s have passed. The 400th `tawr`, the first `dawr`... when the 400th `tawr` began, a `dawr` begins within it. That is, a week begins. Within the week, then there is day and night. So the Day, approximately seven have passed. The seventh night is ongoing. Did you understand? That is, when Adam Alaihis Salam was there, 7,000 years ago, that was the tenth `alam` which was ending, then this `dawr` began. So the seventh night is still ongoing. And when will the seventh night end? When the Qaim Alaihis Salam comes. When the Qaim Alaihis Salam comes, then the seventh night will end, and the `dawr` itself will change. And the... that is, the `tawr` will also be completed, and the `kashf` will happen. The `kashf` of what? Of the second `dawr`. Now these seven `kashf` and seven... seven days and seven nights will be complete. So for the four lakh years to be completed, only a few years remain. And after that, then that era will begin, which is a completely peaceful era. All these disturbances we are seeing, the tension, pollution, this and that, no such thing will remain. It will be a completely clear and pure environment. And regarding this, there are details in the books, that within the `dass`, what will what be like. And for how long will it remain? 50,000 years. It's not just two or four years. For 50,000 years, man will have only comfort and relief. After that, this world of trial and tribulation will come again. And why will it come? Because the clashes you have amongst yourselves, the clashes amongst yourselves... you, say, troubled your brother a lot. You will have to give retribution for that. Or if someone else has troubled you, he will have to... his retribution will be given. Because Allah's `adl` is certainly established. No one can escape. If someone has caused pain to your eye, his eye will go. If to your ear, then his ear will go. `al-uzunu bil-uzuni wal-nafsa bil-nafsi wal-'ayna bil-'ayni` (the ear for the ear, and the soul for the soul, and the eye for the eye). An eye for an eye... for everything, there is... no `qisas` can be escaped. And it is to repay that very thing that we have come here into the world. Whatever you are doing is all your own accounting. You and I are going through it. We are going. We are going through something, aren't we?

one should get food. What are you doing? This is my food. This thing is, really, from what? From a stone. So how is it food from a stone? What about animals... what is it that their necks are hung... Neither have they been given intellect, nor anything else. We are hitting them, we are doing everything. That not everyone is a creator of humanity. But we have some of our own vices, due to which we are put into punishments. And these punishments are for one who has strayed from the *din* (religion). The *din*, our correct *din*... of *mabda wa ma'ad* (the beginning and the return). They say *mabda wa ma'ad*; *mabda* means the beginning. *Ma'ad* means the end. So I, the discourse on *mabda*, our book has been completed... Allah. And later, we will see the other. how the world was created, what happened. Now in this, the system of *shari'at* (Islamic law) ran. And you all know the system of *shari'at*: fasting, prayer, etc., which the *payghambar* (prophet) told, or the *nabi* (prophet) told. While doing all this, there are also some who are doing it. How many thousands are there who are Muslims. Will you consider them to be correct? For explaining, everyone will explain, but you are not someone who passes judgment. Whatever is to be done, Allah does it. So who is correct, who? So what we have is that we who take the *'ahd* (covenant), meaning we take the *'ahd* on the hand of the *Imam al-Zaman*. The one who takes the *'ahd*, is a *mustajib*, or is a *mumin*, he is the one who is right and perfect. All the rest, whether they are Christian, Hindu, or let's say Jewish, they are all upon untruth in our view. And they will be punished. And it is not that, hey, he is a Jew, how would he know that this is the correct religion, or that he would come to it. This is not our job. It is the job of the One above, that He... Many people, like now you came, your example is right in front. Now you, your parents or any of your [family] did not know who would come into this correct [path]. But you received *tawfiq* (divine grace) from Allah, or you got the environment, or you got some means, you are here. And this very thing is what we recite in the *Ayat al-Kursi*, that *min al-zulumati ila al-nur* (from the darknesses into the light). To come from darkness towards light, or to leave light and go towards darkness. From among us there are many boys, many people, who have strayed and gone out. And there are also some like that... So it is not in our hands. To give *hidayat* (guidance) is the work of the One above. We can only explain. We cannot change anyone's *qalb* (heart). That changing, if Allah Ta'ala gave *tawfiq*, as it was explained to you, 'Okay, brother, I have understood one thing'. So now the matter is that someone is coming, someone is going. So now this part of ours, of a *mumin*, how will it be tested? That in the future, his progress, what is its name? That we have a *ruh* (spirit) and also a *jism* (body). These two things, we are carrying around in a combination. So in the end, we will pass away, what is our clinical death. Clinical death is when our breath stops, or the heartbeat stops, it is finished. So now will we progress, or not? So you yourself will become great, the *'ahd*... was given, the *'ahd* is given. You are the one to take it.

So first, the matter will be asked. So if you listen carefully... So the first thing that will be asked about is namaz. And then from there, it is said that if namaz is there, then zakat will also be asked about, roza will also be asked about, and hajj will also be asked about. This is of the mumin. And the mumin will make taraqqi. So the channels of a mumin's taraqqi are what you will see in the CD. If I have time, I will tell you, because then you will not find it difficult. This is called ma'ad. So ma'ad is the final outcome. This is the second part. The second part is divided into two parts. One is ours, that we who are mumin, so we are sure, we are confident that we have to ascend. Meaning, to go up and not go down. That we will make a lot of progress. So in what way will you make progress? Your jism has to make progress, and your ruh also has to make progress. So the ruh, is it one or two or three? Now you ask any Muslim, he will say there is only one ruh. There is one ruh. Soul and this jism. We have... We have three types of arwah. The nufus are three. So the first nafs is created, you can ask a doctor, that at the moment the nutfa is confirmed, that you and your wife have met, and from that a child is going to be born... So what happens is that a special thing from you comes here. This spinal column. What we call semen, that piece, meaning that substance, the liquid, that comes from you. So with us, the name given to it is sulala. The name sulala is given. In Arabic it is sulala. That is, a gist of the thing has come from you. Now that gist, when it goes into the mother's womb, meaning the woman's, the wife's, then it changes its form. Because she also has a type of fluid. When these two mix, then it is called confirming the nutfa. That okay, your wife is pregnant, and a child is going to be born in the future. So the fluid of both the mother and the father mixes. And the father's is dominant. In that... the details of that are many. We also have it, how many... what percentage this should be and what percentage that should be. That is also a science, there is a lot in it. Anyway, so this is, from the sulala the nutfa was formed. Now you say, "Oh, this person's character is not good." So what has happened? The nutfa has become spoiled. Because the parents were like this, so the child turned out like that. Nutfa. So when is it a nutfa? When the thing, the liquid, from the father is transferred to the mother, then the nutfa is formed. One month passed. The second month came. When the second month came, its name changed. The third is what? 'Alaqa. After the nutfa. The fourth is mudgha. These are all Arabic terms. Mudgha. After that is 'izam. After that is lahm. After that is khalq-i-akhar. These seven that are there... seven stages. The first one is, what we say is, that Saturn's influence falls on it, it has an effect. And I have already told you that Saturn's task is to freeze things. So if it had not frozen the father's fluid and the mother's fluid, then the nutfa would not have been confirmed. The fluid would just keep flowing out. So solidifying it, the act of freezing, happens through Saturn. This is the first month. The second month is good, in that the beginning takes place. The third came, it got even better. The fourth came, the fifth... So each one has been given a name. And the fourth month is when, you can ask a doctor, in the fourth month, we have been told that in the body, in the mother's womb, movement begins, the child starts to move.

In the fifth month, its skeleton is fully prepared. All the skeleton that is there is in the fifth month. These are bones. And in the sixth month, this skin and flesh are placed upon it. Before birth. In the seventh month, it becomes completely perfected. If it comes out then, it will live. It will remain alive. But, generally what happens? The ninth month comes. So now, what is its arrangement? That for seven months, Saturn... first was [unclear], its... second was that, its... third was... in the fourth month, it was the sun's. The sun is powerful, so it started moving. The fifth is Venus, the sixth is Mercury, and after that... the seventh month is the moon's, which is good. If it is born in the seventh month, it can remain alive. Now, instead of that, what happens? The eighth month passes. At that time, even the doctor will say to just rest a bit. They will tell the woman to rest a bit. Why? Because this month, the eighth month, is a bit dangerous. Why is it dangerous? Because when the child was nothing, it was necessary to freeze it. In the first month. Now, after the seventh month, the eighth month again went back to that... it went to Saturn. And that Saturn, if it freezes it again, the child will be born dead. So at that time, one must be careful. Right? At that time, be careful. And in the ninth month, which is Jupiter's, Jupiter is the best star, so at that time the child comes out. So how is it? That seven are these, and two stars are above. Meaning, the count of nine is complete. But their arrangement happens... first *zuhal*'s... *zuhal*'s happens, then *mushtarī*'s happens, and it is born. So now these, at the time when the water of the mother and father mixes, when the drop comes, at that time a power is created within it. That it has been confirmed that this will happen. And after that, as you... have been told, and in science too, in a lecture given by some doctor... that the germs that are there, of life, they shoot up. They shoot up and go forward. So, many germs are there. But there is only one that is useful; the rest all fall away. They fall. Isn't that right, brother? Yes, sir. One remains. This *'alaqa*, which is... now see how much knowledge we have in accordance with science. Science also... *'alaqa*, they say, is something that hangs. A hanger is called *'alaqa*, the hanger on which we put clothes. So what happens is that the germs that shoot upwards, one of them gets stuck. And from that one, the child is formed. The child is formed from that one. Now, the question is that these seven that you have counted, so its background is that the first month, second month, third month, all these... Saturn and so on is going on. The planets that we have, against them there are seven *anbiyā'*. Adam, Nuh, Ibrahim... The first is upon Adam, the second upon Nuh, the third... The third, which is... the *'alaqa*... that is Sayyidna Ibrahim. The third, they say, is a great *nabī*. Then there is Musa, then 'Isa. So, the fifth, which is... the skeleton in which they are placed... that is... acts upon Sayyidna Musa. That the entire world's *sharī'at*, where it started from Adam, that *sharī'at*... which one? The *dīn* of Allah. Happening and happening, in the time of 'Isa, this entire skeleton was completed. When the time of the Prophet came, at that time, *fa kasawna l-‘iẓama lahma* (and We clothed the bones with flesh). We placed flesh upon the bone. Meaning...

The *payghambar*'s *sharī'ah*, the Muḥammadī [one], that is... the whole child has been prepared from the beginning. We have blessed it and made it ready. Now what is the delay for? For coming out. Who will come? Janāb-e-Ḥadd. They will come, they will blow the *rūḥ* (spirit), so that the child may remain alive. And it will come out. This is our *nizām* (system). So this first *quwwat* (power), at the time the *nuṭfah* (sperm-drop) was formed, there was a *quwwat* of the spirits that, hey, it's like a small piece, from this, how does it become so big when it's in the mother's womb. That is such a person who has the power to produce a human being like himself. Where that happens, at that very moment, a *ḥadd* should be given to him. Meaning now... so what does it mean to give a *ḥadd*? It is the matter of receiving the third *nafs*. Two *nafs* it has. This third *nafs*, the higher *nafs*, which we have... three *nafs*... what we are doing is that one, we grew from small to big. Everyone knows that we grew from small to big. These three births occurred. So now, the end (*anjām*) of these three should also be separate. And that is, when our *intiqāl* (passing away) occurs, then these parts of our *jism* (body), they are put into the *qabr* (grave). to go to them. So what happens is that? So that is the master, the real world. And then greater than them is the Imam. It reaches up to the Imam.
